BS.label: Assets
BS.description: Amount of asset recognized for present right to economic benefit.

BS.label: Assets, Current
BS.description: Amount of asset recognized for present right to economic benefit, classified as current.

BS.label: Liabilities and Equity
BS.description: Amount of liabilities and equity items, including the portion of equity attributable to noncontrolling interests, if any.

BS.label: Cash and Cash Equivalents, at Carrying Value
BS.description: Amount of cash and cash equivalent. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

BS.label: Liabilities, Current
BS.description: Total obligations incurred as part of normal operations that are expected to be paid during the following twelve months or within one business cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Retained Earnings (Accumulated Deficit)
BS.description: Amount of accumulated undistributed earnings (deficit).

BS.label: Stockholders' Equity Attributable to Parent
BS.description: Amount of equity (deficit) attributable to parent. Excludes temporary equity and equity attributable to noncontrolling interest.

BS.label: Cash, Cash Equivalents, Restricted Cash and Restricted Cash Equivalents
BS.description: Amount of cash and cash equivalent, and cash and cash equivalent restricted to withdrawal or usage; attributable to continuing operation. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

BS.label: Common Stock, Shares, Issued
BS.description: Total number of common shares of an entity that have been sold or granted to shareholders (includes common shares that were issued, repurchased and remain in the treasury). These shares represent capital invested by the firm's shareholders and owners, and may be all or only a portion of the number of shares authorized. Shares issued include shares outstanding and shares held in the treasury.

BS.label: Common Stock, Value, Issued
BS.description: Aggregate par or stated value of issued nonredeemable common stock (or common stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer). This item includes treasury stock repurchased by the entity. Note: elements for number of nonredeemable common shares, par value and other disclosure concepts are in another section within stockholders' equity.

BS.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Net
BS.description: Amount, after accumulated depreciation, depletion, and amortization, of property, plant, and equipment. Includes, but is not limited to, land and land improvement; building; machinery and equipment; furniture and fixture; and work of art, historical treasure, or similar asset classified as collection.

BS.label: Operating Lease, Right-of-Use Asset
BS.description: Amount of lessee's right to use underlying asset under operating lease.

BS.label: Accounts Payable, Current
BS.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of liabilities incurred (and for which invoices have typically been received) and payable to vendors for goods and services received that are used in an entity's business. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

BS.label: Accounts Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
BS.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration from customer for product sold and service rendered in normal course of business, classified as current.

BS.label: Common Stock, Shares Authorized
BS.description: The maximum number of common shares permitted to be issued by an entity's charter and bylaws.

BS.label: Other Assets, Noncurrent
BS.description: Amount of noncurrent assets classified as other.

BS.label: Accumulated Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization, Property, Plant, and Equipment
BS.description: Amount of accumulated depreciation, depletion, and amortization of property, plant, and equipment. Includes, but is not limited to, land and land improvement; building; machinery and equipment; furniture and fixture; and work of art, historical treasure, or similar asset classified as collection.

BS.label: Common Stock, Shares, Outstanding
BS.description: Number of shares of common stock outstanding. Common stock represent the ownership interest in a corporation.

BS.label: Other Liabilities, Noncurrent
BS.description: Amount of liabilities classified as other, due after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax
BS.description: Amount, after tax, of accumulated increase (decrease) in equity from transaction and other event and circumstance from nonowner source.

BS.label: Liabilities
BS.description: Amount of liability recognized for present obligation requiring transfer or otherwise providing economic benefit to others.

BS.label: Long-term Debt, Excluding Current Maturities
BS.description: Amount, after deduction of unamortized premium (discount) and debt issuance cost, of long-term debt classified as noncurrent. Excludes lease obligation.

BS.label: Operating Lease, Liability, Current
BS.description: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease, classified as current.

BS.label: Operating Lease, Liability, Noncurrent
BS.description: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease, classified as noncurrent.

BS.label: Other Assets, Current
BS.description: Amount of current assets classified as other.

BS.label: Accounts Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
BS.description: Amount of allowance for credit loss on accounts receivable, classified as current.

BS.label: Long-term Debt, Current Maturities
BS.description: Amount, after deduction of unamortized premium (discount) and debt issuance cost, of long-term debt classified as current. Excludes lease obligation.

BS.label: Other Liabilities, Current
BS.description: Amount of liabilities classified as other, due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Deferred Income Tax Liabilities, Net
BS.description: Amount, after deferred tax asset, of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable differences with jurisdictional netting.

BS.label: Common Stock, Par or Stated Value Per Share
BS.description: Face amount or stated value per share of common stock.

BS.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Gross
BS.description: Amount, before accumulated depreciation, depletion, and amortization, of property, plant, and equipment. Includes, but is not limited to, land and land improvement; building; machinery and equipment; furniture and fixture; and work of art, historical treasure, or similar asset classified as collection.

BS.label: Stockholders' Equity, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
BS.description: Amount of equity (deficit) attributable to parent and noncontrolling interest. Excludes temporary equity.

BS.label: Short-term Debt
BS.description: Reflects the total carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of debt having initial terms less than one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Long-term Debt
BS.description: Amount, after deduction of unamortized premium (discount) and debt issuance cost, of long-term debt. Excludes lease obligation.

BS.label: Additional Paid in Capital
BS.description: Amount of excess of issue price over par or stated value of stock and from other transaction involving stock or stockholder. Includes, but is not limited to, additional paid-in capital (APIC) for common and preferred stock.

BS.label: Goodwill
BS.description: Amount, after accumulated impairment loss, of asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

BS.label: Interest Payable, Current
BS.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of [accrued] interest payable on all forms of debt, including trade payables, that has been incurred and is unpaid. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

BS.label: Derivative Liability, Current
BS.description: Fair value, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset, expected to be settled within one year or normal operating cycle, if longer. Includes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

BS.label: Stockholders' Equity Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
BS.description: Amount of equity (deficit) attributable to noncontrolling interest. Excludes temporary equity.

BS.label: Preferred Stock, Shares Authorized
BS.description: The maximum number of nonredeemable preferred shares (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer) permitted to be issued by an entity's charter and bylaws.

BS.label: Preferred Stock, Shares Outstanding
BS.description: Aggregate share number for all nonredeemable preferred stock (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer) held by stockholders. Does not include preferred shares that have been repurchased.

BS.label: Equity Method Investments
BS.description: This item represents the carrying amount on the entity's balance sheet of its investment in common stock of an equity method investee. This is not an indicator of the fair value of the investment, rather it is the initial cost adjusted for the entity's share of earnings and losses of the investee, adjusted for any distributions (dividends) and other than temporary impairment (OTTI) losses recognized.

BS.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Accumulated Amortization
BS.description: Amount of accumulated amortization of finite-lived intangible asset. Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

BS.label: Prepaid Expense, Current
BS.description: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for costs that provide economic benefits within a future period of one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Regulatory Assets, Noncurrent
BS.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of capitalized costs of regulated entities that are not expected to be recovered through revenue sources within one year or the normal operating cycle if longer.

BS.label: Asset Retirement Obligations, Noncurrent
BS.description: Noncurrent portion of the carrying amount of a liability for an asset retirement obligation. An asset retirement obligation is a legal obligation associated with the disposal or retirement of a tangible long-lived asset that results from the acquisition, construction or development, or the normal operations of a long-lived asset, except for certain obligations of lessees.

BS.label: Derivative Liability, Noncurrent
BS.description: Fair value, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset, expected to be settled after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer. Includes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

BS.label: Regulatory Liability, Noncurrent
BS.description: The amount for the individual regulatory noncurrent liability as itemized in a table of regulatory noncurrent liabilities as of the end of the period.

BS.label: Intangible Assets, Net (Excluding Goodwill)
BS.description: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of finite- and indefinite-lived intangible assets and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed. Excludes goodwill.

BS.label: Liabilities, Noncurrent
BS.description: Amount of obligation due after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Restricted Cash and Cash Equivalents, Current
BS.description: Amount of cash and cash equivalent restricted as to withdrawal or usage, classified as current. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

BS.label: Construction in Progress, Gross
BS.description: Amount of structure or a modification to a structure under construction. Includes recently completed structures or modifications to structures that have not been placed into service.

BS.label: Inventory, Net
BS.description: Amount after valuation and LIFO reserves of inventory expected to be sold, or consumed within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Preferred Stock, Shares Issued
BS.description: Number of shares issued for nonredeemable preferred shares and preferred shares redeemable solely at option of issuer. Includes, but is not limited to, preferred shares issued, repurchased, and held as treasury shares. Excludes preferred shares classified as debt.

BS.label: Regulatory Assets, Current
BS.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of capitalized costs of regulated entities that are expected to be recovered through revenue sources within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer. Such costs are capitalized if they meet both of the following criteria: a. It is probable that future revenue in an amount at least equal to the capitalized cost will result from inclusion of that cost in allowable costs for rate-making purposes. b. Based on available evidence, the future revenue will be provided to permit recovery of the previously incurred cost rather than to provide for expected levels of similar future costs. If the revenue will be provided through an automatic rate-adjustment clause, this criterion requires that the regulator's intent clearly be to permit recovery of the previously incurred cost.

BS.label: Regulatory Liability, Current
BS.description: The amount for the individual regulatory current liability as itemized in a table of regulatory current liabilities as of the end of the period.

BS.label: Finance Lease, Liability
BS.description: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from finance lease.

BS.label: Liability, Defined Benefit Plan, Noncurrent
BS.description: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for defined benefit pension and other postretirement plans, classified as noncurrent.

BS.label: Additional Paid in Capital, Common Stock
BS.description: Value received from shareholders in common stock-related transactions that are in excess of par value or stated value and amounts received from other stock-related transactions. Includes only common stock transactions (excludes preferred stock transactions). May be called contributed capital, capital in excess of par, capital surplus, or paid-in capital.

BS.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Assets, Current
BS.description: Amount classified as assets attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Derivative Asset, Current
BS.description: Fair value, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset, expected to be settled within one year or normal operating cycle, if longer. Includes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

BS.label: Derivative Asset, Noncurrent
BS.description: Fair value, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset, expected to be settled after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer. Includes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

BS.label: Finance Lease, Right-of-Use Asset, after Accumulated Amortization
BS.description: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of right-of-use asset from finance lease.

BS.label: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Net
BS.description: Period end amount of total net PPE.

BS.label: Assets, Noncurrent
BS.description: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all assets that are expected to be realized in cash, sold or consumed after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Income Taxes Receivable, Current
BS.description: Carrying amount due within one year of the balance sheet date (or one operating cycle, if longer) from tax authorities as of the balance sheet date representing refunds of overpayments or recoveries based on agreed-upon resolutions of disputes.

BS.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Liabilities, Current
BS.description: Amount classified as liabilities attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Prepaid Expense and Other Assets, Current
BS.description: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for costs that provide economic benefits in future periods, and amount of other assets that are expected to be realized or consumed within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Exercises in Period
BS.description: Number of share options (or share units) exercised during the current period.

BS.label: Accrued Liabilities, Current
BS.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable, pertaining to costs that are statutory in nature, are incurred on contractual obligations, or accumulate over time and for which invoices have not yet been received or will not be rendered. Examples include taxes, interest, rent and utilities. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

BS.label: Finance Lease, Liability, Current
BS.description: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from finance lease, classified as current.

BS.label: Finance Lease, Liability, Noncurrent
BS.description: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from finance lease, classified as noncurrent.

BS.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Net
BS.description: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of finite-lived intangible asset. Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

BS.label: Long-term Investments
BS.description: The total amount of investments that are intended to be held for an extended period of time (longer than one operating cycle).

BS.label: Preferred Stock, Par or Stated Value Per Share
BS.description: Face amount or stated value per share of preferred stock nonredeemable or redeemable solely at the option of the issuer.

BS.label: Preferred Stock, Value, Issued
BS.description: Aggregate par or stated value of issued nonredeemable preferred stock (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer). This item includes treasury stock repurchased by the entity. Note: elements for number of nonredeemable preferred shares, par value and other disclosure concepts are in another section within stockholders' equity.

BS.label: Accounts Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss
BS.description: Amount of allowance for credit loss on accounts receivable.

BS.label: Cash
BS.description: Amount of currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions. Includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits. Excludes cash and cash equivalents within disposal group and discontinued operation.

BS.label: Derivative, Collateral, Right to Reclaim Cash
BS.description: Amount of right to receive cash collateral under master netting arrangements that have not been offset against derivative liabilities.

BS.label: Accrued Income Taxes, Current
BS.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the unpaid sum of the known and estimated amounts payable to satisfy all currently due domestic and foreign income tax obligations.

BS.label: Taxes Payable, Current
BS.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable for statutory income, sales, use, payroll, excise, real, property and other taxes. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

BS.label: Derivative, Collateral, Obligation to Return Cash
BS.description: Amount of obligation to return cash collateral under master netting arrangements that have not been offset against derivative assets.

BS.label: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Plant in Service
BS.description: Period end amount of total gross PPE.

BS.label: Treasury Stock, Common, Shares
BS.description: Number of previously issued common shares repurchased by the issuing entity and held in treasury.

BS.label: Unbilled Receivables, Current
BS.description: Amount received for services rendered and products shipped, but not yet billed, for non-contractual agreements due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Accumulated Deferred Investment Tax Credit
BS.description: The noncurrent portion of the reserve for accumulated deferred investment tax credits as of the balance sheet date. This is the remaining investment credit, which will reduce the cost of services collected from ratepayers by a ratable portion over the investment's regulatory life.

BS.label: Other Long-term Investments
BS.description: Amount of long-term investments classified as other.

BS.label: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Accumulated Depreciation
BS.description: Period end book value of accumulated depreciation on property, plant and equipment (PPE) that is owned by the regulated operations of the public utility.

BS.label: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Construction Work in Progress
BS.description: Period end amount of construction work in progress in public utility.

BS.label: Accounts Receivable, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
BS.description: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration from customer for product sold and service rendered in normal course of business, classified as current.

BS.label: Contract with Customer, Liability, Current
BS.description: Amount of obligation to transfer good or service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable, classified as current.

BS.label: Decommissioning Fund Investments, Fair Value
BS.description: The fair value of investments held in a trust fund to pay for the costs of decontaminating and decommissioning facilities, whether such amount is presented as a separate caption or as a parenthetical disclosure on the balance sheet. Additionally, this element may be used in connection with the fair value disclosures required in the footnote disclosures to the financial statements.

BS.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Liabilities, Noncurrent
BS.description: Amount classified as liabilities attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of beyond one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Other Receivables, Net, Current
BS.description: Amount, after allowance, of receivables classified as other, due within one year or the operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest, Equity, Carrying Amount
BS.description: As of the reporting date, the aggregate carrying amount of all noncontrolling interests which are redeemable by the (parent) entity (1) at a fixed or determinable price on a fixed or determinable date, (2) at the option of the holder of the noncontrolling interest, or (3) upon occurrence of an event that is not solely within the control of the (parent) entity. This item includes noncontrolling interest holder's ownership (or holders' ownership) regardless of the type of equity interest (common, preferred, other) including all potential organizational (legal) forms of the investee entity.

BS.label: Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities, Current
BS.description: Sum of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and due within one year (or the operating cycle, if longer), including liabilities incurred (and for which invoices have typically been received) and payable to vendors for goods and services received, taxes, interest, rent and utilities, accrued salaries and bonuses, payroll taxes and fringe benefits.

BS.label: Commercial Paper
BS.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of short-term borrowings using unsecured obligations issued by banks, corporations and other borrowers to investors. The maturities of these money market securities generally do not exceed 270 days.

BS.label: Decommissioning Fund Investments
BS.description: Decommission fund to pay for the costs of decontaminating and decommissioning of facilities through collection of revenues derived from utility assessments and government appropriations. Decommission fund investment for the process whereby a power station, at the end of its economic life, is taken permanently out of service and its site made available for other purposes. In the case of a nuclear station this comprises three different states of clearance. Immediately after the final closure, radioactive material such as nuclear fuel and operational waste is removed and the buildings surrounding the reactor shield are dismantled and finally the reactor itself is dismantled.

BS.label: Assets for Plan Benefits, Defined Benefit Plan
BS.description: Amount of asset, recognized in statement of financial position, for overfunded defined benefit pension and other postretirement plans.

BS.label: Employee-related Liabilities, Current
BS.description: Total of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable for obligations related to services received from employees, such as accrued salaries and bonuses, payroll taxes and fringe benefits. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

BS.label: Loss Contingency Accrual
BS.description: Amount of loss contingency liability.

BS.label: Other Accrued Liabilities, Current
BS.description: Amount of expenses incurred but not yet paid classified as other, due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Other, Gross
BS.description: Amount, before accumulated depreciation, depletion, and amortization, of property, plant, and equipment; classified as other. Includes, but is not limited to, land and land improvement; building; machinery and equipment; furniture and fixture; and work of art, historical treasure, or similar asset classified as collection.

BS.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Forfeitures in Period
BS.description: The number of shares under options that were cancelled during the reporting period as a result of occurrence of a terminating event specified in contractual agreements pertaining to the stock option plan.

BS.label: Asset Retirement Obligation, Current
BS.description: Current portion of the carrying amount of a liability for an asset retirement obligation. An asset retirement obligation is a legal obligation associated with the disposal or retirement of a tangible long-lived asset that results from the acquisition, construction or development, or the normal operations of a long-lived asset, except for certain obligations of lessees.

BS.label: Assets Held-for-sale, Not Part of Disposal Group, Current
BS.description: Amount of assets held-for-sale that are not part of a disposal group, expected to be sold within a year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Assets
BS.description: Amount classified as assets attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

BS.label: Cash Equivalents, at Carrying Value
BS.description: Amount of short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Excludes cash and cash equivalents within disposal group and discontinued operation.

BS.label: Liability, Defined Benefit Pension Plan, Noncurrent
BS.description: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for defined benefit pension plan, classified as noncurrent. Excludes other postretirement benefit plan.

BS.label: Dividends Payable, Current
BS.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of dividends declared but unpaid on equity securities issued by the entity and outstanding. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

BS.label: Long-term Debt and Lease Obligation
BS.description: Amount of long-term debt and lease obligation, classified as noncurrent.

BS.label: Long-term Debt and Lease Obligation, Current
BS.description: Amount of long-term debt and lease obligation, classified as current.

BS.label: Restricted Cash, Current
BS.description: Amount of cash restricted as to withdrawal or usage, classified as current. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits.

BS.label: Temporary Equity, Carrying Amount, Attributable to Parent
BS.description: Carrying amount, attributable to parent, of an entity's issued and outstanding stock which is not included within permanent equity. Temporary equity is a security with redemption features that are outside the control of the issuer, is not classified as an asset or liability in conformity with GAAP, and is not mandatorily redeemable. Includes any type of security that is redeemable at a fixed or determinable price or on a fixed or determinable date or dates, is redeemable at the option of the holder, or has conditions for redemption which are not solely within the control of the issuer. Includes stock with a put option held by an ESOP and stock redeemable by a holder only in the event of a change in control of the issuer.

BS.label: Unbilled Contracts Receivable
BS.description: Unbilled amounts due for services rendered or to be rendered, actions taken or to be taken, or a promise to refrain from taking certain actions in accordance with the terms of a legally binding agreement between the entity and, at a minimum, one other party. An example would be amounts associated with contracts or programs where the recognized revenue for performance thereunder exceeds the amounts billed under the terms thereof as of the date of the balance sheet.

BS.label: Deferred Income Tax Assets, Net
BS.description: Amount, after allocation of valuation allowances and deferred tax liability, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible differences and carryforwards, with jurisdictional netting.

BS.label: Energy Related Inventory
BS.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of merchandise, goods, commodities, or supplies relating to a source of usable power held for future sale or future use in manufacturing or production process.

BS.label: Liabilities, Other than Long-term Debt, Noncurrent
BS.description: Aggregated carrying amounts of obligations as of the balance sheet date, excluding long-term debt, incurred as part of the normal operations that are expected to be paid after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer. Alternate captions include Total Deferred Credits and Other Liabilities.

BS.label: Line of Credit, Current
BS.description: The carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the current portion of long-term obligations drawn from a line of credit, which is a bank's commitment to make loans up to a specific amount. Examples of items that might be included in the application of this element may consist of letters of credit, standby letters of credit, and revolving credit arrangements, under which borrowings can be made up to a maximum amount as of any point in time conditional on satisfaction of specified terms before, as of and after the date of drawdowns on the line. Includes short-term obligations that would normally be classified as current liabilities but for which (a) postbalance sheet date issuance of a long term obligation to refinance the short term obligation on a long term basis, or (b) the enterprise has entered into a financing agreement that clearly permits the enterprise to refinance the short-term obligation on a long term basis and the following conditions are met (1) the agreement does not expire within 1 year and is not cancelable by the lender except for violation of an objectively determinable provision, (2) no violation exists at the BS date, and (3) the lender has entered into the financing agreement is expected to be financially capable of honoring the agreement.

BS.label: Other Receivables
BS.description: Amount due from parties in nontrade transactions, classified as other.

BS.label: Restricted Cash
BS.description: Amount of cash restricted as to withdrawal or usage. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits.

BS.label: Short-term Investments
BS.description: Amount of investments including trading securities, available-for-sale securities, held-to-maturity securities, and short-term investments classified as other and current.

BS.label: Treasury Stock, Value
BS.description: The amount allocated to treasury stock. Treasury stock is common and preferred shares of an entity that were issued, repurchased by the entity, and are held in its treasury.

BS.label: Accounts Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss
BS.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration from customer for product sold and service rendered in normal course of business.

BS.label: Common Stock, No Par Value
BS.description: Face amount per share of no-par value common stock.

BS.label: Derivative Instruments and Hedges, Assets
BS.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the asset arising from derivative instruments and hedging activities, which are expected to be converted into cash or otherwise disposed of within a year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Derivative Instruments and Hedges, Noncurrent
BS.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the assets arising from derivative contracts and hedging activities, which are expected to be converted into cash or otherwise disposed of after a year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Inventory, Raw Materials and Supplies, Gross
BS.description: Gross amount of unprocessed materials to be used in manufacturing or production process and supplies that will be consumed.

BS.label: Other Assets, Miscellaneous, Noncurrent
BS.description: Amount of other miscellaneous assets expected to be realized or consumed after one year or normal operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Other Investments
BS.description: Amount of investments classified as other.

BS.label: Preferred Stock, Value, Outstanding
BS.description: Value of nonredeemable preferred shares and preferred shares redeemable solely at option of issuer, held by shareholders. Excludes preferred shares repurchased and held as treasury shares.

BS.label: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Other Property, Plant and Equipment
BS.description: Period end book value of other property, plant and equipment (PPE) owned (but not classified elsewhere) by the public utility.

BS.label: Accounts and Other Receivables, Net, Current
BS.description: Amount, after allowance, receivable from customers, clients, or other third-parties, and receivables classified as other due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Capitalization, Long-term Debt and Equity
BS.description: Amount of consolidated capitalization which comprises long-term debt and equity instruments.

BS.label: Deferred Credits and Other Liabilities
BS.description: Total carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of unearned revenue or income, not otherwise specified in the taxonomy, which is expected to be taken into income in future periods and obligations not separately disclosed in the balance sheet (other liabilities).

BS.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Liabilities
BS.description: Amount classified as liabilities attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

BS.label: Liability for Uncertainty in Income Taxes, Noncurrent
BS.description: Amount recognized for uncertainty in income taxes classified as noncurrent.

BS.label: Other Inventory, Supplies, Gross
BS.description: Amount before valuation and LIFO reserves of other supplies used within the manufacturing or production process expected to be consumed within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Accrual for Taxes Other than Income Taxes, Current
BS.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable for real and property taxes. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

BS.label: Accrued Environmental Loss Contingencies, Noncurrent
BS.description: Carrying value of the obligation (known or estimated) arising from requirements to perform activities to remediate one or more sites, payable after twelve months or beyond the next operating cycle if longer.

BS.label: Contract with Customer, Liability, Noncurrent
BS.description: Amount of obligation to transfer good or service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable, classified as noncurrent.

BS.label: Interest Payable
BS.description: Amount of interest payable on debt, including, but not limited to, trade payables.

BS.label: Loss Contingency, Accrual, Current
BS.description: Amount of loss contingency liability expected to be resolved within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Nuclear Fuel, Net of Amortization
BS.description: The carrying amount as of the balance sheet of nuclear fuel held as property plant and equipment. This amount is net of amortization based on the energy produced over the life of the fuel.

BS.label: Other Long-term Debt, Current
BS.description: Amount of long-term debt classified as other, payable within one year or the operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Other Long-term Debt, Noncurrent
BS.description: Amount of long-term debt classified as other, payable after one year or the operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Prepaid Taxes
BS.description: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for income and other taxes that provide economic benefits within a future period of one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Repayments of Notes Payable
BS.description: The cash outflow for a borrowing supported by a written promise to pay an obligation.

BS.label: Restricted Cash, Noncurrent
BS.description: Amount of cash restricted as to withdrawal or usage, classified as noncurrent. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits.

BS.label: Deferred Costs, Noncurrent
BS.description: Amount of deferred cost, excluding capitalized cost related to contract with customer; classified as noncurrent.

BS.label: Deferred Offering Costs
BS.description: Specific incremental costs directly attributable to a proposed or actual offering of securities which are deferred at the end of the reporting period.

BS.label: Deferred Revenue, Current
BS.description: Amount of deferred income and obligation to transfer product and service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable, classified as current.

BS.label: Derivative Instruments and Hedges, Liabilities
BS.description: Sum as of the balance sheet date of the (a) fair values of all liabilities resulting from contracts that meet the criteria of being accounted for as derivative instruments, and (b) the carrying amounts of the liabilities arising from financial instruments or contracts used to mitigate a specified risk (hedge), and which are expected to be extinguished or otherwise disposed of within a year or the normal operating cycle, if longer, net of the effects of master netting arrangements.

BS.label: Energy Related Inventory, Natural Gas in Storage
BS.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of natural gas in storage, which is a mixture of gases (liquefied or otherwise), used for fuel and manufacturing purposes, which is ready for sale.

BS.label: Inventory, Raw Materials and Supplies, Net of Reserves
BS.description: Aggregated amount of unprocessed materials to be used in manufacturing or production process and supplies that will be consumed. This amount is net of valuation reserves and adjustments.

BS.label: Investments in and Advance to Affiliates, Subsidiaries, Associates, and Joint Ventures
BS.description: Amount of investment in equity method investee and investment in and advance to affiliate.

BS.label: Marketable Securities, Current
BS.description: Amount of investment in marketable security, classified as current.

BS.label: Notes Payable
BS.description: Including the current and noncurrent portions, aggregate carrying amount of all types of notes payable, as of the balance sheet date, with initial maturities beyond one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Notes Payable, Current
BS.description: Sum of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date of the portions of long-term notes payable due within one year or the operating cycle if longer.

BS.label: Other Assets
BS.description: Amount of assets classified as other.

BS.label: Other Short-term Borrowings
BS.description: Amount of borrowings classified as other, maturing within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Public Utilities, Inventory
BS.description: The period end amount for a type of inventory held by the utility in a schedule of inventories.

BS.label: Temporary Equity, Shares Outstanding
BS.description: The number of securities classified as temporary equity that have been issued and are held by the entity's shareholders. Securities outstanding equals securities issued minus securities held in treasury. Temporary equity is a security with redemption features that are outside the control of the issuer, is not classified as an asset or liability in conformity with GAAP, and is not mandatorily redeemable. Includes any type of security that is redeemable at a fixed or determinable price or on a fixed or determinable date or dates, is redeemable at the option of the holder, or has conditions for redemption which are not solely within the control of the issuer. If convertible, the issuer does not control the actions or events necessary to issue the maximum number of shares that could be required to be delivered under the conversion option if the holder exercises the option to convert the stock to another class of equity. If the security is a warrant or a rights issue, the warrant or rights issue is considered to be temporary equity if the issuer cannot demonstrate that it would be able to deliver upon the exercise of the option by the holder in all cases. Includes stock with put option held by ESOP and stock redeemable by holder only in the event of a change in control of the issuer.

BS.label: Accounts Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
BS.description: Amount of allowance for credit loss on accounts receivable, classified as noncurrent.

BS.label: Assets Held-in-trust, Noncurrent
BS.description: The amount of cash, securities, or other assets held by a third-party trustee pursuant to the terms of an agreement which assets are available to be used by beneficiaries to that agreement only within the specific terms thereof and which agreement is expected to terminate more than one year from the balance sheet date (or operating cycle, if longer) at which time the assets held-in-trust will be released or forfeited.

BS.label: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration, Liability, Current
BS.description: Amount of liability recognized arising from contingent consideration in a business combination, expected to be settled within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Contract with Customer, Asset, after Allowance for Credit Loss
BS.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time.

BS.label: Contract with Customer, Asset, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
BS.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time, classified as current.

BS.label: Debt Issuance Costs, Noncurrent, Net
BS.description: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of debt issuance costs classified as noncurrent. Includes, but is not limited to, legal, accounting, underwriting, printing, and registration costs.

BS.label: Energy Related Inventory, Other Fossil Fuel
BS.description: Amount of fossil fuel included in inventory classified as other.

BS.label: Long-term Line of Credit, Noncurrent
BS.description: The carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the noncurrent portion of long-term obligations drawn from a line of credit, which is a bank's commitment to make loans up to a specific amount. Examples of items that might be included in the application of this element may consist of letters of credit, standby letters of credit, and revolving credit arrangements, under which borrowings can be made up to a maximum amount as of any point in time conditional on satisfaction of specified terms before, as of and after the date of drawdowns on the line. Includes short-term obligations that would normally be classified as current liabilities but for which (a) postbalance sheet date issuance of a long term obligation to refinance the short term obligation on a long term basis, or (b) the enterprise has entered into a financing agreement that clearly permits the enterprise to refinance the short-term obligation on a long term basis and the following conditions are met (1) the agreement does not expire within 1 year and is not cancelable by the lender except for violation of an objectively determinable provision, (2) no violation exists at the BS date, and (3) the lender has entered into the financing agreement is expected to be financially capable of honoring the agreement.

BS.label: Margin Deposit Assets
BS.description: The amount of cash or securities placed with a broker or counterparty as security for a trading or derivatives securities position which was partially obtained with funds provided by the broker dealer.

BS.label: Marketable Securities, Noncurrent
BS.description: Amount of investment in marketable security, classified as noncurrent.

BS.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Other, Net
BS.description: Amount, after accumulated depreciation, depletion, and amortization, of property, plant, and equipment; classified as other. Includes, but is not limited to, land and land improvement; building; machinery and equipment; furniture and fixture; and work of art, historical treasure, or similar asset classified as collection.

BS.label: Restricted Cash and Investments, Current
BS.description: The current cash, cash equivalents and investments that are restricted as to withdrawal or usage. Restrictions may include legally restricted deposits held as compensating balances against short-term borrowing arrangements, contracts entered into with others, or entity statements of intention with regard to particular deposits; however, time deposits and short-term certificates of deposit are not generally included in legally restricted deposits. Excludes compensating balance arrangements that are not agreements which legally restrict the use of cash amounts shown on the balance sheet. Includes current cash equivalents and investments that are similarly restricted as to withdrawal, usage or disposal.

BS.label: Temporary Equity, Shares Issued
BS.description: The number of securities classified as temporary equity that have been sold (or granted) to the entity's shareholders. Securities issued include securities outstanding and securities held in treasury. Temporary equity is a security with redemption features that are outside the control of the issuer, is not classified as an asset or liability in conformity with GAAP, and is not mandatorily redeemable. Includes any type of security that is redeemable at a fixed or determinable price or on a fixed or determinable date or dates, is redeemable at the option of the holder, or has conditions for redemption which are not solely within the control of the issuer. If convertible, the issuer does not control the actions or events necessary to issue the maximum number of shares that could be required to be delivered under the conversion option if the holder exercises the option to convert the stock to another class of equity. If the security is a warrant or a rights issue, the warrant or rights issue is considered to be temporary equity if the issuer cannot demonstrate that it would be able to deliver upon the exercise of the option by the holder in all cases. Includes stock with put option held by ESOP and stock redeemable by holder only in the event of a change in control of the issuer.

BS.label: Treasury Stock, Common, Value
BS.description: Amount allocated to previously issued common shares repurchased by the issuing entity and held in treasury.

BS.label: Accounts Payable and Other Accrued Liabilities, Current
BS.description: Amount of liabilities incurred to vendors for goods and services received, and accrued liabilities classified as other, payable within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Accounts Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
BS.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration from customer for product sold and service rendered in normal course of business, classified as noncurrent.

BS.label: Allowance for Doubtful Other Receivables, Current
BS.description: Amount of allowance for credit loss on receivable, classified as other and current.

BS.label: Common Stock, Value, Outstanding
BS.description: Value of common shares held by shareholders. Excludes common shares repurchased and held as treasury shares.

BS.label: Construction Payable, Current
BS.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable for the acquisition of merchandise, materials, supplies and services pertaining to construction projects such as a housing development or factory expansion not classified as trade payables. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

BS.label: Deferred Fuel Cost
BS.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of capitalized fuel costs of a regulated entity that are expected to be recoverable through rate adjustments within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Deposits Assets, Noncurrent
BS.description: Carrying value of amounts transferred to third parties for security purposes that are expected to be returned or applied towards payment after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Financing Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss
BS.description: Amortized cost, after allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable. Excludes financing receivable covered under loss sharing agreement and net investment in lease.

BS.label: Other Deferred Costs, Net
BS.description: Net amount of other deferred costs capitalized at the end of the reporting period. Does not include deferred finance costs or deferred acquisition costs of insurance companies.

BS.label: Other Prepaid Expense, Current
BS.description: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for other costs that provide economic benefits within a future period of one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Property, Plant, and Equipment and Finance Lease Right-of-Use Asset, after Accumulated Depreciation and Amortization
BS.description: Amount, after accumulated depreciation and amortization, of property, plant, and equipment and finance lease right-of-use asset.

BS.label: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Fuel
BS.description: Period end amount of property, plant and equipment (PPE) related to fuels owned by the public utility.

BS.label: Receivables, Net, Current
BS.description: The total amount due to the entity within one year of the balance sheet date (or one operating cycle, if longer) from outside sources, including trade accounts receivable, notes and loans receivable, as well as any other types of receivables, net of allowances established for the purpose of reducing such receivables to an amount that approximates their net realizable value.

BS.label: Restricted Cash and Investments, Noncurrent
BS.description: The noncurrent cash, cash equivalents and investments that is restricted as to withdrawal or usage. Restrictions may include legally restricted deposits held as compensating balances against borrowing arrangements, contracts entered into with others, or entity statements of intention with regard to particular deposits classified as long-term; that is not expected to be released from such existing restrictions within one year of the balance sheet date or operating cycle, whichever is longer. Excludes compensating balance arrangements that are not agreements which legally restrict the use of cash amounts shown on the balance sheet. Includes noncurrent cash equivalents and investments that are similarly restricted as to withdrawal, usage or disposal.

BS.label: Securitized Regulatory Transition Assets, Noncurrent
BS.description: Carrying value of the regulatory asset that represents capitalized stranded costs that have been securitized (financed with debt) and are expected to be recoverable through a transition charge after one year (or beyond the operating cycle if longer). A transition charge is a charge approved by a regulator that allows deregulated utilities to recover investments in certain assets, such as power plants, over a transition period leading into a deregulated market.

BS.label: Short-term Bank Loans and Notes Payable
BS.description: Amount of borrowings from a bank classified as other, maturing within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Accounts Payable, Other, Current
BS.description: Amount of obligations incurred classified as other, payable within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Commitments and Contingencies
BS.description: Represents the caption on the face of the balance sheet to indicate that the entity has entered into (1) purchase or supply arrangements that will require expending a portion of its resources to meet the terms thereof, and (2) is exposed to potential losses or, less frequently, gains, arising from (a) possible claims against a company's resources due to future performance under contract terms, and (b) possible losses or likely gains from uncertainties that will ultimately be resolved when one or more future events that are deemed likely to occur do occur or fail to occur.

BS.label: Convertible Notes Payable, Current
BS.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the portion of long-term debt due within one year or the operating cycle if longer identified as Convertible Notes Payable. Convertible Notes Payable is a written promise to pay a note which can be exchanged for a specified amount of another, related security, at the option of the issuer and the holder.

BS.label: Deferred Compensation Share-based Arrangements, Liability, Current
BS.description: Aggregate carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the liabilities for stock option plans and other equity-based compensation arrangements payable within one year (or the operating cycle, if longer).

BS.label: Deferred Costs and Other Assets
BS.description: Amount of deferred cost assets and assets classified as other.

BS.label: Debt Issuance Costs, Current, Net
BS.description: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of debt issuance costs classified as current. Includes, but is not limited to, legal, accounting, underwriting, printing, and registration costs.

BS.label: Deferred Income Taxes and Other Tax Liabilities, Noncurrent
BS.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences, after deferred tax asset, and other tax liabilities expected to be paid after one year or operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Deposits Assets, Current
BS.description: Carrying value of amounts transferred to third parties for security purposes that are expected to be returned or applied towards payment within one year or during the operating cycle, if shorter.

BS.label: Notes Payable, Noncurrent
BS.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of notes payable (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer), excluding current portion.

BS.label: Loss Contingency, Accrual, Noncurrent
BS.description: Amount of loss contingency liability expected to be resolved after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Marketable Securities
BS.description: Amount of investment in marketable security.

BS.label: Other Intangible Assets, Net
BS.description: Amount after accumulated amortization of finite-lived and indefinite-lived intangible assets classified as other.

BS.label: Liability, Other Postretirement Defined Benefit Plan, Noncurrent
BS.description: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for defined benefit other postretirement plan, classified as noncurrent. Excludes pension plan.

BS.label: Other Sundry Liabilities, Noncurrent
BS.description: Obligations not otherwise itemized or categorized in the footnotes to the financial statements that are expected to be paid after one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer), from the balance sheet date.

BS.label: Liability, Defined Benefit Plan, Current
BS.description: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for defined benefit pension and other postretirement plans, classified as current.

BS.label: Preferred Stock, No Par Value
BS.description: Face amount per share of no-par value preferred stock nonredeemable or redeemable solely at the option of the issuer.

BS.label: Prepaid Expense, Noncurrent
BS.description: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of amounts paid in advance for expenses which will be charged against earnings in periods after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Prepaid Insurance
BS.description: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for insurance that provides economic benefits within a future period of one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Regulated Entity, Other Assets, Noncurrent
BS.description: Total of noncurrent other assets held by public utility entities.

BS.label: Shares, Issued
BS.description: Number of shares of stock issued as of the balance sheet date, including shares that had been issued and were previously outstanding but which are now held in the treasury.

BS.label: Temporary Equity, Shares Authorized
BS.description: The maximum number of securities classified as temporary equity that are permitted to be issued by an entity's charter and bylaws. Temporary equity is a security with redemption features that are outside the control of the issuer, is not classified as an asset or liability in conformity with GAAP, and is not mandatorily redeemable. Includes any type of security that is redeemable at a fixed or determinable price or on a fixed or determinable date or dates, is redeemable at the option of the holder, or has conditions for redemption which are not solely within the control of the issuer. If convertible, the issuer does not control the actions or events necessary to issue the maximum number of shares that could be required to be delivered under the conversion option if the holder exercises the option to convert the stock to another class of equity. If the security is a warrant or a rights issue, the warrant or rights issue is considered to be temporary equity if the issuer cannot demonstrate that it would be able to deliver upon the exercise of the option by the holder in all cases. Includes stock with put option held by ESOP and stock redeemable by holder only in the event of a change in control of the issuer.

BS.label: Unsecured Long-term Debt, Noncurrent
BS.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of uncollateralized debt obligation (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer), excluding current portion.

BS.label: Accounts Payable
BS.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of liabilities incurred (and for which invoices have typically been received) and payable to vendors for goods and services received that are used in an entity's business.

BS.label: Accrued Salaries, Current
BS.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the obligations incurred through that date and payable for employees' services provided. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

BS.label: Assets Held-for-sale, Not Part of Disposal Group
BS.description: Amount of assets held-for-sale that are not part of a disposal group.

BS.label: Assets, Noncurrent, Other than Noncurrent Investments and Property, Plant and Equipment
BS.description: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all assets, excluding property, plant, and equipment and other property and investments, that are expected to be realized in cash, sold or consumed after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer. Alternate captions include Total Deferred Charges and Other Assets.

BS.label: Common Stocks, Including Additional Paid in Capital
BS.description: Amount of par value plus amounts in excess of par value or issuance value for common stock issued.

BS.label: Contract with Customer, Refund Liability, Current
BS.description: Amount of liability for consideration received or receivable from customer which is not included in transaction price, when consideration is expected to be refunded to customer, classified as current.

BS.label: Convertible Notes Payable, Noncurrent
BS.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of long-term debt (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer) identified as Convertible Notes Payable, excluding current portion. Convertible Notes Payable is a written promise to pay a note which can be exchanged for a specified amount of another, related security, at the option of the issuer and the holder.

BS.label: Dividends Payable
BS.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of dividends declared but unpaid on equity securities issued by the entity and outstanding.

BS.label: Energy Related Inventory, Coal
BS.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of coal, which is a combustible rock or minerals which are extracted from the ground and used as fuel.

BS.label: Inventory, Raw Materials, Gross
BS.description: Amount before valuation and LIFO reserves of raw materials expected to be sold, or consumed within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Investments and Other Noncurrent Assets
BS.description: Amount of investments, and noncurrent assets classified as other.

BS.label: Nontrade Receivables, Current
BS.description: The sum of amounts currently receivable other than from customers. For classified balance sheets, represents the current amount receivable, that is amounts expected to be collected within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Other Restricted Assets, Current
BS.description: Amount of current assets that are pledged or subject to withdrawal restrictions, classified as other.

BS.label: Liability, Retirement and Postemployment Benefits
BS.description: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for pension, other postretirement and postemployment benefits.

BS.label: Postemployment Benefits Liability, Noncurrent
BS.description: For a classified balance sheet, the carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the portion of the obligations recognized for the various benefits provided to former or inactive employees, their beneficiaries, and covered dependents after employment but before retirement that is payable after one year (or beyond the operating cycle if longer).

BS.label: Preferred Stock, Liquidation Preference Per Share
BS.description: The per share liquidation preference (or restrictions) of nonredeemable preferred stock (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer) that has a preference in involuntary liquidation considerably in excess of the par or stated value of the shares. The liquidation preference is the difference between the preference in liquidation and the par or stated values of the share.

BS.label: Preferred Stock, Liquidation Preference, Value
BS.description: Value of the difference between preference in liquidation and the par or stated values of the preferred shares.

BS.label: Recorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation
BS.description: Amount of the recorded obligation to transfer funds in the future for fixed or minimum amounts or quantities of goods or services at fixed or minimum prices (for example, as in take-or-pay contracts or throughput contracts).

BS.label: Temporary Equity, Par or Stated Value Per Share
BS.description: Per share amount of par value or stated value of stock classified as temporary equity. Temporary equity is a security with redemption features that are outside the control of the issuer, is not classified as an asset or liability in conformity with GAAP, and is not mandatorily redeemable.

BS.label: Unamortized Loss Reacquired Debt, Noncurrent
BS.description: Unamortized Loss on Reacquired Debt is the loss incurred upon reacquisition or refinancing of debt, is treated as a deferred charge and amortized over the life of the new debt issued.

BS.label: Accrued Employee Benefits, Current
BS.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations, excluding pension and other postretirement benefits, incurred through that date and payable for perquisites provided to employees pertaining to services received from them. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

BS.label: Accrued Liabilities and Other Liabilities
BS.description: Amount of expenses incurred but not yet paid nor invoiced, and liabilities classified as other.

BS.label: AssetAcquisitionContingentConsiderationLiabilityCurrent
BS.description: Amount of liability recognized from contingent consideration in asset acquisition, classified as current.

BS.label: Asset Recovery Damaged Property Costs, Noncurrent
BS.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the portion of the reserved funds established by a utility from customer payments to cover the repair costs of damages from major storms, which repairs are expected to be incurred beyond one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Credit Risk Derivative Assets, at Fair Value
BS.description: Fair value of credit risk derivative asset.

BS.label: Customer Refund Liability, Current
BS.description: Current regulatory liabilities generally represent obligations to make refunds to customers for various reasons including overpayment.

BS.label: Deferred Credits and Other Liabilities, Noncurrent
BS.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of unearned revenue or income, not otherwise specified in the taxonomy, which is expected to be taken into income after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer and noncurrent obligations not separately disclosed in the balance sheet (other liabilities, noncurrent).

BS.label: Insurance Settlements Receivable, Noncurrent
BS.description: Carrying amount due after one year of the balance sheet date (or one operating cycle, if longer) of amount due in settlement of a claim for reimbursement from an insurance company when the Company has suffered a loss covered under an insurance policy.

BS.label: Junior Subordinated Notes, Noncurrent
BS.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of long-term debt (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer) identified as Junior Subordinated Notes, which have a lower priority than senior instruments, excluding current portion.

BS.label: Life Insurance, Corporate or Bank Owned, Amount
BS.description: This item represents the amount that could be realized under a life insurance contract or contracts owned by the Entity as of the date of the statement of financial position. Such Entity-owned life insurance policies are commonly known as corporate-owned life insurance (COLI) or bank-owned life insurance (BOLI).

BS.label: Members' Equity
BS.description: Amount of ownership interest in limited liability company (LLC), attributable to the parent entity.

BS.label: Mineral Rights
BS.description: Carrying amount at the balance sheet date of mineral rights, or rights to extract a mineral from the earth or to receive payment in the form of a royalty for the extraction of minerals, net of amortization.

BS.label: Noncontrolling Interest, Amount Represented by Preferred Stock
BS.description: The amount of noncontrolling interest in subsidiary represented by preferred securities issued by the subsidiary.

BS.label: Noncontrolling Interest in Variable Interest Entity
BS.description: Portion of equity (net assets) in a variable interest entity (VIE) not attributable, directly or indirectly, to the parent entity. That is, this is the portion of equity in a VIE that is attributable to the noncontrolling interest (previously referred to as minority interest).

BS.label: Receivables from Customers
BS.description: Amount due from customers for fees and charges arising from transactions related to the entity's brokerage activities and operations.

BS.label: Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest, Equity, Preferred, Carrying Amount
BS.description: As of the reporting date, the carrying amount of noncontrolling interests which are redeemable by the (parent) entity (1) at a fixed or determinable price on a fixed or determinable date, (2) at the option of the holder of the noncontrolling interest, or (3) upon occurrence of an event that is not solely within the control of the (parent) entity. The noncontrolling interest holder's ownership (or holders' ownership) may be in the form of preferred shares (regardless of class), preferred partnership units (regardless of class), preferential membership interests, or any other form of preferred equity regardless of investee entity legal form.

BS.label: Secured Debt, Current
BS.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the portion of long-term, collateralized debt obligations due within one year or the operating cycle, if longer. Such obligations include mortgage loans, chattel loans, and any other borrowings secured by assets of the borrower.

BS.label: Secured Long-term Debt, Noncurrent
BS.description: Carrying amount of collateralized debt obligations with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer, excluding the current portion. Obligations include, but not limited to, mortgage loans, chattel loans, and other borrowings secured by assets.

BS.label: Temporary Equity, Redemption Price Per Share
BS.description: Amount to be paid per share that is classified as temporary equity by entity upon redemption. Temporary equity is a security with redemption features that are outside the control of the issuer, is not classified as an asset or liability in conformity with GAAP, and is not mandatorily redeemable. Includes any type of security that is redeemable at a fixed or determinable price or on a fixed or determinable date or dates, is redeemable at the option of the holder, or has conditions for redemption which are not solely within the control of the issuer. If convertible, the issuer does not control the actions or events necessary to issue the maximum number of shares that could be required to be delivered under the conversion option if the holder exercises the option to convert the stock to another class of equity. If the security is a warrant or a rights issue, the warrant or rights issue is considered to be temporary equity if the issuer cannot demonstrate that it would be able to deliver upon the exercise of the option by the holder in all cases. Includes stock with put option held by ESOP and stock redeemable by holder only in the event of a change in control of the issuer.

BS.label: Transfers Accounted for as Secured Borrowings, Assets, Carrying Amount
BS.description: Carrying amount of financial assets accounted for as secured borrowings recognized in the transferor's statement of financial position at the end of each period presented.

BS.label: Transfers Accounted for as Secured Borrowings, Associated Liabilities, Carrying Amount
BS.description: Carrying amount of liabilities associated with financial assets accounted for as secured borrowings recognized in the transferor's statement of financial position at the end of each period presented.

BS.label: Unsecured Debt, Current
BS.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the portion of long-term, uncollateralized debt obligations due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities, Noncurrent
BS.description: Sum of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and due after one year (or beyond the operating cycle if longer), including liabilities for compensation costs, fringe benefits other than pension and postretirement obligations, rent, contractual rights and obligations, and statutory obligations.

BS.label: AssetAcquisitionContingentConsiderationLiabilityNoncurrent
BS.description: Amount of liability recognized from contingent consideration in asset acquisition, classified as noncurrent.

BS.label: Common Stocks, Including Additional Paid in Capital, Net of Discount
BS.description: Amount after discount on shares of par value plus amounts in excess of par value or issuance value for common stock held by shareholders. Includes common stock repurchased and held as treasury stock.

BS.label: DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleExcludingAccruedInterestCurrent
BS.description: Amount excluding accrued interest, of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), classified as current.

BS.label: DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleExcludingAccruedInterestNoncurrent
BS.description: Amount excluding accrued interest, of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), classified as noncurrent.

BS.label: Deferred Credits and Other Liabilities, Current
BS.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of unearned revenue or income, not otherwise specified in the taxonomy, which is expected to be taken into income during the current period and current obligations not separately disclosed in the balance sheet (other liabilities, current).

BS.label: Deferred Rent Receivables, Net, Noncurrent
BS.description: Amount of excess of rental income recognized over rental payment required by lease, classified as noncurrent.

BS.label: Energy Marketing Accounts Payable
BS.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable for energy purchases, typically by a utility or an entity engaged in selling energy contracts.

BS.label: Excess Stock, Shares Issued
BS.description: Number of excess stock shares of an entity that have been sold or granted to shareholders.

BS.label: Excess Stock, Shares Outstanding
BS.description: Number of shares of excess stock held by shareholders.

BS.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestAfterAllowanceForCreditLossNoncurrent
BS.description: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, after allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable classified as noncurrent. Excludes net investment in lease.

BS.label: GovernmentAssistanceAmountCumulativeCurrent
BS.description: Amount of asset from government assistance, classified as current.

BS.label: Inventory, Supplies, Net of Reserves
BS.description: Carrying amount, net of valuation reserves and adjustments, as of the balance sheet date of products used directly or indirectly in the manufacturing or production process, which may or may not become part of the final product. May also include items used in the storage, presentation or transportation of physical goods.

BS.label: Investment Owned, Balance, Shares
BS.description: Number of shares of investment owned.

BS.label: Limited Partners' Capital Account
BS.description: The amount of the limited partners' ownership interests.

BS.label: Limited Partners' Capital Account, Units Issued
BS.description: The number of limited partner units issued.

BS.label: Limited Partners' Capital Account, Units Outstanding
BS.description: The number of limited partner units outstanding.
