BS.label: Other Notes Payable, Current
BS.description: Amount of long-term notes classified as other, payable within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Plant Held for Future Use Amount
BS.description: Discloses the period end amount of plants held for future use and whether such amount is included in the utility's rate base.

IS.label: Operating Income (Loss)
IS.description: The net result for the period of deducting operating expenses from operating revenues.

IS.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent
IS.description: The portion of profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, which is attributable to the parent.

IS.label: Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
IS.description: Amount of current income tax expense (benefit) and deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to continuing operations.

IS.label: Earnings Per Share, Basic
IS.description: The amount of net income (loss) for the period per each share of common stock or unit outstanding during the reporting period.

IS.label: Earnings Per Share, Diluted
IS.description: The amount of net income (loss) for the period available to each share of common stock or common unit outstanding during the reporting period and to each share or unit that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of common shares or units for all dilutive potential common shares or units outstanding during the reporting period.

IS.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Diluted
IS.description: The average number of shares or units issued and outstanding that are used in calculating diluted EPS or earnings per unit (EPU), determined based on the timing of issuance of shares or units in the period.

IS.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Basic
IS.description: Number of [basic] shares or units, after adjustment for contingently issuable shares or units and other shares or units not deemed outstanding, determined by relating the portion of time within a reporting period that common shares or units have been outstanding to the total time in that period.

IS.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Income Taxes, Noncontrolling Interest
IS.description: Amount of income (loss) from continuing operations, including income (loss) from equity method investments, before deduction of income tax expense (benefit), and income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest.

IS.label: Revenues
IS.description: Amount of revenue recognized from goods sold, services rendered, insurance premiums, or other activities that constitute an earning process. Includes, but is not limited to, investment and interest income before deduction of interest expense when recognized as a component of revenue, and sales and trading gain (loss).

IS.label: Net Income (Loss), Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
IS.description: The consolidated profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

IS.label: Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax, Attributable to Parent
IS.description: Amount after tax of increase (decrease) in equity from transactions and other events and circumstances from net income and other comprehensive income, attributable to parent entity. Excludes changes in equity resulting from investments by owners and distributions to owners.

IS.label: Deferred Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
IS.description: Amount of deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations.

IS.label: Interest Expense
IS.description: Amount of interest expense classified as operating and nonoperating. Includes, but is not limited to, cost of borrowing accounted for as interest expense.

IS.label: Other Nonoperating Income (Expense)
IS.description: Amount of income (expense) related to nonoperating activities, classified as other.

IS.label: Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization
IS.description: The aggregate expense recognized in the current period that allocates the cost of tangible assets, intangible assets, or depleting assets to periods that benefit from use of the assets.

IS.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax
IS.description: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss).

IS.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Expense
IS.description: Amount of expense for award under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes amount capitalized.

IS.label: Nonoperating Income (Expense)
IS.description: The aggregate amount of income or expense from ancillary business-related activities (that is to say, excluding major activities considered part of the normal operations of the business).

IS.label: Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
IS.description: Amount after tax of increase (decrease) in equity from transactions and other events and circumstances from net income and other comprehensive income. Excludes changes in equity resulting from investments by owners and distributions to owners.

IS.label: Depreciation
IS.description: The amount of expense recognized in the current period that reflects the allocation of the cost of tangible assets over the assets' useful lives. Includes production and non-production related depreciation.

IS.label: Net Income (Loss) Available to Common Stockholders, Basic
IS.description: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities; of income (loss) available to common shareholders.

IS.label: Operating Lease, Cost
IS.description: Amount of single lease cost, calculated by allocation of remaining cost of lease over remaining lease term. Includes, but is not limited to, single lease cost, after impairment of right-of-use asset, calculated by amortization of remaining right-of-use asset and accretion of lease liability.

IS.label: Asset Retirement Obligation, Accretion Expense
IS.description: Amount of accretion expense recognized during the period that is associated with an asset retirement obligation. Accretion expense measures and incorporates changes due to the passage of time into the carrying amount of the liability.

IS.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Noncash Expense
IS.description: Amount of noncash expense for share-based payment arrangement.

IS.label: Current Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
IS.description: Amount of current income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to taxable income (loss) from continuing operations.

IS.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
IS.description: Amount of Net Income (Loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest.

IS.label: Common Stock, Dividends, Per Share, Declared
IS.description: Aggregate dividends declared during the period for each share of common stock outstanding.

IS.label: Revenue from Contract with Customer, Excluding Assessed Tax
IS.description: Amount, excluding tax collected from customer, of revenue from satisfaction of performance obligation by transferring promised good or service to customer. Tax collected from customer is tax assessed by governmental authority that is both imposed on and concurrent with specific revenue-producing transaction, including, but not limited to, sales, use, value added and excise.

IS.label: Income (Loss) from Equity Method Investments
IS.description: Amount of income (loss) for proportionate share of equity method investee's income (loss).

IS.label: Investment Income, Interest
IS.description: Amount before accretion (amortization) of purchase discount (premium) of interest income on nonoperating securities.

IS.label: Operating Expenses
IS.description: Generally recurring costs associated with normal operations except for the portion of these expenses which can be clearly related to production and included in cost of sales or services. Includes selling, general and administrative expense.

IS.label: Asset Impairment Charges
IS.description: Amount of impairment loss for asset. Includes, but is not limited to, tangible and intangible assets and goodwill.

IS.label: Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax, Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
IS.description: Amount after tax of increase (decrease) in equity from transactions and other events and circumstances from net income (loss) and other comprehensive income (loss), attributable to noncontrolling interests. Excludes changes in equity resulting from investments by owners and distributions to owners.

IS.label: Costs and Expenses
IS.description: Total costs of sales and operating expenses for the period.

IS.label: Gain (Loss) on Extinguishment of Debt
IS.description: Difference between the fair value of payments made and the carrying amount of debt which is extinguished prior to maturity.

IS.label: Incremental Common Shares Attributable to Dilutive Effect of Share-based Payment Arrangements
IS.description: Additional shares included in the calculation of diluted EPS as a result of the potentially dilutive effect of share based payment arrangements using the treasury stock method.

IS.label: InterestExpenseNonoperating
IS.description: Amount of interest expense classified as nonoperating.

IS.label: Other Nonoperating Income
IS.description: Amount of income related to nonoperating activities, classified as other.

IS.label: Public Utilities, Allowance for Funds Used During Construction, Capitalized Cost of Equity
IS.description: The component of the allowance for funds used during construction during the period based on an assumed rate of return on equity funds used in financing the construction of regulated assets.

IS.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Equity Method Investments, Income Taxes, Noncontrolling Interest
IS.description: Amount of income (loss) from continuing operations before deduction of income tax expense (benefit) and income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest, and addition of income (loss) from equity method investments.

IS.label: Net Income (Loss) Available to Common Stockholders, Diluted
IS.description: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities, and addition from assumption of issuance of common shares for dilutive potential common shares; of income (loss) available to common shareholders.

IS.label: Goodwill, Impairment Loss
IS.description: Amount of impairment loss from asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

IS.label: Impairment of Long-Lived Assets Held-for-use
IS.description: Amount of impairment loss for long-lived asset held and used. Includes, but is not limited to, impairment loss for long-lived asset to be disposed of other than by sale.

IS.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Per Basic Share
IS.description: The amount of net income (loss) from continuing operations per each share of common stock or unit outstanding during the reporting period.

IS.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Per Diluted Share
IS.description: The amount of net income (loss) derived from continuing operations during the period available to each share of common stock or common unit outstanding during the reporting period and to each share or unit that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of common shares or units for all dilutive potential common shares or units outstanding during the reporting period.

IS.label: Derivative, Gain (Loss) on Derivative, Net
IS.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in the fair value of derivatives recognized in the income statement.

IS.label: General and Administrative Expense
IS.description: The aggregate total of expenses of managing and administering the affairs of an entity, including affiliates of the reporting entity, which are not directly or indirectly associated with the manufacture, sale or creation of a product or product line.

IS.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Net of Tax, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
IS.description: Amount after tax of income (loss) from continuing operations including portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

IS.label: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations and Disposal of Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Per Basic Share
IS.description: Per basic share amount, after tax, of income (loss) from the day-to-day business activities of the discontinued operation and gain (loss) from the disposal of the discontinued operation.

IS.label: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations and Disposal of Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Per Diluted Share
IS.description: Per diluted share amount, after tax, of income (loss) from the day-to-day business activities of the discontinued operation and gain (loss) from the disposal of the discontinued operation.

IS.label: Taxes, Miscellaneous
IS.description: All taxes not related to income of the entity or excise or sales taxes levied on the revenue of the entity that are not reported elsewhere. These taxes could include production, real estate, personal property, and pump tax.

IS.label: Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization, Nonproduction
IS.description: The current period expense charged against earnings on long-lived, physical assets not used in production, and which are not intended for resale, to allocate or recognize the cost of such assets over their useful lives; or to record the reduction in book value of an intangible asset over the benefit period of such asset; or to reflect consumption during the period of an asset that is not used in production.

IS.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Net of Tax, Attributable to Parent
IS.description: Amount after tax of income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to the parent.

IS.label: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
IS.description: Amount after tax of income (loss) from a discontinued operation including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest. Includes, but is not limited to, the income (loss) from operations during the phase-out period, gain (loss) on disposal, gain (loss) for reversal of write-down (write-down) to fair value, less cost to sell, and adjustments to a prior period gain (loss) on disposal.

IS.label: Utilities Operating Expense, Maintenance and Operations
IS.description: Amount of operating expense for routine plant maintenance, repairs and operations of regulated operation.

IS.label: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Attributable to Parent
IS.description: Amount after tax of income (loss) from a discontinued operation attributable to the parent. Includes, but is not limited to, the income (loss) from operations during the phase-out period, gain (loss) on disposal, gain (loss) for reversal of write-down (write-down) to fair value, less cost to sell, and adjustments to a prior period gain (loss) on disposal.

IS.label: Other Cost and Expense, Operating
IS.description: The total amount of other operating cost and expense items that are associated with the entity's normal revenue producing operation.

IS.label: Discontinued Operation, Tax Effect of Discontinued Operation
IS.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) related to a discontinued operation. Includes, but is not limited to, tax expense (benefit) related to income (loss) from operations during the phase-out period, tax expense (benefit) related to gain (loss) on disposal, tax expense (benefit) related to gain (loss) for reversal of write-down (write-down) to fair value, less cost to sell, and tax expense (benefit) related to adjustments of a prior period gain (loss) on disposal.

IS.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Other Assets
IS.description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of other assets.

IS.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Property Plant Equipment
IS.description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of property, plant and equipment assets, including oil and gas property and timber property.

IS.label: Other Nonoperating Expense
IS.description: Amount of expense related to nonoperating activities, classified as other.

IS.label: Pension and Other Postretirement Benefits Cost (Reversal of Cost)
IS.description: Amount of cost (reversal of cost) for pension and other postretirement benefits.

IS.label: Disposal Group, Not Discontinued Operation, Gain (Loss) on Disposal
IS.description: Amount before tax of gain (loss) recognized on the sale or disposal of a disposal group. Excludes discontinued operations.

IS.label: Interest Expense, Other
IS.description: Amount of interest expense classified as other.

IS.label: Common Stock, Dividends, Per Share, Cash Paid
IS.description: Aggregate dividends paid during the period for each share of common stock outstanding.

IS.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), before Reclassification, after Tax
IS.description: Amount, after tax and before reclassification, of gain (loss) from derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.

IS.label: Other Income
IS.description: Amount of revenue and income classified as other.

IS.label: Revenue from Contract with Customer, Including Assessed Tax
IS.description: Amount, including tax collected from customer, of revenue from satisfaction of performance obligation by transferring promised good or service to customer. Tax collected from customer is tax assessed by governmental authority that is both imposed on and concurrent with specific revenue-producing transaction, including, but not limited to, sales, use, value-added and excise.

IS.label: Weighted Average Number Diluted Shares Outstanding Adjustment
IS.description: The sum of dilutive potential common shares or units used in the calculation of the diluted per-share or per-unit computation.

IS.label: Amortization of Debt Issuance Costs
IS.description: Amount of amortization expense attributable to debt issuance costs.

IS.label: Cost of Goods and Services Sold
IS.description: The aggregate costs related to goods produced and sold and services rendered by an entity during the reporting period. This excludes costs incurred during the reporting period related to financial services rendered and other revenue generating activities.

IS.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Adjustment, Net of Tax
IS.description: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature.

IS.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Gain (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, after Tax
IS.description: Amount, after tax, of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for gain (loss) of defined benefit plan.

IS.label: Public Utilities, Allowance for Funds Used During Construction, Additions
IS.description: Total increase in earnings in the period representing the cost of equity (based on assumed rate of return) and/or borrowed funds (based on interest rate) used to finance construction of regulated assets, which is expected to be recovered through rate adjustments.

IS.label: Dividends, Preferred Stock
IS.description: Amount of paid and unpaid preferred stock dividends declared with the form of settlement in cash, stock and payment-in-kind (PIK).

IS.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Business
IS.description: Amount of gain (loss) from sale and disposal of integrated set of activities and assets capable of being conducted and managed for purpose of providing return in form of dividend, lower cost, or other economic benefit to investor, owner, member and participant.

IS.label: Gain (Loss) Related to Litigation Settlement
IS.description: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in settlement of litigation and insurance claims. Excludes claims within an insurance entity's normal claims settlement process.

IS.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Income Taxes, Domestic
IS.description: The portion of earnings or loss from continuing operations before income taxes that is attributable to domestic operations.

IS.label: Interest Income, Other
IS.description: Amount of interest income earned from interest bearing assets classified as other.

IS.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), after Reclassification and Tax
IS.description: Amount, after tax and reclassification, of gain (loss) from derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.

IS.label: Preferred Stock Dividends, Income Statement Impact
IS.description: The amount of preferred stock dividends that is an adjustment to net income apportioned to common stockholders.

IS.label: Research and Development Expense
IS.description: Amount of expense for research and development. Includes, but is not limited to, cost for computer software product to be sold, leased, or otherwise marketed and writeoff of research and development assets acquired in transaction other than business combination or joint venture formation or both. Excludes write-down of intangible asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, used in research and development activity.

IS.label: Amortization
IS.description: The aggregate amount of recurring noncash expense charged against earnings in the period to allocate the cost of assets over their estimated remaining economic lives.

IS.label: Equity Method Investment, Other than Temporary Impairment
IS.description: Amount of other-than-temporary decline in value that has been recognized against investment accounted for under equity method of accounting.

IS.label: Interest Income (Expense), Net
IS.description: Amount of interest income (expense) classified as operating.

IS.label: Net Periodic Defined Benefits Expense (Reversal of Expense), Excluding Service Cost Component
IS.description: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for net periodic benefit cost components, excluding service cost component, of defined benefit plan. Amount includes, but is not limited to, interest cost, expected (return) loss on plan asset, amortization of prior service cost (credit), amortization of (gain) loss, amortization of transition (asset) obligation, settlement (gain) loss, curtailment (gain) loss and certain termination benefits.

IS.label: Other Asset Impairment Charges
IS.description: The charge against earnings resulting from the write down of long lived assets other than goodwill due to the difference between the carrying value and lower fair value.

IS.label: Business Combination, Acquisition Related Costs
IS.description: Amount of expense for acquisition-related cost incurred to effect business combination. Includes, but is not limited to, finder's fee; advisory, legal, accounting, valuation, and other professional and consulting fees; and general administrative cost, including cost of maintaining internal acquisition department.

IS.label: Gain (Loss) on Investments
IS.description: Amount of realized and unrealized gain (loss) on investment.

IS.label: Gross Profit
IS.description: Aggregate revenue less cost of goods and services sold or operating expenses directly attributable to the revenue generation activity.

IS.label: Interest Expense, Debt
IS.description: Amount of the cost of borrowed funds accounted for as interest expense for debt.

IS.label: Regulated and Unregulated Operating Revenue
IS.description: The total amount of operating revenues recognized during the period.

IS.label: Selling, General and Administrative Expense
IS.description: The aggregate total costs related to selling a firm's product and services, as well as all other general and administrative expenses. Direct selling expenses (for example, credit, warranty, and advertising) are expenses that can be directly linked to the sale of specific products. Indirect selling expenses are expenses that cannot be directly linked to the sale of specific products, for example telephone expenses, Internet, and postal charges. General and administrative expenses include salaries of non-sales personnel, rent, utilities, communication, etc.

IS.label: Foreign Currency Transaction Gain (Loss), before Tax
IS.description: Amount, before tax, of realized and unrealized gain (loss) from foreign currency transaction.

IS.label: Fuel Costs
IS.description: Fuel costs incurred that are directly related to goods produced and sold and services rendered during the reporting period.

IS.label: Interest Costs Capitalized Adjustment
IS.description: Amount of interest costs capitalized disclosed as an adjusting item to interest costs incurred.

IS.label: Investment Income, Interest and Dividend
IS.description: Amount before accretion (amortization) of purchase discount (premium) of interest income and dividend income on nonoperating securities.

IS.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Gain (Loss) Arising During Period, Net of Tax
IS.description: Amount after tax, before reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature.

IS.label: Other Depreciation and Amortization
IS.description: Amount of expense charged against earnings to allocate the cost of tangible and intangible assets over their remaining economic lives, classified as other.

IS.label: Unregulated Operating Revenue
IS.description: The amount of unregulated operating revenues recognized during the period.

IS.label: Utilities Operating Expense, Depreciation and Amortization
IS.description: Amount of operating expense for depreciation and amortization of regulated operation.

IS.label: Utilities Operating Expense, Maintenance, Operations, and Other Costs and Expenses
IS.description: The amount of operating expenses for the period that are associated with the utility's normal revenue producing operation; including selling, general, and administrative expenses, costs incurred for routine plant repairs and maintenance, and operations.

IS.label: Utilities Operating Expense, Purchased Power
IS.description: Amount of operating expense for purchased power of regulated operation.

IS.label: Cost of Revenue
IS.description: The aggregate cost of goods produced and sold and services rendered during the reporting period.

IS.label: Gain (Loss) on Derivative Instruments, Net, Pretax
IS.description: Aggregate net gain (loss) on all derivative instruments recognized in earnings during the period, before tax effects.

IS.label: Interest and Debt Expense
IS.description: Interest and debt related expenses associated with nonoperating financing activities of the entity.

IS.label: Interest Income (Expense), Nonoperating, Net
IS.description: Amount of interest income (expense) classified as nonoperating.

IS.label: Investment Income, Net
IS.description: Amount after accretion (amortization) of discount (premium), and investment expense, of interest income and dividend income on nonoperating securities.

IS.label: Other Operating Income (Expense), Net
IS.description: The net amount of other operating income and expenses, the components of which are not separately disclosed on the income statement, from items that are associated with the entity's normal revenue producing operations.

IS.label: Utilities Operating Expense, Taxes
IS.description: Amount of operating expense for taxes other than income taxes of regulated operation.

IS.label: Discontinued Operation, Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operation, Net of Tax, Per Basic Share
IS.description: Per basic share amount, after tax, of income (loss) from the day-to-day business activities of the discontinued operation.

IS.label: Equity Method Investment, Realized Gain (Loss) on Disposal
IS.description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of an equity method investment.

IS.label: Interest Expense, Long-term Debt
IS.description: Aggregate amount of interest paid or due on all long-term debt.

IS.label: Loss Contingency, Loss in Period
IS.description: Amount of loss (reversal of loss) recognized for loss contingency liability. Includes, but is not limited to, effect of revision in previously reported estimate.

IS.label: Operating Costs and Expenses
IS.description: Generally recurring costs associated with normal operations except for the portion of these expenses which can be clearly related to production and included in cost of sales or services. Excludes Selling, General and Administrative Expense.

IS.label: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration Arrangements, Change in Amount of Contingent Consideration, Liability
IS.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in value of liability in contingent consideration arrangement in business combination, including, but not limited to, difference arising upon settlement.

IS.label: Discontinued Operation, Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operation, Net of Tax, Per Diluted Share
IS.description: Per diluted share amount, after tax, of income (loss) from the day-to-day business activities of the discontinued operation.

IS.label: Equity Securities, FV-NI, Gain (Loss)
IS.description: Amount of unrealized and realized gain (loss) on investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).

IS.label: Fair Value Adjustment of Warrants
IS.description: Amount of expense (income) related to adjustment to fair value of warrant liability.

IS.label: Interest Costs Incurred
IS.description: Total interest costs incurred during the period and either capitalized or charged against earnings.

IS.label: Marketable Securities, Unrealized Gain (Loss)
IS.description: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in marketable security.

IS.label: Preferred Stock Dividends and Other Adjustments
IS.description: The aggregate value of preferred stock dividends and other adjustments necessary to derive net income apportioned to common stockholders.

IS.label: Undistributed Earnings (Loss) Allocated to Participating Securities, Basic
IS.description: Amount of undistributed earnings (loss) allocated to participating securities for the basic earnings (loss) per share or per unit calculation under the two-class method.

IS.label: Utilities Operating Expense, Fuel Used
IS.description: Amount of operating expense for fuel used by regulated operation.

IS.label: Accretion Expense, Including Asset Retirement Obligations
IS.description: Amount of accretion expense, which includes, but is not limited to, accretion expense from asset retirement obligations, environmental remediation obligations, and other contingencies.

IS.label: Amortization of Nuclear Fuel Lease
IS.description: Amount of amortization of nuclear fuel.

IS.label: Cost, Depreciation and Amortization
IS.description: Amount of expense for allocation of cost of tangible and intangible assets over their useful lives directly used in production of good and rendering of service.

IS.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Assets and Asset Impairment Charges
IS.description: Amount of gain (loss) from the difference between the sale price or salvage price and the book value of an asset that was sold or retired, and gain (loss) from the write down of assets from their carrying value to fair value.

IS.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, Prior Service Cost (Credit), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, after Tax
IS.description: Amount, after tax, of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss for prior service cost (credit) of defined benefit plan.

IS.label: Other Operating Income
IS.description: The total amount of other operating income, the components of which are not separately disclosed on the income statement, from items that are associated with the entity's normal revenue producing operation.

IS.label: Regulated Operating Revenue
IS.description: The total amount of regulated operating revenues recognized during the period.

IS.label: Stockholders' Equity Note, Stock Split, Conversion Ratio
IS.description: Ratio applied to the conversion of stock split, for example but not limited to, one share converted to two or two shares converted to one.

IS.label: Taxes, Other
IS.description: Amount of tax expense classified as other.

IS.label: Utilities Operating Expense
IS.description: Amount of operating expense of regulated operation.

IS.label: Business Combination, Integration Related Costs
IS.description: Amount of expense for integration-related cost incurred in connection with business combination. Includes system integration and conversion costs; severance and other employee-related costs; restructuring and other post-combination costs. Excludes acquisition-related cost incurred to effect business combination; cost to issue debt or equity securities; and cost related to acquisition of asset.

IS.label: Cost of Goods and Service, Excluding Depreciation, Depletion, and Amortization
IS.description: Cost of product sold and service rendered, excluding depreciation, depletion, and amortization.

IS.label: Depreciation, Nonproduction
IS.description: The expense recognized in the current period that allocates the cost of nonproduction tangible assets over their useful lives.

IS.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Net of Tax, Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
IS.description: Amount after tax of income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

IS.label: Interest Expense, Short-term Borrowings
IS.description: The aggregate interest expense incurred on short-term borrowings including commercial paper and Federal funds purchased and securities sold under agreements to repurchase.

IS.label: OCI, Equity Method Investment, after Tax
IS.description: Amount, after tax, of other comprehensive income (loss) (OCI) for proportionate share of equity method investee's OCI.

IS.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Other Cost (Credit)
IS.description: Amount of defined benefit plan cost (credit), classified as other.

IS.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Accounts Receivable
IS.description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale of accounts receivable.

IS.label: Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent, before Tax
IS.description: Amount, before tax, of income (loss) attributable to parent. Includes, but is not limited to, income (loss) from continuing operations, discontinued operations and equity method investments.

IS.label: Labor and Related Expense
IS.description: Amount of expense for salary, wage, profit sharing; incentive and equity-based compensation; and other employee benefit.

IS.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Nonredeemable Noncontrolling Interest
IS.description: Portion of net income (loss) attributable to nonredeemable noncontrolling interest.

IS.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Transition Asset (Obligation), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, after Tax
IS.description: Amount, after tax, of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for transition asset (obligation) of defined benefit plan.

IS.label: Other Expenses
IS.description: Amount of expense classified as other.

IS.label: Regulated Operating Revenue, Electric, Non-Nuclear
IS.description: The amount of regulated power revenues recognized during the period.

IS.label: Excise Taxes Collected
IS.description: The excise taxes collected by a public utility and reported in revenues if the amount of excise taxes is equal to 1 percent or more of such total.

IS.label: Gain (Loss) on Hedging Activity
IS.description: Gain (loss) incurred in hedging activities.

IS.label: Other General Expense
IS.description: Amount of general expenses not normally included in Other Operating Costs and Expenses.

IS.label: Temporary Equity, Accretion to Redemption Value, Adjustment
IS.description: Amount of decrease to net income for accretion of temporary equity to its redemption value to derive net income apportioned to common stockholders.

IS.label: Utilities Operating Expense, Operations
IS.description: Amount of operating expense for routine operations of regulated operation.

IS.label: Utilities Operating Expense, Products and Services
IS.description: Amount of operating expense for products and services of regulated operation.

IS.label: Amortization of Deferred Sales Commissions
IS.description: The amount of expense recognized in the current period for the periodic realization of capitalized fees that were paid to salespeople, distributors, brokers, and agents at the time of the conclusion of the sale. As a noncash expense, this element is added back to net income when calculating cash provided by or used in operations using the indirect method.

IS.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Amount Recognized in Net Periodic Benefit Cost (Credit) and Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, before Tax
IS.description: Amount recognized in net periodic benefit cost (credit) and other comprehensive (income) loss.

IS.label: Contract with Customer, Liability, Cumulative Catch-up Adjustment to Revenue, Change in Estimate of Transaction Price
IS.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in revenue recognized for cumulative catch-up adjustment from change in estimate of transaction price which (increases) decreases obligation to transfer good or service to customer for which consideration from customer has been received or is due. Includes, but is not limited to, change in assessment of whether estimate of variable consideration is constrained.

IS.label: Cost, Direct Material
IS.description: Cost of material used for good produced and service rendered.

IS.label: Direct Communications and Utilities Costs
IS.description: The aggregate costs of direct communications and utilities incurred during the reporting period.

IS.label: Exploration Abandonment and Impairment Expense
IS.description: Amount of impairment loss for oil and gas properties with unproved reserve in oil- and gas-producing activities. Includes, but is not limited to, previously capitalized cost of drilling exploratory well when proved reserve is not found or when there is substantial doubt about economic or operational viability of project.

IS.label: Exploration Expense
IS.description: Exploration expenses (including prospecting) related to oil and gas producing entities and would be included in operating expenses of that entity. Costs incurred in identifying areas that may warrant examination and in examining specific areas that are considered to have prospects of containing oil and gas reserves, including costs of drilling exploratory wells and exploratory-type stratigraphic test wells. Exploration costs may be incurred both before acquiring the related property (sometimes referred to in part as prospecting costs) and after acquiring the property. Principal types of exploration costs, which include depreciation and applicable operating costs of support equipment and facilities and other costs of exploration activities, are: (i) Costs of topographical, geographical and geophysical studies, rights of access to properties to conduct those studies, and salaries and other expenses of geologists, geophysical crews, and others conducting those studies. Collectively, these are sometimes referred to as geological and geophysical or "G&G" costs. (ii) Costs of carrying and retaining undeveloped properties, such as delay rentals, ad valorem taxes on properties, legal costs for title defense, and the maintenance of land and lease records. (iii) Dry hole contributions and bottom hole contributions. (iv) Costs of drilling and equipping exploratory wells. (v) Costs of drilling exploratory-type stratigraphic test wells.

IS.label: Income (Loss), Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest, before Tax
IS.description: Amount, before tax, of income (loss) including portion attributable to noncontrolling interest. Includes, but is not limited to, income (loss) from continuing operations, discontinued operations and equity method investments.

IS.label: Interest Expense, Debt, Excluding Amortization
IS.description: Represents the portion of interest incurred in the period on debt arrangements that was charged against earnings, excluding amortization of debt discount (premium) and financing costs.

IS.label: Pro Forma Weighted Average Shares Outstanding, Diluted
IS.description: The weighted average number of shares or units and dilutive common stock or unit equivalents outstanding in the calculation of proforma diluted earnings per share (earnings per unit), which is commonly presented in initial public offerings based on the terms of the offering.

IS.label: Selling and Marketing Expense
IS.description: The aggregate total amount of expenses directly related to the marketing or selling of products or services.

IS.label: Utilities Operating Expense, Gas and Petroleum Purchased
IS.description: Amount of operating expense for purchased gas and petroleum of regulated operation.

IS.label: Utilities Operating Expense, Maintenance
IS.description: Amount of operating expense for routine plant maintenance and repairs of regulated operation.

CF.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Financing Activities
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from financing activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Financing activity includes, but is not limited to, obtaining resource from owner and providing return on, and return of, their investment; borrowing money and repaying amount borrowed, or settling obligation; and obtaining and paying for other resource obtained from creditor on long-term credit.

CF.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Investing Activities
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from investing activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Investing activity includes, but is not limited to, making and collecting loan, acquiring and disposing of debt and equity instruments, property, plant, and equipment, and other productive assets.

CF.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activities
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Operating activity includes, but is not limited to, transaction, adjustment, and change in value not defined as investing or financing activity.

CF.label: Cash and Cash Equivalents, at Carrying Value
CF.description: Amount of cash and cash equivalent. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

CF.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent
CF.description: The portion of profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, which is attributable to the parent.

CF.label: Cash, Cash Equivalents, Restricted Cash and Restricted Cash Equivalents
CF.description: Amount of cash and cash equivalent, and cash and cash equivalent restricted to withdrawal or usage; attributable to continuing operation. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

CF.label: Interest Paid, Excluding Capitalized Interest, Operating Activities
CF.description: Amount of cash paid for interest, excluding capitalized interest, classified as operating activity. Includes, but is not limited to, payment to settle zero-coupon bond for accreted interest of debt discount and debt instrument with insignificant coupon interest rate in relation to effective interest rate of borrowing attributable to accreted interest of debt discount.

CF.label: Cash, Cash Equivalents, Restricted Cash and Restricted Cash Equivalents, Period Increase (Decrease), Including Exchange Rate Effect
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in cash and cash equivalent, and cash and cash equivalent restricted to withdrawal or usage; including effect from exchange rate change and including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

CF.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Common Stock
CF.description: The cash inflow from the additional capital contribution to the entity.

CF.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Long-term Debt
CF.description: The cash inflow from a debt initially having maturity due after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer.

CF.label: Net Income (Loss), Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
CF.description: The consolidated profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

CF.label: Deferred Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
CF.description: Amount of deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Property, Plant, and Equipment
CF.description: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of long-lived, physical assets that are used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale; includes cash outflows to pay for construction of self-constructed assets.

CF.label: Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization
CF.description: The aggregate expense recognized in the current period that allocates the cost of tangible assets, intangible assets, or depleting assets to periods that benefit from use of the assets.

CF.label: Income Taxes Paid, Net
CF.description: Amount, after refund, of cash paid to foreign, federal, state, and local jurisdictions as income tax.

CF.label: Repayments of Long-term Debt
CF.description: The cash outflow for debt initially having maturity due after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

CF.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Other Investing Activities
CF.description: Amount of cash (inflow) outflow from investing activity, classified as other.

CF.label: Proceeds from (Payments for) Other Financing Activities
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from financing activity, classified as other.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Payable
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of liabilities incurred (and for which invoices have typically been received) and payable to vendors for goods and services received that are used in an entity's business.

CF.label: Capital Expenditures Incurred but Not yet Paid
CF.description: Future cash outflow to pay for purchases of fixed assets that have occurred.

CF.label: Depreciation
CF.description: The amount of expense recognized in the current period that reflects the allocation of the cost of tangible assets over the assets' useful lives. Includes production and non-production related depreciation.

CF.label: Asset Retirement Obligation, Accretion Expense
CF.description: Amount of accretion expense recognized during the period that is associated with an asset retirement obligation. Accretion expense measures and incorporates changes due to the passage of time into the carrying amount of the liability.

CF.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Noncash Expense
CF.description: Amount of noncash expense for share-based payment arrangement.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Inventories
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate value of all inventory held by the reporting entity, associated with underlying transactions that are classified as operating activities.

CF.label: Right-of-Use Asset Obtained in Exchange for Operating Lease Liability
CF.description: Amount of increase in right-of-use asset obtained in exchange for operating lease liability.

CF.label: Payments of Ordinary Dividends, Common Stock
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow in the form of ordinary dividends to common shareholders of the parent entity.

CF.label: Income (Loss) from Equity Method Investments
CF.description: Amount of income (loss) for proportionate share of equity method investee's income (loss).

CF.label: Investment Income, Interest
CF.description: Amount before accretion (amortization) of purchase discount (premium) of interest income on nonoperating securities.

CF.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Short-term Debt
CF.description: The net cash inflow or outflow for borrowing having initial term of repayment within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

CF.label: Asset Impairment Charges
CF.description: Amount of impairment loss for asset. Includes, but is not limited to, tangible and intangible assets and goodwill.

CF.label: Amortization of Intangible Assets
CF.description: Amount of amortization expense for finite-lived intangible asset. Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

CF.label: Payments for Repurchase of Common Stock
CF.description: The cash outflow to reacquire common stock during the period.

CF.label: Restricted Cash and Cash Equivalents, Current
CF.description: Amount of cash and cash equivalent restricted as to withdrawal or usage, classified as current. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

CF.label: Gain (Loss) on Extinguishment of Debt
CF.description: Difference between the fair value of payments made and the carrying amount of debt which is extinguished prior to maturity.

CF.label: Public Utilities, Allowance for Funds Used During Construction, Capitalized Cost of Equity
CF.description: The component of the allowance for funds used during construction during the period based on an assumed rate of return on equity funds used in financing the construction of regulated assets.

CF.label: Cash, Cash Equivalents, Restricted Cash and Restricted Cash Equivalents, Period Increase (Decrease), Excluding Exchange Rate Effect
CF.description: Amount, excluding effect from change in exchange rate, of increase (decrease) in cash and cash equivalent, and cash and cash equivalent restricted to withdrawal or usage; including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Receivable
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in amount due within one year (or one business cycle) from customers for the credit sale of goods and services.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Operating Assets and Liabilities, Net
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in operating assets after deduction of operating liabilities classified as other.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Businesses, Net of Cash Acquired
CF.description: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of a business, net of the cash acquired from the purchase.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Productive Assets
CF.description: The cash outflow for purchases of and capital improvements on property, plant and equipment (capital expenditures), software, and other intangible assets.

CF.label: Finance Lease, Principal Payments
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow for principal payment on finance lease.

CF.label: Goodwill, Impairment Loss
CF.description: Amount of impairment loss from asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

CF.label: Accounts Receivable, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
CF.description: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for expected credit loss on accounts receivable.

CF.label: Impairment of Long-Lived Assets Held-for-use
CF.description: Amount of impairment loss for long-lived asset held and used. Includes, but is not limited to, impairment loss for long-lived asset to be disposed of other than by sale.

CF.label: Income Taxes Paid
CF.description: Amount, before refund, of cash paid to foreign, federal, state, and local jurisdictions as income tax.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amounts payable to vendors for goods and services received and the amount of obligations and expenses incurred but not paid.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Operating Assets
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in operating assets classified as other.

CF.label: Other Noncash Income (Expense)
CF.description: Amount of income (expense) included in net income that results in no cash inflow (outflow), classified as other.

CF.label: Payments of Stock Issuance Costs
CF.description: The cash outflow for cost incurred directly with the issuance of an equity security.

CF.label: Proceeds from Noncontrolling Interests
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow from a noncontrolling interest. Includes, but is not limited to, purchase of additional shares or other increase in noncontrolling interest ownership.

CF.label: Right-of-Use Asset Obtained in Exchange for Finance Lease Liability
CF.description: Amount of increase in right-of-use asset obtained in exchange for finance lease liability.

CF.label: Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Derivatives
CF.description: The net change in the difference between the fair value and the carrying value, or in the comparative fair values, of derivative instruments, including options, swaps, futures, and forward contracts, held at each balance sheet date, that was included in earnings for the period.

CF.label: Derivative, Gain (Loss) on Derivative, Net
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in the fair value of derivatives recognized in the income statement.

CF.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Net of Tax, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
CF.description: Amount after tax of income (loss) from continuing operations including portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

CF.label: Restricted Cash and Cash Equivalents
CF.description: Amount of cash and cash equivalent restricted as to withdrawal or usage. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

CF.label: Deferred Income Taxes and Tax Credits
CF.description: Amount of deferred income tax expense (benefit) and income tax credits.

CF.label: Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization, Nonproduction
CF.description: The current period expense charged against earnings on long-lived, physical assets not used in production, and which are not intended for resale, to allocate or recognize the cost of such assets over their useful lives; or to record the reduction in book value of an intangible asset over the benefit period of such asset; or to reflect consumption during the period of an asset that is not used in production.

CF.label: Proceeds from Equity Method Investment, Distribution
CF.description: Amount of distribution received from equity method investee for return on investment, classified as operating activities. Excludes distribution for return of investment, classified as investing activities.

CF.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Assets
CF.description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of assets, including but not limited to property plant and equipment, intangible assets and equity in securities of subsidiaries or equity method investee.

CF.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Net of Tax, Attributable to Parent
CF.description: Amount after tax of income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to the parent.

CF.label: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
CF.description: Amount after tax of income (loss) from a discontinued operation including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest. Includes, but is not limited to, the income (loss) from operations during the phase-out period, gain (loss) on disposal, gain (loss) for reversal of write-down (write-down) to fair value, less cost to sell, and adjustments to a prior period gain (loss) on disposal.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Operating Liabilities
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in operating liabilities classified as other.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Prepaid Expense
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount of outstanding money paid in advance for goods or services that bring economic benefits for future periods.

CF.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activities, Continuing Operations
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activity attributable to continuing operation. Operating activity includes, but is not limited to, transaction, adjustment, and change in value not defined as investing or financing activity.

CF.label: Other Operating Activities, Cash Flow Statement
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activity, classified as other, in reconciling net income to reflect cash provided by (used in) operating activity when indirect cash flow method is applied.

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale of Property, Plant, and Equipment
CF.description: The cash inflow from the sale of long-lived, physical assets that are used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale.

CF.label: Proceeds from Stock Options Exercised
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow from exercise of option under share-based payment arrangement.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Income Taxes Payable
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the period in the amount due for taxes based on the reporting entity's earnings or attributable to the entity's income earning process (business presence) within a given jurisdiction.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Current Assets
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in current assets classified as other.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Receivables
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the total amount due within one year (or one operating cycle) from all parties, associated with underlying transactions that are classified as operating activities.

CF.label: Payments of Ordinary Dividends, Preferred Stock and Preference Stock
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow in the form of ordinary dividends to preferred shareholders of the parent entity.

CF.label: Proceeds from Divestiture of Businesses
CF.description: The cash inflow associated with the amount received from the sale of a portion of the company's business, for example a segment, division, branch or other business, during the period.

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale of Productive Assets
CF.description: The cash inflow from the sale of property, plant and equipment (capital expenditures), software, and other intangible assets.

CF.label: Cash, Cash Equivalents, Restricted Cash and Restricted Cash Equivalents, Including Disposal Group and Discontinued Operations
CF.description: Amount of cash and cash equivalent, and cash and cash equivalent restricted to withdrawal or usage; including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

CF.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Other Assets
CF.description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of other assets.

CF.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Property Plant Equipment
CF.description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of property, plant and equipment assets, including oil and gas property and timber property.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Regulatory Assets and Liabilities
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the value of assets that are created when regulatory agencies permits public utilities to defer costs (revenues) to the balance sheet. This element is a the increase (decrease) of regulatory assets and liabilities combined.

CF.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Financing Activities, Continuing Operations
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from financing activity attributable to continuing operation. Financing activity includes, but is not limited to, obtaining resource from owner and providing return on, and return of, their investment; borrowing money and repaying amount borrowed, or settling obligation; and obtaining and paying for other resource obtained from creditor on long-term credit.

CF.label: Pension and Other Postretirement Benefits Cost (Reversal of Cost)
CF.description: Amount of cost (reversal of cost) for pension and other postretirement benefits.

CF.label: Proceeds from Lines of Credit
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow from contractual arrangement with the lender, including but not limited to, letter of credit, standby letter of credit and revolving credit arrangements.

CF.label: Proceeds from Short-term Debt
CF.description: The cash inflow from a borrowing having initial term of repayment within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

CF.label: Repayments of Short-term Debt
CF.description: The cash outflow for a borrowing having initial term of repayment within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

CF.label: Disposal Group, Not Discontinued Operation, Gain (Loss) on Disposal
CF.description: Amount before tax of gain (loss) recognized on the sale or disposal of a disposal group. Excludes discontinued operations.

CF.label: Repayments of Lines of Credit
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow for payment of an obligation from a lender, including but not limited to, letter of credit, standby letter of credit and revolving credit arrangements.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accrued Liabilities
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of expenses incurred but not yet paid.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Prepaid Expense and Other Assets
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in prepaid expenses, and assets classified as other.

CF.label: Interest Costs Capitalized
CF.description: Amount of interest capitalized during the period.

CF.label: Interest Paid, Including Capitalized Interest, Operating and Investing Activities
CF.description: Amount of cash paid for interest, including, but not limited to, capitalized interest and payment to settle zero-coupon bond attributable to accreted interest of debt discount and debt instrument with insignificant coupon interest rate in relation to effective interest rate of borrowing attributable to accreted interest of debt discount; classified as operating and investing activities.

CF.label: Payments of Debt Issuance Costs
CF.description: The cash outflow paid to third parties in connection with debt origination, which will be amortized over the remaining maturity period of the associated long-term debt.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Equity Method Investments
CF.description: The cash outflow associated with the purchase of or advances to an equity method investments, which are investments in joint ventures and entities in which the entity has an equity ownership interest normally of 20 to 50 percent and exercises significant influence.

CF.label: Payments to Noncontrolling Interests
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow to a noncontrolling interest. Includes, but not limited to, reduction of noncontrolling interest ownership. Excludes dividends paid to the noncontrolling interest.

CF.label: Payment for Pension Benefits
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow for pension benefit. Includes, but is not limited to, employer contribution to fund plan asset and payment to retiree. Excludes other postretirement benefit.

CF.label: Amortization of Debt Issuance Costs
CF.description: Amount of amortization expense attributable to debt issuance costs.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Noncurrent Assets
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in noncurrent assets classified as other.

CF.label: Payment, Tax Withholding, Share-based Payment Arrangement
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow to satisfy grantee's tax withholding obligation for award under share-based payment arrangement.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Intangible Assets
CF.description: The cash outflow to acquire asset without physical form usually arising from contractual or other legal rights, excluding goodwill.

CF.label: Proceeds from Convertible Debt
CF.description: The cash inflow from the issuance of a long-term debt instrument which can be exchanged for a specified amount of another security, typically the entity's common stock, at the option of the issuer or the holder.

CF.label: Public Utilities, Allowance for Funds Used During Construction, Additions
CF.description: Total increase in earnings in the period representing the cost of equity (based on assumed rate of return) and/or borrowed funds (based on interest rate) used to finance construction of regulated assets, which is expected to be recovered through rate adjustments.

CF.label: Repayments of Related Party Debt
CF.description: The cash outflow for the payment of a long-term borrowing made from a related party where one party can exercise control or significant influence over another party; including affiliates, owners or officers and their immediate families, pension trusts, and so forth. Alternate caption: Payments for Advances from Affiliates.

CF.label: Depreciation, Amortization and Accretion, Net
CF.description: The aggregate net amount of depreciation, amortization, and accretion recognized during an accounting period. As a noncash item, the net amount is added back to net income when calculating cash provided by or used in operations using the indirect method.

CF.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Business
CF.description: Amount of gain (loss) from sale and disposal of integrated set of activities and assets capable of being conducted and managed for purpose of providing return in form of dividend, lower cost, or other economic benefit to investor, owner, member and participant.

CF.label: Gain (Loss) Related to Litigation Settlement
CF.description: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in settlement of litigation and insurance claims. Excludes claims within an insurance entity's normal claims settlement process.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Interest Payable, Net
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in interest payable, which represents the amount owed to note holders, bond holders, and other parties for interest earned on loans or credit extended to the reporting entity.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Noncurrent Liabilities
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in noncurrent operating liabilities classified as other.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Regulatory Liabilities
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in regulated liabilities. Regulated liabilities are created when regulatory agency permits an entity to defer revenues to the balance sheet.

CF.label: Payments for Repurchase of Preferred Stock and Preference Stock
CF.description: The cash outflow to reacquire preferred stock during the period.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Investments
CF.description: The cash outflow associated with the purchase of all investments (debt, security, other) during the period.

CF.label: Proceeds from Equity Method Investment, Distribution, Return of Capital
CF.description: Amount of distribution received from equity method investee for return of investment, classified as investing activities. Excludes distribution for return on investment, classified as operating activities.

CF.label: Restricted Cash, Current
CF.description: Amount of cash restricted as to withdrawal or usage, classified as current. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits.

CF.label: Stock Issued
CF.description: The fair value of stock issued in noncash financing activities.

CF.label: Amortization
CF.description: The aggregate amount of recurring noncash expense charged against earnings in the period to allocate the cost of assets over their estimated remaining economic lives.

CF.label: Amortization of Debt Discount (Premium)
CF.description: Amount of noncash expense included in interest expense to amortize debt discount and premium associated with the related debt instruments. Excludes amortization of financing costs. Alternate captions include noncash interest expense.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Current Liabilities
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in current liabilities classified as other.

CF.label: Other Asset Impairment Charges
CF.description: The charge against earnings resulting from the write down of long lived assets other than goodwill due to the difference between the carrying value and lower fair value.

CF.label: Payments of Dividends
CF.description: Cash outflow in the form of capital distributions and dividends to common shareholders, preferred shareholders and noncontrolling interests.

CF.label: Payments of Ordinary Dividends, Noncontrolling Interest
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow in the form of ordinary dividends provided by the non-wholly owned subsidiary to noncontrolling interests.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Investments to be Held in Decommissioning Trust Fund
CF.description: The cash outflow for the purchase of investments that will be held in a decommissioning trust fund.

CF.label: Payment for Pension and Other Postretirement Benefits
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow for pension and other postretirement benefits. Includes, but is not limited to, employer contribution to fund plan asset and payment to retiree.

CF.label: Proceeds from Decommissioning Trust Fund Assets
CF.description: The cash inflow from the sale of assets held in a decommissioning trust fund.

CF.label: Gain (Loss) on Investments
CF.description: Amount of realized and unrealized gain (loss) on investment.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Income Taxes Receivable
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in income taxes receivable, which represents the amount due from tax authorities for refunds of overpayments or recoveries of income taxes paid.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Regulatory Assets
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the value of other assets that are created when regulatory agencies permits public utilities to defer costs to the balance sheet.

CF.label: Payments of Financing Costs
CF.description: The cash outflow for loan and debt issuance costs.

CF.label: Proceeds from Insurance Settlement, Investing Activities
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow for proceeds from settlement of insurance claim, classified as investing activities. Excludes insurance settlement classified as operating activities.

CF.label: Proceeds from Notes Payable
CF.description: The cash inflow from a borrowing supported by a written promise to pay an obligation.

CF.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Financing Activities, Discontinued Operations
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from financing activity attributable to discontinued operation. Financing activity includes, but is not limited to, obtaining resource from owner and providing return on, and return of, their investment; borrowing money and repaying amount borrowed, or settling obligation; and obtaining and paying for other resource obtained from creditor on long-term credit.

CF.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activities, Discontinued Operations
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activity attributable to discontinued operation. Operating activity includes, but is not limited to, transaction, adjustment, and change in value not defined as investing or financing activity.

CF.label: Effect of Exchange Rate on Cash, Cash Equivalents, Restricted Cash and Restricted Cash Equivalents
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) from effect of exchange rate change on cash and cash equivalent, and cash and cash equivalent restricted to withdrawal or usage; held in foreign currency; attributable to continuing operation. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

CF.label: Foreign Currency Transaction Gain (Loss), before Tax
CF.description: Amount, before tax, of realized and unrealized gain (loss) from foreign currency transaction.

CF.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Property Plant Equipment, Excluding Oil and Gas Property and Timber Property
CF.description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of property, plant and equipment assets, excluding oil and gas property and timber property.

CF.label: Income (Loss) from Equity Method Investments, Net of Dividends or Distributions
CF.description: This element represents the undistributed income (or loss) of equity method investments, net of dividends or other distributions received from unconsolidated subsidiaries, certain corporate joint ventures, and certain noncontrolled corporations; such investments are accounted for under the equity method of accounting. This element excludes distributions that constitute a return of investment, which are classified as investing activities.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts and Other Receivables
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount due from customers for the credit sale of goods and services; includes accounts receivable and other types of receivables.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accrued Taxes Payable
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period of all taxes owed but not paid, including income, property and other taxes.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Obligation, Pension and Other Postretirement Benefits
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in obligation for pension and other postretirement benefits. Includes, but is not limited to, defined benefit and defined contribution plans.

CF.label: Operating Lease, Expense
CF.description: Amount of operating lease expense. Excludes sublease income.

CF.label: Operating Lease, Right-of-Use Asset, Amortization Expense
CF.description: Amount of periodic reduction over lease term of carrying amount of right-of-use asset from operating lease.

CF.label: Other Depreciation and Amortization
CF.description: Amount of expense charged against earnings to allocate the cost of tangible and intangible assets over their remaining economic lives, classified as other.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Other Investments
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow to acquire investments classified as other.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Short-term Investments
CF.description: The cash outflow for securities or other assets acquired, which qualify for treatment as an investing activity and are to be liquidated, if necessary, within the current operating cycle. Includes cash flows from securities classified as trading securities that were acquired for reasons other than sale in the short-term.

CF.label: Proceeds from Related Party Debt
CF.description: The cash inflow from a long-term borrowing made from related parties where one party can exercise control or significant influence over another party; including affiliates, owners or officers and their immediate families, pension trusts, and so forth. Alternate caption: Proceeds from Advances from Affiliates.

CF.label: Repayments of Other Long-term Debt
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow for the payment of debt classified as other, maturing after one year or the operating cycle, if longer.

CF.label: Utilities Operating Expense, Depreciation and Amortization
CF.description: Amount of operating expense for depreciation and amortization of regulated operation.

CF.label: Accretion Expense
CF.description: Amount recognized for the passage of time, typically for liabilities, that have been discounted to their net present values. Excludes accretion associated with asset retirement obligations.

CF.label: Cash Acquired from Acquisition
CF.description: The cash inflow associated with the acquisition of business during the period (for example, cash that was held by the acquired business).

CF.label: Gain (Loss) on Derivative Instruments, Net, Pretax
CF.description: Aggregate net gain (loss) on all derivative instruments recognized in earnings during the period, before tax effects.

CF.label: Income Tax Credits and Adjustments
CF.description: A credit or adjustment for government or taxing authority authorized decrease in taxes owed as a result of meeting certain tax policy conditions.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Contract with Customer, Liability
