CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in obligation to transfer good or service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Revenue
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in deferred income and obligation to transfer product and service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Derivative Assets and Liabilities
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the period in the net carrying value of derivative instruments reported as assets and liabilities that are due to be disposed of within one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer).

CF.label: IncreaseDecreaseInOperatingLeaseLiability
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in obligation for operating lease.

CF.label: Payments of Distributions to Affiliates
CF.description: The distributions of earnings to an entity that is affiliated with the reporting entity by means of direct or indirect ownership.

CF.label: Proceeds from Contributions from Affiliates
CF.description: The cash inflow from an entity that is affiliated with the entity by means of direct or indirect ownership.

CF.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Debt
CF.description: The cash inflow during the period from additional borrowings in aggregate debt. Includes proceeds from short-term and long-term debt.

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale and Maturity of Marketable Securities
CF.description: The cash inflow associated with the aggregate amount received by the entity through sale or maturity of marketable securities (held-to-maturity or available-for-sale) during the period.

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale of Other Productive Assets
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow from the sale of tangible or intangible assets used to produce goods or deliver services, classified as other.

CF.label: Repayments of Notes Payable
CF.description: The cash outflow for a borrowing supported by a written promise to pay an obligation.

CF.label: Restricted Cash, Noncurrent
CF.description: Amount of cash restricted as to withdrawal or usage, classified as noncurrent. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits.

CF.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Investments
CF.description: The net realized gain (loss) on investments sold during the period, not including gains (losses) on securities separately or otherwise categorized as trading, available-for-sale, or held-to-maturity, which, for cash flow reporting, is a component of proceeds from investing activities.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Deposit Assets
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in moneys or securities given as security including, but not limited to, contract, escrow, or earnest money deposits, retainage (if applicable), deposits with clearing organizations and others, collateral, or margin deposits.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Margin Deposits Outstanding
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in money or securities placed with a broker or counterparty as security for a trading or derivative position.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Operating Capital
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in asset and (increase) decrease in liability, used in operating activity in reconciling net income to reflect cash provided by (used in) operating activity when indirect cash flow method is applied.

CF.label: Payment for Debt Extinguishment or Debt Prepayment Cost
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow for cost from early extinguishment and prepayment of debt. Includes, but is not limited to, third-party cost, premium paid, and other fee paid to lender directly for debt extinguishment or debt prepayment. Excludes accrued interest.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Debt Securities, Available-for-sale
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow to acquire investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Marketable Securities
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow for purchase of marketable security.

CF.label: Proceeds from Issuance Initial Public Offering
CF.description: The cash inflow associated with the amount received from entity's first offering of stock to the public.

CF.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Private Placement
CF.description: The cash inflow associated with the amount received from entity's raising of capital via private rather than public placement.

CF.label: Proceeds from Long-term Lines of Credit
CF.description: The cash inflow from a contractual arrangement with the lender, including letter of credit, standby letter of credit and revolving credit arrangements, under which borrowings can be made up to a specific amount at any point in time with maturities due beyond one year or the operating cycle, if longer.

CF.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Commercial Paper
CF.description: The net cash inflow or cash outflow from issuing (borrowing) and repaying commercial paper.

CF.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Short-term Debt, Maturing in Three Months or Less
CF.description: The cash inflow from a borrowing net of the cash outflow from repayment of a borrowing having initial term of repayment within three months.

CF.label: Sale of Stock, Consideration Received on Transaction
CF.description: Cash received on stock transaction after deduction of issuance costs.

CF.label: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration Arrangements, Change in Amount of Contingent Consideration, Liability
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in value of liability in contingent consideration arrangement in business combination, including, but not limited to, difference arising upon settlement.

CF.label: Debt Conversion, Converted Instrument, Amount
CF.description: The value of the financial instrument(s) that the original debt is being converted into in a noncash (or part noncash) transaction. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

CF.label: Effect of Exchange Rate on Cash, Cash Equivalents, Restricted Cash and Restricted Cash Equivalents, Including Disposal Group and Discontinued Operations
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) from effect of exchange rate change on cash and cash equivalent, and cash and cash equivalent restricted to withdrawal or usage; held in foreign currency; including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

CF.label: Equity Securities, FV-NI, Gain (Loss)
CF.description: Amount of unrealized and realized gain (loss) on investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).

CF.label: Fair Value Adjustment of Warrants
CF.description: Amount of expense (income) related to adjustment to fair value of warrant liability.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Fuel Costs
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in carrying amount of capitalized fuel costs of a regulated entity that are expected to be recoverable through rate adjustments within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Materials and Supplies
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the period in the carrying amount of capitalized costs of materials, supplies, or both, which are not included in inventory.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Current Assets and Liabilities, Net
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in current operating assets after deduction of current operating liabilities classified as other.

CF.label: Marketable Securities, Unrealized Gain (Loss)
CF.description: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in marketable security.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Additional Interest in Subsidiaries
CF.description: The cash outflow associated with the purchase of noncontrolling interest during the period.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Other Productive Assets
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow for the purchase of or improvements to tangible or intangible assets, used to produce goods or deliver services, classified as other.

CF.label: Proceeds from Contribution in Aid of Construction
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow from contribution in aid of construction, classified as investing activity. Includes, but is not limited to, contribution from developer, builder, government agency, and municipality.

CF.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Other Debt
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) for debt classified as other.

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale of Debt Securities, Available-for-sale
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow from sale of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale of Interest in Partnership Unit
CF.description: The proceeds from the sale of an interest in a unit of partnership.

CF.label: Repayments of Long-term Lines of Credit
CF.description: The cash outflow for the settlement of obligation drawn from a contractual arrangement with the lender, including letter of credit, standby letter of credit and revolving credit arrangements, under which borrowings can be made up to a specific amount at any point in time with maturities due beyond one year or the operating cycle, if longer.

CF.label: Repayments of Other Short-term Debt
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow for the payment of debt classified as other, maturing within one year or the operating cycle, if longer.

CF.label: Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Derivatives and Commodity Contracts
CF.description: The net change in the difference between the fair value and the carrying value, or in the comparative fair values, of open derivatives, commodity, or energy contracts, held at each balance sheet date, that was included in earnings for the period.

CF.label: Amortization of Debt Issuance Costs and Discounts
CF.description: Amount of amortization expense attributable to debt discount (premium) and debt issuance costs.

CF.label: Amortization of Nuclear Fuel Lease
CF.description: Amount of amortization of nuclear fuel.

CF.label: Asset Retirement Obligation, Cash Paid to Settle
CF.description: Amount of cash paid during the period to settle an asset retirement obligation. Amounts paid to settle an asset retirement obligation are generally included in the operating section of the Statement of Cash Flows.

CF.label: Fair Value of Assets Acquired
CF.description: The fair value of assets acquired in noncash investing or financing activities.

CF.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Assets and Asset Impairment Charges
CF.description: Amount of gain (loss) from the difference between the sale price or salvage price and the book value of an asset that was sold or retired, and gain (loss) from the write down of assets from their carrying value to fair value.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Payable, Trade
CF.description: Change in recurring obligations of a business that arise from the acquisition of merchandise, materials, supplies and services used in the production and sale of goods and services.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Contract with Customer, Asset
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Fuel Inventories
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the value of fuel held in inventory.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Income Taxes
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amounts payable to taxing authorities for taxes that are based on the reporting entity's earnings, net of amounts receivable from taxing authorities for refunds of overpayments or recoveries of income taxes, and in deferred and other tax liabilities and assets.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Receivables
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in receivables classified as other.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Prepaid Taxes
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) of consideration paid in advance for income and other taxes that provide economic benefits in future periods.

CF.label: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Value of Liabilities Assumed
CF.description: The total amount of [all] liabilities that an Entity assumes in acquiring a business or in consideration for an asset received in a noncash (or part noncash) acquisition. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

CF.label: Amortization of Other Deferred Charges
CF.description: Amount of amortization of other deferred costs recognized in the income statement.

CF.label: Payments for Advance to Affiliate
CF.description: The cash outflow from advancing money to an affiliate (an entity that is related but not strictly controlled by the entity).

CF.label: Payments for Nuclear Fuel
CF.description: Cash outflow associated with the purchase of any material that is commonly used in the generation of nuclear energy.

CF.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Investments
CF.description: The net cash paid (received) associated with the acquisition or disposal of all investments, including securities and other assets.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Assets, Investing Activities
CF.description: Aggregate cash payments for a combination of transactions that are classified as investing activities in which assets, which may include securities, other types of investments, or productive assets, are purchased from third-party sellers. This element can be used by entities to aggregate payments for all asset purchases that are classified as investing activities.

CF.label: Proceeds from Other Short-term Debt
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow from short-term debt classified as other.

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale of Intangible Assets
CF.description: The cash inflow from disposal of asset without physical form usually arising from contractual or other legal rights, excluding goodwill.

CF.label: Allowance for Funds Used During Construction, Investing Activities
CF.description: Cash inflow due to change during the period in the allowance for other funds used during construction classified as an investing activity.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) Cash Collateral from Counterparties
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount of cash held either as collateral directly or provided to third parties associated with derivative instruments. Upon the occurrence of any specified triggering event or condition associated with the derivative, these amounts can be utilized to recover all or a portion of the amounts due or payable under the derivative.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Allowance for Equity Funds Used During Construction
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the capitalized cost of equity (based on assumed rate of return) and / or borrowed funds (based on interest rate) used to finance construction of regulated assets, which is expected to be recovered through rate adjustments. As a result of this capitalization, net income is increased. This element pertains to certain regulated industries, such as public utilities.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Due to Related Parties
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of obligations to be paid to the following types of related parties: a parent company and its subsidiaries; subsidiaries of a common parent; an entity and trust for the benefit of employees, such as pension and profit-sharing trusts that are managed by or under the trusteeship of the entities' management; an entity and its principal owners, management, or member of their immediate families; affiliates; or other parties with the ability to exert significant influence.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Due to Related Parties, Current
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of obligations to be paid to the following types of related parties: a parent company and its subsidiaries; subsidiaries of a common parent; an entity and trust for the benefit of employees, such as pension and profit-sharing trusts that are managed by or under the trusteeship of the entities' management; an entity and its principal owners, management, or member of their immediate families, affiliates, or other parties with the ability to exert significant influence.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in other obligations or expenses incurred but not yet paid.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Noncurrent Assets and Liabilities, Net
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in noncurrent operating assets after deduction of noncurrent operating liabilities classified as other.

CF.label: Issuance of Stock and Warrants for Services or Claims
CF.description: Fair value of share-based compensation granted to nonemployees as payment for services rendered or acknowledged claims.

CF.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Nuclear Fuel
CF.description: The net cash inflow or outflow from any material that is commonly used in the generation of nuclear energy.

CF.label: Payments of Ordinary Dividends
CF.description: Cash outflow in the form of ordinary dividends to common shareholders, preferred shareholders and noncontrolling interests, generally out of earnings.

CF.label: Proceeds from Collection of Notes Receivable
CF.description: The cash inflow associated with principal collections from a borrowing supported by a written promise to pay an obligation.

CF.label: Proceeds from Contributions from Parent
CF.description: The cash inflow from parent as a source of financing that is recorded as additional paid in capital.

CF.label: Proceeds from Divestiture of Interest in Subsidiaries and Affiliates
CF.description: The cash inflow associated with the deconsolidation of a previously consolidated subsidiary or sale of an entity that is related to it but not strictly controlled.

CF.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Other Long-term Debt
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow from issuance of long-term debt classified as other.

CF.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Secured Debt
CF.description: The cash inflow from amounts received from issuance of long-term debt that is wholly or partially secured by collateral. Excludes proceeds from tax exempt secured debt.

CF.label: Proceeds, Issuance of Shares, Share-based Payment Arrangement, Including Option Exercised
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow from issuance of shares under share-based payment arrangement. Includes, but is not limited to, option exercised.

CF.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Related Party Debt
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from long-term debt by a related party. Related parties, include, but are not limited to, affiliates, owners or officers and their immediate families, and pension trusts.

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale and Maturity of Other Investments
CF.description: The cash inflow associated with the sale and maturity (principal being due) of other investments, prepayment and call (request of early payment) of other investments not otherwise defined in the taxonomy.

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale, Maturity and Collection of Investments
CF.description: The cash inflow associated with the sale, maturity and collection of all investments such as debt, security and so forth during the period.

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale of Treasury Stock
CF.description: The cash inflow from the issuance of an equity stock that has been previously reacquired by the entity.

CF.label: Proceeds from Sales of Assets, Investing Activities
CF.description: Aggregate cash proceeds received from a combination of transactions that are classified as investing activities in which assets, which may include one or more investments, are sold to third-party buyers. This element can be used by entities to aggregate proceeds from all asset sales that are classified as investing activities.

CF.label: Proceeds from Short-term Debt, Maturing in More than Three Months
CF.description: The cash inflow from a borrowing having initial term of repayment of more than three months but less than one year or one operating cycle (if the normal cycle is more than one year).

CF.label: Proceeds from Warrant Exercises
CF.description: The cash inflow associated with the amount received from holders exercising their stock warrants.

CF.label: Repayment of Long-term Debt, Long-term Lease Obligation, and Capital Security
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow for debt, mandatory redeemable security, and principal payment for finance lease obligation.

CF.label: Repayments of Unsecured Debt
CF.description: The cash outflow to repay long-term debt that is not secured by collateral. Excludes repayments of tax exempt unsecured debt.

CF.label: Temporary Equity, Accretion to Redemption Value
CF.description: Value of accretion of temporary equity to its redemption value during the period.

CF.label: Capitalized Contract Cost, Amortization
CF.description: Amount of amortization expense for asset recognized from cost incurred to obtain or fulfill contract with customer.

CF.label: Conversion of Stock, Amount Converted
CF.description: The value of the stock converted in a noncash (or part noncash) transaction. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

CF.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Cash Used to Settle Award
CF.description: Aggregate cash paid by the entity during the period to settle equity instruments granted under equity-based payment arrangements.

CF.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Accounts Receivable
CF.description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale of accounts receivable.

CF.label: Impairment of Intangible Assets (Excluding Goodwill)
CF.description: Amount of impairment loss for finite- and indefinite-lived intangible assets and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed. Excludes goodwill.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accrued Liabilities and Other Operating Liabilities
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in accrued expenses, and obligations classified as other.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Commodity Contract Assets and Liabilities
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the assets (liabilities) created through trading commodity-based derivative instruments.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Employee Related Liabilities
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of obligations related to services received from employees, such as accrued salaries and bonuses, payroll taxes and fringe benefits.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Accrued Liabilities
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in other expenses incurred but not yet paid.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Obligation, Pension Benefits
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in obligation for pension benefits. Includes, but is not limited to, defined benefit or defined contribution plans. Excludes other postretirement benefits.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Prepaid Expenses, Other
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) of consideration paid in advance for other costs that provide economic benefits in future periods.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Prepaid Insurance
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) of consideration paid in advance for insurance that provides economic benefits in future periods.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Regulatory Clause Revenue
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in unrecovered fuel costs for a regulated utility company.

CF.label: Interest Paid, Capitalized, Investing Activities
CF.description: Amount of cash paid for interest capitalized, classified as investing activity.

CF.label: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Debt Assumed
CF.description: The amount of debt that an Entity assumes in acquiring a business or in consideration for an asset received in a noncash (or part noncash) acquisition. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

CF.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Derivative Instrument, Financing Activities
CF.description: The net cash outflow or inflow from derivative instruments during the period, which are classified as financing activities, excluding those designated as hedging instruments.

CF.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Loans and Leases
CF.description: The net cash outflow or inflow for the increase (decrease) in the beginning and end of period of loan and lease balances which are not originated or purchased specifically for resale. Includes cash payments and proceeds associated with (a) loans held-for-investment, (b) leases held-for-investment, and (c) both.

CF.label: Payments for Repurchase of Equity
CF.description: The cash outflow to reacquire common and preferred stock.

CF.label: Payments of Capital Distribution
CF.description: Cash outflow to owners or shareholders, excluding ordinary dividends. Includes special dividends.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Notes Receivable
CF.description: The cash outflow to acquire an agreement for an unconditional promise by the maker to pay the entity (holder) a definite sum of money at a future date. Such amount may include accrued interest receivable in accordance with the terms of the note. The note also may contain provisions including a discount or premium, payable on demand, secured, or unsecured, interest bearing or noninterest bearing, among myriad other features and characteristics.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Projects
CF.description: The cash outflow from the amount invested for projects in hopes of getting a future return or interest from it.

CF.label: Proceeds from Derivative Instrument, Financing Activities
CF.description: The cash inflow provided by derivative instruments during the period, which are classified as financing activities, excluding those designated as hedging instruments.

CF.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Unsecured Debt
CF.description: The cash inflow from the issuance of long-term debt that is not secured by collateral. Excludes proceeds from tax exempt unsecured debt.

CF.label: Proceeds from (Payments to) Noncontrolling Interests
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from (to) a noncontrolling interest. Excludes dividends paid to the noncontrolling interest.

CF.label: Provision for Other Losses
CF.description: Amount of expense related to other loss.

CF.label: Repayments of Convertible Debt
CF.description: The cash outflow from the repayment of a long-term debt instrument which can be exchanged for a specified amount of another security, typically the entity's common stock, at the option of the issuer or the holder.

CF.label: Repayments of Short-term Debt, Maturing in More than Three Months
CF.description: The cash outflow from a repayment of a borrowing having initial term of repayment of more than three months but less than one year or one operating cycle (if the normal cycle is more than one year).

CF.label: Stock or Unit Option Plan Expense
CF.description: Amount of noncash expense for option under share-based payment arrangement.

CF.label: Treasury Stock, Retired, Cost Method, Amount
CF.description: Amount of decrease of par value, additional paid in capital (APIC) and retained earnings of common and preferred stock retired from treasury when treasury stock is accounted for under the cost method.

CF.label: Business Combination, Bargain Purchase, Gain Recognized, Amount
CF.description: In a business combination in which the amount of net identifiable assets acquired and liabilities assumed exceeds the aggregate consideration transferred or to be transferred (as defined), this element represents the amount of gain recognized by the entity.

CF.label: SEC Schedule, 12-04, Cash Dividends Paid to Registrant, Subsidiaries and Equity Method Investees
CF.description: This element represents disclosure of the total aggregate cash dividends paid to the entity by consolidated subsidiaries, by unconsolidated subsidiaries, and by 50 percent or less owned persons accounted for using the equity method.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts and Notes Receivable
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period of the sum of amounts due within one year (or one business cycle) from customers for the credit sale of goods and services; and from note holders for outstanding loans.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Payable, Related Parties
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the obligations due for goods and services provided by the following types of related parties: a parent company and its subsidiaries, subsidiaries of a common parent, an entity and trust for the benefit of employees, such as pension and profit-sharing trusts that are managed by or under the trusteeship of the entities' management, an entity and its principal owners, management, or member of their immediate families, affiliates, or other parties with the ability to exert significant influence.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Receivable and Other Operating Assets
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in receivables, and operating assets classified as other.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Receivable, Related Parties
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount due to the reporting entity for good and services provided to the following types of related parties: a parent company and its subsidiaries; subsidiaries of a common parent; an entity and trust for the benefit of employees, such as pension and profit-sharing trusts that are managed by or under the trusteeship of the entity's management, an entity and its principal owners, management, member of their immediate families, affiliates, or other parties with the ability to exert significant influence.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Due from Related Parties
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in receivables to be collected from other entities that could exert significant influence over the reporting entity.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Restructuring Reserve
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the period in the carrying amount (including both current and noncurrent portions of the accrual) of the liability pertaining to the exit from or disposal of business activities or restructuring pursuant to a duly authorized plan, excluding costs or losses pertaining to an entity newly acquired in a business combination and to asset retirement obligations.

CF.label: Induced Conversion of Convertible Debt Expense
CF.description: Amount of expense for inducement to convert debt instrument representing fair value of security and other consideration transferred in excess of fair value of security and other consideration issuable pursuant to conversion privilege provided in terms of existing instrument.

CF.label: PaymentForAdvanceForConstructionFinancingActivity
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow for repayment of advance for construction, classified as financing activity.

CF.label: Payments for Removal Costs
CF.description: Cash outflow related to disposal costs of plants, whether by demolishing, dismantling, abandoning, sale, and so forth during the period.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Loans Receivable
CF.description: The cash outflow for the purchase of loan receivable arising from the financing of goods and services.

CF.label: ProceedsFromAdvanceForAndContributionInAidOfConstructionFinancingActivity
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow from advance for and contribution in aid of construction, classified as financing activity.

CF.label: Proceeds from Bank Debt
CF.description: The cash inflow from bank borrowing during the year.

CF.label: Proceeds from Collection of Advance to Affiliate
CF.description: The cash inflow from the collection of money previously advanced to an entity that is related to it but not strictly controlled.

CF.label: Proceeds from Maturities, Prepayments and Calls of Debt Securities, Available-for-sale
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow from maturity, prepayment and call of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

CF.label: Proceeds from Nuclear Fuel
CF.description: Cash inflow resulting from the sale of any material that is commonly used in the generation of nuclear energy.

CF.label: Repayments of Bank Debt
CF.description: The cash outflow to settle a bank borrowing during the year.

CF.label: Repayments of Other Debt
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow for the payment of debt classified as other.

CF.label: Amortization of Acquisition Costs
CF.description: The amount of expense recognized in the current period that reflects the allocation of capitalized costs associated with acquisition of business. As a noncash expense, this element is added back to net income when calculating cash provided by or used in operations using the indirect method.

CF.label: Distribution Made to Limited Liability Company (LLC) Member, Cash Distributions Paid
CF.description: Amount of cash distribution paid to unit-holder of limited liability company (LLC).

CF.label: Embedded Derivative, Gain (Loss) on Embedded Derivative, Net
CF.description: Net Increase or Decrease in the fair value of the embedded derivative or group of embedded derivatives included in earnings in the period.

CF.label: Exploration Abandonment and Impairment Expense
CF.description: Amount of impairment loss for oil and gas properties with unproved reserve in oil- and gas-producing activities. Includes, but is not limited to, previously capitalized cost of drilling exploratory well when proved reserve is not found or when there is substantial doubt about economic or operational viability of project.

CF.label: Impairment of Ongoing Project
CF.description: Amount recognized as an operating expense or loss during the period to reduce the carrying amount of a project that has been impaired but not abandoned.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accrued Salaries
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the period in accrued salaries.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Equity Securities, FV-NI
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) of investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Obligation, Other Postretirement Benefits
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in obligation for other postretirement benefits. Includes, but is not limited to, defined benefit and defined contribution plans. Excludes pension benefits.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Recoverable Property Damage Costs
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the public utility damage costs that will be permitted by regulatory agencies to be recovered from rate payers.

CF.label: Notes Assumed
CF.description: The fair value of notes assumed in noncash investing or financing activities.

CF.label: Payment for Contingent Consideration Liability, Investing Activities
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow, made soon after acquisition date of business combination, to settle contingent consideration liability.

CF.label: Payments for Construction in Process
CF.description: The cash outflow from construction costs to date on capital projects that have not been completed and assets being constructed that are not ready to be placed into service.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire in Process Research and Development
CF.description: The cash outflows from the purchase of net carrying value allocated to in-process research and development costs and materials acquired in a business combination.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Long-term Investments
CF.description: The cash outflow for securities or other assets acquired, which qualify for treatment as an investing activity and are to be liquidated, if necessary, beyond the current operating cycle. Includes cash flows from securities classified as trading securities that were acquired for reasons other than sale in the long-term.

CF.label: Pension and Other Postretirement Benefits Expense (Reversal of Expense), Noncash
CF.description: Amount of noncash expense (reversal of expense) for pension and other postretirement benefits.

CF.label: Proceeds from Collection of Loans Receivable
CF.description: The cash inflow associated with the collection, including prepayments, of loans receivable issued for financing of goods and services.

CF.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Common Stock, Dividend Reinvestment Plan
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow from capital contributions to an entity associated with a dividend reinvestment plan.

CF.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Long-term Debt and Capital Securities, Net
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow from long-term debt, finance lease obligation, and mandatorily redeemable capital security.

CF.label: Proceeds from Partnership Contribution
CF.description: The cash inflow from the capital received in cash from a partner in a partnership during the period.

CF.label: Proceeds from Collection of (Payments to Fund) Long-term Loans to Related Parties
CF.description: The cash inflow or outflow associated with long-term loans for related parties where one party can exercise control or significant influence over another party, including affiliates, owners or officers and their immediate families, pension trusts, and so forth. Alternate caption: Proceeds from (Payments for) Advances to Affiliates.

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale of Machinery and Equipment
CF.description: The cash inflow from sale of machinery and equipment.

CF.label: Transfer to Investments
CF.description: Value of investments transferred to the entity's investments in noncash transactions.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of current income tax expense (benefit) and deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to continuing operations.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, at Federal Statutory Income Tax Rate, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of domestic federal statutory tax rate applicable to pretax income (loss).

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation at Federal Statutory Income Tax Rate, Amount
unclassified.description: The amount of income tax expense or benefit for the period computed by applying the domestic federal statutory tax rates to pretax income from continuing operations.

unclassified.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, New Issues
unclassified.description: Equity impact of the value of new stock issued during the period. Includes shares issued in an initial public offering or a secondary public offering.

unclassified.label: Number of Reportable Segments
unclassified.description: Number of segments reported by the entity. A reportable segment is a component of an entity for which there is an accounting requirement to report separate financial information on that component in the entity's financial statements.

unclassified.label: Cash and Cash Equivalents, Period Increase (Decrease)
Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, State and Local Income Taxes, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations applicable to state and local income tax expense (benefit), net of federal tax expense (benefit).

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Net of Valuation Allowance
unclassified.description: Amount after allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences and carryforwards.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Net
unclassified.description: Amount, after deferred tax asset, of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable differences without jurisdictional netting.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, State and Local Income Taxes, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to state and local income tax expense (benefit).

unclassified.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease.

unclassified.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Two
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Operating Lease, Liability
unclassified.description: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease.

unclassified.label: Antidilutive Securities Excluded from Computation of Earnings Per Share, Amount
unclassified.description: Securities (including those issuable pursuant to contingent stock agreements) that could potentially dilute basic earnings per share (EPS) or earnings per unit (EPU) in the future that were not included in the computation of diluted EPS or EPU because to do so would increase EPS or EPU amounts or decrease loss per share or unit amounts for the period presented.

unclassified.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year One
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Three
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Operating Lease, Weighted Average Discount Rate, Percent
unclassified.description: Weighted average discount rate for operating lease calculated at point in time.

unclassified.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits
unclassified.description: Amount of unrecognized tax benefits.

unclassified.label: Current State and Local Tax Expense (Benefit)
unclassified.description: Amount of current state and local tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations. Includes, but is not limited to, current regional, territorial, and provincial tax expense (benefit) for non-US (United States of America) jurisdiction.

unclassified.label: Deferred Federal Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred federal tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations. Includes, but is not limited to, deferred national tax expense (benefit) for non-US (United States of America) jurisdiction.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Valuation Allowance
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax assets for which it is more likely than not that a tax benefit will not be realized.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Other Adjustments, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to other adjustments.

unclassified.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Four
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Current Federal Tax Expense (Benefit)
unclassified.description: Amount of current federal tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations. Includes, but is not limited to, current national tax expense (benefit) for non-US (United States of America) jurisdiction.

unclassified.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, Year One
unclassified.description: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, Year Two
unclassified.description: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Deferred State and Local Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred state and local tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations. Includes, but is not limited to, deferred regional, territorial, and provincial tax expense (benefit) for non-US (United States of America) jurisdiction.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Operating Loss Carryforwards
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible operating loss carryforwards.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Other
unclassified.description: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences, classified as other.

unclassified.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, after Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease due after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, Undiscounted Excess Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments in excess of discounted obligation for lease payments for operating lease.

unclassified.label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, Year Four
unclassified.description: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, Year Three
unclassified.description: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Asset Retirement Obligation
unclassified.description: The carrying amount of a liability for an asset retirement obligation. An asset retirement obligation is a legal obligation associated with the disposal or retirement of a tangible long-lived asset that results from the acquisition, construction or development, or the normal operations of a long-lived asset, except for certain obligations of lessees.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Net
unclassified.description: Amount, after allocation of valuation allowances and deferred tax liability, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible differences and carryforwards, without jurisdictional netting.

unclassified.label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Operating Lease, Payments
unclassified.description: Amount of cash outflow from operating lease, excluding payments to bring another asset to condition and location necessary for its intended use.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Property, Plant and Equipment
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from property, plant, and equipment.

unclassified.label: Asset Retirement Obligation, Liabilities Incurred
unclassified.description: Amount of asset retirement obligations incurred during the period.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Other Adjustments, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to other adjustments.

unclassified.label: IncomeTaxPaidFederalAfterRefundReceived
unclassified.description: Amount, after income tax refund received, of cash paid to federal (national) tax jurisdiction for tax on income.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Change in Deferred Tax Assets Valuation Allowance, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to increase (decrease) in the valuation allowance for deferred tax assets.

unclassified.label: Lease, Cost
unclassified.description: Amount of lease cost recognized by lessee for lease contract.

unclassified.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Remainder of Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease having initial or remaining lease term in excess of one year to be paid in remainder of current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments Due
unclassified.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable letter-terms in excess of one year.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Four Years
unclassified.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the fourth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Three Years
unclassified.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the third fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Two Years
unclassified.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the second fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due Thereafter
unclassified.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due after the fifth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Asset Retirement Obligation, Revision of Estimate
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in the asset retirement obligation from changes in the amount or timing of the estimated cash flows associated with the settlement of the obligation.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Change in Deferred Tax Assets Valuation Allowance, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to changes in the valuation allowance for deferred tax assets.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments Due, Next Twelve Months
unclassified.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the next fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Five Years
unclassified.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the fifth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Increase Resulting from Prior Period Tax Positions
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from tax positions taken in prior period tax returns.

unclassified.label: Asset Retirement Obligation, Liabilities Settled
unclassified.description: Amount of asset retirement obligations settled, or otherwise disposed of, during the period. This may include asset retirement obligations transferred to third parties associated with the sale of a long-lived asset.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences and carryforwards.

unclassified.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Decrease Resulting from Prior Period Tax Positions
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from tax positions taken in prior period tax returns.

unclassified.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Increase Resulting from Current Period Tax Positions
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from tax positions that have been or will be taken in current period tax return.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Other
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences classified as other.

unclassified.label: Line of Credit Facility, Maximum Borrowing Capacity
unclassified.description: Maximum borrowing capacity under the credit facility without consideration of any current restrictions on the amount that could be borrowed or the amounts currently outstanding under the facility.

unclassified.label: Finance Lease, Weighted Average Discount Rate, Percent
unclassified.description: Weighted average discount rate for finance lease calculated at point in time.

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, Year One
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization expense for finite-lived intangible asset expected to be recognized in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach). Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

unclassified.label: Cumulative Effect of New Accounting Principle in Period of Adoption (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Finance Lease, Interest Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of interest expense on finance lease liability.

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, Year Four
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization expense for finite-lived intangible asset expected to be recognized in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach). Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, Year Three
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization expense for finite-lived intangible asset expected to be recognized in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach). Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, Year Two
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization expense for finite-lived intangible asset expected to be recognized in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach). Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

unclassified.label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, New Issues
unclassified.description: Number of new stock issued during the period.

unclassified.label: Valuation Allowance, Deferred Tax Asset, Increase (Decrease), Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in the valuation allowance for a specified deferred tax asset.

unclassified.label: APIC, Share-based Payment Arrangement, Increase for Cost Recognition
unclassified.description: Amount of increase to additional paid-in capital (APIC) for recognition of cost for award under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Credit Carryforwards
unclassified.description: Amount, before allocation of a valuation allowances, of deferred tax assets attributable to deductible tax credit carryforwards including, but not limited to, research, foreign, general business, alternative minimum tax, and other deductible tax credit carryforwards.

unclassified.label: Defined Contribution Plan, Cost
unclassified.description: Amount of cost for defined contribution plan.

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization expense for finite-lived intangible asset expected to be recognized in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach). Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Change in Enacted Tax Rate, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations, attributable to increase (decrease) in the income tax rates.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Other, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to other nondeductible expenses.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Rent Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of rent expense incurred for leased assets, including but not limited to, furniture and equipment, that is not directly or indirectly associated with the manufacture, sale or creation of a product or product line.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Outstanding, Number
unclassified.description: Number of options outstanding, including both vested and non-vested options.

unclassified.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Decrease Resulting from Settlements with Taxing Authorities
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from settlements with taxing authorities.

unclassified.label: Variable Lease, Cost
unclassified.description: Amount of variable lease cost, excluded from lease liability, recognized when obligation for payment is incurred for finance and operating leases.

unclassified.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Expense, Tax Benefit
unclassified.description: Amount of tax benefit for recognition of expense of award under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount, before accumulated amortization, of finite-lived intangible asset. Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

unclassified.label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, after Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Noncontrolling Interest, Decrease from Distributions to Noncontrolling Interest Holders
unclassified.description: Decrease in noncontrolling interest balance from payment of dividends or other distributions by the non-wholly owned subsidiary or partially owned entity, included in the consolidation of the parent entity, to the noncontrolling interest holders.

unclassified.label: Regulatory Liabilities
unclassified.description: The amount for the individual regulatory liability as itemized in a table of regulatory liabilities as of the end of the period.

unclassified.label: Share Price
unclassified.description: Price of a single share of a number of saleable stocks of a company.

unclassified.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits that Would Impact Effective Tax Rate
unclassified.description: The total amount of unrecognized tax benefits that, if recognized, would affect the effective tax rate.

unclassified.label: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Stock Issued, Issuance Costs
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in additional paid in capital (APIC) resulting from direct costs associated with issuing stock. Includes, but is not limited to, legal and accounting fees and direct costs associated with stock issues under a shelf registration.

unclassified.label: Assets, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of asset recognized for present right to economic benefit.

unclassified.label: Long-term Debt, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount, before unamortized (discount) premium and debt issuance costs, of long-term debt. Includes, but is not limited to, notes payable, bonds payable, commercial loans, mortgage loans, convertible debt, subordinated debt and other types of debt.

unclassified.label: Derivative Liability
unclassified.description: Fair value, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset. Includes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

unclassified.label: Dividends, Common Stock, Cash
unclassified.description: Amount of paid and unpaid common stock dividends declared with the form of settlement in cash.

unclassified.label: Finance Lease, Liability, Payment, Due
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments for finance lease.

unclassified.label: Finance Lease, Right-of-Use Asset, Amortization
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization expense attributable to right-of-use asset from finance lease.

unclassified.label: Letters of Credit Outstanding, Amount
unclassified.description: The total amount of the contingent obligation under letters of credit outstanding as of the reporting date.

unclassified.label: Line of Credit Facility, Remaining Borrowing Capacity
unclassified.description: Amount of borrowing capacity currently available under the credit facility (current borrowing capacity less the amount of borrowings outstanding).

unclassified.label: Operating Loss Carryforwards
unclassified.description: Amount of operating loss carryforward, before tax effects, available to reduce future taxable income under enacted tax laws.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Net of Valuation Allowance, Current
Derivative Asset
unclassified.description: Fair value, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset. Includes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

unclassified.label: Derivative Liability, Fair Value, Gross Liability
unclassified.description: Fair value, before effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset. Includes liabilities elected not to be offset. Excludes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement.

unclassified.label: Finance Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Four
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for finance lease to be paid in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Finance Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Three
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for finance lease to be paid in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Finance Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Two
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for finance lease to be paid in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Credit, Other, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to other tax credits.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent
unclassified.description: Amount after tax of other comprehensive income (loss) attributable to parent entity.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Derivatives Arising During Period, Net of Tax
unclassified.description: Amount after tax of increase (decrease) in accumulated gain (loss) from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's increase (decrease) in deferred hedging gain (loss).

unclassified.label: Reclassification from Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income, Current Period, Net of Tax
unclassified.description: Amount after tax of reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss).

unclassified.label: Regulatory Assets
unclassified.description: The amount for the individual regulatory asset as itemized in a table of regulatory assets as of the end of the period.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Exercisable, Number
unclassified.description: The number of shares into which fully or partially vested stock options outstanding as of the balance sheet date can be currently converted under the option plan.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Outstanding, Weighted Average Exercise Price
unclassified.description: Weighted average price at which grantees can acquire the shares reserved for issuance under the stock option plan.

unclassified.label: Stockholders' Equity, Other
unclassified.description: This element represents movements included in the statement of changes in stockholders' equity which are not separately disclosed or provided for elsewhere in the taxonomy.

unclassified.label: Derivative Asset, Fair Value, Gross Asset
unclassified.description: Fair value, before effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset. Includes assets elected not to be offset. Excludes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement.

unclassified.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Nonvested Award, Cost Not yet Recognized, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of cost not yet recognized for nonvested award under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Finance Lease, Liability, to be Paid, after Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for finance lease to be paid after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Finance Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year One
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for finance lease to be paid in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Finance Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for finance lease to be paid in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: IncomeTaxPaidStateAndLocalAfterRefundReceived
unclassified.description: Amount, after income tax refund received, of cash paid to state and local tax jurisdictions for tax on income.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Income Tax Refunds
unclassified.description: Amount of income tax refund received from tax jurisdiction.

unclassified.label: Collateral Already Posted, Aggregate Fair Value
unclassified.description: The aggregate fair value of assets that are already posted, at the end of the reporting period, as collateral for derivative instruments with credit-risk-related contingent features.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Regulatory Assets and Liabilities
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences derived regulatory assets and liabilities.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Net Liability Position, Aggregate Fair Value
unclassified.description: The aggregate fair value amounts of derivative instruments that contain credit-risk-related contingent features that are in a net liability position at the end of the reporting period. For nonderivative instruments that are designated and qualify as hedging instruments, the fair value amounts are the carrying value of the nonderivative hedging instrument, including the adjustment for the foreign currency transaction gain (loss) on that instrument.

unclassified.label: Earnings Per Share, Basic and Diluted
Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Other, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to other nondeductible expenses.

unclassified.label: Finance Lease, Liability, Undiscounted Excess Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments in excess of discounted obligation for lease payments for finance lease.

unclassified.label: Goodwill, Acquired During Period
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in asset representing future economic benefits arising from other assets acquired in a business combination that are not individually identified and separately recognized resulting from a business combination.

unclassified.label: Long-term Line of Credit
unclassified.description: The carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the current and noncurrent portions of long-term obligations drawn from a line of credit, which is a bank's commitment to make loans up to a specific amount. Examples of items that might be included in the application of this element may consist of letters of credit, standby letters of credit, and revolving credit arrangements, under which borrowings can be made up to a maximum amount as of any point in time conditional on satisfaction of specified terms before, as of and after the date of drawdowns on the line. Includes short-term obligations that would normally be classified as current liabilities but for which (a) postbalance sheet date issuance of a long term obligation to refinance the short term obligation on a long term basis, or (b) the enterprise has entered into a financing agreement that clearly permits the enterprise to refinance the short-term obligation on a long term basis and the following conditions are met (1) the agreement does not expire within 1 year and is not cancelable by the lender except for violation of an objectively determinable provision, (2) no violation exists at the BS date, and (3) the lender has entered into the financing agreement is expected to be financially capable of honoring the agreement.

unclassified.label: Noncontrolling Interest, Increase from Subsidiary Equity Issuance
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in noncontrolling interest from subsidiary issuance of equity interests to noncontrolling interest holders.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Derivatives Arising During Period, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit), before reclassification adjustments, related to increase (decrease) in accumulated gain (loss) from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's increase (decrease) in deferred hedging gain (loss).

unclassified.label: Allowance for Funds Used During Construction, Capitalized Interest
unclassified.description: Amount capitalized of allowance for funds used during construction.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Exercisable, Weighted Average Exercise Price
unclassified.description: The weighted-average price as of the balance sheet date at which grantees can acquire the shares reserved for issuance on vested portions of options outstanding and currently exercisable under the stock option plan.
