unclassified.label: Finance Lease, Interest Payment on Liability
unclassified.description: Amount of interest paid on finance lease liability.

unclassified.label: Finance Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Remainder of Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for finance lease to be paid in remainder of current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Credit, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to tax credits. Including, but not limited to, research credit, foreign tax credit, investment tax credit, and other tax credits.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Credit, Investment, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to investment tax credit.

unclassified.label: Financial and Nonfinancial Liabilities, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value of financial and nonfinancial obligations.

unclassified.label: Noncontrolling Interest, Decrease from Redemptions or Purchase of Interests
unclassified.description: Decrease in noncontrolling interest (for example, but not limited to, redeeming or purchasing the interests of noncontrolling shareholders, issuance of shares (interests) by the non-wholly owned subsidiary to the parent entity for other than cash, and a buyback of shares (interest) by the non-wholly owned subsidiary from the noncontrolling interests).

unclassified.label: Number of Operating Segments
unclassified.description: Number of operating segments. An operating segment is a component of an enterprise: (a) that engages in business activities from which it may earn revenues and incur expenses (including revenues and expenses relating to transactions with other components of the same enterprise), (b) whose operating results are regularly reviewed by the enterprise's chief operating decision maker to make decisions about resources to be allocated to the segment and assess its performance, and (c) for which discrete financial information is available. An operating segment may engage in business activities for which it has yet to earn revenues, for example, start-up operations may be operating segments before earning revenues.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI on Derivatives, Net of Tax
unclassified.description: Amount after tax of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income of accumulated gain (loss) realized from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's deferred hedging gain (loss).

unclassified.label: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Unrealized Holding Gain (Loss), before Adjustment, after Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax and before adjustment, of unrealized holding gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale). Excludes unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to available-for-sale.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Fair Value Assumptions, Expected Dividend Rate
unclassified.description: The estimated dividend rate (a percentage of the share price) to be paid (expected dividends) to holders of the underlying shares over the option's term.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Fair Value Assumptions, Expected Volatility Rate
unclassified.description: The estimated measure of the percentage by which a share price is expected to fluctuate during a period. Volatility also may be defined as a probability-weighted measure of the dispersion of returns about the mean. The volatility of a share price is the standard deviation of the continuously compounded rates of return on the share over a specified period. That is the same as the standard deviation of the differences in the natural logarithms of the stock prices plus dividends, if any, over the period.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangements by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Exercises in Period, Weighted Average Exercise Price
unclassified.description: Weighted average price at which option holders acquired shares when converting their stock options into shares.

unclassified.label: Shares Issued, Value, Share-based Payment Arrangement, after Forfeiture
unclassified.description: Value, after forfeiture, of shares issued under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

unclassified.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Reduction Resulting from Lapse of Applicable Statute of Limitations
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from lapses of applicable statutes of limitations.

unclassified.label: Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cumulative Changes in Net Gain (Loss) from Cash Flow Hedges, Effect Net of Tax
unclassified.description: Accumulated change, net of tax, in accumulated gains and losses from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges. Includes an entity's share of an equity investee's Increase or Decrease in deferred hedging gains or losses.

unclassified.label: Accounts Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Writeoff
unclassified.description: Amount of direct write-downs of accounts receivable charged against the allowance.

unclassified.label: Dividends, Common Stock
unclassified.description: Amount of paid and unpaid common stock dividends declared with the form of settlement in cash, stock and payment-in-kind (PIK).

unclassified.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Investing Activities, Continuing Operations
unclassified.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from investing activity attributable to continuing operation. Investing activity includes, but is not limited to, making and collecting loan, acquiring and disposing of debt and equity instruments, property, plant, and equipment, and other productive assets.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), before Reclassifications, Net of Tax
unclassified.description: Amount after tax, before reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss).

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI on Derivatives, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income of accumulated gain (loss) realized from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's deferred hedging gain (loss).

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment on Derivatives Included in Net Income, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
SegmentExpenditureAdditionToLongLivedAssets
unclassified.description: Amount of expenditure for addition to long-lived asset included in determination of segment asset by chief operating decision maker (CODM) or otherwise regularly provided to CODM. Long-lived asset excludes financial instrument, long-term customer relationship of financial institution, mortgage and other servicing rights, deferred policy acquisition cost, and deferred tax asset.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Number of Shares Authorized
unclassified.description: Number of shares authorized for issuance under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Exercises in Period, Intrinsic Value
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated difference between fair value of underlying shares on dates of exercise and exercise price on options exercised (or share units converted) into shares.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Grants in Period, Weighted Average Grant Date Fair Value
unclassified.description: The weighted average grant-date fair value of options granted during the reporting period as calculated by applying the disclosed option pricing methodology.

unclassified.label: Short-term Debt, Weighted Average Interest Rate, at Point in Time
unclassified.description: Weighted average interest rate of short-term debt outstanding calculated at point in time.

unclassified.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Acquisitions
unclassified.description: Value of stock issued pursuant to acquisitions during the period.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Unamortized Discount
unclassified.description: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of debt discount.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Derivative Instruments
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from derivative instruments.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Regulatory Assets
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from regulatory assets.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Credit, Other, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to other tax credits.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Other Reconciling Items, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying statutory federal (national) tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation attributable to other reconciling item. Excludes state and local income tax expense (benefit), federal tax expense (benefit), statutory income tax expense (benefit) outside of country of domicile, tax credit, nondeductible expense, deduction, income tax settlement, income tax contingency, and cross-border tax law.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Contingency, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to increase (decrease) in income tax contingencies. Including, but not limited to, domestic tax contingency, foreign tax contingency, state and local tax contingency, and other contingencies.

unclassified.label: Line of Credit Facility, Amount Outstanding (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Gain (Loss) Arising During Period, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) for (increase) decrease in value of benefit obligation for change in actuarial assumptions and increase (decrease) in value of plan assets from experience different from that assumed of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, after Reclassification Adjustment, after Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax and reclassification adjustment, of (increase) decrease in accumulated other comprehensive income for defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Fair Value Assumptions, Risk Free Interest Rate
unclassified.description: The risk-free interest rate assumption that is used in valuing an option on its own shares.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Grants in Period, Gross
unclassified.description: Gross number of share options (or share units) granted during the period.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangements by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Grants in Period, Weighted Average Exercise Price
unclassified.description: Weighted average per share amount at which grantees can acquire shares of common stock by exercise of options.

unclassified.label: Short-term Lease, Cost
unclassified.description: Amount of short-term lease cost, excluding expense for lease with term of one month or less.

unclassified.label: Additional Collateral, Aggregate Fair Value
unclassified.description: The aggregate fair value of additional assets that would be required to be posted as collateral for derivative instruments with credit-risk-related contingent features if the credit-risk-related contingent features were triggered at the end of the reporting period.

unclassified.label: Asset Retirement Obligation, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in asset retirement obligations.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale
unclassified.description: Amount of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments Due
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for capital leases.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments Due, Next Twelve Months
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for capital leases due in the next fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments Due in Two Years
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for capital leases due in the second fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Cash Flow Hedge Gain (Loss) to be Reclassified within Twelve Months
unclassified.description: The estimated net amount of existing gains or losses on cash flow hedges at the reporting date expected to be reclassified to earnings within the next 12 months.

unclassified.label: Contract with Customer, Liability
unclassified.description: Amount of obligation to transfer good or service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Interest Rate, Stated Percentage
unclassified.description: Contractual interest rate for funds borrowed, under the debt agreement.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Unamortized Discount (Premium), Net
unclassified.description: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of debt discount (premium).

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Operating Loss Carryforwards, State and Local
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible state and local operating loss carryforwards.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Effect of One Percentage Point Increase on Accumulated Postretirement Benefit Obligation
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in accumulated postretirement benefit obligation from one-percentage-point increase in assumed health care cost trend rate.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Effect of One Percentage Point Increase on Service and Interest Cost Components
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in service and interest cost components of net periodic postretirement benefit cost from one-percentage-point increase in assumed health care cost trend rate.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Contingency, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to income tax contingencies. Includes, but not limited to, domestic tax contingency, foreign tax contingency, state and local tax contingency, and other contingencies.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Gain (Loss) Arising During Period, after Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of gain (loss) for (increase) decrease in value of benefit obligation for change in actuarial assumptions and increase (decrease) in value of plan assets from experience different from that assumed of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), Reclassification, after Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of reclassification of gain (loss) from accumulated other comprehensive income (AOCI) for derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivatives Qualifying as Hedges, Net of Tax
unclassified.description: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments, of increase (decrease) in accumulated gain (loss) from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's increase (decrease) in deferred hedging gain (loss).

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment on Derivatives Included in Net Income, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Payments to Acquire Businesses, Gross
unclassified.description: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of business during the period. The cash portion only of the acquisition price.

unclassified.label: Revenue, Remaining Performance Obligation, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of transaction price allocated to performance obligation that has not been recognized as revenue.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Number of Shares Available for Grant
unclassified.description: The difference between the maximum number of shares (or other type of equity) authorized for issuance under the plan (including the effects of amendments and adjustments), and the sum of: 1) the number of shares (or other type of equity) already issued upon exercise of options or other equity-based awards under the plan; and 2) shares (or other type of equity) reserved for issuance on granting of outstanding awards, net of cancellations and forfeitures, if applicable.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Outstanding, Intrinsic Value
unclassified.description: Amount by which the current fair value of the underlying stock exceeds the exercise price of options outstanding.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Exercisable, Intrinsic Value
unclassified.description: Amount of difference between fair value of the underlying shares reserved for issuance and exercise price of vested portions of options outstanding and currently exercisable.

unclassified.label: Unamortized Debt Issuance Expense
unclassified.description: The remaining balance of debt issuance expenses that were capitalized and are being amortized against income over the lives of the respective bond issues. This does not include the amounts capitalized as part of the cost of the utility plant or asset.

unclassified.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Interest on Income Taxes Accrued
unclassified.description: Amount of interest expense accrued for an underpayment of income taxes.

unclassified.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Interest on Income Taxes Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of interest expense for an underpayment of income taxes.

unclassified.label: Accumulated Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, after Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss for defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit cost (credit).

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments Due in Five Years
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for capital leases due in the fifth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments Due in Four Years
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for capital leases due in the fourth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments Due in Three Years
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for capital leases due in the third fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Cash and Cash Equivalents, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions. Includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits. Also includes short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Face Amount
unclassified.description: Face (par) amount of debt instrument at time of issuance.

unclassified.label: Debt Issuance Costs, Net
unclassified.description: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of debt issuance costs. Includes, but is not limited to, legal, accounting, underwriting, printing, and registration costs.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Net of Valuation Allowance, Noncurrent
Deferred Tax Liabilities, Derivatives
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from derivatives.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Contributions by Employer
unclassified.description: Amount of contribution received by defined benefit plan from employer which increases plan assets.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Change in Enacted Tax Rate, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to changes in the income tax rates.

unclassified.label: Investment Tax Credit
unclassified.description: The amount deducted from an entities' taxes, reflecting a percentage of an amount invested in certain assets spread over the useful life of those assets; includes deferred investment tax credits.

unclassified.label: Long-term Debt, Fair Value
unclassified.description: The fair value amount of long-term debt whether such amount is presented as a separate caption or as a parenthetical disclosure. Additionally, this element may be used in connection with the fair value disclosures required in the footnote disclosures to the financial statements. The element may be used in both the balance sheet and disclosure in the same submission.

unclassified.label: Noncontrolling Interest, Increase from Sale of Parent Equity Interest
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in noncontrolling interest from sale of a portion of the parent's controlling interest.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, after Reclassification Adjustment, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after reclassification adjustment, of tax (expense) benefit for (increase) decrease in accumulated other comprehensive income of defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment on Derivatives Included in Net Income, Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Unrealized Holding Gain (Loss), before Adjustment, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before adjustment, of tax expense (benefit) for unrealized holding gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale). Excludes tax expense (benefit) for unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to available-for-sale.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Issuance or Sale of Equity
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from the issuance of common stock, preferred stock, treasury stock, stock options, and other types of equity.

unclassified.label: Tax Adjustments, Settlements, and Unusual Provisions
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) to previously recorded tax expense. Includes, but is not limited to, significant settlements of income tax disputes, and unusual tax positions or infrequent actions taken by the entity, including tax assessment reversal, and IRS tax settlement.

unclassified.label: Treasury Stock, Value, Acquired, Cost Method
unclassified.description: Equity impact of the cost of common and preferred stock that were repurchased during the period. Recorded using the cost method.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments Due Thereafter
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for capital leases due after the fifth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Interest Included in Payments
unclassified.description: Amount necessary to reduce net minimum lease payments to present value for capital leases.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Present Value of Net Minimum Payments
unclassified.description: Present value of minimum lease payments for capital leases net of executory costs, including amounts paid by the lessee to the lessor for insurance, maintenance and taxes.

unclassified.label: Contract with Customer, Liability, Revenue Recognized
unclassified.description: Amount of revenue recognized that was previously included in balance of obligation to transfer good or service to customer for which consideration from customer has been received or is due.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Compensation and Benefits
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from compensation and benefits costs.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Effect of One Percentage Point Decrease on Service and Interest Cost Components
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in service and interest cost components of net periodic postretirement benefit cost from one-percentage-point decrease in assumed health care cost trend rate.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Assets, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount classified as assets attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Dividends, Preferred Stock, Cash
unclassified.description: Amount of paid and unpaid preferred stock dividends declared with the form of settlement in cash.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Credit, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to tax credits. Including, but not limited to, research credit, foreign tax credit, investment tax credit, and other tax credits.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Credit, Investment, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to investment tax credit.

unclassified.label: Federal Income Tax Expense (Benefit), Continuing Operations
unclassified.description: Amount of current and deferred federal tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations. Includes, but is not limited to, current and deferred national tax expense (benefit) for non-US (United States of America) jurisdiction.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Share-based Payment Arrangement, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of reported income tax expense (benefit) in excess of (less than) expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation, attributable to nondeductible expense for award under share-based payment arrangement. Includes, but is not limited to, expense determined to be nondeductible upon grant or after for award under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Pension and Other Postretirement Benefit Plans, Adjustment, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Pension and Other Postretirement Benefit Plans, Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment on Derivatives Included in Net Income, Tax (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Grants in Period
unclassified.description: The number of grants made during the period on other than stock (or unit) option plans (for example, phantom stock or unit plan, stock or unit appreciation rights plan, performance target plan).

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Grants in Period, Net of Forfeitures
unclassified.description: Net number of share options (or share units) granted during the period.

unclassified.label: State and Local Income Tax Expense (Benefit), Continuing Operations
unclassified.description: Amount of current and deferred state and local tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations. Includes, but is not limited to, current and deferred regional, territorial, and provincial tax expense (benefit) for non-US (United States of America) jurisdiction.

unclassified.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Decrease Resulting from Current Period Tax Positions
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from tax positions that have been or will be taken in current period tax return.

unclassified.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in unrecognized tax benefits attributable to uncertain tax positions taken in tax returns.

unclassified.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Basic and Diluted
Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Other
unclassified.description: Amount of other increase (decrease) in additional paid in capital (APIC).

unclassified.label: Capital Lease Obligations, Current
unclassified.description: Amount of capital lease obligation due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Customer Deposits, Current
unclassified.description: The current portion of money or property received from customers which is either to be returned upon satisfactory contract completion or applied to customer receivables in accordance with the terms of the contract or the understandings.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Operating Loss Carryforwards, Domestic
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible domestic operating loss carryforwards. Excludes state and local operating loss carryforwards.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Effect of One Percentage Point Decrease on Accumulated Postretirement Benefit Obligation
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in accumulated postretirement benefit obligation from one-percentage-point decrease in assumed health care cost trend rate.

unclassified.label: Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments, Gain (Loss), Net
unclassified.description: Amount of realized and unrealized gain (loss) of derivative instruments not designated or qualifying as hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to nondeductible expenses.

unclassified.label: Employee Service Share-based Compensation, Nonvested Awards, Total Compensation Cost Not yet Recognized, Period for Recognition (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Environmental Remediation Expense
unclassified.description: Amount, before recovery, of expense for known and estimated future costs arising from requirement to perform environmental remediation.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Asset Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of financial instrument classified as an asset measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

unclassified.label: Goodwill, Written off Related to Sale of Business Unit
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in goodwill acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized, from divestiture.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to nondeductible expenses.

unclassified.label: Operating Lease, Lease Income
unclassified.description: Amount of operating lease income from lease payments and variable lease payments paid and payable to lessor. Includes, but is not limited to, variable lease payments not included in measurement of lease receivable.

unclassified.label: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Gain (Loss), after Adjustment and Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax and adjustment, of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) and unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to available-for-sale.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), Reclassification, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) for reclassification of gain (loss) from accumulated other comprehensive income (AOCI) for derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Preferred Stock and Preference Stock
unclassified.description: Proceeds from issuance of capital stock which provides for a specific dividend that is paid to the shareholders before any dividends to common stockholders and which takes precedence over common stockholders in the event of liquidation.

unclassified.label: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Disclosure of Composite Depreciation Rate for Plants in Service
unclassified.description: Composite depreciation rate for public utility plants in service.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangements by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Forfeitures in Period, Weighted Average Exercise Price
unclassified.description: Weighted average price at which grantees could have acquired the underlying shares with respect to stock options that were terminated.

unclassified.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Stock Options Exercised
unclassified.description: Value of stock issued as a result of the exercise of stock options.

unclassified.label: Tax Credit Carryforward, Amount
unclassified.description: The amount of the tax credit carryforward, before tax effects, available to reduce future taxable income under enacted tax laws.

unclassified.label: Treasury Stock, Shares, Acquired
unclassified.description: Number of shares that have been repurchased during the period and are being held in treasury.

unclassified.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Income Tax Penalties and Interest Accrued
unclassified.description: Amount accrued for interest on an underpayment of income taxes and penalties related to a tax position claimed or expected to be claimed in the tax return.

unclassified.label: Adjustments, Noncash Items, to Reconcile Net Income (Loss) to Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activities, Other (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Fair Value, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, after Year One Through Five
unclassified.description: Fair value of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing in second through fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Fair Value, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, Year One
unclassified.description: Fair value of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Consideration Transferred
unclassified.description: Amount of consideration transferred, consisting of acquisition-date fair value of assets transferred by the acquirer, liabilities incurred by the acquirer, and equity interest issued by the acquirer.

unclassified.label: Capital Lease Obligations, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount equal to the present value (the principal) at the beginning of the lease term of minimum lease payments during the lease term (excluding that portion of the payments representing executory costs such as insurance, maintenance, and taxes to be paid by the lessor, together with any profit thereon) net of payments or other amounts applied to the principal, through the balance sheet date and due to be paid more than one year (or one operating cycle, if longer) after the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Current Foreign Tax Expense (Benefit)
unclassified.description: Amount of current foreign income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations.

unclassified.label: Debt, Weighted Average Interest Rate
unclassified.description: Weighted average interest rate of debt outstanding.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Regulatory Assets and Liabilities
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from regulatory assets and liabilities.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of asset segregated and restricted to provide benefit under defined benefit plan. Asset includes, but is not limited to, stock, bond, other investment, earning from investment, and contribution by employer and employee.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Net Periodic Benefit Cost (Credit)
unclassified.description: Amount of net periodic benefit cost (credit) for defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Ultimate Health Care Cost Trend Rate (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Derivative Liability, Fair Value, Gross Asset
unclassified.description: Fair value of asset associated with financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset.

unclassified.label: Effect of Exchange Rate on Cash and Cash Equivalents
Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Noncontrolling Interest Income (Loss), Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to noncontrolling interest income (loss) exempt from income taxes.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Asset, Transfers out of Level 3
unclassified.description: Amount of transfers of financial instrument classified as an asset out of level 3 of the fair value hierarchy.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Net Derivative Asset (Liability) Measured on Recurring Basis with Unobservable Inputs
unclassified.description: Fair value of financial instrument classified as derivative asset (liability) after deduction of derivative liability (asset), measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

unclassified.label: Income Tax Examination, Liability (Refund) Adjustment from Settlement with Taxing Authority
unclassified.description: The amount of the additional liability or refund received or expected based on a final settlement with a taxing authority.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Prior Year Income Taxes, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to revisions of previously reported income tax expense (benefit).

unclassified.label: Line of Credit Facility, Current Borrowing Capacity
unclassified.description: Amount of current borrowing capacity under the credit facility considering any current restrictions on the amount that could be borrowed (for example, borrowings may be limited by the amount of current assets), but without considering any amounts currently outstanding under the facility.

unclassified.label: Net Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations Available to Common Shareholders, Basic
unclassified.description: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities; of income (loss) from continuing operations available to common shareholders.

unclassified.label: Noncontrolling Interest, Increase from Business Combination
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in noncontrolling interest from a business combination.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), before Reclassification, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before reclassification, of tax expense (benefit) for gain (loss) from derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivatives Qualifying as Hedges, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit), after reclassification adjustments, of increase (decrease) in accumulated gain (loss) from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's increase (decrease) in deferred hedging gain (loss).

unclassified.label: Other Long-term Debt
unclassified.description: Amount of long-term debt classified as other.

unclassified.label: Payments to Acquire Interest in Subsidiaries and Affiliates
unclassified.description: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of or advances to an entity that is related to it but not strictly controlled (for example, an unconsolidated subsidiary, affiliate, and joint venture or equity method investment) or the acquisition of an additional interest in a subsidiary (controlled entity).

unclassified.label: Restricted Cash and Cash Equivalents, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount of cash and cash equivalent restricted as to withdrawal or usage, classified as noncurrent. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

unclassified.label: Sale of Stock, Number of Shares Issued in Transaction
unclassified.description: The number of shares issued or sold by the subsidiary or equity method investee per stock transaction.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Exercises in Period, Weighted Average Exercise Price (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Stock Issued During Period, Value, Conversion of Convertible Securities
unclassified.description: The gross value of stock issued during the period upon the conversion of convertible securities.

unclassified.label: Stock Repurchased During Period, Value
unclassified.description: Equity impact of the value of stock that has been repurchased during the period and has not been retired and is not held in treasury. Some state laws may mandate the circumstances under which an entity may acquire its own stock and prescribe the accounting treatment therefore. This element is used when state law does not recognize treasury stock.

unclassified.label: SEC Schedule, 12-09, Valuation Allowances and Reserves, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of valuation and qualifying accounts and reserves.

unclassified.label: SEC Schedule, 12-09, Valuation Allowances and Reserves, Additions, Charge to Cost and Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in valuation and qualifying accounts and reserves from charge to cost and expense.

unclassified.label: Accounts Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in allowance for credit loss on accounts receivable.

unclassified.label: Amortization of Regulatory Asset
unclassified.description: The expense charged against earnings during the period to allocate the capitalized costs of regulatory assets over the periods expected to benefit from such costs.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Accumulated Gross Unrealized Gain, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, of unrealized gain in accumulated other comprehensive income (AOCI) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Accumulated Gross Unrealized Loss, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, of unrealized loss in accumulated other comprehensive income (AOCI) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Amortized Cost
unclassified.description: Amortized cost of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Fair Value, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, after Year 5 Through 10
unclassified.description: Fair value of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing in sixth through tenth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Property, Plant and Equipment (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Acquisition, Pro Forma Revenue
unclassified.description: Amount of pro forma revenue of combined entity as if acquisition date of business combination occurred as of beginning of period.

unclassified.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Investing Activities, Discontinued Operations
unclassified.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from investing activity attributable to discontinued operation. Investing activity includes, but is not limited to, making and collecting loan, acquiring and disposing of debt and equity instruments, property, plant, and equipment, and other productive assets.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Unamortized Discount (Premium) and Debt Issuance Costs, Net
unclassified.description: Amount of unamortized debt discount (premium) and debt issuance costs.

unclassified.label: Decommissioning Liability, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount of a decommissioning liability associated with a legal obligation that a firm incurs when it constructs or operates an asset that must eventually be withdrawn from active service. This may include operating assets such as nuclear power plants or shipping vessels.

unclassified.label: Deferred Foreign Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred foreign income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations.

unclassified.label: Deferred Revenue
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred income and obligation to transfer product and service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Capital Loss Carryforwards
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible capital loss carryforwards.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Property, Plant and Equipment
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from property, plant, and equipment.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Compensation and Benefits, Pensions
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from pension benefits.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals, Allowance for Doubtful Accounts
unclassified.description: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary difference from allowance for credit loss on accounts receivable.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Investments
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from investments (excludes investments in subsidiaries and equity method investments).

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Effect of One Percentage Point Decrease on Accumulated Postretirement Benefit Obligation (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Effect of One Percentage Point Decrease on Service and Interest Cost Components (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Employer Contributions, Next Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount of contribution expected to be received by defined benefit plan from employer in next fiscal year following current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Health Care Cost Trend Rate Assumed for Next Fiscal Year (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Derivative Asset, Fair Value, Gross Liability
unclassified.description: Fair value of liability associated with financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset.

unclassified.label: Derivative Liability, Fair Value, Amount Offset Against Collateral
unclassified.description: Fair value, after effect of master netting arrangement and deduction of obligation to return financial collateral not offset and financial instrument subject to master netting arrangement not offset, of financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and contract can be net settled by means outside contract or delivery of asset. Includes derivative not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

unclassified.label: Derivative Liability, Collateral, Right to Reclaim Cash, Offset
unclassified.description: Amount of right to receive cash collateral under master netting arrangements offset against derivative liabilities.

unclassified.label: Discontinued Operation, Gain (Loss) from Disposal of Discontinued Operation, before Income Tax
unclassified.description: Amount before tax of gain (loss) not previously recognized resulting from the disposal of a discontinued operation.

unclassified.label: Discontinued Operation, Gain (Loss) on Disposal of Discontinued Operation, Net of Tax
unclassified.description: Amount after tax of gain (loss) not previously recognized resulting from the disposal of a discontinued operation.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Property, Plant and Equipment
unclassified.description: Amount classified as property, plant, and equipment attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Revenue
unclassified.description: Amount of revenue attributable to disposal group, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Share-based Payment Arrangement, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation, attributable to nondeductible expense for share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Nonvested Award, Option, Cost Not yet Recognized, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of cost to be recognized for option under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Equity Securities, FV-NI, Unrealized Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Asset, Transfers, Net
unclassified.description: Amount of transfer of financial instrument classified as an asset into (out of) level 3 of the fair value hierarchy.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Net Derivative Asset (Liability) Measured on Recurring Basis, Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Gain (Loss) Included in Earnings
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in income from derivative asset (liability) after deduction of derivative liability (asset), measured at fair value on recurring basis using unobservable input (level 3).

unclassified.label: Guarantor Obligations, Current Carrying Value
unclassified.description: The current carrying amount of the liability for the freestanding or embedded guarantor's obligations under the guarantee or each group of similar guarantees.

unclassified.label: Other than Temporary Impairment Losses, Investments
unclassified.description: The amount by which the fair value of an investment is less than the amortized cost basis or carrying amount of that investment at the balance sheet date and the decline in fair value is deemed to be other than temporary, before considering whether or not such amount is recognized in earnings or other comprehensive income.

unclassified.label: Impairment of Long-Lived Assets to be Disposed of
unclassified.description: The aggregate amount of write-downs for impairments recognized during the period for long-lived assets held for abandonment, exchange or sale.

unclassified.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Income Taxes, Foreign
unclassified.description: The portion of earnings or loss from continuing operations before income taxes that is attributable to foreign operations, which is defined as Income or Loss generated from operations located outside the entity's country of domicile.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Foreign Income Tax Rate Differential, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to foreign income tax expense (benefit).

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Noncontrolling Interest Income (Loss), Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to noncontrolling interest income (loss) exempt from income taxes.

unclassified.label: Capitalized Interest Costs, Including Allowance for Funds Used During Construction
unclassified.description: Amount of interest capitalized, including amount of allowance for funds used during construction.

unclassified.label: Investments, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of investment securities, including, but not limited to, marketable securities, derivative financial instruments, and investments accounted for under the equity method.

unclassified.label: Loss Contingency, Damages Sought, Value
unclassified.description: The value (monetary amount) of the award the plaintiff seeks in the legal matter.

unclassified.label: Noncontrolling Interest, Decrease from Deconsolidation
unclassified.description: The amount of the reduction or elimination during the period of a noncontrolling interest resulting from the parent's loss of control and deconsolidation of the entity in which one or more outside parties had a noncontrolling interest.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Remainder of Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the remainder of the fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Operating Loss Carryforwards, Valuation Allowance
unclassified.description: The portion of the valuation allowance pertaining to the deferred tax asset representing potential future taxable deductions from net operating loss carryforwards for which it is more likely than not that a tax benefit will not be realized.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivatives Qualifying as Hedges, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, Prior Service Cost (Credit), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss for prior service cost (credit) of defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Translation Adjustment, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit), after reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI for Sale of Securities, Net of Tax
unclassified.description: Amount after tax of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income for unrealized gain (loss) realized upon the sale of available-for-sale securities.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Gain (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for gain (loss) of defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Distribution
unclassified.description: Period end amount of property, plant and equipment (PPE) related to utility distribution.

unclassified.label: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Generation or Processing
unclassified.description: Period end amount of property, plant and equipment (PPE) related to generation or processing owned by public utility.

unclassified.label: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Transmission
unclassified.description: Period end amount of property, plant and equipment (PPE) related to utility transmission owned by public utility.

unclassified.label: Sale of Stock, Price Per Share
unclassified.description: Per share amount received by subsidiary or equity investee for each share of common stock issued or sold in the stock transaction.

unclassified.label: Treasury Stock Acquired, Average Cost Per Share
unclassified.description: Total cost of shares repurchased divided by the total number of shares repurchased.

unclassified.label: Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Investments
unclassified.description: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) on investment.

unclassified.label: SEC Schedule, 12-09, Valuation Allowances and Reserves, Additions, Charge to Other Account
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in valuation and qualifying accounts and reserves from charge to accounts other than cost and expense.

unclassified.label: AOCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Adjustment, after Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of accumulated unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

unclassified.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Decrease for Tax Withholding Obligation
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease to equity for grantee's tax withholding obligation for award under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Business Acquisition, Pro Forma Net Income (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of pro forma income (loss) of combined entity as if acquisition date of business combination occurred as of beginning of period.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Liabilities
unclassified.description: Amount of liability assumed in business combination and recognized at acquisition date.

unclassified.label: Capital Lease Obligations
unclassified.description: Amount equal to the present value (the principal) at the beginning of the lease term of minimum lease payments during the lease term (excluding that portion of the payments representing executory costs such as insurance, maintenance, and taxes to be paid by the lessor, together with any profit thereon) net of payments or other amounts applied to the principal through the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Capital Leased Assets, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount before accumulated depreciation of leased physical assets used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services.

unclassified.label: Debt Conversion, Original Debt, Amount
unclassified.description: The amount of the original debt being converted in a noncash (or part noncash) transaction. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Deferred Income
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from deferred income.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Return (Loss) on Plan Assets
unclassified.description: Amount of expected return (loss) recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit, calculated based on expected long-term rate of return and market-related value of plan assets of defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Defined Contribution Plan, Employer Discretionary Contribution Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of discretionary contributions made by an employer to a defined contribution plan.

unclassified.label: Defined Contribution Plan, Employer Matching Contribution, Percent of Employees' Gross Pay
unclassified.description: Percentage of employees' gross pay for which the employer contributes a matching contribution to a defined contribution plan.

unclassified.label: Defined Contribution Plan, Maximum Annual Contributions Per Employee, Percent
unclassified.description: Maximum percentage of employee gross pay the employee may contribute to a defined contribution plan.

unclassified.label: Derivative Asset Not Designated as Hedging Instrument, Fair Value (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Derivative Instruments, Gain (Loss) Recognized in Income, Net (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Derivative Instruments, Gain (Loss) Recognized in Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Effective Portion, Net (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Derivative Liability Not Designated as Hedging Instrument, Fair Value (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Discontinued Operation, Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operation, before Income Tax
unclassified.description: Amount before tax of income (loss) from a discontinued operation. Includes, but is not limited to, the income (loss) from operations during the phase-out period, gain (loss) on disposal, gain (loss) for reversal of write-down (write-down) to fair value, less cost to sell, and adjustments to a prior period gain (loss) on disposal.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation,Other Reconciling Items, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of reported income tax benefit (expense) from difference to income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying statutory federal (national) income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation, attributable to other reconciling items. Excludes state and local income tax expense (benefit), federal tax expense (benefit), statutory income tax expense (benefit) outside of country of domicile, tax credit, nondeductible expense, deduction, income tax settlement, income tax contingency, and cross-border tax law.

unclassified.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Amount Capitalized
unclassified.description: Amount of cost capitalized for award under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Equity Method Investment, Ownership Percentage
unclassified.description: The percentage of ownership of common stock or equity participation in the investee accounted for under the equity method of accounting.

unclassified.label: EquitySecuritiesFvNiCurrentAndNoncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount of investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Asset, Gain (Loss) Included in Earnings (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Asset Transfers Into Level 3
unclassified.description: Amount of transfer of financial instrument classified as an asset into level 3 of the fair value hierarchy.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Net Derivative Asset (Liability) Measured on Recurring Basis, Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Settlements
unclassified.description: Amount of settlements of financial instrument classified as a derivative asset (liability) after deduction of derivative liability, measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

unclassified.label: Foreign Income Tax Expense (Benefit), Continuing Operations
unclassified.description: Amount of current and deferred foreign income tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations.

unclassified.label: Goodwill, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) of asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

unclassified.label: Guarantor Obligations, Maximum Exposure, Undiscounted
unclassified.description: Maximum potential amount of future payments (undiscounted) the guarantor could be required to make under the guarantee or each group of similar guarantees before reduction for potential recoveries under recourse or collateralization provisions.

unclassified.label: Income Tax Expense (Benefit), Continuing Operations, Adjustment of Deferred Tax (Asset) Liability
unclassified.description: Amount of income tax expense (benefit) from continuing operations attributable to an adjustment of a deferred tax liability or asset for enacted changes in tax laws or rates or a change in the tax status of the entity.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Deduction, Qualified Production Activity, Amount
Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Income Taxes
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the account that represents the temporary difference that results from Income or Loss that is recognized for accounting purposes but not for tax purposes and vice versa.

unclassified.label: Incremental Common Shares Attributable to Dilutive Effect of Conversion of Debt Securities
unclassified.description: Additional shares included in the calculation of diluted EPS as a result of the potentially dilutive effect of convertible debt securities using the if-converted method.

unclassified.label: Incremental Common Shares Attributable to Dilutive Effect of Equity Forward Agreements
unclassified.description: Additional shared included in the calculation of diluted EPS as a result of the potentially dilutive effect of equity forward arrangements using the reverse treasury stock method.

unclassified.label: Indefinite-lived Intangible Assets (Excluding Goodwill)
unclassified.description: Amount of indefinite-lived intangible asset. Excludes goodwill.

unclassified.label: Lessor, Operating Lease, Payments to be Received
unclassified.description: Amount of lease payments to be received by lessor for operating lease.

unclassified.label: Loss Contingency, Range of Possible Loss, Maximum (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Operating Leases, Rent Expense, Net
unclassified.description: Rental expense for the reporting period incurred under operating leases, including minimum and any contingent rent expense, net of related sublease income.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, Prior Service Cost (Credit), after Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of cost (credit) of benefit change attributable to participants' prior service from plan amendment or plan initiation of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit cost (credit).

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI for Sale of Securities, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income for unrealized gain (loss) realized upon the sale of available-for-sale securities.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, after Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss for net periodic benefit cost (credit) of defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Divestiture of Businesses, Net of Cash Divested
unclassified.description: This element represents the cash inflow during the period from the sale of a component of the entity.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Lines of Credit
unclassified.description: The net cash inflow or cash outflow from a contractual arrangement with the lender, including letter of credit, standby letter of credit and revolving credit arrangements, under which borrowings can be made up to a specific amount at any point in time with either short term or long term maturity that is collateralized (backed by pledge, mortgage or other lien in the entity's assets).

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale of Available-for-sale Securities
Purchase Obligation
unclassified.description: Minimum amount of purchase arrangement in which the entity has agreed to expend funds to procure goods or services from a supplier.

unclassified.label: Repayments of Debt
unclassified.description: Amount of cash outflow for short-term and long-term debt. Excludes payment of lease obligation.

unclassified.label: Restructuring Charges
unclassified.description: Amount of expenses associated with exit or disposal activities pursuant to an authorized plan. Excludes expenses related to a discontinued operation or an asset retirement obligation.

unclassified.label: Segment Reporting Information, Revenue for Reportable Segment (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Acquisitions
unclassified.description: Number of shares of stock issued during the period pursuant to acquisitions.

unclassified.label: Stock Redeemed or Called During Period, Value
unclassified.description: Equity impact of the value of stock bought back by the entity at the exercise price or redemption price.

unclassified.label: Temporary Equity, Carrying Amount, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interests
unclassified.description: Carrying amount, attributable to parent and noncontrolling interests, of an entity's issued and outstanding stock which is not included within permanent equity. Temporary equity is a security with redemption features that are outside the control of the issuer, is not classified as an asset or liability in conformity with GAAP, and is not mandatorily redeemable. Includes any type of security that is redeemable at a fixed or determinable price or on a fixed or determinable date or dates, is redeemable at the option of the holder, or has conditions for redemption which are not solely within the control of the issuer. Includes stock with a put option held by an ESOP and stock redeemable by a holder only in the event of a change in control of the issuer.

unclassified.label: SEC Schedule, 12-09, Valuation Allowances and Reserves, Deduction
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in valuation and qualifying accounts and reserves.

unclassified.label: Accrual for Environmental Loss Contingencies
unclassified.description: Total costs accrued as of the balance sheet date for environmental loss contingencies.

unclassified.label: Segment Reporting Information, Expenditures for Additions to Long-Lived Assets (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Income Tax Benefit from Share-based Compensation
Accounts Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Recovery
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in allowance for credit loss on accounts receivable, from recovery.

unclassified.label: Business Acquisition, Cost of Acquired Entity, Purchase Price (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Acquisition, Percentage of Voting Interests Acquired
unclassified.description: Percentage of voting equity interest acquired in business combination.

unclassified.label: Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Goodwill Amount (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Assets
unclassified.description: Amount of asset acquired in business combination and recognized at acquisition date.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Net
unclassified.description: Amount of asset acquired in excess of (less than) liability assumed in business combination and recognized at acquisition date. Excludes goodwill.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Property, Plant, and Equipment
unclassified.description: Amount of property, plant, and equipment acquired in business combination and recognized at acquisition date.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Lessee Balance Sheet, Assets by Major Class, Accumulated Depreciation
unclassified.description: The total charge for the use of long-lived depreciable assets subject to a lease meeting the criteria for capitalization.

unclassified.label: Common Stock, Capital Shares Reserved for Future Issuance
unclassified.description: Aggregate number of common shares reserved for future issuance.

unclassified.label: Contractual Obligation
