unclassified.description: Amount of contractual obligation, including, but not limited to, long-term debt, lease obligation, purchase obligation, and other commitments.

unclassified.label: Costs in Excess of Billings, Current
unclassified.description: Amount of receivable reflecting the cost incurred on uncompleted contracts in excess of related billings which is expected to be collected within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Customer Advances for Construction
unclassified.description: For utilities only, represents the carrying amount of the liability as of the balance sheet date for payments received by a utility from its customers in advance of performing its obligations under terms of its construction agreements.

unclassified.label: Debt, Current
unclassified.description: Amount of debt and lease obligation, classified as current.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of debt instrument payable, including, but not limited to, notes payable and loans payable.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Unamortized Premium
unclassified.description: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of debt premium.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Equity Method Investments
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from equity method investments.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Goodwill and Intangible Assets
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from intangible assets including goodwill.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Operating Loss Carryforwards, Subject to Expiration
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible operating loss carryforwards that are subject to expiration dates.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Compensation and Benefits, Postretirement Benefits
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from postretirement benefits.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals, Asset Retirement Obligations
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from asset retirement obligations. An asset retirement obligation is a legal obligation associated with the disposal or retirement from service of a tangible long-lived asset.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Accumulated Benefit Obligation
unclassified.description: Amount of actuarial present value of benefits attributed to employee service rendered, excluding assumptions about future compensation level.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Target Allocation, Percentage
unclassified.description: Percentage of target investment allocation to total plan assets. Includes, but is not limited to, percentage on weighted-average basis if more than one plan.

unclassified.label: Derivative Asset, Collateral, Obligation to Return Cash, Offset
unclassified.description: Amount of obligation to return cash collateral under master netting arrangements offset against derivative assets.

unclassified.label: Derivative Asset Designated as Hedging Instrument, Fair Value (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Derivative Asset, Fair Value, Amount Offset Against Collateral
unclassified.description: Fair value, after effect of master netting arrangement and deduction of obligation to return financial collateral not offset and financial instrument subject to master netting arrangement not offset, of financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and contract can be net settled by means outside contract or delivery of asset. Includes derivative not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

unclassified.label: Derivative Liability, Fair Value, Amount Not Offset Against Collateral
unclassified.description: Fair value, after offset of derivative asset, of financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset, elected not to be and before offset against a right to receive collateral under a master netting arrangement. Includes liabilities elected not to be offset. Excludes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement.

unclassified.label: Derivative Instruments, Gain (Loss) Reclassified from Accumulated OCI into Income, Effective Portion, Net
unclassified.description: The effective portion of net gain (loss) reclassified from accumulated other comprehensive income into income on derivative instruments designated and qualifying as hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Derivative Liability Designated as Hedging Instrument, Fair Value (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Cash and Cash Equivalents
unclassified.description: Amount classified as cash and cash equivalents attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Foreign Income Tax Rate Differential, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations applicable to statutory income tax expense (benefit) outside of the country of domicile.

unclassified.label: EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationTaxCreditEnergyRelatedAmount
unclassified.description: Amount of reported income tax benefit (expense) from difference to income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying statutory federal (national) income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation, attributable to energy-related tax credit.

unclassified.label: EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationTaxCreditEnergyRelatedPercent
unclassified.description: Percentage of reported income tax benefit (expense) from difference to income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying statutory federal (national) income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation, attributable to energy-related tax credit.

unclassified.label: Employee Service Share-based Compensation, Cash Received from Exercise of Stock Options (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Employee Service Share-based Compensation, Tax Benefit Realized from Exercise of Stock Options (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Equity Method Investment, Difference Between Carrying Amount and Underlying Equity
unclassified.description: Difference between amount at which an investment accounted for under the equity method of accounting is carried (reported) on the balance sheet and amount of underlying equity in net assets the reporting Entity has in the investee.

unclassified.label: Excess Tax Benefit from Share-based Compensation, Financing Activities
Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Asset, Gain (Loss) Included in Earnings
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in income from asset measured at fair value on recurring basis using unobservable input (level 3).

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Asset, Purchases
unclassified.description: Amount of purchases of financial instrument classified as an asset measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Liability Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of financial instrument classified as a liability measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Net Derivative Asset (Liability) Measured on Recurring Basis, Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Transfers into Level 3
unclassified.description: Amount of transfers of financial instrument classified as a derivative asset (liability) after deduction of derivative liability (asset) into level 3 of the fair value hierarchy.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Depreciation, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to nondeductible depreciation.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Settlement, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to income tax settlements. Including, but not limited to, domestic tax settlement, foreign tax settlement, state and local tax settlement, and other tax settlements.

unclassified.label: Inventory Write-down
unclassified.description: Amount of loss from reductions in inventory due to subsequent measurement adjustments, including, but not limited to, physical deterioration, obsolescence, or changes in price levels.

unclassified.label: Investments
unclassified.description: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all investments.

unclassified.label: Lessor, Operating Lease, Payment to be Received, Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of lease payment to be received by lessor for operating lease in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Lessor, Operating Lease, Payment to be Received, Year Four
unclassified.description: Amount of lease payment to be received by lessor for operating lease in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Lessor, Operating Lease, Payment to be Received, Year One
unclassified.description: Amount of lease payment to be received by lessor for operating lease in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Lessor, Operating Lease, Payment to be Received, after Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of lease payment to be received by lessor for operating lease after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Lessor, Operating Lease, Payment to be Received, Year Three
unclassified.description: Amount of lease payment to be received by lessor for operating lease in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Lessor, Operating Lease, Payment to be Received, Year Two
unclassified.description: Amount of lease payment to be received by lessor for operating lease in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Litigation Settlement, Amount Awarded to Other Party
unclassified.description: Amount awarded to other party in judgment or settlement of litigation.

unclassified.label: Loss Contingency, Estimate of Possible Loss
unclassified.description: Reflects the estimated amount of loss from the specified contingency as of the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Net Income (Loss), Including Portion Attributable to Nonredeemable Noncontrolling Interest
unclassified.description: Amount after income tax of income (loss) including the portion attributable to nonredeemable noncontrolling interest. Excludes the portion attributable to redeemable noncontrolling interest recognized as temporary equity.

unclassified.label: Operating Lease, Lease Income, Lease Payments
unclassified.description: Amount of operating lease income from lease payments paid and payable to lessor. Excludes variable lease payments not included in measurement of lease receivable.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), after Reclassification, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after reclassification, of tax expense (benefit) for gain (loss) from derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment for Sale of Securities Included in Net Income, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment for Sale of Securities Included in Net Income, Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification, Pension and Other Postretirement Benefit Plans, Net Gain (Loss) Recognized in Net Periodic Benefit Cost, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification, Pension and Other Postretirement Benefit Plans, Net Gain (Loss) Recognized in Net Periodic Benefit Cost, Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Other Tax Expense (Benefit)
unclassified.description: Amount of other income tax expense (benefit).

unclassified.label: Payments for Repurchase of Redeemable Preferred Stock
unclassified.description: The cash outflow for reacquisition of callable preferred stock.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Warrants
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from issuance of rights to purchase common shares at predetermined price (usually issued together with corporate debt).

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale of Equity Method Investments
unclassified.description: The cash inflow associated with the sale of equity method investments, which are investments in joint ventures and entities in which the entity has an equity ownership interest normally of 20 to 50 percent and exercises significant influence.

unclassified.label: Public Utilities, Allowance for Funds Used During Construction, Rate
unclassified.description: Effective rate, including composite rate, of cost of financing additions to qualifying regulated assets, commonly called allowance for funds used during construction.

unclassified.label: Public Utilities, Requested Rate Increase (Decrease), Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of public utility's requested rate increase (decrease) with regulatory agency.

unclassified.label: Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Year One
unclassified.description: Amount of purchase arrangement to be paid in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Includes, but is not limited to, recorded and unrecorded purchase obligations, long-term purchase commitment, and short-term purchase commitment. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Repayments of Long-term Capital Lease Obligations
unclassified.description: The cash outflow for the obligation for a lease meeting the criteria for capitalization (with maturities exceeding one year or beyond the operating cycle of the entity, if longer).

unclassified.label: SegmentReportingOtherItemAmount
unclassified.description: Amount of other expense (income) and loss (gain) calculated as difference between segment revenue and separately disclosed expense category to arrive at segment profit (loss).

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Nonvested, Number
unclassified.description: The number of non-vested equity-based payment instruments, excluding stock (or unit) options, that validly exist and are outstanding as of the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Exercisable, Weighted Average Remaining Contractual Term (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Forfeitures and Expirations in Period
unclassified.description: For presentations that combine terminations, the number of shares under options that were cancelled during the reporting period as a result of occurrence of a terminating event specified in contractual agreements pertaining to the stock option plan or that expired.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Forfeitures and Expirations in Period, Weighted Average Exercise Price
unclassified.description: Weighted average price of options that were either forfeited or expired.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Grants in Period, Weighted Average Exercise Price (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Vested and Expected to Vest, Outstanding, Aggregate Intrinsic Value
unclassified.description: Amount by which current fair value of underlying stock exceeds exercise price of fully vested and expected to vest options outstanding. Includes, but is not limited to, unvested options for which requisite service period has not been rendered but that are expected to vest based on achievement of performance condition, if forfeitures are recognized when they occur.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Outstanding, Weighted Average Remaining Contractual Term (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Shares Issued, Price Per Share
unclassified.description: Per share or per unit amount of equity securities issued.

unclassified.label: Sublease Income
unclassified.description: Amount of sublease income excluding finance and operating lease expense.

unclassified.label: Write off of Deferred Debt Issuance Cost
unclassified.description: Write-off of amounts previously capitalized as debt issuance cost in an extinguishment of debt.

unclassified.label: Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Translation Adjustment, Net of Tax
unclassified.description: Accumulated adjustment, net of tax, that results from the process of translating subsidiary financial statements and foreign equity investments into the reporting currency from the functional currency of the reporting entity, net of reclassification of realized foreign currency translation gains or losses.

unclassified.label: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Warrant Issued
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in additional paid in capital (APIC) resulting from the issuance of warrants. Includes allocation of proceeds of debt securities issued with detachable stock purchase warrants.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Fair Value, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, after Year 10
unclassified.description: Fair value of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing after tenth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration, Liability
unclassified.description: Amount of liability recognized arising from contingent consideration in a business combination.

unclassified.label: Lease Obligation Incurred
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in lease obligation from new lease.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Balance Sheet, Assets by Major Class, Net
unclassified.description: The total gross amount less the charge for the use of the long-lived depreciable assets subject to a lease meeting the criteria for capitalization.

unclassified.label: Cash, FDIC Insured Amount
unclassified.description: The amount of cash deposited in financial institutions as of the balance sheet date that is insured by the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation.

unclassified.label: Cash Flow Hedge Gain (Loss) Reclassified to Earnings, Net (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Class of Warrant or Right, Exercise Price of Warrants or Rights
unclassified.description: Exercise price per share or per unit of warrants or rights outstanding.

unclassified.label: Class of Warrant or Right, Outstanding
unclassified.description: Number of warrants or rights outstanding.

unclassified.label: Contractual Obligation, to be Paid, Year One
unclassified.description: Amount of contractual obligation to be paid in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Contractual Obligation, to be Paid, Year Two
unclassified.description: Amount of contractual obligation to be paid in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Contractual Obligation, to be Paid, Year Three
unclassified.description: Amount of contractual obligation to be paid in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Cumulative Effect of Initial Adoption of New Accounting Principle (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Debt Instrument, Convertible, Conversion Ratio
unclassified.description: Ratio applied to the conversion of debt instrument into equity with equity shares divided by debt principal amount.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Realized Gain
unclassified.description: Amount of realized gain on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Credit Carryforwards, Alternative Minimum Tax
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible alternative minimum tax credit carryforwards.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Credit Carryforwards, General Business
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible general business tax credit carryforwards.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Compensation and Benefits, Employee Benefits
unclassified.description: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from employee benefits, classified as other.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Compensation and Benefits, Share-based Compensation Cost
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from share-based compensation.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals, Accrued Liabilities
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from accrued liabilities.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Intangible Assets
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from intangible assets other than goodwill.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Investment in Noncontrolled Affiliates
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from investments in unconsolidated subsidiaries and investments in other affiliates which are not controlled nor consolidated.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Amortization of Prior Service Cost (Credit)
unclassified.description: Amount of prior service cost (credit) recognized in net periodic benefit cost (credit) of defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Assumptions Used Calculating Net Periodic Benefit Cost, Expected Long-term Rate of Return on Plan Assets
unclassified.description: Weighted average rate of return on plan assets, reflecting average rate of earnings expected on existing plan assets and expected contributions, used to determine net periodic benefit cost of defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Assumptions Used Calculating Net Periodic Benefit Cost, Rate of Compensation Increase
unclassified.description: Weighted average rate of compensation increase used to determine net periodic benefit cost of defined benefit plan. Plan includes, but is not limited to, pay-related defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Interest Cost
unclassified.description: Amount of cost recognized for passage of time related to defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Service Cost
unclassified.description: Amount of cost for actuarial present value of benefits attributed to service rendered by employee for defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Ultimate Health Care Cost Trend Rate
unclassified.description: Ultimate trend rate for health care cost for defined benefit postretirement plan.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Actual Allocation, Percentage
unclassified.description: Percentage of actual investment allocation to total plan assets. Includes, but is not limited to, percentage on weighted-average basis if more than one plan.

unclassified.label: Deposit Assets
unclassified.description: The carrying amount of the asset transferred to a third party to serve as a deposit, which typically serves as security against failure by the transferor to perform under terms of an agreement.

unclassified.label: Dilutive Securities, Effect on Basic Earnings Per Share
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) to net income used for calculating diluted earnings per share (EPS), resulting from the assumed exercise stock options, restrictive stock units (RSUs), convertible preferred stock of an employee stock ownership plan (ESOP), and other dilutive convertible securities.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Accounts, Notes and Loans Receivable, Net
unclassified.description: Amount classified as accounts, notes and loans receivable attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Other Assets, Current
unclassified.description: Amount classified as other assets attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Other Liabilities, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount classified as other liabilities attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of beyond one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Dividends
unclassified.description: Amount of paid and unpaid cash, stock, and paid-in-kind (PIK) dividends declared, for example, but not limited to, common and preferred stock.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Expense (Benefit), Share-based Payment Arrangement, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation, attributable to expense for award under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes expense determined to be nondeductible upon grant or after for award under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Credit, Research, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to research tax credit.

unclassified.label: Equity Securities, FV-NI
unclassified.description: Amount of investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI), classified as current.

unclassified.label: Extinguishment of Debt, Amount
unclassified.description: Gross amount of debt extinguished.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Assets Measured on Recurring Basis, Derivative Financial Instruments, Assets (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Fair Value, Liabilities Measured on Recurring Basis, Derivative Financial Instruments, Liabilities (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Liability, Transfers out of Level 3
unclassified.description: Amount of transfers of financial instrument classified as a liability out of level 3 of the fair value hierarchy.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Asset, Purchases, (Sales), Issuances, (Settlements)
unclassified.description: Amount of purchases, (sales), issuances and (settlements) of financial instrument classified as an asset measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Asset, Settlements
unclassified.description: Amount of settlement of financial instrument classified as an asset measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Liability, Settlements
unclassified.description: Amount of settlements of financial instrument classified as a liability measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Net Derivative Asset (Liability) Measured on Recurring Basis, Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Transfers out of Level 3
unclassified.description: Amount of transfers of financial instrument classified as derivative asset (liability) after deduction of derivative liability (asset) out of level 3 of the fair value hierarchy.

unclassified.label: Finance Lease, Right-of-Use Asset, before Accumulated Amortization
unclassified.description: Amount, before accumulated amortization, of right-of-use asset from finance lease.

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, Remainder of Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization expense for finite-lived intangible asset expected to be recognized in remainder of current fiscal year. Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

unclassified.label: Finite-lived Intangible Assets Acquired
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in finite-lived intangible asset acquired in business combination, asset acquisition, and from joint venture formation. Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

unclassified.label: Forward Contract Indexed to Issuer's Equity, Forward Rate Per Share
unclassified.description: The per share price of the Company's stock at which the contract holder of the freestanding contract has the right to purchase or sell the Company's stock at a future date.

unclassified.label: Forward Contract Indexed to Issuer's Equity, Shares
unclassified.description: Maximum number of shares that could be issued to settle forward contract indexed to equity.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Contract Termination
unclassified.description: Gain (loss) related to the termination of a contract between the parties. The termination may be due to many causes including early termination of a lease by a lessee, a breach of contract by one party, or a failure to perform.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Derivatives
unclassified.description: The difference between the book value and the sale price of options, swaps, futures, forward contracts, and other derivative instruments. This element refers to the gain (loss) included in earnings.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Oil and Gas and Timber Property
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of oil and gas property or timber property.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Stock in Subsidiary or Equity Method Investee
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of equity in securities of subsidiaries or equity method investee.

unclassified.label: Goodwill, Purchase Accounting Adjustments
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) from measurement period adjustment of asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

unclassified.label: Income Tax Examination, Penalties and Interest Accrued
unclassified.description: The amount of estimated penalties and interest accrued as of the balance sheet date arising from income tax examinations.

unclassified.label: IncomeTaxPaidForeignAfterRefundReceived
unclassified.description: Amount, after income tax refund received, of cash paid to foreign tax jurisdiction for tax on income.

unclassified.label: Income Taxes Receivable
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of income taxes previously overpaid to tax authorities (such as U.S. Federal, state and local tax authorities) representing refunds of overpayments or recoveries based on agreed-upon resolutions of disputes. Also called income tax refund receivable.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Deduction, Medicare Prescription Drug Benefit, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to deduction for Medicare prescription drug benefit subsidy.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Disposition of Business, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to the disposition of a business not qualifying as a discontinued operation.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Impairment Losses, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to nondeductible impairment loss.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Credit, Research, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to research tax credit.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Settlement, Domestic, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to domestic income tax settlement.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Asset Retirement Obligations
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the carrying amount of asset retirement obligations.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Customer Deposits
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the period in the amount of customer money held in customer accounts, including security deposits, collateral for a current or future transactions, initial payment of the cost of acquisition or for the right to enter into a contract or agreement.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Unbilled Receivables
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period of the amount of revenue for work performed for which billing has not occurred, net of uncollectible accounts.

unclassified.label: Legal Fees
unclassified.description: The amount of expense provided in the period for legal costs incurred on or before the balance sheet date pertaining to resolved, pending or threatened litigation, including arbitration and mediation proceedings.

unclassified.label: Lessor, Operating Lease, Payment to be Received, Remainder of Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount of lease payment to be received by lessor for operating lease in remainder of current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Litigation Settlement, Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of litigation expense, including but not limited to legal, forensic, accounting, and investigative fees.

unclassified.label: Long-term Transition Bond, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Long-Term transition bonds are bonds under the Competition Act in which the proceeds of Transition Bonds are required to be used principally to reduce qualified stranded costs and the related capitalization of the utility. This represents the noncurrent portion.

unclassified.label: Long-term Pollution Control Bond
unclassified.description: Represents the current and noncurrent portions of a debt security issued by a state, certain agencies or authorities, a local government, or development corporation to finance the construction of air- or water-pollution control facilities or sewage or solid waste disposal facilities pursuant to federal law. The bonds are backed by the credit of the beneficiary of the financing rather than the credit of the issuer.

unclassified.label: Net Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations Available to Common Shareholders, Basic
unclassified.description: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities; of income (loss) from discontinued operations available to common shareholders.

unclassified.label: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Investments Acquired
unclassified.description: The amount of investments that an Entity acquires in a noncash (or part noncash) acquisition. Noncash is defined as information about all investing and financing activities of an enterprise during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
unclassified.description: Amortized cost, after allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable classified as current. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable, classified as noncurrent.

unclassified.label: Other Commitment
unclassified.description: Minimum amount of other commitment not otherwise specified in the taxonomy. Excludes commitments explicitly modeled in the taxonomy, including but not limited to, long-term and short-term purchase commitments, recorded and unrecorded purchase obligations, supply commitments, registration payment arrangements, leases, debt, product warranties, guarantees, environmental remediation obligations, and pensions.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Amortization, Pension and Other Postretirement Benefit Plans, Net Prior Service Cost Recognized in Net Periodic Pension Cost, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Adjustment, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Amortization, Pension and Other Postretirement Benefit Plans, Net Prior Service Cost Recognized in Net Periodic Pension Cost, Tax Effect (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Gain (Loss), after Adjustment, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after adjustment, of tax expense (benefit) for unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) and tax expense (benefit) for unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to available-for-sale.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, Prior Service Cost (Credit), Tax
unclassified.description: Amount of tax (expense) benefit for cost (credit) of benefit change attributable to participants' prior service from plan amendment or plan initiation of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit cost (credit).

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment for Sale of Securities Included in Net Income, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification, Pension and Other Postretirement Benefit Plans, Net Gain (Loss) Recognized in Net Periodic Benefit Cost, Tax (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Tax
unclassified.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) allocated to other comprehensive income (loss).

unclassified.label: Postemployment Benefits Liability
unclassified.description: The carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the obligations recognized for the various benefits provided to former or inactive employees, their beneficiaries, and covered dependents after employment but before retirement.

unclassified.label: Preferred Stock, Dividends Per Share, Declared
unclassified.description: Aggregate dividends declared during the period for each share of preferred stock outstanding.

unclassified.label: Preferred Stock, Redemption Price Per Share
unclassified.description: The price per share at which the preferred stock of an entity that has priority over common stock in the distribution of dividends and in the event of liquidation of the entity is redeemed or may be called at. The redemption features of this preferred stock are solely within the control of the issuer.

unclassified.label: Prior Period Reclassification Adjustment
unclassified.description: The amount of a reclassification adjustment made to prior period financial statement amounts.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale of Short-term Investments
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from sales of all investments, including securities and other assets, having ready marketability and intended by management to be liquidated, if necessary, within the current operating cycle. Includes cash flows from securities classified as trading securities that were acquired for reasons other than sale in the short-term.

unclassified.label: Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Year Four
unclassified.description: Amount of purchase arrangement to be paid in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Includes, but is not limited to, recorded and unrecorded purchase obligations, long-term purchase commitment, and short-term purchase commitment. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Year Two
unclassified.description: Amount of purchase arrangement to be paid in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Includes, but is not limited to, recorded and unrecorded purchase obligations, long-term purchase commitment, and short-term purchase commitment. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Year Three
unclassified.description: Amount of purchase arrangement to be paid in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Includes, but is not limited to, recorded and unrecorded purchase obligations, long-term purchase commitment, and short-term purchase commitment. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Reclassification from AOCI, Current Period, Net of Tax, Attributable to Parent
unclassified.description: Amount after tax of reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss) attributable to parent.

unclassified.label: Remaining Amounts of Regulatory Assets for which No Return on Investment During Recovery Period is Provided
unclassified.description: Remaining balance of regulatory assets for which no return on investment during recovery is provided. In some cases, a regulator may permit an enterprise to include a cost that would be charged to expense by an unregulated enterprise as an allowable cost over a period of time by amortizing that cost for rate-making purposes, but the regulator does not include the unrecovered amount in the rate base.

unclassified.label: Restructuring Reserve
unclassified.description: Carrying amount (including both current and noncurrent portions of the accrual) as of the balance sheet date pertaining to a specified type of cost associated with exit from or disposal of business activities or restructuring pursuant to a duly authorized plan.

unclassified.label: Segment Reporting Information, Expenditures for Additions to Long-Lived Assets (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Severance Costs
unclassified.description: Amount of expenses for special or contractual termination benefits provided to current employees involuntarily terminated under a benefit arrangement associated exit or disposal activities pursuant to an authorized plan. Excludes expenses related to one-time termination benefits, a discontinued operation or an asset retirement obligation.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Forfeited in Period
unclassified.description: The number of equity-based payment instruments, excluding stock (or unit) options, that were forfeited during the reporting period.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Grants in Period, Weighted Average Grant Date Fair Value
unclassified.description: The weighted average fair value at grant date for nonvested equity-based awards issued during the period on other than stock (or unit) option plans (for example, phantom stock or unit plan, stock or unit appreciation rights plan, performance target plan).

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Nonvested, Weighted Average Grant Date Fair Value
unclassified.description: Per share or unit weighted-average fair value of nonvested award under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes share and unit options.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Vested in Period, Weighted Average Grant Date Fair Value
unclassified.description: The weighted average fair value as of grant date pertaining to an equity-based award plan other than a stock (or unit) option plan for which the grantee gained the right during the reporting period, by satisfying service and performance requirements, to receive or retain shares or units, other instruments, or cash in accordance with the terms of the arrangement.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Fair Value Assumptions, Expected Term (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Shares Issued in Period
unclassified.description: Number of shares issued under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Short-term Debt, Average Outstanding Amount
unclassified.description: For the form of debt having an initial term of less than one year or less than the normal operating cycle, if longer, average borrowings during the period.

unclassified.label: Significant Change in Unrecognized Tax Benefits is Reasonably Possible, Amount of Unrecorded Benefit
unclassified.description: The amount of the unrecognized tax benefit of a position taken for which it is reasonably possible that the total amount thereof will significantly increase or decrease within twelve months of the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Conversion of Convertible Securities
unclassified.description: Number of shares issued during the period as a result of the conversion of convertible securities.

unclassified.label: Shares Issued, Shares, Share-based Payment Arrangement, after Forfeiture
unclassified.description: Number, after forfeiture, of shares or units issued under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes shares or units issued under employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

unclassified.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Issued for Services
unclassified.description: Value of stock issued in lieu of cash for services contributed to the entity. Value of the stock issued includes, but is not limited to, services contributed by vendors and founders.

unclassified.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Other
unclassified.description: Value of shares of stock issued attributable to transactions classified as other.

unclassified.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Treasury Stock Reissued
unclassified.description: Value of treasury shares or units reissued. Excludes reissuance of shares or units in treasury for award under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Stock Repurchase Program, Remaining Authorized Repurchase Amount
unclassified.description: Amount remaining authorized for purchase of share under share repurchase plan. Includes, but is not limited to, repurchase of stock and unit of ownership.

unclassified.label: Stock Repurchased and Retired During Period, Shares
unclassified.description: Number of shares that have been repurchased and retired during the period.

unclassified.label: Stock Repurchased During Period, Shares
unclassified.description: Number of shares that have been repurchased during the period and have not been retired and are not held in treasury. Some state laws may govern the circumstances under which an entity may acquire its own stock and prescribe the accounting treatment therefore. This element is used when state law does not recognize treasury stock.

unclassified.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Income Tax Penalties Accrued
unclassified.description: Amount of statutory penalties accrued for a tax position claimed or expected to be claimed by the entity, in its tax return.

unclassified.label: Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation
unclassified.description: Amount of unrecorded obligation to transfer funds in future for fixed or minimum amount or quantity of product and service at fixed or minimum price. Includes, but is not limited to, lease not yet commenced and take-or-pay and throughput contracts.

unclassified.label: Accrued Professional Fees, Current
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable for professional fees, such as for legal and accounting services received. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

unclassified.label: Acquisition Costs, Period Cost
unclassified.description: Amount of capitalized acquisition cost incurred during period and excluded from amortization for oil- and gas-producing activities accounted for under full cost method. Excludes exploration and development costs and capitalized interest.

unclassified.label: Adjustment to Additional Paid in Capital, Income Tax Effect from Share-based Compensation, Net
APIC, Share-based Payment Arrangement, Option, Increase for Cost Recognition
unclassified.description: Amount of increase to additional paid-in capital (APIC) for recognition of cost for option under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Asset Retirement Obligation, Legally Restricted Assets, Fair Value
unclassified.description: Carrying amount of an asset that is legally restricted for purposes of settling an asset retirement obligation.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Unrealized Loss
unclassified.description: Amount of unrealized loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

unclassified.label: Available-for-sale Securities, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, Fair Value
Available-for-sale Securities, Debt Maturities, Amortized Cost Basis (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Business Acquisition, Pro Forma Earnings Per Share, Basic
unclassified.description: Per basic share amount, after tax, of pro forma income (loss) of combined entity as if acquisition date of business combination occurred as of beginning of period.

unclassified.label: Business Acquisition, Pro Forma Earnings Per Share, Diluted
unclassified.description: Per diluted share amount, after tax, of pro forma income (loss) of combined entity as if acquisition date of business combination occurred as of beginning of period.

unclassified.label: Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Current Assets, Cash and Cash Equivalents (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Cash and Equivalents
unclassified.description: Amount of cash and cash equivalent acquired in business combination and recognized at acquisition date.

unclassified.label: Cash, Cash Equivalents, and Short-term Investments
unclassified.description: Cash includes currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions. It also includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits in that the customer may deposit additional funds at any time and effectively may withdraw funds at any time without prior notice or penalty. Cash equivalents, excluding items classified as marketable securities, include short-term, highly liquid Investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash, and so near their maturity that they present minimal risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Generally, only investments with original maturities of three months or less qualify under that definition. Original maturity means original maturity to the entity holding the investment. For example, both a three-month US Treasury bill and a three-year Treasury note purchased three months from maturity qualify as cash equivalents. However, a Treasury note purchased three years ago does not become a cash equivalent when its remaining maturity is three months. Short-term investments, exclusive of cash equivalents, generally consist of marketable securities intended to be sold within one year (or the normal operating cycle if longer) and may include trading securities, available-for-sale securities, or held-to-maturity securities (if maturing within one year), as applicable.

unclassified.label: Contractual Obligation, to be Paid, after Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of contractual obligation to be paid after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Contractual Obligation, to be Paid, Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of contractual obligation to be paid in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Contractual Obligation, to be Paid, Year Four
unclassified.description: Amount of contractual obligation to be paid in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Convertible Debt
unclassified.description: Including the current and noncurrent portions, carrying amount of debt identified as being convertible into another form of financial instrument (typically the entity's common stock) as of the balance sheet date, which originally required full repayment more than twelve months after issuance or greater than the normal operating cycle of the company.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Convertible, Conversion Price
unclassified.description: The price per share of the conversion feature embedded in the debt instrument.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Interest Rate During Period
unclassified.description: The average effective interest rate during the reporting period.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, 12 Months or Longer
unclassified.description: Amount of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), in continuous unrealized loss position for more than 12 months, without allowance for credit loss. Includes beneficial interest in securitized financial asset.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Realized Loss
unclassified.description: Amount of realized loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Unrealized Loss Position
unclassified.description: Amount of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), in unrealized loss position without allowance for credit loss.

unclassified.label: Deferred Revenue, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred income and obligation to transfer product and service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable, classified as noncurrent.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Asset, Interest Carryforward
unclassified.description: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible interest carryforward.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Investments
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from investments (excludes investments in subsidiaries and equity method investments).

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Other
unclassified.description: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from provisions, reserves, allowances, and accruals, classified as other.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Goodwill
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from goodwill.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Amortization of Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit of defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Assumptions Used Calculating Benefit Obligation, Rate of Compensation Increase
unclassified.description: Weighted average rate increase of compensation, used to determine benefit obligation of defined benefit plan. Plan includes, but is not limited to, pay-related defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Estimated Future Employer Contributions in Current Fiscal Year (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Benefit Payment, after Year Five for Next Five Years
unclassified.description: Amount of benefit for defined benefit plan expected to be paid in five fiscal years after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Benefit Payment, Year One
unclassified.description: Amount of benefit for defined benefit plan expected to be paid in next fiscal year following current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Benefit Payment, Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of benefit for defined benefit plan expected to be paid in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Benefit Payment, Year Four
unclassified.description: Amount of benefit for defined benefit plan expected to be paid in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Benefit Payment, Year Three
unclassified.description: Amount of benefit for defined benefit plan expected to be paid in third fiscal year following current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Benefit Payment, Year Two
unclassified.description: Amount of benefit for defined benefit plan expected to be paid in second fiscal year following current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan with Accumulated Benefit Obligation in Excess of Plan Assets, Accumulated Benefit Obligation
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated benefit obligation for defined benefit plan with accumulated benefit obligation in excess of plan assets.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Target Plan Asset Allocations (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Defined Contribution Plan, Employer Matching Contribution, Percent of Match
unclassified.description: Percentage employer matches of the employee's percentage contribution matched.

unclassified.label: Derivative Assets (Liabilities), at Fair Value, Net
unclassified.description: Fair values as of the balance sheet date of the net amount of all assets and liabilities resulting from contracts that meet the criteria of being accounted for as derivative instruments.

unclassified.label: Derivative Instruments, Gain (Loss) Recognized in Income, Ineffective Portion and Amount Excluded from Effectiveness Testing, Net
unclassified.description: The portion of gains and losses (net) on derivative instruments designated and qualifying as hedging instruments representing (a) the amount of the hedge ineffectiveness and (b) the amount, if any, excluded from the assessment of hedge effectiveness.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Operating Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of operating expense attributable to disposal group, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Other Liabilities
unclassified.description: Amount classified as other liabilities attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Property, Plant, and Equipment, Net (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Deduction, Employee Stock Ownership Plan Dividend, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to deduction for dividend paid to employee stock ownership plan.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Deduction, Qualified Production Activity, Percent
Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Depreciation, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to depreciation.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Expense (Benefit), Share-based Payment Arrangement, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation, attributable to expense for award under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes expense determined to be nondeductible upon grant or after for award under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Employee Benefits and Share-based Compensation
unclassified.description: Amount of expense for employee benefit and equity-based compensation.

unclassified.label: Employee Service Share-based Compensation, Unrecognized Compensation Costs on Nonvested Awards, Weighted Average Period of Recognition (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Equity Method Investment, Summarized Financial Information, Net Income (Loss) (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Escrow Deposit
unclassified.description: The designation of funds furnished by a borrower to a lender to assure future payments of the borrower's real estate taxes and insurance obligations with respect to a mortgaged property. Escrow deposits may be made for a variety of other purposes such as earnest money and contingent payments. This element excludes replacement reserves which are an escrow separately provided for within the US GAAP taxonomy.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Assets and Liabilities Measured on Recurring Basis, Gain (Loss) Included in Earnings
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in income from asset and liability measured at fair value on recurring basis using unobservable input (level 3).

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Assets, Level 1 to Level 2 Transfers, Amount
Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Asset, Gain (Loss) Included in Other Comprehensive Income (Loss) (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Liability, Issuances
unclassified.description: Amount of issuances of financial instrument classified as a liability measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Net Asset (Liability)
unclassified.description: Fair value of asset after deduction of liability.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Net Derivative Asset (Liability) Measured on Recurring Basis, Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Gain (Loss) Included in Other Comprehensive Income (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in other comprehensive income from derivative asset (liability) after deduction of derivative liability (asset), measured at fair value on recurring basis using unobservable input (level 3).

unclassified.label: Finance Lease, Right-of-Use Asset, Accumulated Amortization
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated amortization of right-of-use asset from finance lease.

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, after Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization expense for finite-lived intangible asset expected to be recognized after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach). Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Cash Flow Hedge Ineffectiveness, Net
unclassified.description: The net gain (loss) recognized in earnings during the reporting period representing the amount of the cash flow hedges' ineffectiveness.

unclassified.label: Impairment of Intangible Assets, Finite-lived
unclassified.description: Amount of impairment loss for finite-lived intangible asset. Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

unclassified.label: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
unclassified.description: Amount after tax of income (loss) from a discontinued operation attributable to the noncontrolling interest. Includes, but is not limited to, the income (loss) from operations during the phase-out period, gain (loss) on disposal, gain (loss) for reversal of write-down (write-down) to fair value, less cost to sell, and adjustments to a prior period gain (loss) on disposal.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Deduction, Other, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to other deductions.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Liabilities
unclassified.description: Change during the period in carrying value for all deferred liabilities due within one year or operating cycle.

unclassified.label: Insurance Recoveries
unclassified.description: The amount recovered from insurance. These recoveries reduce costs and losses that are reported as a separate line item under operating expenses.

unclassified.label: Inventory, Finished Goods, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount before valuation and LIFO reserves of completed merchandise or goods expected to be sold within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Jointly Owned Utility Plant, Gross Ownership Amount of Plant in Service
unclassified.description: The period end amount owned by the reporting utility of a jointly owned utility plant in service.

unclassified.label: Jointly Owned Utility Plant, Ownership Amount of Plant Accumulated Depreciation
unclassified.description: The period end amount of accumulated depreciation in a jointly owned electricity generation plant.

unclassified.label: Liabilities Assumed
unclassified.description: The fair value of liabilities assumed in noncash investing or financing activities.

unclassified.label: Line of Credit Facility, Commitment Fee Percentage
unclassified.description: The fee, expressed as a percentage of the line of credit facility, for the line of credit facility regardless of whether the facility has been used.

unclassified.label: Long-term Debt and Lease Obligation, Including Current Maturities
unclassified.description: Amount of long-term debt and lease obligation, including portion classified as current.

unclassified.label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, Remainder of Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing in remainder of current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Long-term Purchase Commitment, Amount
unclassified.description: The minimum amount the entity agreed to spend under the long-term purchase commitment.

unclassified.label: Noncontrolling Interest, Ownership Percentage by Noncontrolling Owners
unclassified.description: The equity interest of noncontrolling shareholders, partners or other equity holders in consolidated entity.

unclassified.label: Noncontrolling Interest, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Net Increase or Decrease in balance of noncontrolling interest in the subsidiary during the reporting period.

unclassified.label: Money Market Funds, at Carrying Value
unclassified.description: Investment in short-term money-market instruments (such as commercial paper, banker's acceptances, repurchase agreements, government securities, certificates of deposit, and so forth) which are highly liquid (that is, readily convertible to known amounts of cash) and so near their maturity that they present an insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Generally, only investments with original maturities of three months or less qualify as cash equivalents by definition. Original maturity means an original maturity to the entity holding the investment. For example, both a three-month US Treasury bill and a three-year Treasury note purchased three months from maturity qualify as cash equivalents. However, a Treasury note purchased three-years ago does not become a cash equivalent when its remaining maturity is three months.

unclassified.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent, Diluted
unclassified.description: The portion of profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, which is attributable to the parent, and includes adjustments resulting from the assumption that dilutive convertible securities were converted, options or warrants were exercised, or that other shares were issued upon the satisfaction of certain conditions.

unclassified.label: New Accounting Pronouncement or Change in Accounting Principle, Effect of Adoption, Quantification (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Fixed Assets Acquired
unclassified.description: The amount of fixed assets that an Entity acquires in a noncash (or part noncash) acquisition. Noncash is defined as information about all investing and financing activities of an enterprise during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

unclassified.label: Long-Lived Assets
unclassified.description: Amount of long-lived asset, excluding financial instrument, long-term customer relationship of financial institution, mortgage and other servicing rights, deferred policy acquisition cost, and deferred tax asset.

unclassified.label: Number of States in which Entity Operates
unclassified.description: The number of states the entity operates in as of the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Amortization, Pension and Other Postretirement Benefit Plans, Net Prior Service Cost Recognized in Net Periodic Pension Cost, Tax (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Available-for-sale Securities Adjustment, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, after Tax and Reclassification Adjustment, Attributable to Parent
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax and reclassification adjustment, of (increase) decrease in accumulated other comprehensive income for defined benefit plan, attributable to parent.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivatives Qualifying as Hedges, Tax Effect (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
OCI, Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Gain (Loss), Arising During Period, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit), before reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, Prior Service Cost (Credit), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount of tax (expense) benefit of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss for prior service cost (credit) of defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax, Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
unclassified.description: Amount after tax of other comprehensive income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interests.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment for Sale of Securities Included in Net Income, Tax (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss for net period benefit cost (credit) of defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Gain (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for gain (loss) of defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent
unclassified.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) allocated to other comprehensive income (loss) attributable to parent entity.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income, Other, Net of Tax
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in other comprehensive income, after tax, from changes classified as other.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment on Derivatives Included in Net Income, before Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)

Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification, Pension and Other Postretirement Benefit Plans, Net Transition Asset (Obligation), Recognized in Net Periodic Benefit Cost, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Other Noncash Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of expense or loss included in net income that result in no cash flow, classified as other.
