unclassified.label: Other Significant Noncash Transaction, Value of Consideration Given
unclassified.description: The value of the noncash (or part noncash) consideration given (for example, liability, equity) in a transaction. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of a transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

unclassified.label: Payments for Derivative Instrument, Financing Activities
unclassified.description: The cash outflow for derivative instruments during the period, which are classified as financing activities, excluding those designated as hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Payments for Repurchase of Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest
unclassified.description: The cash outflow during the period for redemption of redeemable noncontrolling interests.

unclassified.label: Payments for Restructuring
unclassified.description: Amount of cash payments made as the result of exit or disposal activities. Excludes payments associated with a discontinued operation or an asset retirement obligation.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Divestiture of Businesses and Interests in Affiliates
unclassified.description: The cash inflow associated with the amount received from the sale of a business segment or subsidiary or sale of an entity that is related to it but not strictly controlled during the period (for example, an unconsolidated subsidiary, affiliate, joint venture or equity method investment).

unclassified.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Other, Accumulated Depreciation
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization of property, plant, and equipment; classified as other. Includes, but is not limited to, land and land improvement; building; machinery and equipment; furniture and fixture; and work of art, historical treasure, or similar asset classified as collection.

unclassified.label: Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, after Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of purchase arrangement to be paid after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Includes, but is not limited to, recorded and unrecorded purchase obligations, long-term purchase commitment, and short-term purchase commitment. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of purchase arrangement to be paid in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Includes, but is not limited to, recorded and unrecorded purchase obligations, long-term purchase commitment, and short-term purchase commitment. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Ratio of Indebtedness to Net Capital
unclassified.description: Indebtedness divided by net capital.

unclassified.label: Related Party Transaction, Amounts of Transaction
unclassified.description: Amount of transactions with related party during the financial reporting period.

unclassified.label: Related Party Transaction, Expenses from Transactions with Related Party
Repayments of Secured Debt
unclassified.description: The cash outflow to repay long-term debt that is wholly or partially secured by collateral. Excludes repayments of tax exempt secured debt.

unclassified.label: Retained Earnings, Undistributed Earnings from Equity Method Investees
unclassified.description: Amount of consolidated retained earnings that represent undistributed (not yet received) earnings from 50 percent or less owned persons accounted for by the equity method (equity method investees).

unclassified.label: Revenue Not from Contract with Customer
unclassified.description: Amount of revenue that is not accounted for under Topic 606.

unclassified.label: Revenue Not from Contract with Customer, Other
unclassified.description: Amount of revenue that is not accounted for under Topic 606, classified as other.

unclassified.label: Secured Debt
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date, including the current and noncurrent portions, of collateralized debt obligations (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer). Such obligations include mortgage loans, chattel loans, and any other borrowings secured by assets of the borrower.

unclassified.label: Segment Reporting Information, Depreciation, Depletion, and Amortization Expense (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Segment Reporting Information, Revenue from External Customers (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Vested in Period
unclassified.description: The number of equity-based payment instruments, excluding stock (or unit) options, that vested during the reporting period.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Exercises in Period (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Expirations in Period
unclassified.description: Number of options or other stock instruments for which the right to exercise has lapsed under the terms of the plan agreements.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Forfeitures in Period, Weighted Average Exercise Price (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Grants in Period, Grant Date Intrinsic Value
unclassified.description: The grant-date intrinsic value of options granted during the reporting period as calculated by applying the disclosed option pricing methodology.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Vested, Number of Shares
unclassified.description: Number of options vested.

unclassified.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Shares Withheld for Tax Withholding Obligation
unclassified.description: Number of shares used to settle grantee's tax withholding obligation for award under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Significant (Increase) Decrease in Unrecognized Tax Benefits is Reasonably Possible, Estimated Range of Change, Upper Bound (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
Shares Granted, Value, Share-based Payment Arrangement, after Forfeiture
unclassified.description: Value, after forfeiture, of shares granted under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

unclassified.label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Dividend Reinvestment Plan
unclassified.description: Number of shares issued during the period from a dividend reinvestment plan (DRIP). A dividend reinvestment plan allows the shareholders to reinvest dividends paid to them by the entity on new issues of stock by the entity.

unclassified.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Conversion of Units
unclassified.description: Value of stock issued during the period upon the conversion of units. An example of a convertible unit is an umbrella partnership real estate investment trust unit (UPREIT unit).

unclassified.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Employee Stock Purchase Plan
unclassified.description: Aggregate change in value for stock issued during the period as a result of employee stock purchase plan.

unclassified.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Restricted Stock Award, Gross
unclassified.description: Aggregate value of stock related to Restricted Stock Awards issued during the period.

unclassified.label: Stock Repurchased and Retired During Period, Value
unclassified.description: Equity impact of the value of stock that has been repurchased and retired during the period. The excess of the purchase price over par value can be charged against retained earnings (once the excess is fully allocated to additional paid in capital).

unclassified.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Income Tax Penalties and Interest Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of expense for interest on an underpayment of income taxes and penalties related to a tax position claimed or expected to be claimed in the tax return.

unclassified.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Increase Resulting from Acquisition
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from acquisitions.

unclassified.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Increase Resulting from Settlements with Taxing Authorities
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from settlements with taxing authorities.

unclassified.label: Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of fixed and determinable portion of unrecorded unconditional purchase obligation to be paid in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach). Includes, but is not limited to, lease not yet commenced.

unclassified.label: Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Year Four
unclassified.description: Amount of fixed and determinable portion of unrecorded unconditional purchase obligation to be paid in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach). Includes, but is not limited to, lease not yet commenced.

unclassified.label: Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Year Two
unclassified.description: Amount of fixed and determinable portion of unrecorded unconditional purchase obligation to be paid in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach). Includes, but is not limited to, lease not yet commenced.

unclassified.label: Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Year Three
unclassified.description: Amount of fixed and determinable portion of unrecorded unconditional purchase obligation to be paid in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach). Includes, but is not limited to, lease not yet commenced.

unclassified.label: Accrual for Environmental Loss Contingencies, Gross
unclassified.description: Undiscounted amount of the accrual for environmental loss contingencies.

unclassified.label: Accrued Environmental Loss Contingencies, Current
unclassified.description: Carrying value of the obligation (known or estimated) arising from requirements to perform activities to remediate one or more sites, payable in twelve months or in the next operating cycle if longer.

unclassified.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Expense, after Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of expense for award under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Amount of Restricted Net Assets for Consolidated and Unconsolidated Subsidiaries
unclassified.description: Amount of restricted net assets of consolidated and unconsolidated subsidiaries as of the end of the most recently completed fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Available-for-sale Securities, Accumulated Gross Unrealized Gain, before Tax
Available-for-sale Securities, Accumulated Gross Unrealized Loss, before Tax
Available-for-sale Securities, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, Twelve Months or Longer, Fair Value
Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Amortized Cost, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, after Year 5 Through 10
unclassified.description: Amortized cost of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing in sixth through tenth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Amortized Cost, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, after Year One Through Five
unclassified.description: Amortized cost of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing in second through fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Amortized Cost, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, after Year 10
unclassified.description: Amortized cost of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing after tenth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Available-for-sale Securities, Debt Maturities, Fair Value (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Amortized Cost, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, Year One
unclassified.description: Amortized cost of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Available-for-sale Securities, Gross Realized Gains (Losses), Sale Proceeds (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Business Acquisition, Cost of Acquired Entity, Cash Paid (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Amortizable Intangible Assets (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Current Liabilities (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Liabilities Assumed (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Other Noncurrent Assets (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Acquisition, Pro Forma Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Net of Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of pro forma income (loss) from continuing operations of combined entity as if acquisition date of business combination occurred as of beginning of period.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Acquisition of Less than 100 Percent, Noncontrolling Interest, Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of noncontrolling interest in acquiree at acquisition date when acquirer holds less than 100 percent of equity interest in acquiree.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Consideration Transferred, Other
unclassified.description: Amount of tangible and intangible assets other than cash transferred by acquirer as part of consideration transferred in business combination. Includes, but is not limited to, business or subsidiary, or both, of acquirer transferred to former owner of acquiree.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Pro Forma Information, Revenue of Acquiree since Acquisition Date, Actual
unclassified.description: Amount of acquiree's revenue since acquisition date of business combination included in consolidated statement of income.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Current Assets
unclassified.description: Amount of asset acquired in business combination and recognized at acquisition date, classified as current.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Current Liabilities
unclassified.description: Amount of liability assumed in business combination and recognized at acquisition date, classified as current.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired, Goodwill, and Liabilities Assumed, Net
unclassified.description: Amount of asset acquired in excess of (less than) liability assumed plus goodwill in business combination and recognized at acquisition date.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Executory Costs
unclassified.description: Amounts to be paid by lessee to lessor for maintenance, insurance, and tax expenses related to the leased asset.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Income Statement, Interest Expense
unclassified.description: The financing charge for leasing arrangements meeting the criteria for capitalization.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Net Investment in Direct Financing Leases
unclassified.description: The net investment in direct financing leases as of the balance sheet date consisting of: (a) minimum lease payments due on direct financing leases, (b) unguaranteed residual value, and (c) any unamortized initial direct costs; less: (i) executory costs, (ii) unearned income, and (iii) the accumulated allowance for uncollectible minimum lease payments.

unclassified.label: Capitalized Computer Software, Amortization
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization expense for capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed. Excludes capitalized cost for internal-use software.

unclassified.label: Cash Flow Hedge Derivative Instrument Assets at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of all asset derivatives designated as cash flow hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Cash Flow Hedge Derivative Instrument Liabilities at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of all liability derivatives designated as cash flow hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Concentration Risk, Credit Risk, Financial Instrument, Maximum Exposure
unclassified.description: Maximum amount of loss due to credit risk that, based on the gross fair value of the financial instrument, the entity would incur if parties to the financial instruments that make up the concentration failed completely to perform according to the terms of the contracts and the collateral or other security, if any, for the amount due proved to be of no value to the entity.

unclassified.label: Concentration Risk, Percentage
unclassified.description: For an entity that discloses a concentration risk in relation to quantitative amount, which serves as the "benchmark" (or denominator) in the equation, this concept represents the concentration percentage derived from the division.

unclassified.label: Contributions in Aid of Construction
unclassified.description: Developers, builders, governmental agencies and municipalities will provide the entity with cash, or in some cases property, to extend its services to their properties. Nonrefundable contributions are recorded as contributions in aid of construction ("CIAC").

unclassified.label: Cumulative Effect of Initial Adoption of FIN 48 (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Debt and Lease Obligation
unclassified.description: Amount of short-term and long-term debt and lease obligation.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Interest Rate, Effective Percentage
unclassified.description: Effective interest rate for the funds borrowed under the debt agreement considering interest compounding and original issue discount or premium.

unclassified.label: Debt, Long-term and Short-term, Combined Amount
unclassified.description: Represents the aggregate of total long-term debt, including current maturities and short-term debt.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, 12 Months or Longer, Accumulated Loss
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated unrealized loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), in continuous unrealized loss position for 12 months or longer, without allowance for credit loss. Includes beneficial interest in securitized financial asset.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, Less than 12 Months
unclassified.description: Amount of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), in continuous unrealized loss position for less than 12 months, without allowance for credit loss. Includes beneficial interest in securitized financial asset.

unclassified.label: Decrease in Unrecognized Tax Benefits is Reasonably Possible
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease reasonably possible in the next twelve months for the unrecognized tax benefit.

unclassified.label: Debt Issuance Costs, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount, before accumulated amortization, of debt issuance costs. Includes, but is not limited to, legal, accounting, underwriting, printing, and registration costs.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, in Process Research and Development
unclassified.description: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary difference from in-process research and development cost acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Operating Loss Carryforwards, Foreign
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible foreign operating loss carryforwards.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Operating Loss Carryforwards, Not Subject to Expiration
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible operating loss carryforwards that are not subject to expiration dates.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, State Taxes
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from state taxes.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Credit Carryforwards, Other
unclassified.description: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible tax credit carryforwards, classified as other.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals, Legal Settlements
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from the estimated loss from legal settlements.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Deferred Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from capitalized costs.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Leasing Arrangements
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from leasing arrangements.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Other Comprehensive Income
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from unrealized gains in other comprehensive income.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Prepaid Expenses
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax consequences attributable to taxable temporary differences derived from prepaid expenses.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Prepaid Pension Costs (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, Actuarial Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) from change in actuarial assumptions which (increases) decreases benefit obligation of defined benefit plan. Assumptions include, but are not limited to, interest, mortality, employee turnover, salary, and temporary deviation from substantive plan.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Increase (Decrease) for Assets Transferred to (from) Plan
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in plan assets of defined benefit plan from assets transferred into (from) plan.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Assumptions Used Calculating Benefit Obligation, Discount Rate
unclassified.description: Weighted average rate for present value of future retirement benefits cash flows, used to determine benefit obligation of defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Assumptions Used Calculating Benefit Obligation, Weighted-Average Interest Crediting Rate
unclassified.description: Weighted-average interest crediting rate used to determine benefit obligation of defined benefit plan. Plan includes, but is not limited to, cash balance and other defined benefit plans with promised interest crediting rate.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Estimated Future Employer Contributions in Next Fiscal Year (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Employer Contributions, Remainder of Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount of contribution expected to be received by defined benefit plan from employer in remainder of current fiscal year. Excludes contribution previously paid by employer in current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Net Periodic Benefit Cost (Credit), Gain (Loss) Due to Curtailment
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit from event reducing expected years of future service of present employees or eliminating accrual of defined benefits for some or all future services of present employees.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plans, Estimated Future Employer Contributions in Next Fiscal Year (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
DerivativeAssetAfterOffsetSubjectToMasterNettingArrangement
unclassified.description: Fair value, after effect of master netting arrangement, of financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and contract can be net settled by means outside contract or delivery of asset. Includes derivative subject to master netting arrangement not elected or qualified to offset. Excludes derivative not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

unclassified.label: Derivative Asset, Fair Value, Amount Not Offset Against Collateral
unclassified.description: Fair value, after offset of derivative liability, of financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset, before offset against an obligation to return collateral under a master netting arrangement. Includes assets elected not to be offset. Excludes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Fair Value, Net
unclassified.description: Fair value of the assets less the liabilities of a derivative or group of derivatives.

unclassified.label: Derivative Financial Instruments, Liabilities, Fair Value Disclosure (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
DerivativeLiabilityAfterOffsetSubjectToMasterNettingArrangement
unclassified.description: Fair value, after effect of master netting arrangement, of financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and contract can be net settled by means outside contract or delivery of asset. Includes derivative subject to master netting arrangement not elected or qualified to offset. Excludes derivative not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

unclassified.label: Derivative Liability, Fair Value, Gross Asset and Right to Reclaim Cash, Offset
unclassified.description: Fair value of asset associated with financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset, and right to receive cash collateral under master netting arrangements.

unclassified.label: Derivative Liability, Fair Value of Collateral
unclassified.description: Fair value of securities pledged as collateral against derivative liabilities.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Notional Amount
unclassified.description: Nominal or face amount used to calculate payment on derivative.

unclassified.label: Discontinued Operation, Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operation During Phase-out Period, Net of Tax
unclassified.description: Amount after tax of income (loss) from operations classified as a discontinued operation. Excludes gain (loss) on disposal and provision for gain (loss) until disposal.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Deferred Tax Liabilities
unclassified.description: Amount classified as deferred tax liabilities attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Depreciation and Amortization
unclassified.description: Amount of depreciation and amortization expense attributable to disposal group, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Other Assets, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount classified as other assets attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Dividends, Cash
unclassified.description: Amount of paid and unpaid cash dividends declared for classes of stock, for example, but not limited to, common and preferred.

unclassified.label: Dividends, Preferred Stock, Stock
unclassified.description: Amount of paid and unpaid preferred stock dividends declared with the form of settlement in stock.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Disposition of Business, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to disposition of a business not qualifying as a discontinued operation.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Amortization, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to amortization.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Prior Year Income Taxes, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to revisions of previously reported income tax expense.

unclassified.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Exercise of Option, Tax Benefit
unclassified.description: Amount of tax benefit from exercise of option under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Employee Service Share-based Compensation, Unrecognized Compensation Costs on Nonvested Awards (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Equity Method Investment, Summarized Financial Information, Revenue (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Equity Securities, FV-NI, Cost
unclassified.description: Cost of investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI). Excludes equity method investment and investment in equity security without readily determinable fair value.

unclassified.label: Equity Securities, FV-NI, Unrealized Gain
unclassified.description: Amount of unrealized gain on investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).

unclassified.label: Equity Securities, FV-NI, Unrealized Loss
unclassified.description: Amount of unrealized loss on investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).

unclassified.label: Equity Securities without Readily Determinable Fair Value, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of investment in equity security without readily determinable fair value.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Assets, Level 2 to Level 1 Transfers, Amount
Fair Value, Assets Measured on Recurring Basis, Cash and Cash Equivalents (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Fair Value, Asset, Recurring Basis, Still Held, Unrealized Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) recognized in income from asset measured at fair value on recurring basis using unobservable input (level 3) and still held.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Liabilities, Level 1 to Level 2 Transfers, Amount
Fair Value, Liabilities, Level 2 to Level 1 Transfers, Amount
Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Asset, Gain (Loss) Included in Other Comprehensive Income (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in other comprehensive income (OCI) from asset measured at fair value on recurring basis using unobservable input (level 3).

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Asset, Issuances
unclassified.description: Amount of issuances of financial instrument classified as an asset measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Net Derivative Asset (Liability) Measured on Recurring Basis, Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Purchases
unclassified.description: Amount of purchases of financial instrument classified as a derivative asset (liability) after deduction of derivative liability (asset), measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Useful Life, Maximum (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Foreign Currency Transaction Gain (Loss), Unrealized
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, of unrealized gain (loss) from foreign currency transaction.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Intangible Assets
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of intangible assets.

unclassified.label: Goodwill, Foreign Currency Translation Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of foreign currency translation gain (loss) which increases (decreases) asset representing future economic benefit from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

unclassified.label: Goodwill, Other Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) of asset representing future economic benefit from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized, classified as other.

unclassified.label: Goodwill, Transfers
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) from transfer into (out of) asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

unclassified.label: Income Tax Effects Allocated Directly to Equity, Cumulative Effect of Change in Accounting Principle
unclassified.description: Amount of cumulative tax effect on beginning retained earnings from change in accounting principle.

unclassified.label: Income Tax Examination, Interest Expense
unclassified.description: The amount of estimated interest recognized in the period arising from income tax examinations.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Deduction, Employee Stock Ownership Plan Dividend, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to deduction for dividend paid to employee stock ownership plan.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Deduction, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to deduction. Includes, but is not limited to, dividend deduction, deduction for dividend paid to employee stock ownership plan (ESOP), Medicare prescription drug benefit subsidy deduction, and other deductions.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Amortization, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to nondeductible amortization.

unclassified.label: Income Taxes Receivable, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Carrying amount due after one year of the balance sheet date (or one operating cycle, if longer) from tax authorities as of the balance sheet date representing refunds of overpayments or recoveries based on agreed-upon resolutions of disputes.

unclassified.label: Incremental Common Shares Attributable to Dilutive Effect of Contingently Issuable Shares
unclassified.description: Additional shares included in the calculation of diluted EPS as a result of the potentially dilutive effect of contingently issuable shares. Contingently issuable shares are those shares that are issuable for little or no cash contingent on certain conditions being met.

unclassified.label: Insurance Settlements Receivable, Current
unclassified.description: Amount due in settlement of a claim for reimbursement from an insurance company when the Company has suffered a loss covered under an insurance policy. For classified balance sheets, represents the current amount receivable, that is amounts expected to be collected within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Intangible Assets, Gross (Excluding Goodwill)
unclassified.description: Amount, before accumulated amortization, of finite- and indefinite-lived intangible assets and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed. Excludes goodwill.

unclassified.label: Interest Income, Operating
unclassified.description: Amount of operating interest income, including, but not limited to, amortization and accretion of premiums and discounts on securities.

unclassified.label: Interest Rate Cash Flow Hedge Gain (Loss) to be Reclassified During Next 12 Months, Net
unclassified.description: The estimated net amount of unrealized gains or losses on interest rate cash flow hedges as of the balance sheet date expected to be reclassified to earnings within the next twelve months.

unclassified.label: Interest Rate Derivative Assets, at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of interest rate derivative assets, which includes all such derivative instruments in hedging and nonhedging relationships that are recognized as assets.

unclassified.label: Interest Receivable, Current
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of current interest earned but not received. Also called accrued interest or accrued interest receivable. For classified balance sheets, represents the current amount receivable, that is amounts expected to be collected within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Inventory Valuation Reserves
unclassified.description: Amount of valuation reserve for inventory.

unclassified.label: Inventory, Work in Process, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount before valuation and LIFO reserves of merchandise or goods in the production process expected to be completed within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Land
unclassified.description: Amount before accumulated depletion of real estate held for productive use, excluding land held for sale.

unclassified.label: Lines of Credit, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of contractual arrangement with a lender under which borrowings can be made up to a specific amount at any point in time.

unclassified.label: Estimated Litigation Liability
unclassified.description: Aggregate carrying amount of the estimated litigation liability for known or estimated probable loss from litigation, which may include attorneys' fees and other litigation costs.

unclassified.label: Estimated Litigation Liability, Current
unclassified.description: Carrying amount of reserve for known or estimated probable loss from litigation, which may include attorneys' fees and other litigation costs, which is expected to be paid within one year of the date of the statement of financial position.

unclassified.label: Loss Contingency, Number of Plaintiffs
unclassified.description: Number of plaintiffs that have filed claims pertaining to a loss contingency.

unclassified.label: Loss Contingency, Pending Claims, Number
unclassified.description: Number of pending claims pertaining to a loss contingency.

unclassified.label: Loss Contingency, Range of Possible Loss, Minimum (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Continuing Operations
unclassified.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating, investing, and financing activities; attributable to continuing operation.

unclassified.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Discontinued Operations
unclassified.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating, investing, and financing activities; attributable to discontinued operation.

unclassified.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest
unclassified.description: Amount of Net Income (Loss) attributable to redeemable noncontrolling interest.

unclassified.label: Net Regulatory Assets
unclassified.description: The net amount of all regulatory assets less all regulatory liabilities as of the end of the period.

unclassified.label: New Accounting Pronouncement or Change in Accounting Principle, Effect of Change on Net Income (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Noncash or Part Noncash Divestiture, Amount of Consideration Received
unclassified.description: Amount of noncash consideration received for selling an asset or business through a noncash (or part noncash) transaction.

unclassified.label: Operating Lease, Variable Lease Income
unclassified.description: Amount of operating lease income from variable lease payments paid and payable to lessor, excluding amount included in measurement of lease receivable.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Income Statement, Contingent Revenue
unclassified.description: Amount of contingent rental revenue recognized for the period under lease, based on the occurrences of an event or condition.

unclassified.label: Other Commitment, to be Paid, after Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of commitment classified as other to be paid after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Other Commitment, to be Paid, Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of commitment classified as other to be paid in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Other Commitment, to be Paid, Year Four
unclassified.description: Amount of commitment classified as other to be paid in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Other Commitment, to be Paid, Year One
unclassified.description: Amount of commitment classified as other to be paid in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Other Commitment, to be Paid, Year Two
unclassified.description: Amount of commitment classified as other to be paid in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Other Commitment, to be Paid, Year Three
unclassified.description: Amount of commitment classified as other to be paid in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Available-for-sale Securities, Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Adjustment, Net of Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent
unclassified.description: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature, attributable to parent entity.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Translation Adjustment, Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), after Reclassification and Tax, Parent
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax and reclassification, of gain (loss) from derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness, attributable to parent.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), after Reclassification, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax and after reclassification, of gain (loss) from derivative instrument designated and qualifying cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), Reclassification, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, of reclassification of gain (loss) from accumulated other comprehensive income (AOCI) for derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, before Reclassification Adjustment, after Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, before reclassification adjustment, of (increase) decrease in accumulated other comprehensive income of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit cost (credit).

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, before Reclassification Adjustment, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before reclassification adjustment, of tax (expense) benefit for (increase) decrease in accumulated other comprehensive income for defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount of tax (expense) benefit for reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss of defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Minimum Pension Liability Net Adjustment, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Minimum Pension Liability Net Adjustment, Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification, Pension and Other Postretirement Benefit Plans, Net Gain (Loss) Recognized in Net Periodic Benefit Cost, before Tax (Deprecated 2013-01-31)

Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification, Pension and Other Postretirement Benefit Plans, Net Transition Asset (Obligation), Recognized in Net Periodic Benefit Cost, Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Unrealized Holding Gain (Loss), before Adjustment and Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax and adjustment, of unrealized holding gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale). Excludes unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to available-for-sale.

unclassified.label: Other Inventory, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount before valuation and LIFO reserves of other inventory expected to be sold, or consumed within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Other Liabilities
unclassified.description: Amount of liabilities classified as other.

unclassified.label: Other Preferred Stock Dividends and Adjustments
unclassified.description: Amount of preferred stock dividends and adjustments classified as other.

unclassified.label: Other Short-term Investments
unclassified.description: Amount of short-term investments classified as other.

unclassified.label: Other than Temporary Impairment Losses, Investments, Portion Recognized in Earnings, Net
Paid-in-Kind Interest
unclassified.description: Interest paid other than in cash for example by issuing additional debt securities. As a noncash item, it is added to net income when calculating cash provided by or used in operations using the indirect method.

unclassified.label: Payment of Financing and Stock Issuance Costs
unclassified.description: The total of the cash outflow during the period which has been paid to third parties in connection with debt origination, which will be amortized over the remaining maturity period of the associated long-term debt and the cost incurred directly for the issuance of equity securities.

unclassified.label: Payments for Environmental Liabilities
unclassified.description: Cash outflows made during the period for environmental remediation activities.

unclassified.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Productive Assets
unclassified.description: The net cash outflow or inflow from purchases, sales and disposals of property, plant and equipment and other productive assets, including intangibles.

unclassified.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Removal Costs
unclassified.description: The net cash inflow or outflow from the costs of disposing of plant, whether by demolishing, dismantling, abandoning, sale, and so forth during the period.

unclassified.label: Payments to Acquire Business Two, Net of Cash Acquired
unclassified.description: The cash outflow associated with a second acquisition of a business, net of the cash acquired from the purchase.

unclassified.label: Payments to Acquire Businesses and Interest in Affiliates
unclassified.description: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of a controlling interest in another entity or an entity that is related to it but not strictly controlled (for example, an unconsolidated subsidiary, affiliate, joint venture or equity method investment).

unclassified.label: Payments to Acquire Interest in Joint Venture
unclassified.description: The cash outflow associated with the investment in or advances to an entity in which the reporting entity shares control of the entity with another party or group.

unclassified.label: Payments to Acquire Other Property, Plant, and Equipment
unclassified.description: Amount of cash outflow from the acquisition of or improvements to long-lived, physical assets used to produce goods and services and not intended for resale, classified as other.

unclassified.label: Postemployment Benefits, Period Expense
unclassified.description: Period expense related to postemployment benefits.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Contributed Capital
unclassified.description: The cash inflow associated with the amount received by a corporation from a shareholder during the period.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Divestiture of Interest in Consolidated Subsidiaries
unclassified.description: The cash inflow associated with the deconsolidation of a previously consolidated subsidiary or the sale of investment in consolidated subsidiaries (generally greater than 50 percent).

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Dividends Received
unclassified.description: Dividends received on equity and other investments during the current period.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Commercial Paper
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from borrowing by issuing commercial paper.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Senior Long-term Debt
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from a borrowing with the highest claim on the assets of the entity in case of bankruptcy or liquidation (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer).

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Other Debt
unclassified.description: Amount of cash inflow from debt classified as other.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale of Other Investments
unclassified.description: Amount of cash inflow from the sale of investments classified as other.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale of Other Property, Plant, and Equipment
unclassified.description: Amount of cash inflow for the sale of long-lived, physical assets used to produce goods and services and not intended for resale, classified as other.

unclassified.label: Professional Fees
unclassified.description: A fee charged for services from professionals such as doctors, lawyers and accountants. The term is often expanded to include other professions, for example, pharmacists charging to maintain a medicinal profile of a client or customer.

unclassified.label: Property Subject to or Available for Operating Lease, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount, before accumulated depreciation, of lessor's underlying asset for which right to use has been conveyed to lessee under operating lease.

unclassified.label: Public Utilities, Approved Return on Equity, Percentage
unclassified.description: Percentage of public utility's approved return on equity.

unclassified.label: Ratio of Indebtedness to Net Capital (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Reclassification from Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income, Current Period, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount before tax of reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss).

unclassified.label: Repayments of Commercial Paper
unclassified.description: The cash outflow due to repaying amounts borrowed by issuing commercial paper.

unclassified.label: Restructuring and Related Cost, Incurred Cost
unclassified.description: Discloses the amount charged against the accrued restructuring reserves, or earnings if not previously accrued, during the period for the specified type of restructuring cost.

unclassified.label: Retained Earnings, Unappropriated
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated undistributed earnings (deficit) available for dividend distribution. Includes, but is not limited to, retained earnings not appropriated for specific business purpose.

unclassified.label: Sales-type and Direct Financing Leases, Lease Receivable, Payments to be Received
unclassified.description: Amount of undiscounted cash flows to be received by lessor for sales-type and direct financing leases.

unclassified.label: Security Deposit
unclassified.description: The amount of an asset, typically cash, provided to a counterparty to provide certain assurance of performance by the entity pursuant to the terms of a written or oral agreement, such as a lease.

unclassified.label: Segment Reporting Information, Income Tax Expense (Benefit) (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Segment Reporting Information, Investment in Equity Method Investees (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Vested in Period, Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of share-based awards for which the grantee gained the right by satisfying service and performance requirements, to receive or retain shares or units, other instruments, or cash.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Fair Value Assumptions, Expected Volatility Rate, Maximum
unclassified.description: The estimated measure of the maximum percentage by which a share price is expected to fluctuate during a period. Volatility also may be defined as a probability-weighted measure of the dispersion of returns about the mean. The volatility of a share price is the standard deviation of the continuously compounded rates of return on the share over a specified period. That is the same as the standard deviation of the differences in the natural logarithms of the stock prices plus dividends, if any, over the period.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Fair Value Assumptions, Expected Volatility Rate, Minimum
unclassified.description: The estimated measure of the minimum percentage by which a share price is expected to fluctuate during a period. Volatility also may be defined as a probability-weighted measure of the dispersion of returns about the mean. The volatility of a share price is the standard deviation of the continuously compounded rates of return on the share over a specified period. That is the same as the standard deviation of the differences in the natural logarithms of the stock prices plus dividends, if any, over the period.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Fair Value Assumptions, Risk Free Interest Rate, Maximum
unclassified.description: The maximum risk-free interest rate assumption that is used in valuing an option on its own shares.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Fair Value Assumptions, Risk Free Interest Rate, Minimum
unclassified.description: The minimum risk-free interest rate assumption that is used in valuing an option on its own shares.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Vested and Expected to Vest, Outstanding, Number
unclassified.description: Number of fully vested and expected to vest options outstanding that can be converted into shares under option plan. Includes, but is not limited to, unvested options for which requisite service period has not been rendered but that are expected to vest based on achievement of performance condition, if forfeitures are recognized when they occur.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Vested and Expected to Vest, Outstanding, Weighted Average Exercise Price
unclassified.description: Weighted-average exercise price, at which grantee can acquire shares reserved for issuance, for fully vested and expected to vest options outstanding. Includes, but is not limited to, unvested options for which requisite service period has not been rendered but that are expected to vest based on achievement of performance condition, if forfeitures are recognized when they occur.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangements by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Expirations in Period, Weighted Average Exercise Price
unclassified.description: Weighted average price at which grantees could have acquired the underlying shares with respect to stock options of the plan that expired.

unclassified.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Option, Exercise Price Range, Shares Outstanding
unclassified.description: The number of shares reserved for issuance pertaining to the outstanding stock options as of the balance sheet date for all option plans in the customized range of exercise prices.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Nonvested, Number of Shares
unclassified.description: Number of non-vested options outstanding.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Vested in Period, Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of options vested. Excludes equity instruments other than options, for example, but not limited to, share units, stock appreciation rights, restricted stock.

unclassified.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Option, Exercise Price Range, Exercisable, Weighted Average Exercise Price
unclassified.description: Weighted average exercise price as of the balance sheet date for those equity-based payment arrangements exercisable and outstanding.

unclassified.label: Short-term Debt, Maximum Amount Outstanding During Period
unclassified.description: For the form of debt having an initial term of less than one year or less than the normal operating cycle, if longer, the maximum amount borrowed at any time during the period.

unclassified.label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Employee Stock Purchase Plans
unclassified.description: Number of shares issued during the period as a result of an employee stock purchase plan.

unclassified.label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Restricted Stock Award, Gross
unclassified.description: Total number of shares issued during the period, including shares forfeited, as a result of Restricted Stock Awards.

unclassified.label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Treasury Stock Reissued
unclassified.description: Number of treasury shares or units reissued. Excludes reissuance of shares or units in treasury for award under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Dividend Reinvestment Plan
unclassified.description: Value of stock issued during the period from a dividend reinvestment plan (DRIP). A dividend reinvestment plan allows the holder of the stock to reinvest dividends paid to them by the entity on new issues of stock by the entity.

unclassified.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Restricted Stock Award, Net of Forfeitures
unclassified.description: Value of stock related to Restricted Stock Awards issued during the period, net of the stock value of such awards forfeited.

unclassified.label: Tangible Asset Impairment Charges
unclassified.description: The charge against earnings resulting from the aggregate write down of tangible assets from their carrying value to their fair value.

unclassified.label: Tax Credit Carryforward, Deferred Tax Asset (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
Tax Credit Carryforward, Valuation Allowance
unclassified.description: Amount of valuation allowance pertaining to the deferred tax asset representing potential future taxable deductions from tax credit carryforwards for which it is more likely than not that a tax benefit will not be realized.

unclassified.label: Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, Reclassification from AOCI to Retained Earnings, Tax Effect
Treasury Stock, Shares, Retired
unclassified.description: Number of shares of common and preferred stock retired from treasury during the period.

unclassified.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits Resulting in Net Operating Loss Carryforward (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Year One
unclassified.description: Amount of fixed and determinable portion of unrecorded unconditional purchase obligation to be paid in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach). Includes, but is not limited to, lease not yet commenced.

unclassified.label: Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, after Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of fixed and determinable portion of unrecorded unconditional purchase obligation to be paid after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach). Includes, but is not limited to, lease not yet commenced.

unclassified.label: Unsecured Debt
unclassified.description: Including the current and noncurrent portions, carrying value as of the balance sheet date of uncollateralized debt obligations (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer).

unclassified.label: SEC Schedule, 12-09, Valuation Allowances and Reserves, Increase (Decrease) Adjustment
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in valuation and qualifying accounts and reserves from adjustment.

unclassified.label: Warrants and Rights Outstanding
unclassified.description: Value of outstanding derivative securities that permit the holder the right to purchase securities (usually equity) from the issuer at a specified price.

unclassified.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares, Restricted Stock
unclassified.description: Number of shares of restricted stock determined by relating the portion of time within a reporting period that restricted shares have been outstanding to the total time in that period. Restricted shares are subject to sales, contractual, regulatory or other restrictions that prevent or inhibit the holder from freely disposing of them before the restriction ends.

unclassified.label: Accounts Payable and Other Accrued Liabilities
unclassified.description: Amount of liabilities incurred and payable to vendors for goods and services received, and accrued liabilities classified as other.

unclassified.label: Accounts Payable, Trade, Current
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred (and for which invoices have typically been received) and payable to vendors for goods and services received that are used in an entity's business. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

unclassified.label: Accounts Receivable, before Allowance for Credit Loss
unclassified.description: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration from customer for product sold and service rendered in normal course of business.

unclassified.label: Accrual for Environmental Loss Contingencies, Discount Rate
unclassified.description: Rate applied to the undiscounted amount of environmental loss contingencies to arrive at the present value recorded as of the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Accrual for Taxes Other than Income Taxes
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable for real and property taxes.

unclassified.label: Accrued Income Taxes
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the unpaid sum of the known and estimated amounts payable to satisfy all domestic and foreign income tax obligations due. This amount is the total of current and noncurrent accrued income taxes.

unclassified.label: Accrued Liabilities
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable, pertaining to costs that are statutory in nature, are incurred on contractual obligations, or accumulate over time and for which invoices have not yet been received or will not be rendered. Examples include taxes, interest, rent and utilities.

unclassified.label: APIC, Share-based Payment Arrangement, Restricted Stock Unit, Increase for Cost Recognition
unclassified.description: Amount of increase to additional paid-in capital (APIC) for recognition of cost for restricted stock unit under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Advertising Expense
unclassified.description: Amount charged to advertising expense for the period, which are expenses incurred with the objective of increasing revenue for a specified brand, product or product line.

unclassified.label: Alternative Investment
unclassified.description: Fair value of investment other than investment in equity security, investment in debt security and equity method investment. Includes, but is not limited to, investment in certain entities that calculate net asset value per share. Example includes, but is not limited to, investment in hedge fund, venture capital fund, private equity fund, and real estate partnership or fund.

unclassified.label: Amortization of Power Contracts Emission Credits
unclassified.description: The expense charged against earnings for the periodic recognition of capitalized costs related to purchasing power, fuel, or emission credits. These items may be purchased in one accounting period but are deducted from earnings over time through amortization.

unclassified.label: AOCI, Cash Flow Hedge, Cumulative Gain (Loss), after Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of accumulated gain (loss) on derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.

unclassified.label: Area of Land
unclassified.description: Area of land held.

unclassified.label: Area of Real Estate Property
unclassified.description: Area of a real estate property.

unclassified.label: Assets Held-in-trust
unclassified.description: The total amount of cash and securities held by third party trustees pursuant to terms of debt instruments or other agreements as of the date of each statement of financial position presented, which can be used by the trustee only to pay the noncurrent portion of specified obligations.

unclassified.label: Assets of Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Noncurrent (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Unrealized Gain
unclassified.description: Amount of unrealized gain on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

unclassified.label: Available-for-sale Securities, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, Less than Twelve Months, Fair Value
Billings in Excess of Cost
unclassified.description: Liability attributable to (i) billings in excess of costs under the percentage of completion contract accounting method representing the difference between contractually invoiced amounts (billings) and revenue recognized based, for example, on costs incurred to estimated total costs at period end or (ii) contractually invoiced amounts (billings) in excess of costs incurred and accumulated under the completed contract accounting method.

unclassified.label: Business Acquisition, Transaction Costs
unclassified.description: Amount of transaction cost incurred to effect business combination. Excludes separately recognized transaction and indirect cost.

unclassified.label: Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Assets Acquired (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Assets Acquired (Liabilities Assumed), Net (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Current Assets (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Current Assets, Receivables (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Acquisition, Share Price
unclassified.description: Per share price of saleable stock paid or offered to be paid by acquirer in business combination.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Consideration Transferred, Equity Interests Issued and Issuable
unclassified.description: Amount of equity interests of the acquirer, including instruments or interests issued or issuable in consideration for the business combination.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Provisional Information, Initial Accounting Incomplete, Adjustment, Property, Plant, and Equipment
unclassified.description: This element represents the amount of any measurement period adjustment (as defined) realized during the reporting period to property, plant, and equipment acquired in connection with a business combination for which the initial accounting was incomplete.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Current Assets, Receivables
unclassified.description: Amount of receivable acquired in business combination and recognized at acquisition date, classified as current. Includes, but is not limited to, receivable from customer for product and service.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Equipment
unclassified.description: Amount of equipment acquired in business combination and recognized at acquisition date.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Intangible Assets, Other than Goodwill
unclassified.description: Amount of identifiable intangible asset acquired in business combination and recognized at acquisition date. Excludes goodwill and financial asset.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Noncurrent Assets
unclassified.description: Amount of asset acquired in business combination and recognized at acquisition date, classified as noncurrent.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Noncurrent Liabilities, Long-term Debt
unclassified.description: Amount of long-term debt assumed in business combination and recognized at acquisition date, classified as noncurrent.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Noncurrent Liabilities, Other
unclassified.description: Amount of liability assumed in business combination and recognized at acquisition date, classified as other and noncurrent.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Other Noncurrent Assets
unclassified.description: Amount of asset acquired in business combination and recognized at acquisition date, classified as other and noncurrent.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Lessor Balance Sheet, Net Investment in Direct Financing Leases, Current
unclassified.description: The net amount due within one year of the balance sheet date or the normal operating cycle, if longer, consisting of: (a) minimum lease payments due on direct financing leases, (b) unguaranteed residual value, and (c) any unamortized initial direct costs, less: (i) executory costs, (ii) unearned income, and (iii) the accumulated allowance for uncollectible minimum lease payments.

unclassified.label: Capitalized Computer Software, Accumulated Amortization
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated amortization for capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed. Excludes capitalized cost for internal-use software.

unclassified.label: Capitalized Computer Software, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount, before accumulated amortization, of capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed. Excludes capitalized cost for internal-use software.

unclassified.label: Capitalized Computer Software, Net
unclassified.description: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed. Excludes capitalized cost for internal-use software.

unclassified.label: Cash Collateral for Borrowed Securities
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of cash collateral held for borrowed securities, for which the cash is restricted as to withdrawal or usage.

unclassified.label: Class of Warrant or Right, Number of Securities Called by Warrants or Rights
unclassified.description: Number of securities into which the class of warrant or right may be converted. For example, but not limited to, 500,000 warrants may be converted into 1,000,000 shares.

unclassified.label: Commodity Contract Asset, Current
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the asset arising from commodity contracts such as futures contracts tied to the movement of a particular commodity, which are expected to be converted into cash or otherwise disposed of within a year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Construction in Progress Expenditures Incurred but Not yet Paid
unclassified.description: Future cash outflow to pay for construction in progress expenditures that have occurred.

unclassified.label: Contract with Customer, Asset, Reclassified to Receivable
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time from transfer to receivable due to right to consideration becoming unconditional.

unclassified.label: Contribution of Property
unclassified.description: Value of property contributed in noncash investing and financing activities.

unclassified.label: Conversion of Stock, Amount Issued
unclassified.description: The value of the financial instrument issued [noncash or part noncash] in the conversion of stock. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

unclassified.label: Conversion of Stock, Shares Converted
unclassified.description: The number of shares converted in a noncash (or part noncash) transaction. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

unclassified.label: Convertible Debt, Fair Value Disclosures
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of borrowing which can be exchanged for a specified number of another security at the option of the issuer or the holder, for example, but not limited to, the entity's common stock.

unclassified.label: Convertible Debt, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Carrying amount of long-term convertible debt as of the balance sheet date, net of the amount due in the next twelve months or greater than the normal operating cycle, if longer. The debt is convertible into another form of financial instrument, typically the entity's common stock.

unclassified.label: Convertible Preferred Stock, Shares Issued upon Conversion
unclassified.description: Number of shares issued for each share of convertible preferred stock that is converted.
