unclassified.label: Cost of Services, Depreciation and Amortization (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Costs and Expenses, Related Party
unclassified.description: Costs of sales and operating expenses for the period incurred from transactions with related parties.

unclassified.label: Costs Incurred, Asset Retirement Obligation Incurred
unclassified.description: Amount of asset retirement obligation (ARO) cost incurred in oil- and gas-producing activities. Includes capitalized cost and cost charged to expense.

unclassified.label: Cumulative Effect on Retained Earnings, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Customer Advances and Deposits, Current
unclassified.description: The current portion of aggregate prepayments received from customers for goods or services to be provided in the future, as well as the current portion of money or property received from customers that are to be returned upon satisfactory contract completion or as partial prepayment for goods or services to be provided in the future.

unclassified.label: Customer Advances, Current
unclassified.description: The current portion of prepayments received from customers for goods or services to be provided in the future.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Basis Spread on Variable Rate (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Debt Instrument, Repurchase Amount
unclassified.description: Fair value amount of debt instrument that was repurchased.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Repurchased Face Amount
unclassified.description: Face (par) amount of the original debt instrument that was repurchased.

unclassified.label: Debt Issuance Costs Incurred During Noncash or Partial Noncash Transaction
unclassified.description: The amount of debt issuance costs that were incurred during a noncash or partial noncash transaction.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, Less than 12 Months, Accumulated Loss
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated unrealized loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), in continuous unrealized loss position for less than 12 months, without allowance for credit loss. Includes beneficial interest in securitized financial asset.

unclassified.label: DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleExcludingAccruedInterest
unclassified.description: Amount excluding accrued interest, of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Unrealized Loss Position, Accumulated Loss
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated unrealized loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), in unrealized loss position, without allowance for credit loss. Includes beneficial interest in securitized financial asset.

unclassified.label: Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Compensation Expense
unclassified.description: The compensation expense recognized during the period pertaining to the deferred compensation arrangement.

unclassified.label: Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Shares Authorized for Issuance
unclassified.description: The maximum number of shares authorized for issuance under the deferred compensation arrangement as of the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Deferred Compensation Liability, Classified, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Aggregate carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the liabilities for all deferred compensation arrangements payable beyond one year (or the operating cycle, if longer).

unclassified.label: Deferred Compensation Plan Assets
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of assets held under deferred compensation agreements.

unclassified.label: Deferred Costs
unclassified.description: The carrying amount of deferred costs.

unclassified.label: Deferred Federal, State and Local, Tax Expense (Benefit)
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred federal, state, and local tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations. Includes, but is not limited to, deferred national, regional, territorial, and provincial tax expense (benefit) for non-US (United States of America) jurisdiction.

unclassified.label: Deferred Other Tax Expense (Benefit)
unclassified.description: Amount of other deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations. For example, but not limited to, acquisition-date income tax benefits or expenses recognized from changes in the acquirer's valuation allowance for its previously existing deferred tax assets resulting from a business combination and adjustments to beginning-of-year balance of a valuation allowance because of a change in circumstance causing a change in judgment about the realizability of the related deferred tax asset in future periods.

unclassified.label: Deferred Revenue, Revenue Recognized
unclassified.description: Amount of revenue recognized that was previously reported as deferred or unearned revenue.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Investment in Subsidiaries
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from the entity's investment in its wholly-owned subsidiaries.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Other Comprehensive Loss
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from unrealized losses in other comprehensive income.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Credit Carryforwards, Foreign
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible foreign tax credit carryforwards.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Compensation and Benefits, Employee Compensation
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from employee compensation.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals, Contingencies
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from contingent liabilities.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Goodwill and Intangible Assets
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from intangible assets including goodwill.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Other Finite-Lived Assets
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from long-lived assets other than property, plant, and equipment.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Unrealized Gains on Trading Securities
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from unrealized gains on trading securities.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Amortization of Transition Obligations (Assets) (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Amount to be Amortized from Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss) Next Fiscal Year (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Assumptions Used Calculating Net Periodic Benefit Cost, Weighted-Average Interest Crediting Rate
unclassified.description: Weighted-average interest crediting rate used to determine net periodic benefit cost of defined benefit plan. Plan includes, but is not limited to, cash balance and other defined benefit plans with promised interest crediting rate.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, (Increase) Decrease for Curtailment
unclassified.description: Amount of (increase) decrease in benefit obligation of defined benefit plan from event reducing expected years of future service of present employees or eliminating accrual of benefits for some or all future services of present employees.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Benefit Payments in Year Five (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Benefit Payments in Year Four (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Benefit Payments in Year One (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Benefit Payments in Year Three (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Benefit Payments in Year Two (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Funded (Unfunded) Status of Plan
unclassified.description: Amount of funded (unfunded) status of defined benefit plan, measured as difference between fair value of plan assets and benefit obligation. Includes, but is not limited to, overfunded (underfunded) status.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan with Accumulated Benefit Obligation in Excess of Plan Assets, Plan Assets
unclassified.description: Amount of plan asset for defined benefit plan with accumulated benefit obligation in excess of plan assets.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Net Periodic Benefit Cost (Credit), Gain (Loss) Due to Settlement
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit from irrevocable action relieving primary responsibility for benefit obligation and eliminating risk related to obligation and assets used to effect settlement.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Payment for Settlement
unclassified.description: Amount of payment, which decreases plan assets of defined benefit plan, for irrevocable action relieving primary responsibility for benefit obligation and eliminating risk for obligation and assets used to effect settlement. Transaction constituting settlement includes, but is not limited to, making lump-sum cash payment to participant in exchange for their rights to receive specified benefits and purchasing nonparticipating annuity contract.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plans, Estimated Future Employer Contributions in Current Fiscal Year (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Defined Contribution Plan, Maximum Annual Contribution Per Employee, Percent (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Deposits
unclassified.description: The aggregate of all deposit liabilities held by the entity, including foreign and domestic, interest and noninterest bearing; may include demand deposits, saving deposits, Negotiable Order of Withdrawal (NOW) and time deposits among others.

unclassified.label: Derivative Asset, Fair Value, Gross Asset Including Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement
unclassified.description: Fair value, before effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset. Includes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement and elected not to be offset.

unclassified.label: Derivative Asset, Fair Value, Gross Liability and Obligation to Return Cash, Offset
unclassified.description: Fair value of liability associated with financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset, and obligation to return cash collateral under master netting arrangements.

unclassified.label: Derivative Asset, Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement
unclassified.description: Fair value of financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset, not subject to a master netting arrangement.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Collateral, Obligation to Return Securities
unclassified.description: Amount of obligation to return securities collateral under master netting arrangements that have not been offset against derivative assets.

unclassified.label: Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments, Asset, at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of derivative instrument not designated as hedging instrument and classified as an asset.

unclassified.label: Derivative Liability, Fair Value, Gross Liability Including Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement
unclassified.description: Fair value, before effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset. Includes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement and elected not to be offset.

unclassified.label: Derivative Liability, Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement
unclassified.description: Fair value of financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset, not subject to a master netting arrangement.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Nonmonetary Notional Amount, Energy Measure
unclassified.description: Nominal energy measure used to calculate payments on a derivative instrument.

unclassified.label: Discontinued Operation, Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operation, Net of Tax, Per Basic and Diluted Share
Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Goodwill
unclassified.description: Amount classified as goodwill attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Long Lived Assets (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Operating Income (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of operating income (loss) attributable to disposal group, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Other Liabilities, Current
unclassified.description: Amount classified as other liabilities attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Dividends Payable, Amount Per Share
unclassified.description: The per share amount of a dividend declared, but not paid, as of the financial reporting date.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Depletion, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to depletion.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Settlement, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to income tax settlements. Including, but not limited to, domestic tax settlement, foreign tax settlement, state and local tax settlement, and other tax settlements.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Settlement, State and Local, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to state and local income tax settlement.

unclassified.label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Compensation Expense
unclassified.description: The amount of plan compensation cost recognized during the period.

unclassified.label: Disclosure on Geographic Areas, Long-Lived Assets in Foreign Countries (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Environmental Expense and Liabilities
unclassified.description: The adjustment to exclude the noncash portion of, and include cash payments for environmental costs when calculating operating cash flows under the indirect method. The adjustment can include the increase (decrease) during an accounting period in total estimated obligations recorded for probable future loss attributable to environmental contamination issues.

unclassified.label: Equity Method Investment, Summarized Financial Information, Current Assets (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Equity Method Investment, Summarized Financial Information, Current Liabilities (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Equity Method Investment, Summarized Financial Information, Noncurrent Liabilities (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Equity Method Investments, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of investments accounted under the equity method.

unclassified.label: Equity Securities, FV-NI, Realized Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of realized gain (loss) from sale of investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).

unclassified.label: Excess Tax Benefit from Share-based Compensation, Operating Activities
Excise and Sales Taxes
unclassified.description: The amount of excise and sales taxes included in sales and revenues, which are then deducted as a cost of sales. Includes excise taxes, which are applied to specific types of transactions or items (such as gasoline or alcohol); and sales, use and value added taxes, which are applied to a broad class of revenue-producing transactions involving a wide range of goods and services.

unclassified.label: Extraordinary Item, Gain (Loss), Net of Tax, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Liability, Transfers Into Level 3
unclassified.description: Amount of transfers of financial instrument classified as a liability into level 3 of the fair value hierarchy.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Asset, Sales
unclassified.description: Amount of sale of financial instrument classified as an asset measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Liability, Gain (Loss) Included in Earnings
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in income from liability measured at fair value on recurring basis using unobservable input (level 3).

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Net Derivative Asset (Liability) Measured on Recurring Basis, Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Issues
unclassified.description: Amount of issuances of financial instrument classified as a derivative asset (liability) after deduction of derivative liability (asset), measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Net Derivative Asset (Liability) Measured on Recurring Basis, Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Transfers, Net
unclassified.description: Amount of transfers of financial instrument classified as a derivative asset (liability) after deduction of derivative liability (asset) into (out of) level 3 of the fair value hierarchy.

unclassified.label: Finance Lease, Liability, Payments, Due in Next Rolling Twelve Months
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for finance lease due in next rolling 12 months following current statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim period is reported on rolling approach.

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Future Amortization Expense (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Foreign Currency Transaction Gain, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount before tax of foreign currency transaction realized and unrealized gain recognized in the income statement.

unclassified.label: Foreign Currency Transaction Loss, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount before tax of foreign currency transaction realized and unrealized loss recognized in the income statement.

unclassified.label: Forward Contract Indexed to Issuer's Equity, Settlement Alternatives, Cash, at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Amount that would be paid upon settlement of forward contract indexed to equity.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Discontinuation of Cash Flow Hedge Due to Forecasted Transaction Probable of Not Occurring, Net
unclassified.description: The amount of net gain (loss) reclassified into earnings in the period when cash flow hedge is discontinued because it is probable that the original forecasted transactions will not occur by the end of the original period or an additional two month time period.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Equity Method Investments (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Gain (Loss) on Sale of Properties
unclassified.description: The difference between the carrying value and the sale price of real estate or properties that were intended to be sold or held for capital appreciation or rental income. This element refers to the gain (loss) included in earnings and not to the cash proceeds of the sale. This element is a noncash adjustment to net income when calculating net cash generated by operating activities using the indirect method.

unclassified.label: Gain on Business Interruption Insurance Recovery
unclassified.description: The net amount (to the extent disclosed within this portion of the income statement) by which an insurance settlement exceeds incremental costs incurred from the event causing an interruption of business, plus the insurance award for earnings lost from the event, such as a natural catastrophe, explosion or fire.

unclassified.label: Gain on Sale of Investments
unclassified.description: The difference between the carrying value and the sale price of an investment. A gain would be recognized when the sale price of the investment is greater than the carrying value of the investment. This element refers to the Gain included in earnings and not to the cash proceeds of the sale.

unclassified.label: Gains (Losses) on Restructuring of Debt
unclassified.description: For a debtor, the aggregate gain (loss) recognized on the restructuring of payables arises from the difference between the book value of the debt before the restructuring and the fair value of the payments on the debt after restructuring is complete.

unclassified.label: Goodwill, Impaired, Accumulated Impairment Loss
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated impairment loss for asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

unclassified.label: Grants Receivable, Current
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of amounts due under the terms of governmental, corporate, or foundation grants. For classified balance sheets, represents the current amount receivable, that is amounts expected to be collected within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Unrealized Loss Position, Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), in unrealized loss position.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, Less than 12 Months, Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), in continuous unrealized loss position for less than 12 months.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, 12 Months or Longer, Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), in continuous unrealized loss position for 12 months or longer.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

unclassified.label: Impairment of Intangible Assets, Indefinite-lived (Excluding Goodwill)
unclassified.description: Amount of impairment loss for indefinite-lived intangible asset. Excludes goodwill.

unclassified.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Per Basic and Diluted Share
Income (Loss) from Extraordinary Items, Net of Tax, Per Basic Share (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Income (Loss) from Extraordinary Items, Net of Tax, Per Diluted Share (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Deduction, Dividends, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to deduction for dividend.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Disposition of Asset, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations, attributable to disposition of asset. Includes, but is not limited to, intra-entity transfer of asset other than inventory.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Equity in Earnings (Losses) of Unconsolidated Subsidiary, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to equity in earnings (loss) of unconsolidated subsidiaries exempt from income taxes.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Repatriation of Foreign Earnings, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to repatriation of foreign earnings.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Contingency, State and Local, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to increase (decrease) in state and local income tax contingency.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Credit, Foreign, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to foreign tax credit.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Settlement, Foreign, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to foreign income tax settlement.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Settlement, State and Local, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to state and local income tax settlement.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Payable and Other Operating Liabilities
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in obligations incurred but not paid, and operating obligations classified as other.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Deposits
unclassified.description: The net cash inflow or outflow for the increase (decrease) in the beginning and end of period deposits balances.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Due from Related Parties, Current
unclassified.description: The aggregate increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount due from the following types of related parties: a parent company and its subsidiaries; subsidiaries of a common parent; an entity and trust for the benefit of employees, such as pension and profit-sharing trusts that are managed by or under the trusteeship of the entity's management; an entity and its principal owners, management, or member of their immediate families, affiliates, or other parties with the ability to exert significant influence.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Due to Affiliates
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) in obligations owed to an entity that is controlling, under the control of, or within the same control group as the reporting entity by means of direct or indirect ownership.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in over (under) Energy Recovery
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the value of the asset or liability created by an over or under recovery. An over under-recovery means that the basic energy price based on the daily product price and exchange rate is less (over) or more (under) than the basic energy price used in the calculation of the monthly retail energy product.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Debt Securities, Trading, and Equity Securities, FV-NI
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) of investment in debt and equity securities, measured at fair value with changes in fair value recognized in net income.

unclassified.label: Incremental Common Shares Attributable to Dilutive Effect of Call Options and Warrants
unclassified.description: Additional shares included in the calculation of diluted EPS as a result of the potentially dilutive effect of call options and warrants using the treasury stock method.

unclassified.label: Incremental Common Shares Attributable to Dilutive Effect of Conversion of Preferred Stock
unclassified.description: Additional shares included in the calculation of diluted EPS as a result of the potentially dilutive effect of convertible preferred stock using the if-converted method.

unclassified.label: Incremental Common Shares Attributable to Dilutive Effect of Equity Unit Purchase Agreements
unclassified.description: Additional shares included in the calculation of diluted EPS as a result of the potentially dilutive effect of equity unit purchase agreements using the treasury stock method.

unclassified.label: Insured Event, Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of excess (deficiency) of insurance recovery over the loss incurred from an insured event.

unclassified.label: Intangible Assets, Current
unclassified.description: The current portion of nonphysical assets, excluding financial assets, if these assets are classified into the current and noncurrent portions.

unclassified.label: Intangible Assets, Net (Including Goodwill)
unclassified.description: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of finite- and indefinite-lived intangible assets, goodwill, and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

unclassified.label: Interest on Convertible Debt, Net of Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of interest recognized on convertible debt instrument excluding interest on principal required to be paid in cash.

unclassified.label: Interest Rate Derivative Liabilities, at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of interest rate derivative liabilities, which includes all such derivative instruments in hedging and nonhedging relationships that are recognized as liabilities.

unclassified.label: Inventory Adjustments
unclassified.description: Amount of inventory reserves for last-in first-out (LIFO) and other inventory valuation methods.

unclassified.label: Jointly Owned Utility Plant, Ownership Amount of Construction Work in Progress
unclassified.description: The period end amount of construction work in progress at a jointly owned electricity generation plant.

unclassified.label: LIFO Inventory Amount
unclassified.description: The amount of LIFO (last in first out) inventory present at the reporting date when inventory is also valued using different valuation methods.

unclassified.label: Leveraged Leases, Balance Sheet, Investment in Leveraged Leases
unclassified.description: The net investment in arrangements meeting the criteria to be classified as leveraged excluding deferred taxes.

unclassified.label: Leveraged Leases, Balance Sheet, Investment in Leveraged Leases, Net
unclassified.description: The net investment in arrangements meeting the criteria to be classified as leveraged.

unclassified.label: Line of Credit Facility, Capacity Available for Trade Purchases
unclassified.description: The maximum amount of borrowing capacity under a line of credit that is available as of the balance sheet date for financing purchases of goods acquired for inventory or imminent delivery to a customer.

unclassified.label: Line of Credit Facility, Interest Rate at Period End
unclassified.description: The effective interest rate at the end of the reporting period.

unclassified.label: Litigation Settlement, Amount Awarded from Other Party
unclassified.description: Amount awarded from other party in judgment or settlement of litigation.

unclassified.label: Loans Payable to Bank, Current
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of current portion of long-term loans payable to bank due within one year or the operating cycle if longer.

unclassified.label: Long-term Commercial Paper, Current
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the current portion of long-term unsecured obligations issued by corporations and other borrowers to investors (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer).

unclassified.label: Long-term Debt and Capital Lease Obligations, Maturities, Repayments of Principal after Year Five
unclassified.description: Principal amount of long-term debt and capital lease obligation maturing after the fifth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Long-term Debt and Capital Lease Obligations, Maturities, Repayments of Principal in Year Five
unclassified.description: Principal amount of long-term debt and capital lease obligation maturing in the fifth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Long-term Debt and Capital Lease Obligations, Maturities, Repayments of Principal in Year Four
unclassified.description: Principal amount of long-term debt and capital lease obligation maturing in the fourth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Long-term Debt and Capital Lease Obligations, Maturities, Repayments of Principal in Year Three
unclassified.description: Principal amount of long-term debt and capital lease obligation maturing in the third fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Long-term Debt and Capital Lease Obligations, Maturities, Repayments of Principal in Year Two
unclassified.description: Principal amount of long-term debt and capital lease obligation maturing in the second fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Long-term Debt and Capital Lease Obligations, Repayments of Principal in Next Twelve Months
unclassified.description: Principal amount of long-term debt and capital lease obligation maturing in the next fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Long-term Investments and Receivables, Net
unclassified.description: The total amount of investments that are intended to be held for an extended period of time (longer than one operating cycle) and amount due to the Entity from outside sources, including trade accounts receivable, notes and loans receivable, as well as any other types of receivables, net of allowances established for the purpose of reducing such investments and receivables to an amount that approximates their net realizable value.

unclassified.label: Long-term Commercial Paper
unclassified.description: Including the current and noncurrent portions, carrying value as of the balance sheet date of long-term unsecured obligations issued by corporations and other borrowers to investors (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer).

unclassified.label: Long-term Transition Bond, Current
unclassified.description: Long-Term transition bonds are bonds under the Competition Act in which the proceeds of Transition Bonds are required to be used principally to reduce qualified stranded costs and the related capitalization of the utility. This represents the current portion.

unclassified.label: Loss Contingency Accrual, Payments
unclassified.description: Amount of cash outflow reducing loss contingency liability.

unclassified.label: Loss Contingency Accrual, Provision
unclassified.description: Amount charged against operating income increasing loss contingency liability, after adjustments to reduce previously estimated charges.

unclassified.label: Loss Contingency, Damages Awarded, Value
unclassified.description: Amount of damages awarded to the plaintiff in the legal matter.

unclassified.label: Loss Contingency, New Claims Filed, Number
unclassified.description: The total number of new claims filed pertaining to a loss contingency during the period.

unclassified.label: Loss from Catastrophes
unclassified.description: The charge against earnings in the period for the uninsured portion of a loss from a fire, explosion, or natural disaster (hurricane, earthquake).

unclassified.label: Machinery and Equipment, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount before accumulated depreciation of tangible personal property used to produce goods and services, including, but is not limited to, tools, dies and molds, computer and office equipment.

unclassified.label: Marketable Securities, Realized Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of realized gain (loss) on investment in marketable security, including other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI).

unclassified.label: Marketable Securities, Realized Loss, Other than Temporary Impairments, Amount (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Noncontrolling Interest, Change in Redemption Value
unclassified.description: Change in noncontrolling interest during the period as a result of a change in the redemption value of redeemable noncontrolling interest.

unclassified.label: Noncontrolling Interest, Increase from Equity Issuance or Sale of Parent Equity Interest (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Noncontrolling Interest, Ownership Percentage by Parent
unclassified.description: The parent entity's interest in net assets of the subsidiary, expressed as a percentage.

unclassified.label: Net Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations Available to Common Shareholders, Diluted
unclassified.description: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities, and addition from assumption of issuance of common shares for dilutive potential common shares; of income (loss) from continuing operations available to common shareholders.

unclassified.label: Net Investment in Lease
unclassified.description: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases.

unclassified.label: Notes Issued
unclassified.description: The fair value of notes issued in noncash investing and financing activities.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, before Allowance for Credit Loss
unclassified.description: Amortized cost, before allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable. Excludes financing receivable covered under loss sharing agreement and net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: Notional Amount of Interest Rate Derivatives (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Number of Businesses Acquired
unclassified.description: Number of businesses acquired in business combination.

unclassified.label: Number of Interest Rate Derivatives Held
unclassified.description: Number of interest rate derivative instruments held by the entity at the reporting date.

unclassified.label: OCI, before Reclassifications, Net of Tax, Attributable to Parent
unclassified.description: Amount after tax, before reclassification adjustments, of other comprehensive income (loss), attributable to parent.

unclassified.label: OCI, Equity Method Investment, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) allocated to other comprehensive income (loss) (OCI) for proportionate share of equity method investee's OCI.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments Receivable, Current
unclassified.description: Future rental payments receivable within one year of the balance sheet date under an operating lease.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments Receivable, in Five Years
unclassified.description: Future rental payments receivable within the fifth year from the balance sheet date under an operating lease.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments Receivable, in Four Years
unclassified.description: Future rental payments receivable within the fourth year from the balance sheet date under an operating lease.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments Receivable, in Three Years
unclassified.description: Future rental payments receivable within the third year from the balance sheet date under an operating lease.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments Receivable, in Two Years
unclassified.description: Future rental payments receivable within the second year from the balance sheet date under an operating lease.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Income Statement, Lease Revenue
unclassified.description: The total amount of revenue recognized for the period from operating leases, including minimum lease revenue, contingent revenue, percentage revenue and sublease revenue.

unclassified.label: Other Assets, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of other assets.

unclassified.label: Other Assets, Miscellaneous
unclassified.description: Amount of other miscellaneous assets.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Pension and Other Postretirement Benefit Plans, Net Prior Service Costs Arising During Period ,Tax (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, after Reclassification Adjustment, Tax, Attributable to Parent
unclassified.description: Amount, after reclassification adjustment, of tax (expense) benefit for (increase) decrease in accumulated other comprehensive income for defined benefit plan, attributable to parent.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivatives Qualifying as Hedges, before Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Reclassification Adjustment Realized upon Sale or Liquidation, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Amortization, Pension and Other Postretirement Benefit Plans, Net Prior Service Cost Recognized in Net Periodic Pension Cost, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), before Reclassifications, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount before tax and reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss).

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount before tax, after reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss).

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Settlement and Curtailment Gain (Loss), after Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of increase (decrease) to other comprehensive income from settlement and curtailment gain (loss) of defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, before Reclassification Adjustment and Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax and reclassification adjustment, of (increase) decrease in accumulated other comprehensive income of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit cost (credit).

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, after Reclassification Adjustment, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, after reclassification adjustment, of (increase) decrease in accumulated other comprehensive income for defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Gain (Loss) Arising During Period, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, of gain (loss) for (increase) decrease in value of benefit obligation for change in actuarial assumptions and increase (decrease) in value of plan assets from experience different from that assumed of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI on Derivatives, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount before tax of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income of accumulated gain (loss) realized from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's deferred hedging gain (loss).

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment for Write-down of Securities Included in Net Income, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Derivatives Arising During Period, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount before tax of increase (decrease) in accumulated gain (loss) from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's increase (decrease) in deferred hedging gain (loss).

unclassified.label: Other Cost of Operating Revenue
unclassified.description: Other costs incurred during the reporting period related to other revenue generating activities.

unclassified.label: Other Deferred Credits, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount of unearned revenue or income classified as other, expected to be taken into income after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Other Notes Payable
unclassified.description: Amount of long-term notes payable classified as other.

unclassified.label: Other than Temporary Impairment Losses, Investments, Portion Recognized in Earnings, Net, Available-for-sale Securities
Payment for Contingent Consideration Liability, Financing Activities
unclassified.description: Amount of cash outflow, not made soon after acquisition date of business combination, to settle contingent consideration liability up to amount recognized at acquisition date, including, but not limited to, measurement period adjustment and less amount paid soon after acquisition date.

unclassified.label: Payments for Other Fees
unclassified.description: Amount of cash outflow for fees classified as other.

unclassified.label: Payments for Legal Settlements
unclassified.description: The amount of cash paid for the settlement of litigation or for other legal issues during the period.

unclassified.label: Payments for Other Deposits
unclassified.description: Amount of cash outflow for deposits classified as other.

unclassified.label: Payments for Postemployment Benefits
unclassified.description: Cash outflows for payments of postemployment benefits (such as severance pay and health insurance benefits) recognized during the period. Postemployment benefits are benefits paid to employees after employment but before retirement.

unclassified.label: Payments for Repurchase of Warrants
unclassified.description: The aggregate amount paid by the entity to reacquire the right to purchase equity shares at a predetermined price, usually issued together with corporate debt.

unclassified.label: Pension and Other Postretirement Defined Benefit Plans, Noncurrent Liabilities (Deprecated 2009-01-31)
Preferred Stock, Dividend Rate, Percentage
unclassified.description: The percentage rate used to calculate dividend payments on preferred stock.

unclassified.label: Preferred Stock Redemption Premium
unclassified.description: The excess of (1) fair value of the consideration transferred to the holders of the preferred stock over (2) the carrying amount of the preferred stock in the registrant's balance sheet, during the accounting period.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Debt, Net of Issuance Costs
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from additional borrowings, net of cash paid to third parties in connection with debt origination.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Preferred Limited Partners Units
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from the issuance of preferred limited partners units during the period.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Bank Overdrafts
unclassified.description: The net cash inflow or outflow from the excess drawing from an existing cash balance, which will be honored by the bank but reflected as a loan to the drawer.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Other Long-term Debt
unclassified.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from other long-term debt.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from (Repurchase of) Equity
unclassified.description: The net cash inflow or outflow resulting from the entity's share transaction.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale of Interest in Corporate Unit
unclassified.description: The cash inflow resulting from the sale of an interest in a corporate unit during the period.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale of Long-term Investments
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from sales of all investments, including securities and other assets, having ready marketability and intended by management to be liquidated, if necessary, beyond the current operating cycle.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale of Oil and Gas Property and Equipment
unclassified.description: The cash inflow to dispose of long-lived, physical assets and mineral interests in oil and gas properties used for normal oil and gas operations.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sales of Business, Affiliate and Productive Assets
unclassified.description: Aggregate cash proceeds received from a combination of transactions in which noncurrent assets are sold, which may include the sale of a business, an investment in an affiliate (including an equity method investee), property, plant and equipment and intangible assets. Excludes sales of trading, available-for-sale, and held-to-maturity securities.

unclassified.label: Professional and Contract Services Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of expense for professional and contracted services.

unclassified.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Additions
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in property, plant, and equipment from addition. Includes, but is not limited to, land and land improvement; building; machinery and equipment; furniture and fixture; and work of art, historical treasure, or similar asset classified as collection.

unclassified.label: Property, Plant, and Equipment and Finance Lease Right-of-Use Asset, before Accumulated Depreciation and Amortization
unclassified.description: Amount, before accumulated depreciation and amortization, of property, plant, and equipment and finance lease right-of-use asset.

unclassified.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Transfers and Changes
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in property, plant, and equipment from reclassification, impairment, donation, and change classified as other. Includes, but is not limited to, land and land improvement; building; machinery and equipment; furniture and fixture; and work of art, historical treasure, or similar asset classified as collection.

unclassified.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Useful Life, Maximum (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Financing Receivable, Credit Loss, Expense (Reversal)
unclassified.description: Amount of credit loss expense (reversal of expense) for financing receivable.

unclassified.label: Public Utilities, Interim Rate Increase (Decrease), Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of public utility's interim rate increase (decrease) allowed while waiting final decision of regulatory agency.

unclassified.label: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Transmission and Distribution
unclassified.description: Period end amount of property, plant and equipment (PPE) related to transmission and distribution owned by public utility.

unclassified.label: Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Remainder of Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount of purchase arrangement to be paid in remainder of current fiscal year. Includes, but is not limited to, recorded and unrecorded purchase obligations, long-term purchase commitment, and short-term purchase commitment.

unclassified.label: Quantifying Misstatement in Current Year Financial Statements, Amount
Reclassification from AOCI, Current Period, before Tax, Attributable to Parent
unclassified.description: Amount before tax of reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss) attributable to parent.

unclassified.label: Reclassification from AOCI, Current Period, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income (loss).

unclassified.label: Recognition of Deferred Revenue
unclassified.description: The amount of previously reported deferred or unearned revenue that was recognized as revenue during the period. For cash flows, this element primarily pertains to amortization of deferred credits on long-term arrangements. As a noncash item, it is deducted from net income when calculating cash provided by or used in operations using the indirect method.

unclassified.label: Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest, Equity, Other, Carrying Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of noncontrolling interests which are redeemable by the parent entity, classified as other equity.

unclassified.label: Redeemable Preferred Stock Dividends
unclassified.description: Dividends paid to preferred stock holders that is redeemable solely at the option of the issuer.

unclassified.label: Redemption Premium
unclassified.description: The excess of the (1) fair value of consideration transferred to the holders of a security in excess of (2) the carrying amount of the security reported on the registrant's balance sheet, which will be deducted from net earnings to derive net earnings available to common shareholders. This amount is generally an adjustment considered in the computation of earnings per share.

unclassified.label: Regulated Operating Revenue, Gas
unclassified.description: The amount of regulated gas operating revenues recognized during the period.

unclassified.label: Regulated Operating Revenue, Other
unclassified.description: The amount of regulated other operating revenues recognized during the period.

unclassified.label: Related Party Transaction, Other Revenues from Transactions with Related Party
Restructuring and Related Cost, Number of Positions Eliminated
unclassified.description: The number of positions eliminated during the period as a result of restructuring activities.

unclassified.label: Restructuring Costs
unclassified.description: Amount, after cash payment, of expenses associated with exit or disposal activities pursuant to an authorized plan. Excludes expenses related to a discontinued operation or an asset retirement obligation.

unclassified.label: Sale Leaseback Transaction, Net Book Value
unclassified.description: The net book value of the asset(s) sold in connection with the sale of the property to another party and lease back to the seller.

unclassified.label: Sales and Excise Tax Payable, Current
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of liabilities incurred through that date and payable for statutory sales and use taxes, including value added tax. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

unclassified.label: Sales-Type and Direct Financing Leases, Lease Receivable, to be Received, Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of undiscounted cash flows to be received by lessor for sales-type and direct financing leases in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Sales-Type and Direct Financing Leases, Lease Receivable, to be Received, Year Four
unclassified.description: Amount of undiscounted cash flows to be received by lessor for sales-type and direct financing leases in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Sales-Type and Direct Financing Leases, Lease Receivable, to be Received, Year One
unclassified.description: Amount of undiscounted cash flows to be received by lessor for sales-type and direct financing leases in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Sales-Type and Direct Financing Leases, Lease Receivable, to be Received, after Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of undiscounted cash flows to be received by lessor for sales-type and direct financing leases after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Sales-Type and Direct Financing Leases, Lease Receivable, to be Received, Year Three
unclassified.description: Amount of undiscounted cash flows to be received by lessor for sales-type and direct financing leases in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Sales-Type and Direct Financing Leases, Lease Receivable, to be Received, Year Two
unclassified.description: Amount of undiscounted cash flows to be received by lessor for sales-type and direct financing leases in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Sales-type Lease, Net Investment in Lease
unclassified.description: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of net investment in sales-type lease.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Compensation Cost (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Forfeitures, Weighted Average Grant Date Fair Value
unclassified.description: Weighted average fair value as of the grant date of equity-based award plans other than stock (unit) option plans that were not exercised or put into effect as a result of the occurrence of a terminating event.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Share-based Liabilities Paid
unclassified.description: Amount of cash paid to settle liability for award under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Number of Additional Shares Authorized
unclassified.description: Number of additional shares authorized for issuance under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Vested and Expected to Vest, Exercisable, Aggregate Intrinsic Value
unclassified.description: Amount by which current fair value of underlying stock exceeds exercise price of fully vested and expected to vest exercisable or convertible options. Includes, but is not limited to, unvested options for which requisite service period has not been rendered but that are expected to vest based on achievement of performance condition, if forfeitures are recognized when they occur.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Vested and Expected to Vest, Exercisable, Number
unclassified.description: Number of fully vested and expected to vest exercisable options that may be converted into shares under option plan. Includes, but is not limited to, unvested options for which requisite service period has not been rendered but that are expected to vest based on achievement of performance condition, if forfeitures are recognized when they occur.

unclassified.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Plan Modification, Incremental Cost
unclassified.description: An excess of the fair value of the modified award over the fair value of the award immediately before the modification.

unclassified.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Option, Exercise Price Range, Lower Range Limit
unclassified.description: The floor of a customized range of exercise prices for purposes of disclosing shares potentially issuable under outstanding stock option awards on all stock option plans and other required information pertaining to awards in the customized range.

unclassified.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Option, Exercise Price Range, Shares Exercisable
unclassified.description: The number of shares reserved for issuance pertaining to the outstanding exercisable stock options as of the balance sheet date in the customized range of exercise prices for which the market and performance vesting condition has been satisfied.

unclassified.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Option, Exercise Price Range, Upper Range Limit
unclassified.description: The ceiling of a customized range of exercise prices for purposes of disclosing shares potentially issuable under outstanding stock option awards on all stock option plans and other required information pertaining to awards in the customized range.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Nonvested Options Forfeited, Weighted Average Grant Date Fair Value
unclassified.description: Weighted average grant-date fair value of non-vested options forfeited.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Option, Nonvested, Weighted Average Exercise Price
unclassified.description: Weighted average grant-date fair value of non-vested options outstanding.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Vested, Weighted Average Grant Date Fair Value
unclassified.description: Weighted average grant-date fair value of options vested.

unclassified.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Option, Exercise Price Range, Outstanding, Weighted Average Exercise Price
unclassified.description: The weighted average price as of the balance sheet date at which grantees could acquire the underlying shares with respect to all outstanding stock options which are in the customized range of exercise prices.

unclassified.label: Significant (Increase) Decrease in Unrecognized Tax Benefits is Reasonably Possible, Estimated Range of Change, Lower Bound (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
Spent Nuclear Fuel Obligation, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Provision for the disposal costs of spent nuclear fuel from generating stations.

unclassified.label: Stockholders' Equity, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest, Adjusted Balance (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Stockholders' Equity Note, Spinoff Transaction
unclassified.description: The change in equity as a result of a spin-off transaction (a regular or reverse spin-off) which is based on the recorded amounts.

unclassified.label: Tax Benefit from Stock Options Exercised (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Tax Benefit from Stock Options Exercised (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, Change in Tax Rate, Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
Taxes Other than Income, Excise, Production and Property Taxes (Deprecated 2009-01-31)
Temporary Equity, Net Income
unclassified.description: The portion of net income or loss attributable to temporary equity interest.

unclassified.label: Temporary Equity, Other Changes
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in temporary equity from changes classified as other.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Trading, and Equity Securities, FV-NI
unclassified.description: Amount of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading) and investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).

unclassified.label: Undistributed Earnings (Loss) Allocated to Participating Securities, Diluted
unclassified.description: Amount of undistributed earnings (loss) allocated to participating securities for the diluted earnings (loss) per share or per unit calculation under the two-class method.

unclassified.label: Undistributed Earnings of Foreign Subsidiaries
unclassified.description: Amount of undistributed earnings of foreign subsidiaries intended to be permanently reinvested outside the country of domicile.

unclassified.label: Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Cash Flow Hedging Instruments
unclassified.description: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) related to derivatives designated as cash flow hedging instruments, recorded in results of operations to the extent that the cash flow hedge is determined to be ineffective.

unclassified.label: Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Commodity Contracts
unclassified.description: The net change in the difference between the fair value and the carrying value, or in the comparative fair values, of open agreements to purchase or sell mineral resources, energy, and agricultural products at some future point held at each balance sheet date, that was included in earnings for the period.

unclassified.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Income Tax Penalties Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of expense for penalties related to a tax position claimed or expected to be claimed in the tax return.

unclassified.label: Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, Purchases
unclassified.description: The amount purchased during the period under an unrecorded unconditional purchase obligation (for example, under the take-or-pay or throughput contract).

unclassified.label: Utilities Operating Expense, Impairments
unclassified.description: Amount of operating expense for impairments of regulated operation.

unclassified.label: Utilities Operating Expense, Other
unclassified.description: Amount of other operating expense of regulated operation.

unclassified.label: Utilities Operating Expense, Purchased Power under Long-term Contracts
unclassified.description: Amount of operating expense for purchased power procured under arrangements extending beyond one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer, by regulated operation.

unclassified.label: Variable Interest Entity, Consolidated, Carrying Amount, Assets (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Variable Interest Entity, Consolidated, Carrying Amount, Liabilities (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Variable Interest Entity, Qualitative or Quantitative Information, Ownership Percentage
unclassified.description: Percentage of the Variable Interest Entity's (VIE) voting interest owned by (or beneficial interest in) the reporting entity (directly or indirectly).

unclassified.label: Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities
unclassified.description: Sum of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date, including liabilities incurred and payable to vendors for goods and services received, taxes, interest, rent and utilities, compensation costs, payroll taxes and fringe benefits (other than pension and postretirement obligations), contractual rights and obligations, and statutory obligations.

unclassified.label: Construction Contractor, Receivable, Excluding Contract Retainage
unclassified.description: Amount billed to customers under long-term contracts or programs but not paid. Excludes amounts due that have been withheld because of retainage provisions in a contract.

unclassified.label: Accounts Receivable, Sale
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease from sale of accounts receivable.

unclassified.label: Accretion (Amortization) of Discounts and Premiums, Investments
unclassified.description: The sum of the periodic adjustments of the differences between securities' face values and purchase prices that are charged against earnings. This is called accretion if the security was purchased at a discount and amortization if it was purchased at premium. As a noncash item, this element is an adjustment to net income when calculating cash provided by or used in operations using the indirect method.

unclassified.label: Accrual for Environmental Loss Contingencies, Increase (Decrease) for Acquisitions and Divestitures
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in the obligation for environmental loss contingencies from business acquisitions (divestitures).

unclassified.label: Accrual for Environmental Loss Contingencies, Revision in Estimates
unclassified.description: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) which increases (decreases) the accrual for environmental loss contingencies from revisions in estimates to existing obligations. Excludes changes related to business acquisitions, divestitures, or currency movement.

unclassified.label: Accrual for Environmental Loss Contingency, Undiscounted, to be Paid, after Year Five
unclassified.description: Undiscounted amount of accrual for environmental loss contingency to be paid after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Accrual for Environmental Loss Contingency, Undiscounted, to be Paid, Year One
unclassified.description: Undiscounted amount of accrual for environmental loss contingency to be paid in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Accrued Bonuses, Current
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable for incentive compensation awarded to employees and directors or earned by them based on the terms of one or more relevant arrangements. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

unclassified.label: Accrued Capping, Closure, Post-closure and Environmental Costs
unclassified.description: The amount of estimated costs accrued as of the balance sheet date to comply with regulatory requirements pertaining to the retirement of a waste management facility (such as a landfill or waste treatment facility). Represents the portion that will be paid within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Accrued Employee Benefits
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations, excluding pension and other postretirement benefits, incurred through that date and payable for perquisites provided to employees pertaining to services received from them.

unclassified.label: Accrued Professional Fees
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable for professional fees, such as for legal and accounting services received.

unclassified.label: Accumulated Amortization, Debt Issuance Costs
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated amortization of debt issuance costs.

unclassified.label: Accumulated Capitalized Interest Costs
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated interest costs capitalized as part of property, plant and equipment cost basis.

unclassified.label: Accumulated Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization, Property, Plant and Equipment, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization of property, plant and equipment.

unclassified.label: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Convertible Debt with Conversion Feature
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in additional paid in capital (APIC) resulting from recognition of deferred taxes for convertible debt with a beneficial conversion feature.

unclassified.label: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Equity Component of Convertible Debt
unclassified.description: Adjustment to additional paid in capital resulting from the recognition of convertible debt instruments as two separate components - a debt component and an equity component. This bifurcation may result in a basis difference associated with the liability component that represents a temporary difference for purposes of applying accounting for income taxes. The initial recognition of deferred taxes for the tax effect of that temporary difference is as an adjustment to additional paid in capital.

unclassified.label: Advances to Affiliate
unclassified.description: Long-Term advances receivable from a party that is affiliated with the reporting entity by means of direct or indirect ownership. This does not include advances to clients.

unclassified.label: Allowance for Doubtful Accounts, Premiums and Other Receivables
unclassified.description: The valuation allowance as of the balance sheet date to reduce the gross amount of receivables to estimated net realizable value, which would be presented in parentheses on the face of the balance sheet.

unclassified.label: Allowance for Loan and Lease Losses, Write-offs
unclassified.description: Amount of loans and leases that have been written off from both loan receivables and allowance reserve for credit loss.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount of allowance for credit loss on financing receivable, classified as noncurrent.

unclassified.label: Amortization and Depreciation of Decontaminating and Decommissioning Assets
unclassified.description: The current period expense charged against earnings on decontaminating and decommissioning of facilities used in the normal conduct of business and not intended for resale to allocate or recognize the cost of the assets over their useful lives.

unclassified.label: Amortization of Deferred Charges
unclassified.description: The amount of amortization of deferred charges applied against earnings during the period.

unclassified.label: Amortization of Deferred Leasing Fees
unclassified.description: This element represents the amortization of deferred leasing fees incurred by the lessor and amortized over the term of the lease. Such fees represent (a) costs to originate a lease incurred in transactions with independent third parties that (i) result directly from and are essential to acquire that lease and (ii) would not have been incurred had that leasing transaction not occurred and (b) certain costs directly related to specified activities performed by the lessor for that lease. Those activities are: evaluating the prospective lessee's financial condition; evaluating and recording guarantees, collateral, and other security arrangements; negotiating lease terms; preparing and processing lease documents; and closing the transaction.

unclassified.label: Dilutive Securities, Effect on Basic Earnings Per Share, Options and Restrictive Stock Units
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) to net income used for calculating diluted earnings per share (EPS), resulting from the assumed exercise of stock options or restrictive stock units (RSUs).

unclassified.label: Amount of Regulatory Costs Not yet Approved
unclassified.description: Amount of regulatory costs not yet approved by the regulatory authority.

unclassified.label: AOCI Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in accumulated other comprehensive income.

unclassified.label: AOCI Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) allocated to accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) including portion attributable to noncontrolling interest.

unclassified.label: AssetAcquisitionConsiderationTransferredTransactionCost
unclassified.description: Amount of transaction cost incurred as part of consideration transferred in asset acquisition.

unclassified.label: Asset Retirement Obligation, Foreign Currency Translation Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of foreign currency translation gain (loss) which decreases (increases) asset retirement obligations.

unclassified.label: Assets Needed for Immediate Settlement, Aggregate Fair Value
unclassified.description: The aggregate fair value of assets needed to immediately settle the derivative instruments with credit-risk-related contingent features if the credit-risk-related contingent features were triggered at the end of the reporting period.

unclassified.label: Net Assets
unclassified.description: Amount of net assets (liabilities).
