unclassified.label: Available-for-sale Equity Securities, Amortized Cost Basis
Available-for-sale Securities, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, 12 Months or Longer, Aggregate Loss (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Available-for-sale Securities, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, Less than 12 Months, Aggregate Loss (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), classified as noncurrent.

unclassified.label: Available-for-sale Securities, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, 12 Months or Longer, Aggregate Losses (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Available-for-sale Securities, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, Less than 12 Months, Aggregate Losses (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Billed Contracts Receivable
unclassified.description: Amounts due for billed services rendered or to be rendered, actions taken or to be taken, or a promise to refrain from taking certain actions in accordance with the terms of a legally binding agreement between the Company and, at a minimum, one other party. An example would be amounts billed to customers under contracts or programs but not paid as of the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Billings in Excess of Cost, Current
unclassified.description: Liability attributable to (i) billings in excess of costs under the percentage of completion contract accounting method representing the difference between contractually invoiced amounts (billings) and revenue recognized based, for example, on costs incurred to estimated total costs at period end or (ii) contractually invoiced amounts (billings) in excess of costs incurred and accumulated under the completed contract accounting method that are expected to be realized within one year or one operating cycle, whichever is longer, from the reporting date.

unclassified.label: Business Acquisition, Cost of Acquired Entity, Equity Interests Issued and Issuable (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Acquisition, Cost of Acquired Entity, Other Noncash Consideration (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Acquisition, Pro Forma Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Net of Tax, Per Share, Basic
unclassified.description: Per basic share amount, after tax, of pro forma income (loss) from continuing operations of combined entity as if acquisition date of business combination occurred as of beginning of period.

unclassified.label: Business Acquisition, Pro Forma Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Net of Tax, Per Share, Diluted
unclassified.description: Per diluted share amount, after tax, of pro forma income (loss) from continuing operations of combined entity as if acquisition date of business combination occurred as of beginning of period.

unclassified.label: Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Current Assets, Prepaid Expense and Other Assets (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Acquisition, Goodwill, Expected Tax Deductible Amount
unclassified.description: The amount of goodwill arising from a business combination that is expected to be deductible for tax purposes.

unclassified.label: Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Noncurrent Liabilities, Long-term Debt (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Other Noncurrent Liabilities (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Combination, Acquired Receivables, Gross Contractual Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of gross contractual receivable purchased without credit deterioration, acquired in business combination. Excludes purchased financial asset with credit deterioration.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration Arrangements, Change in Amount of Contingent Consideration, Asset
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in value of asset in contingent consideration arrangement in business combination.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration, Liability, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount of liability recognized arising from contingent consideration in a business combination, expected to be settled beyond one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Pro Forma Information, Earnings or Loss of Acquiree since Acquisition Date, Actual
unclassified.description: Amount of acquiree's earnings (loss) since acquisition date of business combination included in consolidated statement of income.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Asset Acquired and Liability Assumed, Lease Obligation
unclassified.description: Amount of lease obligation assumed in business combination and recognized at acquisition date.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Current Assets, Prepaid Expense and Other Assets
unclassified.description: Amount of prepaid expense and asset classified as other, acquired in business combination and recognized at acquisition date, classified as current.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Current Liabilities, Accounts Payable
unclassified.description: Amount of accounts payable assumed in business combination and recognized at acquisition date, classified as current.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Finite-Lived Intangibles
unclassified.description: Amount of identifiable finite-lived intangible asset acquired in business combination and recognized at acquisition date.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired, Goodwill, and Liabilities Assumed, Less Noncontrolling Interest
unclassified.description: Amount of asset acquired in excess of (less than) liability assumed plus goodwill in business combination and recognized at acquisition date, less fair value of noncontrolling interest in acquiree at acquisition date when acquirer holds less than 100 percent of equity interest in acquiree.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Separately Recognized Transactions, Additional Disclosures, Acquisition Costs
unclassified.description: Amount of acquisition-related cost incurred to effect business combination and recognized separately from acquisition of asset and assumption of liability. Includes, but is not limited to, finder's fee; advisory, legal, accounting, valuation, and other professional and consulting fees; and cost of registering and issuing debt and equity securities. Excludes integration, restructuring, and other post-combination costs; cost related to acquisition of asset; and acquisition-related cost for transaction with third party.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Separately Recognized Transactions, Net Gains and Losses
unclassified.description: The net gains or losses recognized for each transaction with the acquiree that was recognized separately from the acquisition of assets and assumptions of liabilities in the business combination.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments Receivable, Next Twelve Months
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum lease payments to be received by the lessor for capital leases in the next fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Receivable in Five Years
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum lease payments to be received by the lessor for capital leases in the fifth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Receivable in Four Years
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum lease payments to be received by the lessor for capital leases in the fourth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Receivable in Three Years
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum lease payments to be received by the lessor for capital leases in the third fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Receivable in Two Years
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum lease payments to be received by the lessor for capital leases in the second fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Remainder of Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for capital leases due in the remainder of the fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Income Statement, Amortization Expense
unclassified.description: The charge for the use of long-lived depreciable capital leased assets for the period.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Lessor Balance Sheet, Net Investment in Direct Financing Leases, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: The net amount due after one year of the balance sheet date or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer, consisting of: (a) minimum lease payments due on direct financing leases, (b) unguaranteed residual value, and (c) any unamortized initial direct costs; less: (i) executory costs, (ii) unearned income, and (iii) the accumulated allowance for uncollectible minimum lease payments.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Net Investment in Direct Financing Leases, Deferred Income
unclassified.description: The remaining (unamortized) difference between the gross investment in a direct financing lease and the cost or carrying amount, if different, of the leased property as of the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Net Investment in Direct Financing Leases, Unguaranteed Residual Values of Leased Property
unclassified.description: The estimate of the lease property's economic value at the end of the direct financing lease term excluding any amounts guaranteed by either the lessee or a third-party.

unclassified.label: Capitalized Costs, Asset Retirement Costs
unclassified.description: Amount, before accumulated depreciation, depletion, amortization, and valuation allowance, of capitalized cost for asset retirement in oil- and gas-producing activities.

unclassified.label: Capitalized Costs, Oil and Gas Producing Activities, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount, before accumulated depreciation, depletion, amortization, and valuation allowance, of capitalized cost in oil- and gas-producing activities.

unclassified.label: Cash and Cash Equivalents, at Carrying Value, Including Discontinued Operations
unclassified.description: For the entity and the disposal group, cash includes currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions. It also includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits in that the Entity may deposit additional funds at any time and also effectively may withdraw funds at any time without prior notice or penalty. Cash equivalents, excluding items classified as marketable securities, include short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash, and so near their maturity that they present minimal risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Generally, only investments with original maturities of three months or less qualify under that definition. Original maturity means original maturity to the entity holding the investment. For example, both a three-month US Treasury bill and a three-year Treasury note purchased three months from maturity qualify as cash equivalents. However, a Treasury note purchased three years ago does not become a cash equivalent when its remaining maturity is three months. Compensating balance arrangements that do not legally restrict the withdrawal or usage of cash amounts may be reported as Cash and Cash Equivalents, while legally restricted deposits held as compensating balances against borrowing arrangements, contracts entered into with others, or company statements of intention with regard to particular deposits are not generally reported as cash and cash equivalents.

unclassified.label: Cash, Cash Equivalents, Restricted Cash and Restricted Cash Equivalents, Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operations
unclassified.description: Amount of cash and cash equivalent, and cash and cash equivalent restricted to withdrawal or usage; attributable to discontinued operation. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

unclassified.label: CashCashEquivalentsRestrictedCashAndRestrictedCashEquivalentsPeriodIncreaseDecreaseIncludingExchangeRateEffectContinuingOperations
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in cash, cash equivalent, and cash and cash equivalent restricted to withdrawal or usage, including effect from exchange rate change; attributable to continuing operation. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

unclassified.label: SEC Schedule, 12-04, Cash Dividends Paid to Registrant, Consolidated Subsidiaries
unclassified.description: This element represents disclosure of the aggregate cash dividends paid to the entity by consolidated subsidiaries.

unclassified.label: Cash Flow Hedge Gain (Loss) Reclassified to Interest Expense, Net (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Cash Flow Hedge Loss Reclassified to Interest Expense (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Cash Surrender Value of Life Insurance
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of amounts which could be received based on the terms of the insurance contract upon surrendering life policies owned by the entity.

unclassified.label: Class of Warrant or Right, Number of Securities Called by Each Warrant or Right
unclassified.description: Number of securities into which each warrant or right may be converted. For example, but not limited to, each warrant may be converted into two shares.

unclassified.label: Collateralized Financings
unclassified.description: The value of the collateral (typically cash) that the entity receives in a financing transaction in exchange for securities lent. This item represents a liability in the financial statements of the lender of the securities.

unclassified.label: Commodity Contract Asset, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the asset arising from commodity contracts such as futures contracts tied to the movement of a particular commodity, which are expected to be converted into cash or otherwise disposed of after a year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Common Stock, Including Additional Paid in Capital (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Contract with Customer, Asset, before Allowance for Credit Loss
unclassified.description: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer, when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time.

unclassified.label: Contract with Customer, Asset, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time, classified as noncurrent.

unclassified.label: Convertible Preferred Stock, Nonredeemable or Redeemable, Issuer Option, Value
unclassified.description: Value of outstanding nonredeemable convertible preferred stock or outstanding convertible preferred stock that is redeemable solely at the option of the issuer.

unclassified.label: Cost of Domestic Regulated Gas Revenue (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Cost of Purchased Oil and Gas (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Costs in Excess of Billings
unclassified.description: Amount of receivable reflecting the cost incurred on uncompleted contracts in excess of related billings.

unclassified.label: Customer Advances and Deposits
unclassified.description: Refundable consideration, usually cash, held by the entity pending satisfactory completion of the entity's obligations or pending the closing of a contract.

unclassified.label: Customer Deposits, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: The noncurrent portion of money or property received from customers that is to be returned upon satisfactory contract completion or as partial prepayment for goods or services to be provided in the future.

unclassified.label: Debt and Equity Securities, Unrealized Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt and equity securities.

unclassified.label: Debt Conversion, Converted Instrument, Rate
unclassified.description: Dividend or interest rate associated with the financial instrument issued in exchange for the original debt being converted in a noncash or part noncash transaction. Noncash are transactions that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments. Part noncash refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments.

unclassified.label: Debt Conversion, Converted Instrument, Shares Issued
unclassified.description: The number of shares issued in exchange for the original debt being converted in a noncash (or part noncash) transaction. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or payments in the period.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Debt Default, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of outstanding long-term debt or borrowing associated with any securities or credit agreement for which there has been a default in principal, interest, sinking fund, or redemption provisions, or any breach of covenant that existed at the end of the period and subsequently has not been cured.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Basis Spread on Variable Rate
unclassified.description: Percentage points added to the reference rate to compute the variable rate on the debt instrument.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Convertible, Beneficial Conversion Feature
unclassified.description: Amount of a favorable spread to a debt holder between the amount of debt being converted and the value of the securities received upon conversion. This is an embedded conversion feature of convertible debt issued that is in-the-money at the commitment date.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Convertible, Carrying Amount of Equity Component
unclassified.description: The carrying amount of the equity component of convertible debt which may be settled in cash upon conversion.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Fee Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the fee that accompanies borrowing money under the debt instrument.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Interest Rate, Stated Percentage Rate Range, Maximum (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Debt Instrument, Interest Rate, Stated Percentage Rate Range, Minimum (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Debt Instrument, Periodic Payment, Principal
unclassified.description: Amount of the required periodic payments applied to principal.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Unamortized Premium, Current
unclassified.description: Amount of debt premium to be amortized within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Unused Borrowing Capacity, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of unused borrowing capacity under the long-term financing arrangement that is available to the entity as of the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), and investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Allowance for Credit Loss
unclassified.description: Amount of allowance for credit loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

unclassified.label: DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAmortizedCostExcludingAccruedInterestAfterAllowanceForCreditLoss
unclassified.description: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

unclassified.label: Debtor Reorganization Items, Other Expense (Income)
unclassified.description: Amount of expense (income) related to reorganization items classified as other.

unclassified.label: Deconsolidation, Gain (Loss), Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) from deconsolidation of subsidiary and derecognition of group of assets constituting transfer of business or nonprofit activity, excluding conveyance of oil and gas mineral rights and transfer of good or service in contract with customer.

unclassified.label: Deferred Compensation Liability, Current
unclassified.description: Aggregate carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the liabilities for all deferred compensation arrangements payable within one year (or the operating cycle, if longer). Represents currently earned compensation under compensation arrangements that is not actually paid until a later date.

unclassified.label: Deferred Compensation Liability, Current and Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Aggregate carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the liabilities for all deferred compensation arrangements. Represents currently earned compensation under compensation arrangements that is not actually paid until a later date.

unclassified.label: Deferred Compensation Share-based Arrangements, Liability, Classified, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Aggregate carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the liabilities for stock option plans and other equity-based compensation arrangements payable after one year (or the operating cycle, if longer).

unclassified.label: Deferred Costs, Leasing, Accumulated Amortization
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated amortization of deferred initial direct cost for lease.

unclassified.label: Deferred (Gain) Loss on Discontinuation of Fair Value Hedge
unclassified.description: Amount as of the balance sheet date of the unamortized adjustment to the carrying value of an interest-bearing hedged item made under an effective fair value hedge that is amortized upon discontinuation of the fair value hedge.

unclassified.label: Deferred Gas Cost
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of capitalized gas costs of a regulated entity that are expected to be recoverable through rate adjustments within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Deferred Purchased Power Costs
unclassified.description: Costs of power used for operations in prior periods that were expected to be recovered from customers in future periods.

unclassified.label: Deferred Revenue and Credits, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Total carrying amount of consideration received or receivable as of the balance sheet date representing potential earnings that were not as yet recognized as revenue or other forms of income in conformity with GAAP, and which are expected to be recognized as such after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Deferred Gain on Sale Leaseback Transaction
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from a gain reported for tax purposes on sale and leaseback transactions in accordance with enacted tax laws.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Other Tax Carryforwards
unclassified.description: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible tax carryforwards, classified as other.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Credit Carryforwards, Research
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible research tax credit carryforwards.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals, Impairment Losses
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from estimated impairment losses.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals, Loss Reserves
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from loss reserves other than estimated credit losses.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals, Other
unclassified.description: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from reserves and accruals, classified as other.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals, Reserves
unclassified.description: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from reserves, classified as other.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Unrealized Currency Losses
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from unrealized losses on foreign currency transactions.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Unrealized Losses on Available-for-Sale Securities, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary difference from unrealized loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Expense from Stock Options Exercised
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax expense from write-off of the deferred tax asset related to deductible stock options at exercise.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Deferred Expense, Debt Issuance Costs
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from debt issuance costs.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Deferred Expense, Other Capitalized Costs
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from capitalized costs classified as other.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Parent's Basis in Discontinued Operation
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from the entity's basis in a discontinued operation.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Tax Deferred Income
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from tax deferred revenue or income classified as other.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Undistributed Foreign Earnings
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from undistributed earnings of subsidiary and other recognized entity not within country of domicile. Includes, but is not limited to, other basis differences.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liability Not Recognized, Amount of Unrecognized Deferred Tax Liability, Undistributed Earnings of Foreign Subsidiaries
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability not recognized because of the exceptions to comprehensive recognition of deferred taxes related to undistributed earnings of foreign subsidiaries.

unclassified.label: Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Gain (Loss), after Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for gain (loss) of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Increase (Decrease) for Actual Return (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in plan assets of defined benefit plan from actual return (loss) determined by change in fair value of plan assets adjusted for contributions, benefit payments, and other expenses.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Amounts for Asset (Liability) Recognized in Statement of Financial Position
unclassified.description: Amount of asset (liability), recognized in statement of financial position, for defined benefit pension and other postretirement plans.

unclassified.label: Pension and Other Postretirement Benefit Plans, Amounts that Will be Amortized from Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss) in Next Fiscal Year (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Assumptions Used Calculating Net Periodic Benefit Cost, Discount Rate
unclassified.description: Weighted average rate for present value of future retirement benefits cash flows, used to determine net periodic benefit cost of defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Amortization, Next Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount of cost (credit) included in accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss expected to be recognized in net periodic benefit cost (credit) for fiscal year following most recent annual statement of financial position.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Benefit Payments in Five Fiscal Years Thereafter (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Gross Prescription Drug Subsidy Receipts Received (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Health Care Cost Trend Rate Assumed, Next Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Assumed rate, for next fiscal year, based on annual change in cost of health care cost benefits used to measure expected cost of benefits covered by defined benefit postretirement plan. Factors include, but are not limited to, estimate of health care inflation, change in health care utilization or delivery pattern, technological advances, and change in health status of participant. Excludes factors for change in composition of plan population by age and dependency status.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Pension Plan with Projected Benefit Obligation in Excess of Plan Assets, Plan Assets
unclassified.description: Amount of plan asset for defined benefit pension plan with projected benefit obligation in excess of plan assets.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Pension Plan with Accumulated Benefit Obligation in Excess of Plan Assets, Projected Benefit Obligation
unclassified.description: Amount of projected benefit obligation for defined benefit pension plan with accumulated benefit obligation in excess of plan assets.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, Increase (Decrease) for Plan Amendment
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in benefit obligation of defined benefit plan from change in terms of existing plan or initiation of new plan.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Benefits Paid
unclassified.description: Amount of payment to participant under defined benefit plan which decreases plan assets. For pension plan, payment includes, but is not limited to, pension benefits and death benefits. For other postretirement plan, payment includes, but is not limited to, prescription drug benefits, health care benefits, life insurance benefits, and legal, educational and advisory services.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, (Increase) Decrease for Settlement
unclassified.description: Amount of (increase) decrease to benefit obligation of defined benefit plan from irrevocable action relieving primary responsibility for benefit obligation and eliminating risk for obligation and assets used to effect settlement. Includes, but is not limited to, lump-sum cash payment to participant in exchange for right to receive specified benefits, purchase of nonparticipating annuity contract and change from remeasurement.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Target Allocation Percentage of Assets, Equity Securities (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Target Allocation Percentage of Assets, Other (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Target Allocation Percentage of Assets, Real Estate (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Defined Contribution Plan, Employers Matching Contribution, Annual Vesting Percentage
unclassified.description: Percentage of employer's matching contributions to a defined contribution plan that vests in a given year.

unclassified.label: DerivativeAssetFairValueAfterOffsetAndDeductionSubjectToMasterNettingArrangement
unclassified.description: Fair value, after effect of master netting arrangement and deduction of obligation to return financial collateral not offset and financial instrument subject to master netting arrangement not offset, of financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and contract can be net settled by means outside contract or delivery of asset. Excludes derivative not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

unclassified.label: Derivative Asset, Fair Value, Offset Against Collateral, Net of Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, Policy Election
unclassified.description: Fair value, after effects of master netting arrangements, deduction of assets not subject to a master netting arrangement and elected not to be offset, of financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset, offset against an obligation to return collateral.

unclassified.label: Derivative Asset, Not Offset, Policy Election Deduction
unclassified.description: Fair value of financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and contract can be net settled by means outside contract or delivery of asset, subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement and not elected or qualified to offset, deducted from derivative asset.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Collateral, Right to Reclaim Securities
unclassified.description: Amount of right to receive securities collateral under master netting arrangements that have not been offset against derivative liabilities.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Fair Value, Amount Offset Against Collateral, Net
unclassified.description: The net amount as of the balance sheet date of the fair value of derivative assets and derivative liabilities that in accordance with the entity's accounting policy were offset against collateral under a master netting arrangement.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Fixed Interest Rate
unclassified.description: Fixed interest rate related to the interest rate derivative.

unclassified.label: Derivative Instruments and Hedges, Liabilities, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Fair value of liability arising from contracts that meet the criteria of being accounted for as derivative instruments, financial instrument or contract used to mitigate a specified risk (hedge), energy marketing activities (trading activities), expected to be settled after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer. Examples of energy marketing activities include, but are not limited to, trading of electricity, coal, natural gas and oil using financial instruments, including, but not limited to, forward contracts, options and swaps.

unclassified.label: Derivative Instruments, Loss Reclassified from Accumulated OCI into Income, Effective Portion
unclassified.description: The effective portion of loss reclassified from accumulated other comprehensive income into income on derivative instruments designated and qualifying as hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments, Liability, at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of derivative instrument not designated as hedging instrument and classified as a liability.

unclassified.label: DerivativeLiabilityFairValueAfterOffsetAndDeductionSubjectToMasterNettingArrangement
unclassified.description: Fair value, after effect of master netting arrangement and deduction of obligation to return financial collateral not offset and financial instrument subject to master netting arrangement not offset, of financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and contract can be net settled by means outside contract or delivery of asset. Excludes derivative not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

unclassified.label: Derivative Liability, Fair Value, Offset Against Collateral, Net of Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, Policy Election
unclassified.description: Fair value, after effects of master netting arrangements, deduction of liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement and elected not to be offset, of financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset, offset against the right to receive collateral.

unclassified.label: Derivative Liability, Not Offset, Policy Election Deduction
unclassified.description: Fair value of financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and contract can be net settled by means outside contract or delivery of asset, subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement and not elected or qualified to offset, deducted from derivative liability.

unclassified.label: Dilutive Securities, Effect on Basic Earnings Per Share, Dilutive Convertible Securities
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) to net income used for calculating diluted earnings per share (EPS), resulting from the assumed exercise of dilutive convertible securities excluding adjustments related to ESOP convertible preferred stock, stock options, and restrictive stock units.

unclassified.label: Direct Financing Lease, Deferred Selling Profit
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred selling profit from direct financing lease.

unclassified.label: Direct Financing Lease, Net Investment in Lease
unclassified.description: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of net investment in direct financing lease.

unclassified.label: Discontinued Operation, Tax Effect of Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operation During Phase-out Period
unclassified.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from operations classified as a discontinued operation. Excludes tax expense (benefit) for gain (loss) on disposal and for provision for gain (loss) until disposal.

unclassified.label: Discontinued Operation, Tax Effect of Gain (Loss) from Disposal of Discontinued Operation
unclassified.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) on gain (loss) not previously recognized resulting from the disposal of a discontinued operation.

unclassified.label: Discounted Future Net Cash Flows Relating to Proved Oil and Gas Reserves, 10 Percent Annual Discount for Estimated Timing of Cash Flows (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Discounted Future Net Cash Flows Relating to Proved Oil and Gas Reserves, Future Cash Inflows (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Discounted Future Net Cash Flows Relating to Proved Oil and Gas Reserves, Future Development Costs (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Discounted Future Net Cash Flows Relating to Proved Oil and Gas Reserves, Future Net Cash Flows (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Discounted Future Net Cash Flows Relating to Proved Oil and Gas Reserves, Future Production Costs (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Accounts Payable
unclassified.description: Amount classified as accounts payable attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Accrued Income Tax Payable
unclassified.description: Amount classified as income tax obligations attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Consideration
unclassified.description: Amount of consideration received or receivable for the disposal of assets and liabilities, including discontinued operation.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Goodwill (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Interest Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of interest expense attributable to disposal group, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Other Assets
unclassified.description: Amount classified as other assets attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Property, Plant and Equipment, Current
unclassified.description: Amount classified as property, plant and equipment attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Property, Plant and Equipment, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount classified as property, plant and equipment attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Not Discontinued Operation, Loss (Gain) on Write-down
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, of (gain) loss recognized for the (reversal of write-down) write-down to fair value, less cost to sell, of a disposal group. Excludes discontinued operations.

unclassified.label: Distribution Made to Limited Liability Company (LLC) Member, Cash Distributions Declared
unclassified.description: Amount of equity impact of cash distributions declared to unit-holder of limited liability company (LLC).

unclassified.label: Dividends, Common Stock, Stock
unclassified.description: Amount of paid and unpaid common stock dividends declared with the form of settlement in stock.

unclassified.label: Dividend, Share-based Payment Arrangement
unclassified.description: Amount of paid and unpaid cash, stock, and paid-in-kind dividends declared for award under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Earnings Per Share, Basic, Distributed
unclassified.description: Dividends declared in the period and the contractual amount of dividends (or interest on participating income bonds) that must be paid per security.

unclassified.label: Earnings Per Share, Basic, Undistributed
unclassified.description: The earnings attributable to each security on the basis that all of the earnings for the period had been distributed (to the extent that each security may share in earnings). This is the earnings amount which reflects the participation rights in undistributed earnings of each security.

unclassified.label: Earnings Per Share, Diluted, Distributed
unclassified.description: Dividends declared in the period and the contractual amount of dividends (or interest on participating income bonds) that must be paid per security, taking into account all dilutive potential common shares outstanding during the period.

unclassified.label: Earnings Per Share, Diluted, Undistributed
unclassified.description: The earnings attributable to each security on the basis that all of the earnings for the period had been distributed (to the extent that each security may share in earnings). This is the earnings amount which reflects the participation rights in undistributed earnings of each security, after giving effect to all dilutive potential common shares outstanding during the period.

unclassified.label: EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationCrossBorderOtherPercent
unclassified.description: Percentage of reported income tax expense (benefit) from difference to income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying statutory federal (national) income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation, attributable to cross-border tax law classified as other.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Deduction, Other, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to other deductions.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Impairment Losses, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to impairment loss.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Credit, Foreign, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to foreign tax credit.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, Amount
Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, Percent
Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Cash Contributions to ESOP
unclassified.description: This item represents the amount of cash contributions during the period made by the entity to the Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP).

unclassified.label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Shares in ESOP
unclassified.description: Sum of the allocated, committed-to-be-released and suspense shares of the entity held by the plan.

unclassified.label: Energy Marketing Contract Liabilities, Current
unclassified.description: Current liabilities attributable to energy marketing activities (trading activities). Current energy marketing (trading activities) are when entities engage in both financial and physical trading to increase profits, manage their commodity price risk and enhance system reliability. They may trade electricity, coal, natural gas and oil. These entities typically use a variety of financial instruments, including forward contracts, options and swaps.

unclassified.label: Energy Related Inventory, Gas Stored Underground
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of natural gas stored underground in depleted gas reservoirs, aquifers, or salt caverns to meet seasonal and peak load demands, and also as insurance against unforeseen supply disruptions, and deemed to be a current asset because it is expected to be used within twelve months or in the normal operating cycle.

unclassified.label: Energy Related Inventory, Petroleum
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of petroleum or crude oil.

unclassified.label: Environmental Costs Recognized, Recovery Credited to Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of expense recovery for known and estimated future costs arising from requirement to perform environmental remediation.

unclassified.label: Environmental Exit Costs, Costs Accrued to Date
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the liability for remediation, site restoration, postclosure, monitoring commitments, or other exit costs associated with the sale, disposal or abandonment of a particular property resulting from unanticipated contamination of the assets.

unclassified.label: Equity Method Investment, Summarized Financial Information, Assets (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Equity Method Investment, Summarized Financial Information, Noncontrolling Interest (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Equity Method Investment, Summarized Financial Information, Noncurrent Assets (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Equity Method Investment, Underlying Equity in Net Assets
unclassified.description: This item represents the entity's ownership percentage in the investee multiplied by the investee's total equity.

unclassified.label: EquitySecuritiesFVNINoncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount of investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI), classified as noncurrent.

unclassified.label: Equity Securities, FV-NI, Realized Gain
unclassified.description: Amount of realized gain from sale of investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).

unclassified.label: Excess of Replacement or Current Costs over Stated LIFO Value
unclassified.description: The excess of replacement or current cost over the stated LIFO (last in first out) inventory value when the LIFO inventory method is utilized.

unclassified.label: Expense Related to Distribution or Servicing and Underwriting Fees
unclassified.description: Expense related to distribution, servicing and underwriting fees.

unclassified.label: Extensions, Discoveries, Additions and Improved Recovery, Less Related Costs
Extinguishment of Debt, Gain (Loss), Net of Tax
unclassified.description: The difference between the reacquisition price and the net carrying amount of the extinguished debt recognized currently as a component of income in the period of extinguishment, net of tax.

unclassified.label: Extraordinary Item, Gain (Loss), Net of Tax, Attributable to Parent (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Fair Value Assumptions, Expected Volatility Rate (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Fair Value, Concentration of Risk, Accounts Receivable
unclassified.description: Fair value of account receivable subject to concentration of credit or market risk or both.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Level 1 to level 2 Transfers, Amount (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Fair Value, Liability, Recurring Basis, Still Held, Unrealized Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) recognized in income from liability measured at fair value on recurring basis using unobservable input (level 3) and still held.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Measured on Recurring Basis, Investments (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Asset and Liability, Gain (Loss) Included in Other Comprehensive Income (Loss) (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Asset, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) of financial instrument classified as an asset measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Gain (Loss) Included in Other Comprehensive Income (Loss) (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Liability, Gain (Loss) Included in Other Comprehensive Income (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in other comprehensive income (OCI) from liability measured at fair value on recurring basis using unobservable input (level 3).

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Liability, Purchases
unclassified.description: Amount of purchases of financial instrument classified as a liability measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Liability, Transfers, Net
unclassified.description: Amount of transfers of financial instrument classified as a liability into (out of) level 3 of the fair value hierarchy.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Net Derivative Asset (Liability), Recurring Basis, Still Held, Unrealized Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) recognized in income for derivative asset (liability) after deduction of derivative liability (asset), measured at fair value using unobservable input (level 3) and still held.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Net Derivative Asset (Liability) Measured on Recurring Basis, Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Purchases, Sales, Issues, Settlements
unclassified.description: Amount of purchases, (sales), issuances and (settlements) of financial instrument classified as a derivative asset (liability) after deduction of derivative liability (asset), measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

unclassified.label: Finance Lease, Liability, Payments, Due in Rolling after Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments for finance lease, due after fifth rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

unclassified.label: Finance Lease, Liability, Payments, Due in Rolling Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments for finance lease, due in fifth rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

unclassified.label: Finance Lease, Liability, Payments, Due in Rolling Year Four
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments for finance lease, due in fourth rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

unclassified.label: Finance Lease, Liability, Payments, Due in Rolling Year Three
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments for finance lease, due in third rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

unclassified.label: Finance Lease, Liability, Payments, Due in Rolling Year Two
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments for finance lease, due in second rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

unclassified.label: Financial Instruments, Owned, Corporate Debt, at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of firm holdings in corporate fixed income securities. Includes pledged and unpledged holdings.

unclassified.label: Financial Instruments, Owned, US Government and Agency Obligations, at Fair Value
unclassified.description: The fair value as of the balance sheet date of firm holdings in debt obligations issued by the US government including short-term Treasury bills, medium-term Treasury notes, and long-term Treasury bonds, as well as debt issued by agencies. Includes both pledged (to counterparties as collateral for financing transactions) and unpledged holdings.

unclassified.label: Financial Liabilities Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value of financial obligations, including, but not limited to, debt instruments, derivative liabilities, federal funds purchased and sold under agreements to repurchase, securities loaned or sold under agreements to repurchase, financial instruments sold not yet purchased, guarantees, line of credit, loans and notes payable, servicing liability, and trading liabilities.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableAllowanceForCreditLossExcludingAccruedInterest
unclassified.description: Amount excluding accrued interest, of allowance for credit loss on financing receivable. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss
unclassified.description: Amount of allowance for credit loss on financing receivable. Excludes allowance for financing receivable covered under loss sharing agreement.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Recovery
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in allowance for credit loss on financing receivable from recovery.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Writeoff
unclassified.description: Amount of writeoff of financing receivable, charged against allowance for credit loss.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestAllowanceForCreditLossRecovery
unclassified.description: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of increase in allowance for credit loss on financing receivable from recovery. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestAllowanceForCreditLossWriteoff
unclassified.description: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of decrease in allowance for credit loss on financing receivable from writeoff. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestCreditLossExpenseReversal
unclassified.description: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of credit loss expense (reversal of expense) on financing receivable. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Customer Relationships, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount, before amortization, of finite-lived asset representing customer relationship acquired in business combination, asset acquisition, and from joint venture formation.

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Amortization Expense, Next Rolling Twelve Months
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization expense for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life expected to be recognized in the next rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Amortization Expense, Rolling Year Four
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization expense for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life expected to be recognized in the fourth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Amortization Expense, Rolling Year Three
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization expense for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life expected to be recognized in the third rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Amortization Expense, Rolling Year Two
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization expense for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life expected to be recognized in the second rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Useful Life, Minimum (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Weighted-Average Useful Life (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Foreign Currency Contract, Asset, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of asset contracts related to the exchange of different currencies, including, but not limited to, foreign currency options, forward contracts, and swaps.

unclassified.label: Foreign Currency Contracts, Liability, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of liability contracts related to the exchange of different currencies, including, but not limited to, foreign currency options, forward (delivery or nondelivery) contracts, and swaps entered into.

unclassified.label: Foreign Currency Derivative Assets at Fair Value (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Foreign Currency Exchange Rate, Translation
unclassified.description: Foreign exchange rate used to translate amounts denominated in functional currency to reporting currency.

unclassified.label: Forward Contract Indexed to Issuer's Equity, Indexed Shares
unclassified.description: The number of issuer's shares to which the forward contract is indexed.

unclassified.label: Future Amortization Expense, after Year Five (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Future Minimum Sublease Rentals, Sale Leaseback Transactions, Next Twelve Months
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum sublease rentals for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing to be received by the seller-lessee in the next fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Gain Contingency, Unrecorded Amount
unclassified.description: The amount or range of possible amounts of gain that could be realized upon the resolution of a contingency.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) from Price Risk Management Activity
unclassified.description: Gain (loss) incurred in risk management activities.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Discontinuation of Price Risk Cash Flow Hedge Due to Forecasted Transaction Probable of Not Occurring, Net
unclassified.description: The amount of net gain (loss) reclassified into earnings when price risk cash flow hedge is discontinued because it is probable that the original forecasted transactions will not occur by the end of the original period or an additional two month time period.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Foreign Currency Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in earnings in the period from the increase (decrease) in fair value of foreign currency derivatives not designated as hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Interest Rate Cash Flow Hedge Ineffectiveness
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) of interest rate cash flow hedge excluded from assessment of effectiveness and recognized in earnings.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Interest Rate Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) included in earnings for the period from the increase (decrease) in fair value of interest rate derivatives not designated as hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Price Risk Cash Flow Hedge Ineffectiveness
unclassified.description: The net gain (loss) recognized in earnings during the period due to ineffectiveness in price risk cash flow hedges.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Other Investments
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) included in earnings for investments classified as other.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Sales of Loans, Net
unclassified.description: The net gain (loss) resulting from a sale of loans, including adjustments to record loans classified as held-for-sale at the lower-of-cost-or-market and fair value adjustments to loan held for investment purposes.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Assets for Financial Service Operations
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of assets utilized in financial service operations.

unclassified.label: Gains (Losses) on Sales of Other Real Estate
unclassified.description: The net gain (loss) resulting from sales and other disposals of other real estate owned, increases (decreases) in the valuation allowance for foreclosed real estate, and write-downs of other real estate owned after acquisition or physical possession.

unclassified.label: Gas Gathering, Transportation, Marketing and Processing Revenue (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Goodwill and Intangible Asset Impairment
unclassified.description: Amount of impairment loss for finite- and indefinite-lived intangible assets, goodwill, and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

unclassified.label: Goodwill, Impairment Loss, Net of Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of impairment loss from asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

unclassified.label: GovernmentAssistanceOperatingIncome
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in income from government assistance, classified as operating.

unclassified.label: Guarantees, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of guarantee, including, but not limited to, financial standby letter of credit, fair value guarantee, guarantee of collection of scheduled contractual cash flows from financial assets, and contracts that contingently require the guarantor to make payments or perform services.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Fair Value, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, after Year 5 Through 10
unclassified.description: Fair value of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing in sixth through tenth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Fair Value, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, after Year One Through Five
unclassified.description: Fair value of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing in second through fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Fair Value, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, after Year 10
unclassified.description: Fair value of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing after tenth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Fair Value, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, Year One
unclassified.description: Fair value of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Hosting Arrangement, Service Contract, Implementation Cost, Expense, Amortization
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization expense for capitalized implementation cost from hosting arrangement that is service contract.

unclassified.label: Impairment of Oil and Gas Properties
unclassified.description: Amount of impairment loss for oil and gas properties with proved and unproved reserves in oil- and gas-producing activities.

unclassified.label: Income (Loss) Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, of income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest. Includes, but is not limited to, income (loss) from continuing operations, discontinued operations and equity method investments.

unclassified.label: Income (Loss) from Operations before Extraordinary Items (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Income (Loss) from Operations before Extraordinary Items, Per Basic Share (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Income (Loss) from Operations before Extraordinary Items, Per Diluted Share (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations and Disposal of Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Per Basic and Diluted Share
Income Tax Examination, Estimate of Possible Loss
unclassified.description: Estimated amount of loss resulting from an adverse tax position.

unclassified.label: Income Tax Examination, Penalties Accrued
unclassified.description: The amount of estimated penalties accrued as of the balance sheet date arising from income tax examinations.

unclassified.label: Income Tax Examination, Penalties and Interest Expense
unclassified.description: The sum of the amounts of estimated penalties and interest recognized in the period arising from income tax examinations.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Depletion, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to nondeductible depletion.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Depreciation and Amortization, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to nondeductible depreciation and amortization.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Life Insurance, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to nondeductible life insurance expense.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Contingency, Domestic, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to increase (decrease) in domestic income tax contingency.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Contingency, Foreign, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to increase (decrease) in foreign income tax contingency.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Coal Inventories
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the value of coal held in inventory.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Customer Advances and Deposits
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount of (a) prepayments by customers for goods or services to be provided at a later date, (b) the amount of customer money held in customer accounts, including security deposits, collateral for a current or future transactions, initial payment of the cost of acquisition or for the right to enter into a contract or agreement, or (c) a combination of (a) and (b).

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Charges
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the value of expenditures made during the current reporting period for benefits that will be received over a period of years. Deferred charges differ from prepaid expenses in that they usually extend over a long period of time and may or may not be regularly recurring costs of operation.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Compensation
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the obligation created by employee agreements whereby earned compensation will be paid in the future.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Derivative Assets
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the period in the carrying value of derivative instruments reported as assets that are due to be disposed of within one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer).

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Derivative Liabilities
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the period in the carrying value of derivative instruments reported as liabilities that are due to be disposed of within one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer).

unclassified.label: Changes in Estimated Future Development Costs
Increase (Decrease) in Fair Value of Interest Rate Fair Value Hedging Instruments (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Increase (Decrease) in Fair Value of Derivative Instruments, Not Designated as Hedging Instruments (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Increase (Decrease) in Notes Receivable, Related Parties, Current
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount owed to the reporting entry (during the current year or operating cycle) in the form of loans and obligations (generally evidenced by promissory notes) made to the following types of related parties: a parent company and its subsidiaries; subsidiaries of a common parent; an entity and trust for the benefit of employees, such as pension and profit-sharing trusts that are managed by or under the trusteeship of the entity's management; an entity and its principal owners, management, or member of their immediate families; affiliates; or other parties with the ability to exert significant influence.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Notes Receivables
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period of the amounts due from borrowers for outstanding secured or unsecured loans evidenced by a note.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Property and Other Taxes Payable
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the period in the amount of cash payments due to taxing authorities for non-income-related taxes.

unclassified.label: Insurance Settlements Receivable
unclassified.description: Amount due in settlement of a claim for reimbursement from an insurance company when the Company has suffered a loss covered under an insurance policy.

unclassified.label: Interest and Dividends Payable, Current
unclassified.description: Sum of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date of (a) interest payable on all forms of debt, including trade payables, that has been incurred, and (b) dividends declared but unpaid on equity securities issued by the entity and outstanding (also includes dividends collected on behalf of another owner of securities that are being held by the entity). Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

unclassified.label: Interest Expense, Other Long-term Debt
unclassified.description: Amount of interest expense incurred on long-term debt classified as other, including, but not limited to, interest on long-term notes and amortization of issuance costs.

unclassified.label: Interest Expense, Subordinated Notes and Debentures
unclassified.description: Interest expense incurred during the reporting period on subordinated notes and debentures. Includes amortization of expenses incurred in the issuance of subordinated notes and debentures.

unclassified.label: Interest Rate Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments, Liability at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all derivative liabilities not designated as hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Interest Rate Derivatives, at Fair Value, Net
unclassified.description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of interest rate derivative assets, net of interest rate derivative liabilities, which includes all such derivative instruments in hedging and nonhedging relationships that are recognized on the balance sheet.

unclassified.label: Interest Rate Fair Value Hedge Derivative at Fair Value, Net
unclassified.description: Fair value of all derivatives designated as interest rate fair value hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Interest Rate Fair Value Hedge Liability at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all derivative liabilities designated as interest rate fair value hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Interest Revenue (Expense), Net
unclassified.description: Amount of interest income (expense) classified as operating and nonoperating.
