unclassified.label: Inventory, Finished Goods, Net of Reserves
unclassified.description: Carrying amount, net of valuation reserves and adjustments, as of the balance sheet date of merchandise or goods held by the company that are readily available for sale.

unclassified.label: Investment Company, Committed Capital
unclassified.description: Amount of funds committed to investment company from investors.

unclassified.label: Investment Owned, at Cost
unclassified.description: Cost of the investment.

unclassified.label: Investments in and Advances to Affiliates, Amount of Equity
Jointly Owned Utility Plant, Net Ownership Amount
unclassified.description: The total period end amount of plant in service and construction in progress net of accumulated depreciation for the utility's share of jointly owned electricity generation plant.

unclassified.label: Junior Subordinated Notes
unclassified.description: Including the current and noncurrent portions, carrying value as of the balance sheet date of long-term debt (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer) identified as Junior Subordinated Notes, which have a lower priority than senior instruments.

unclassified.label: Lease Income
unclassified.description: Amount of lease income from operating, direct financing, and sales-type leases. Includes, but is not limited to, variable lease payments, interest income, profit (loss) recognized at commencement, and lease payments paid and payable to lessor.

unclassified.label: Leasehold Improvements, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount before accumulated depreciation of additions or improvements to assets held under a lease arrangement.

unclassified.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, Payments, Due Next Rolling Twelve Months
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments for operating lease, due in next rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

unclassified.label: Leveraged Leases, Income (Loss)
unclassified.description: The total recognized during the period for income on leases meeting the criteria for classification as leveraged leases.

unclassified.label: Limited Liability Company or Limited Partnership, Members or Limited Partners, Ownership Interest
unclassified.description: Percentage investment held by members or limited partners of limited liability company (LLC) or limited partnership (LP).

unclassified.label: Limited Liability Company (LLC) Members' Equity, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
unclassified.description: Amount of ownership interest in a limited liability company (LLC), including portions attributable to both the parent and noncontrolling interests.

unclassified.label: Line of Credit Facility, Fair Value of Amount Outstanding
unclassified.description: Fair value of the amount outstanding under the credit facility.

unclassified.label: Line of Credit Facility, Unused Capacity, Commitment Fee Percentage
unclassified.description: The fee, expressed as a percentage of the line of credit facility, for available but unused credit capacity under the credit facility.

unclassified.label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Allowance
unclassified.description: Amount of allowance to cover probable credit losses on loans and leases. Includes carryover of or adjustments to the allowance for loan losses in connection with business combinations. Excludes allowance for loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements.

unclassified.label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Net Amount
unclassified.description: Amount after allowance and deduction of deferred interest and fees, unamortized costs and premiums and discounts from face amounts, of loans and leases held in portfolio, including but not limited to, commercial and consumer loans. Excludes loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements and loans held for sale.

unclassified.label: Loans Payable, Current
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of portion of long-term loans payable due within one year or the operating cycle if longer.

unclassified.label: Long-term Debt, Maturities, Repayments of Principal in Next Rolling Twelve Months
unclassified.description: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirements, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable prices and dates maturing in the next rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Long-term Debt, Percentage Bearing Fixed Interest, Percentage Rate
unclassified.description: The interest rate applicable to the portion of the carrying amount of long-term borrowings outstanding as of the balance sheet date, including current maturities, which accrues interest at a set, unchanging rate.

unclassified.label: Long-term Pollution Control Bond, Current
unclassified.description: Current portion of a debt security issued by a state, certain agencies or authorities, a local government, or development corporation to finance the construction of air- or water-pollution control facilities or sewage or solid waste disposal facilities pursuant to federal law. The bonds are backed by the credit of the beneficiary of the financing rather than the credit of the issuer.

unclassified.label: Long-term Transition Bond
unclassified.description: Long-Term transition bonds are bonds under the Competition Act in which the proceeds of Transition Bonds are required to be used principally to reduce qualified stranded costs and the related capitalization of the utility. This represents the current and noncurrent portions. The initial maturity is beyond one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Loss Contingency Accrual, Carrying Value, Provision (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Loss Contingency, Claims Dismissed, Number
unclassified.description: Number of claims dismissed.

unclassified.label: Loss Contingency, Damages Paid, Value
unclassified.description: Amount of damages paid to the plaintiff in the legal matter.

unclassified.label: Loss Contingency, Receivable
unclassified.description: Amount of receivable related to a loss contingency accrual. For example, an insurance recovery receivable.

unclassified.label: Loss on Cash Flow Hedge Ineffectiveness
unclassified.description: The loss recognized in earnings during the reporting period representing the amount of the cash flow hedges' ineffectiveness.

unclassified.label: Loss on Contract Termination
unclassified.description: The loss recognized on termination of a contract.

unclassified.label: Marketable Securities, Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of unrealized and realized gain (loss) on investment in marketable security, including other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI).

unclassified.label: Members' Capital
unclassified.description: Amount of member capital in limited liability company (LLC).

unclassified.label: Mine Reclamation and Closing Liability, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount of a reclamation and mine closing liability that is associated with a legal obligation for the closure and reclamation of a mine including the removal of buildings, equipment, machinery and other physical remnants of mining, closure of tailings impoundments, leach pads and other mine features, and contouring, covering and revegetation of waste rock piles and other disturbed areas.

unclassified.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest, Preferred Unit Holders (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Net Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations Available to Common Shareholders, Diluted
unclassified.description: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities, and addition from assumption of issuance of common shares for dilutive potential common shares; of income (loss) from discontinued operations available to common shareholders.

unclassified.label: Net Increase (Decrease) in Sales and Transfer Prices and Production Costs
Net Investment in Lease, Current
unclassified.description: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases, classified as current.

unclassified.label: Net Investment in Lease, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases, classified as noncurrent.

unclassified.label: New Accounting Pronouncement or Change in Accounting Principle, Cumulative Effect of Change on Equity or Net Assets (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Intangible Assets Acquired
unclassified.description: The amount of intangibles that an Entity acquires in a noncash (or part noncash) acquisition. Noncash is defined as information about all investing and financing activities of an enterprise during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

unclassified.label: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Payables Assumed
unclassified.description: The amount of payables that an Entity assumes in acquiring a business or in consideration for an asset received in a noncash (or part noncash) acquisition. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

unclassified.label: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Value of Assets Acquired
unclassified.description: The value of an asset or business acquired in a noncash (or part noncash) acquisition. Noncash is defined as information about all investing and financing activities of an enterprise during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

unclassified.label: Noncontrolling Interest in Net Income (Loss) Other Noncontrolling Interests, Redeemable
unclassified.description: Amount after tax of income (loss) attributable to other redeemable noncontrolling equity holder.

unclassified.label: Noncontrolling Interest in Net Income (Loss) Preferred Unit Holders, Redeemable
unclassified.description: Amount after tax of income (loss) attributable to redeemable noncontrolling preferred unit holders.

unclassified.label: Noninterest Expense Offering Cost
unclassified.description: Amount of expense for cost associated with issuance of security by investment company. Includes, but is not limited to, legal fee pertaining to share offered for sale, registration fee, underwriting, printing prospectus, and initial fee for listing on exchange.

unclassified.label: Nontrade Receivables, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: The noncurrent portion of the receivable other than from customers, that is amounts expected to be collected after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Notes Receivable, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of an agreement for an unconditional promise by the maker to pay the holder a definite sum of money at a future date.

unclassified.label: Notes Reduction
unclassified.description: The value of notes retired (or transferred to another entity) in noncash investing or financing transactions.

unclassified.label: Notional Amount of Fair Value Hedge Instruments (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Notional Amount of Foreign Currency Derivatives (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Notional Amount of Interest Rate Cash Flow Hedge Derivatives (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Notional Amount of Interest Rate Fair Value Hedge Derivatives (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Number of Foreign Currency Derivatives Held
unclassified.description: Number of foreign currency exchange rate derivatives held by the entity at the reporting date.

unclassified.label: Number of Reporting Units
unclassified.description: Number of reporting units tested for impairment of goodwill. A reporting unit is an operating segment or one level below an operating segment.

unclassified.label: Off-Balance Sheet, Credit Loss, Liability
unclassified.description: Amount of expected credit loss for credit exposure on off-balance-sheet commitment, including but not limited to, loan commitment, standby letter of credit, financial guarantee not accounted for as insurance. Excludes off-balance sheet credit exposure accounted for as insurance and instrument accounted for under derivatives and hedging.

unclassified.label: Off-market Lease, Unfavorable
unclassified.description: This element represents a liability associated with the acquisition of an off-market lease when the terms of the lease are unfavorable to the market terms for the lease at the date of acquisition.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments Receivable
unclassified.description: Future minimum rental payments in aggregate as of the balance sheet date under operating leases.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments Receivable, Thereafter
unclassified.description: Future minimum lease payments receivable under operating leases for periods greater than five years following the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Other Accrued Liabilities
unclassified.description: Amount of expenses incurred but not yet paid classified as other.

unclassified.label: Other Commitment, to be Paid, Remainder of Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount of commitment classified as other to be paid in remainder of current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Amortization, Pension and Other Postretirement Benefit Plans, Net Prior Service Cost (Credit) Recognized in Net Periodic Benefit Cost, before Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, Prior Service Cost (Credit), before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, of cost (credit) of benefit change attributable to participants' prior service from plan amendment or plan initiation of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit cost (credit).

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Pension and Other Postretirement Benefit Plans, Net Unamortized Gain (Loss) Arising During Period, before Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivatives Qualifying as Hedges, Net of Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent
unclassified.description: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments, of increase (decrease) in accumulated gain (loss) from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's increase (decrease) in deferred hedging gain (loss), attributable to parent entity.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Adjustment for Settlement or Curtailment Gain (Loss), Tax
unclassified.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) for increase (decrease) to other comprehensive income from settlement and curtailment gain (loss) of defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Adjustment, before Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Reclassification Adjustment Realized upon Sale or Liquidation, before Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Translation Reclassification Adjustment Realized upon Sale or Liquidation, Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Amortization, Pension and Other Postretirement Benefit Plans, Net Prior Service Cost Recognized in Net Periodic Benefit Cost, before Tax (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Gain (Loss), before Adjustment, after Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax and before adjustment, of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) and unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to available-for-sale.

unclassified.label: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Gain (Loss), before Adjustment, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before adjustment, of tax expense (benefit) for unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) and unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to available-for-sale.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivative, Excluded Component, Increase (Decrease), after Adjustments, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after adjustments, of tax expense (benefit) for gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in value of excluded component of derivative designated and qualifying as hedge. Adjustments include, but are not limited to, reclassifications for sale and settlement, and amounts recognized under systematic and rational method.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivatives Qualifying as Hedges, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount before tax, after reclassification adjustments, of increase (decrease) in accumulated gain (loss) from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's increase (decrease) in deferred hedging gain (loss).

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, Realized upon Sale or Liquidation, Net of Tax
unclassified.description: Amount after tax of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income for translation gain (loss) realized upon the sale or liquidation of an investment in a foreign entity and foreign currency hedges that are designated and qualified as hedging instruments for hedges of the foreign currency exposure of a net investment in a foreign operation.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI for Sale of Securities, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount before tax of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income for unrealized gain (loss) realized upon the sale of available-for-sale securities.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment on Derivatives Included in Net Income, before Tax (Deprecated 2013-01-31)

Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification, Pension and Other Postretirement Benefit Plans, Net Transition Asset (Obligation), Recognized in Net Periodic Benefit Cost, Tax (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Minimum Pension Liability Net Adjustment, before Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Other Employee-related Liabilities, Current
unclassified.description: Amount of obligations incurred for employer-related costs classified as other, payable within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Other General and Administrative Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of general and administrative expense classified as other.

unclassified.label: Other Interest and Dividend Income
unclassified.description: Amount, after discount, accretion and premium amortization, of interest income and dividend income classified as other.

unclassified.label: Other Inventories, Spare Parts, Gross
unclassified.description: Gross amount of components of assembled products that can be sold directly or indirectly through sales of assembled products.

unclassified.label: Other Labor-related Expenses
unclassified.description: Amount of labor-related expenses classified as other.

unclassified.label: Other Loans Payable, Current
unclassified.description: Amount of long-term loans classified as other, payable within one year or the operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Other Loans Payable, Long-term, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount of long-term loans classified as other, payable after one year or the operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Other Nonoperating Gains (Losses)
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) related to nonoperating activities, classified as other.

unclassified.label: Other Nonrecurring (Income) Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of other expense (income) that is infrequent in occurrence or unusual in nature.

unclassified.label: Payment for Other Postretirement Benefits
unclassified.description: Amount of cash outflow for other postretirement benefit. Includes, but is not limited to, employer contribution to fund plan asset and payment to retiree. Excludes pension benefit.

unclassified.label: Other Receivables, Gross, Current
unclassified.description: Amount, before allowance, of receivables classified as other, due within one year or the operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Other Significant Noncash Transaction, Value of Consideration Received
unclassified.description: The value of the noncash (or part noncash) consideration received in a transaction. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of a transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

unclassified.label: Other Sundry Liabilities, Current
unclassified.description: Obligations not otherwise itemized or categorized in the footnotes to the financial statements that are due within one year or operating cycle, if longer, from the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Other-than-temporary Impairment Loss, Debt Securities, Available-for-sale
unclassified.description: Amount of other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), recognized in earnings and other comprehensive loss (OCI).

unclassified.label: Other-than-temporary Impairment Loss, Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Recognized in Earnings
unclassified.description: Amount of other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), recognized in earnings.

unclassified.label: Other than Temporary Impairment Losses, Investments, Portion in Other Comprehensive Loss, before Tax, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
unclassified.description: Amount before tax of other than temporary impairment (OTTI) loss on investments in available-for-sale and held-to-maturity debt securities, recognized in other comprehensive loss.

unclassified.label: Participating Securities, Distributed and Undistributed Earnings (Loss), Basic
unclassified.description: Amount of earnings (loss) distributed and earnings (loss) allocated to participating securities for the basic earnings (loss) per share or per unit calculation under the two-class method.

unclassified.label: Partners' Capital Account, Contributions
unclassified.description: Total contributions made by each class of partners (i.e., general, limited and preferred partners).

unclassified.label: Partners' Capital Account, Distributions
unclassified.description: Total distributions to each class of partners (i.e., general, limited and preferred partners).

unclassified.label: Payments for Capital Improvements
unclassified.description: The cash outflow for acquisition of or capital improvements to properties held for investment (operating, managed, leased) or for use.

unclassified.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Loans Receivable
unclassified.description: The net amount paid or received by the reporting entity associated with purchase (sale or collection) of loans receivable arising from the financing of goods and services.

unclassified.label: Payments for Repurchase of Convertible Preferred Stock
unclassified.description: The cash outflow to reacquire preferred stock originally issued and identified as a security that can be exchanged for another type of financial security. This repurchased stock is held in treasury.

unclassified.label: Payments for Underwriting Expense
unclassified.description: Cash paid for expenses incurred during underwriting activities (the process to review insurance applications, evaluate risks, accept or reject applications, and determine the premiums to be charged) for insurance companies.

unclassified.label: Payments to Acquire Buildings
unclassified.description: The cash outflow for acquisition of buildings (properties) whether for investment or use.

unclassified.label: Payments to Acquire Business Three, Net of Cash Acquired
unclassified.description: The cash outflow associated with a third acquisition of a business, net of the cash acquired from the purchase.

unclassified.label: Payments to Acquire Held-to-maturity Securities
unclassified.description: Amount of cash outflow through purchase of long-term held-to-maturity securities.

unclassified.label: Payments to Acquire Oil and Gas Property
unclassified.description: The cash outflow to purchase of mineral interests in oil and gas properties for use in the normal oil and gas operations and not intended for resale.

unclassified.label: Liability, Pension and Other Postretirement and Postemployment Benefits, Current
unclassified.description: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for pension, other postretirement and postemployment benefits, classified as current.

unclassified.label: Liability, Defined Benefit Plan
unclassified.description: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for defined benefit pension and other postretirement plans.

unclassified.label: Pension Expense (Reversal of Expense), Noncash
unclassified.description: Amount of noncash expense (reversal of expense) for pension benefits. Excludes other postretirement benefits.

unclassified.label: Phase-in Plan, Amount of Costs Deferred for Rate-making Purposes
unclassified.description: The total amount of allowable costs capitalized during the period by the entity pertaining to Phase-In plans which were deferred on the expectation of future recovery.

unclassified.label: Pledged Financial Instruments, Not Separately Reported, Securities for Letter of Credit Facilities
Postemployment Benefits Liability, Current
unclassified.description: For a classified balance sheet, the carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the portion of the obligations recognized for the various benefits provided to former or inactive employees, their beneficiaries, and covered dependents after employment but before retirement that is payable within one year of the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: PreferredStockConvertibleConversionRatio
unclassified.description: Number of common shares issuable upon conversion for each share of preferred stock to be converted.

unclassified.label: Preferred Stock Redemption Discount
unclassified.description: The excess of (1) the carrying amount of the preferred stock in the registrant's balance sheet over (2) the fair value of the consideration transferred to the holders of the preferred stock, during the accounting period, which will be added to net earnings to arrive at net earnings available to common shareholders in the calculation of earnings per share.

unclassified.label: Prepaid Expense and Other Assets
unclassified.description: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for costs that provide economic benefits in future periods, and amount of other assets.

unclassified.label: Prepaid Expense and Other Assets, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for costs that provide economic benefits in future periods, and amount of other assets that are expected to be realized or consumed after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Prescription Drug Subsidy Receipt, Year One
unclassified.description: Amount of prescription drug subsidy receipt expected in next fiscal year following current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Prescription Drug Subsidy Receipts, Year One (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Prescription Drug Subsidy Receipts, Year Two (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Price Risk Cash Flow Hedge Unrealized Gain (Loss) to be Reclassified During Next 12 Months
unclassified.description: The estimated net amount of unrealized gains or losses on price risk cash flow hedges as of the balance sheet date expected to be reclassified to earnings within the next twelve months.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Advances for Construction
unclassified.description: Amount of cash inflow from advance for construction, classified as investing activity. Includes, but is not limited to, borrowing from developer, builder, government agency, and municipality.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Hedge, Financing Activities
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from a financial contract that meets the hedge criteria as either cash flow hedge, fair value hedge or hedge of net investment in foreign operations.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Insurance Settlement, Operating Activities
unclassified.description: Amount of cash inflow for proceeds from settlement of insurance claim, classified as operating activities. Excludes insurance settlement classified as investing activities.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Common Limited Partners Units
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from the issuance of common limited partners units during the period.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Mandatory Redeemable Capital Securities
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from issuance of an equity security that embodies an unconditional obligation requiring the issuer to redeem the security by transferring the assets at a specified or determinable date (or dates) that is (or are) initially more than one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer) from the issuance date, or upon an event that is certain to occur beyond one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer) from the issuance date.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Legal Settlements
unclassified.description: Cash received for the settlement of litigation during the current period.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Life Insurance Policy
unclassified.description: Amount of cash inflow for proceeds from settlement of corporate-owned life insurance policy, classified as investing activities. Includes, but is not limited to, bank-owned life insurance policy.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Maturities, Prepayments and Calls of Held-to-maturity Securities
unclassified.description: The cash inflow associated with the maturity, prepayments and calls (requests for early payments) of debt securities designated as held-to-maturity.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Principal Repayments on Loans and Leases Held-for-investment
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from repayments of the balance excluding interest (principal) on loans receivable and leases held for investment purposes.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Debt
unclassified.description: The net cash inflow or outflow in aggregate debt due to repayments and proceeds from additional borrowings.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from (Repurchase of) Redeemable Preferred Stock
unclassified.description: Cash inflows (outflows) from issuing and redeeming redeemable preferred stock; includes convertible and nonconvertible redeemable preferred stock.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale and Collection of Notes Receivable
unclassified.description: The cash inflow associated with the proceeds from sale of notes receivable, as well as principal collections from a borrowing supported by a written promise to pay an obligation (note receivable).

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale and Collection of Receivables
unclassified.description: The cash inflow associated with the proceeds from sale and collection of receivables during the period.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale and Maturity of Debt Securities, Available-for-sale
unclassified.description: Amount of cash inflow from sale, maturity, prepayment and call of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale of Land Held-for-use
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from the sale of land held for use; excludes sales of land held as inventory or investments.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale of Other Assets, Investing Activities
unclassified.description: Amount of cash inflow from the sale of other assets recognized in investing activities.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale of Property Held-for-sale
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from the sale of formerly productive land held for sale, anything permanently fixed to it, including buildings, structures on it, and so forth.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale of Real Estate Held-for-investment
unclassified.description: Cash received from the sale of real estate that is held for investment, that is, it is part of an investing activity during the period.

unclassified.label: Product Warranty Accrual, Current
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable for estimated claims under standard and extended warranty protection rights granted to customers. For classified balance sheets, represents the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

unclassified.label: Property, Plant, and Equipment and Finance Lease Right-of-Use Asset, Accumulated Depreciation and Amortization
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated depreciation and amortization from plant, property, and equipment and right-of-use asset from finance lease.

unclassified.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Disposals
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in property, plant, and equipment from disposition. Includes, but is not limited to, land and land improvement; building; machinery and equipment; furniture and fixture; and work of art, historical treasure, or similar asset classified as collection.

unclassified.label: Property, Plant, and Equipment, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of physical assets used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale. Examples include, but are not limited to, land, buildings, machinery and equipment, office equipment, and furniture and fixtures.

unclassified.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Gross, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in property, plant, and equipment. Includes, but is not limited to, land and land improvement; building; machinery and equipment; furniture and fixture; and work of art, historical treasure, or similar asset classified as collection.

unclassified.label: Property, Plant, and Equipment, Owned, Accumulated Depreciation
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated depreciation from long-lived, depreciable flight asset owned. Excludes right-of-use asset from finance lease for flight asset.

unclassified.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Useful Life, Minimum (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Property Subject to or Available for Operating Lease, Accumulated Depreciation
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated depreciation of lessor's underlying asset for which right to use has been conveyed to lessee under operating lease.

unclassified.label: Provision for Loan and Lease Losses
unclassified.description: Amount of expense related to estimated loss from loan and lease transactions.

unclassified.label: Provision for Loan, Lease, and Other Losses
unclassified.description: Amount of expense related loan transactions, lease transactions, credit loss from transactions other than loan and lease transactions, and other loss based on assessment of uncollectability from the counterparty to reduce the account to their net realizable value.

unclassified.label: Public Utilities, Approved Debt Capital Structure, Percentage
unclassified.description: Percentage of public utility's approved debt to capital, including debt and equity.

unclassified.label: Public Utilities, Approved Rate Increase (Decrease), Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of public utility's approved rate increase (decrease) by regulatory agency.

unclassified.label: Public Utilities, Requested Rate Increase (Decrease), Percentage
unclassified.description: Percentage of public utility's requested rate increase (decrease) with regulatory agency.

unclassified.label: Receivables, Long-term Contracts or Programs
unclassified.description: Amount to be collected within one year of the balance sheet date (or one operating cycle, if longer) from customers in accordance with the contractual provisions of long-term contracts or programs including amounts billed and unbilled as of the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Reclassifications of Temporary to Permanent Equity
unclassified.description: The difference between the carrying amount of a financial instrument subject to a registration payment arrangement recorded as temporary equity prior to adoption of FSP EITF 00-19-2 and the carrying amount reclassified to permanent equity upon the adoption of FSP EITF 00-19-2. Recorded as a cumulative effect adjustment to the beginning balance of retained earnings. Does not apply to registration payment arrangements that are no longer outstanding upon adoption of FSP EITF 00-19-2.

unclassified.label: Recorded Third-Party Environmental Recoveries, Amount
unclassified.description: Recorded amount of the individual components comprising the asset for third-party recoveries related to environmental remediation obligations.

unclassified.label: Recorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, after Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of recorded unconditional purchase obligation maturing after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Recorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Year One
unclassified.description: Amount of recorded unconditional purchase obligation to be paid in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Reorganization Items
unclassified.description: Total amount of reorganization items.

unclassified.label: Repayment of Notes Receivable from Related Parties
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from a loan, supported by a promissory note, granted to related parties where one party can exercise control or significant influence over another party; including affiliates, owners or officers and their immediate families, pension trusts, and so forth.

unclassified.label: Repayments of Pollution Control Bond
unclassified.description: The cash outflow from settlement of a long-term debt security issued by a state, certain agencies or authorities, a local government, or development corporation to finance the construction of air- or water-pollution control facilities or sewage or solid waste disposal facilities pursuant to federal law. The bonds are backed by the credit of the beneficiary of the financing rather than the credit of the issuer.

unclassified.label: Repayments of Senior Debt
unclassified.description: The cash outflow for a long-term debt where the holder has highest claim on the entity's asset in case of bankruptcy or liquidation during the period.

unclassified.label: Reporting Unit, Percentage of Fair Value in Excess of Carrying Amount
unclassified.description: Percentage of fair value of reporting unit in excess of carrying amount.

unclassified.label: Research and Development Arrangement, Contract to Perform for Others, Costs Incurred, Gross
unclassified.description: The amount of costs incurred under a research and development arrangement accounted for as a contract to perform research and development for others.

unclassified.label: Restructuring and Related Cost, Expected Number of Positions Eliminated
unclassified.description: The expected number of positions to be eliminated as a result of restructuring activities.

unclassified.label: Restructuring Reserve, Accrual Adjustment
unclassified.description: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) which increases (decreases) the restructuring reserve from an adjustment to a previously accrued restructuring liability.

unclassified.label: Retained Earnings, Appropriated
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated undistributed earnings (deficit) not available for dividend distribution. Includes, but is not limited to, retained earnings appropriated for specific business purpose.

unclassified.label: Revenue, Remaining Performance Obligation, Percentage
unclassified.description: Percentage of remaining performance obligation to total remaining performance obligation not recognized as revenue.

unclassified.label: Sale of Stock, Consideration Received Per Transaction
unclassified.description: Amount of consideration received by subsidiary or equity investee in exchange for shares of stock issued or sold. Includes amount of cash received, fair value of noncash assets received, and fair value of liabilities assumed by the investor.

unclassified.label: Sale of Stock, Percentage of Ownership after Transaction
unclassified.description: Percentage of subsidiary's or equity investee's stock owned by parent company after stock transaction.

unclassified.label: Sales and Transfers of Oil and Gas Produced, Net of Production Costs
Sales Commissions and Fees
unclassified.description: Primarily represents commissions incurred in the period based upon the sale by commissioned employees or third parties of the entity's goods or services, and fees for sales assistance or product enhancements performed by third parties (such as a distributor or value added reseller).

unclassified.label: Sales Revenue from Energy Commodities and Services (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Sales-type and Direct Financing Leases, Lease Receivable
unclassified.description: Present value of lease payments not yet received by lessor and amount expected to be derived from underlying asset, following end of lease term guaranteed by lessee or other third party unrelated to lessor, from sales-type and direct financing leases.

unclassified.label: Sales-Type and Direct Financing Leases, Lease Receivable, to be Received, Remainder of Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount of undiscounted cash flows to be received by lessor for sales-type and direct financing leases in remainder of current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Sales-type and Direct Financing Leases, Lease Receivable, Undiscounted Excess Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of undiscounted lease receivable in excess of discounted receivable for sales-type and direct financing leases.

unclassified.label: Sales-type Lease, Lease Receivable
unclassified.description: Present value of lease payments not yet received by lessor and amount expected to be derived from underlying asset, following end of lease term guaranteed by lessee or other third party unrelated to lessor, from sales-type lease.

unclassified.label: Sales-type Lease, Selling Profit (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of profit (loss) recognized at commencement from sales-type lease.

unclassified.label: Securities Received as Collateral
unclassified.description: The carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the assets received as collateral against securities loaned to other broker-dealers. Borrowers of securities generally are required to provide collateral to the lenders of securities, commonly cash but sometimes other securities or standby letters of credit, with a value slightly higher than that of the securities borrowed. In instances where the entity is permitted to sell or re-pledge these securities, the entity reports the fair value of the collateral received and the related obligation to return the collateral as a liability.

unclassified.label: Segment Reporting Information, Equity in Net Income of Equity Method Investees of Segment (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Segment Reporting Information, Income (Loss) before Income Taxes (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Senior Notes
unclassified.description: Including the current and noncurrent portions, carrying value as of the balance sheet date of Notes with the highest claim on the assets of the issuer in case of bankruptcy or liquidation (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer). Senior note holders are paid off in full before any payments are made to junior note holders.

unclassified.label: Senior Notes, Current
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the portion of long-term notes having the highest claim on the assets of the issuer in case of bankruptcy or liquidation, due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer. Senior note holders are paid off in full before any payments are made to debt holders having a lesser priority of repayment.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Exercisable, Intrinsic Value (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Expirations in Period, Weighted Average Exercise Price (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Outstanding, Weighted Average Remaining Contractual Term (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Vested and Expected to Vest, Exercisable, Weighted Average Exercise Price
unclassified.description: Weighted-average exercise price, at which grantee can acquire shares reserved for issuance, for fully vested and expected to vest exercisable or convertible options. Includes, but is not limited to, unvested options for which requisite service period has not been rendered but that are expected to vest based on achievement of performance condition, if forfeitures are recognized when they occur.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation, Shares Authorized under Stock Option Plans, Exercise Price Range, Outstanding Options, Weighted Average Exercise Price, Beginning Balance (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Share-based Compensation, Shares Authorized under Stock Option Plans, Exercise Price Range, Outstanding Options, Weighted Average Remaining Contractual Term (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Share-based Payment Arrangement, Expensed and Capitalized, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of cost expensed and capitalized for award under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation, Shares Authorized under Stock Option Plans, Exercise Price Range, Outstanding Options, Weighted Average Remaining Contractual Term (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Financial Instruments Subject to Mandatory Redemption, Settlement Terms, Share Value, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount that would be paid, determined under the conditions specified in the contract, if the holder of the share has the right to redeem the shares.

unclassified.label: Financial Instruments Subject to Mandatory Redemption, Settlement Terms, Share Value, Amount, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: The amount that is required to be paid, determined under the conditions specified in the contract, if as of the reporting date, the holder of the share has exercised the right to or the shares are mandatorily redeemable after one year from the reporting date or operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Sponsor Fees
unclassified.description: Fees paid to advisors who provide certain management support and administrative oversight services including the organization and sale of stock, investment funds, limited partnerships and mutual funds.

unclassified.label: Standard Product Warranty Accrual
unclassified.description: Amount as of the balance sheet date of the aggregate standard product warranty liability. Does not include the balance for the extended product warranty liability.

unclassified.label: Standard Product Warranty Accrual, Decrease for Payments
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in the standard product warranty accrual from payments made in cash or in kind to satisfy claims under the terms of the standard product warranty. Excludes extended product warranties.

unclassified.label: Standard Product Warranty Accrual, Increase (Decrease) for Preexisting Warranties
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in the standard product warranty accrual from changes in estimates attributable to preexisting product warranties. Excludes extended product warranties.

unclassified.label: Standard Product Warranty Accrual, Increase for Warranties Issued
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in the standard product warranty accrual from warranties issued. Excludes extended product warranties.

unclassified.label: Standardized Measure of Discounted Future Net Cash Flows Relating to Proved Oil and Gas Reserves
Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Other
unclassified.description: Number of shares of stock issued attributable to transactions classified as other.

unclassified.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Employee Benefit Plan
unclassified.description: Value of shares issued during the period to an employee benefit plan, such as a defined contribution or defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Development Stage Entities, Stock Issued, Value, Issued for Cash (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
Shares Issued, Value, Share-based Payment Arrangement, before Forfeiture
unclassified.description: Value, before forfeiture, of shares issued under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

unclassified.label: Stock Redeemed or Called During Period, Shares
unclassified.description: Number of stock bought back by the entity at the exercise price or redemption price.

unclassified.label: Stockholders' Equity, Other Shares
unclassified.description: Number of increase (decrease) in shares of stock classified as other.

unclassified.label: Subsidiary or Equity Method Investee, Cumulative Percentage Ownership after All Transactions
unclassified.description: Percentage of subsidiary's or equity method investee's stock owned by parent immediately after all stock transactions.

unclassified.label: Subsidiary or Equity Method Investee, Noncontrolling Interest in Income of Subsidiary
unclassified.description: The dividends from redeemable preferred stock of a subsidiary that are accounted for as a noncontrolling interest in income of a subsidiary in a parent's consolidated financial statements.

unclassified.label: SupplierFinanceProgramObligation
unclassified.description: Amount of obligation for supplier finance program.

unclassified.label: SupplierFinanceProgramObligationDecreaseSettlement
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in obligation for supplier finance program from settlement.

unclassified.label: SupplierFinanceProgramObligationIncrease
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in obligation for supplier finance program.

unclassified.label: Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, Change in Tax Rate, Deferred Tax Liability, Income Tax Benefit
Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, Incomplete Accounting, Change in Tax Rate, Provisional Income Tax Expense (Benefit) (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, Measurement Period Adjustment, Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
Tax Effect of Extraordinary Item, Gain (Loss) (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Taxes Payable
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable for statutory income, sales, use, payroll, excise, real, property and other taxes.

unclassified.label: Temporary Equity, Dividends, Adjustment
unclassified.description: Accretion of temporary equity during the period due to cash, stock, and in-kind dividends. This item is an adjustment to net income necessary to derive net income apportioned to common stockholders and is to be distinguished from Temporary Equity, Accretion of Dividends (Temporary Equity, Accretion of Dividends).

unclassified.label: Time Deposits, at or Above FDIC Insurance Limit
unclassified.description: Amount of time deposit liabilities, including certificates of deposit, in denominations that meet or exceed the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC) insurance limit.

unclassified.label: Trading Securities, Change in Unrealized Holding Gain (Loss)
Gain (Loss) on Derivative Used in Net Investment Hedge, after Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of reclassification from accumulated other comprehensive income (AOCI) of gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in fair value of net investment hedge.

unclassified.label: Travel and Entertainment Expense
unclassified.description: Expenses incurred for travel and entertainment during the period.

unclassified.label: Treasury Stock, Value, Acquired, Par Value Method
unclassified.description: Equity impact of the cost of common and preferred stock that were repurchased during the period. Recorded using the par value method.

unclassified.label: Unamortized Loan Commitment and Origination Fees and Unamortized Discounts or Premiums
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred fees paid by borrowers and unamortized costs incurred to originate loans and leases, unamortized loan commitments and loan syndication fees, and premiums over or discounts from face amounts of loans that are being amortized into income as an adjustment to yield. Excludes amounts for loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements.

unclassified.label: Undistributed Earnings, Basic
unclassified.description: The earnings that is allocated to common stock and participating securities to the extent that each security may share in earnings as if all of the earnings for the period had been distributed.

unclassified.label: Variable Interest Entity, Consolidated, Carrying Amount, Assets and Liabilities, Net (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Variable Interest Entity, Reporting Entity Involvement, Maximum Loss Exposure, Amount
unclassified.description: The reporting entity's maximum amount of exposure to loss as a result of its involvement with the Variable Interest Entity (VIE).

unclassified.label: Variable Interest Entity, Initial Consolidation, Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: The gain (loss) recognized on initial consolidation of a variable interest entity (VIE) when the VIE is not a business (as defined).

unclassified.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares, Common Stock Subject to Repurchase or Cancellation
unclassified.description: Number of shares of common stock subject to repurchase or cancellation determined by relating the portion of time within a reporting period that these shares have been outstanding to the total time in that period. Common stock subject to repurchase are outstanding common shares that are contingently returnable (that is, subject to recall).

unclassified.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Issued, Basic
unclassified.description: This element represents the weighted average total number of shares issued throughout the period including the first (beginning balance outstanding) and last (ending balance outstanding) day of the period before considering any reductions (for instance, shares held in treasury) to arrive at the weighted average number of shares outstanding. Weighted average relates to the portion of time within a reporting period that common shares have been issued and outstanding to the total time in that period. Such concept is used in determining the weighted average number of shares outstanding for purposes of calculating earnings per share (basic).

unclassified.label: Accelerated Share Repurchases, Settlement (Payment) or Receipt
unclassified.description: Amount of cash receipt from (payment to) bank; or stock received from (issuance to) bank in the settlement of the accelerated share repurchase agreement.

unclassified.label: Accounts and Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss
unclassified.description: Amount of allowance for credit loss of accounts and financing receivables. Includes, but is not limited to, notes and loan receivable.

unclassified.label: Accounts and Financing Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of accounts and financing receivable. Includes, but is not limited to, notes and loan receivable.

unclassified.label: Accounts and Financing Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of accounts and financing receivables, classified as current. Includes, but is not limited to, notes and loan receivable.

unclassified.label: Accounts Payable, Interest-bearing, Interest Rate
unclassified.description: Reflects the effective interest rate as of the balance sheet date on interest-bearing trade payables.

unclassified.label: Accounts Receivable, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of amount due from customers or clients for goods or services, including trade receivables, that have been delivered or sold in the normal course of business, and amounts due from others, including related parties.

unclassified.label: Accounts Receivable, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration from customer for product sold and service rendered in normal course of business, classified as noncurrent.

unclassified.label: Accrual for Environmental Loss Contingencies, Charges to Expense for New Losses
unclassified.description: Amount of expense for newly incurred environmental loss contingencies. Includes, but is not limited to, remediation expense and interest accretion.

unclassified.label: Accrual for Environmental Loss Contingencies, Component Amount
unclassified.description: Recorded amount of the accrual for a material component of an environmental loss contingency.

unclassified.label: Accrual for Environmental Loss Contingencies, Foreign Currency Translation Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of foreign currency translation gain (loss) which decreases (increases) the accrual for environmental loss contingencies.

unclassified.label: Accrual for Environmental Loss Contingencies, Increase (Decrease) for Currency Translation (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Accrual for Environmental Loss Contingencies, Net (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Accrual for Environmental Loss Contingencies, Payments (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Accrual for Environmental Loss Contingencies, Payments
unclassified.description: Amount of cash outflow to settle environmental loss contingencies.

unclassified.label: Accrual for Environmental Loss Contingencies, Provision for New Losses (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Accrual for Environmental Loss Contingency, Undiscounted, to be Paid, Year Five
unclassified.description: Undiscounted amount of accrual for environmental loss contingency to be paid in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Accrual for Environmental Loss Contingency, Undiscounted, to be Paid, Year Four
unclassified.description: Undiscounted amount of accrual for environmental loss contingency to be paid in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Accrual for Environmental Loss Contingency, Undiscounted, to be Paid, Year Two
unclassified.description: Undiscounted amount of accrual for environmental loss contingency to be paid in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Accrual for Environmental Loss Contingency, Undiscounted, to be Paid, Year Three
unclassified.description: Undiscounted amount of accrual for environmental loss contingency to be paid in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Accrued Capping, Closure, Post-closure and Environmental Costs, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: The estimated amount of costs required as of the balance sheet date to comply with regulatory requirements pertaining to the retirement of a waste management facility, which will be paid after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Accrued Income Taxes, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the unpaid sum of the known and estimated amounts payable to satisfy all domestic and foreign income tax obligations due beyond one year or the operating cycle, whichever is longer. Alternate captions include income taxes payable, noncurrent.

unclassified.label: Accrued Investment Income Receivable
unclassified.description: Interest, dividends, rents, ancillary and other revenues earned but not yet received by the entity on its investments.

unclassified.label: Accrued Liabilities for Commissions, Expense and Taxes
unclassified.description: The carrying amount for commissions, taxes and other expenses that were incurred but unpaid as of the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Accrued Payroll Taxes, Current
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable for statutory payroll taxes incurred through that date and withheld from employees pertaining to services received from them, including entity's matching share of the employees FICA taxes and contributions to the state and federal unemployment insurance programs. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

unclassified.label: Accrued Payroll Taxes
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable for statutory payroll taxes incurred through that date and withheld from employees pertaining to services received from them, including entity's matching share of the employees FICA taxes and contributions to the state and federal unemployment insurance programs.

unclassified.label: Accrued Royalties, Current
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable for royalties. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

unclassified.label: Accrued Vacation, Current
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable for unused vacation time owed to employees based on the entity's vacation benefit given to its employees. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

unclassified.label: Accumulated Amortization, Debt Issuance Costs, Current
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated amortization of debt issuance costs classified as current.

unclassified.label: Accumulated Amortization, Debt Issuance Costs, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated amortization of debt issuance costs classified as noncurrent.

unclassified.label: Accumulated Amortization of Other Deferred Costs
unclassified.description: Accumulated amortization of other deferred costs capitalized at the end of the reporting period. Does not include deferred finance costs, deferred acquisition costs of insurance companies, or deferred leasing costs for real estate operations.

unclassified.label: AOCI Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount before tax of increase (decrease) in accumulated equity from transactions and other events and circumstances from non-owner sources, including portion attributable to noncontrolling interest. Excludes net income (loss), and accumulated changes in equity from transactions resulting from investments by owners (distributions to owners).

unclassified.label: Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Financial Liability, Fair Value Option, after Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of accumulated gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in instrument-specific credit risk of financial liability measured under fair value option.

unclassified.label: Acquired Finite-lived Intangible Assets, Weighted-Average Period before Renewal or Extension (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Adjustments, Noncash Items, to Reconcile Net Income (Loss) to Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activities
unclassified.description: Amount of expense (income) and loss (gain) in reconciling net income to reflect cash provided by (used in) operating activity when indirect cash flow method is applied.

unclassified.label: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Dividends in Excess of Retained Earnings
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in additional paid in capital (APIC) resulting from dividends legally declared (or paid) in excess of retained earnings balance.

unclassified.label: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Income Tax Deficiency from Share-based Compensation
Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Fair Value
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) to additional paid in capital (APIC) resulting from changes in fair value of common and preferred stock issued to employee benefit trust but unearned.

unclassified.label: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Reallocation of Noncontrolling Interest (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
APIC, Share-based Payment Arrangement, ESPP, Increase for Cost Recognition
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in additional paid-in capital (APIC) for recognition of cost for employee stock purchase program (ESPP) award under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: APIC, Share-based Payment Arrangement, Recognition and Exercise
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) to additional paid-in capital (APIC) for recognition and exercise of award under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Stock Split
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in additional paid in capital (APIC) resulting from a stock split in which per-share par value or stated value is not changed proportionately.

unclassified.label: Advances from Federal Home Loan Banks
unclassified.description: Amount of borrowings as of the balance sheet date from the Federal Home Loan Bank, which are primarily used to cover shortages in the required reserve balance and liquidity shortages.

unclassified.label: Advances Received on Government Contracts, Not Netted Against Accounts Receivable
unclassified.description: Advances received on government contracts that are not offset against receivables because they cannot be definitely regarded as payments on account for contract work in progress.

unclassified.label: Affordable Housing Program Assessments
unclassified.description: Amount of expense for Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) obligation for Affordable Housing Program (AHP) assessment required by Federal Home Loan Bank Act of 1932.

unclassified.label: Affordable Housing Tax Credits and Other Tax Benefits, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount, before amortization expense, of income tax credit and other tax benefit generated by investment under tax credit program elected to be accounted for using proportional amortization method. Includes, but is not limited to, investment under tax credit program not meeting condition for accounting under proportional amortization method.

unclassified.label: Allowance for Doubtful Accounts Receivable, Charge-offs (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Allowance for Loan and Lease Losses, Provision for Loss, Net (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
unclassified.description: Amount of allowance for credit loss on financing receivable, classified as current.

unclassified.label: Amortization Method Qualified Affordable Housing Project Investments, Amortization
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization expense for investment that generates income tax credit and other income tax benefit under tax credit program accounted for using proportional amortization method.

unclassified.label: Amortization of Advance Royalty
unclassified.description: The expense charged against earnings for the periodic recognition of the advance royalties. These royalties are paid in one accounting period, but are deducted from earnings over time through amortization. For example, royalties that are required to be paid in advance of production from a mineral, oil, or gas property and amortized over the period of right to produce these items.

unclassified.label: Amortization of Deferred Loan Origination Fees, Net
unclassified.description: The net increase(decrease) in interest income during the period representing the allocation of deferred loan origination fees less deferred loan origination costs using the effective interest method over the term of the debt arrangement to which they pertain taking into account the effect of prepayments.

unclassified.label: Amortization of Deferred Property Taxes
unclassified.description: The amount of amortization charged against earnings during the period for deferred property taxes.

unclassified.label: Amortization of Leased Asset
unclassified.description: The expense charged against earnings for the periodic recognition of capitalized leases. This element may apply to energy companies that lease mineral producing properties and to other enterprises that capitalize property, plant, or equipment obtained through capital leases.

unclassified.label: Amortization of Rate Deferral
unclassified.description: The periodic expense to reduce the value of the rate deferral asset that is created when utilities under bill customers during periods of rate increases by deferring rate increases. These customers eventually pay higher rates to repay the utility for the rate deferral.

unclassified.label: Amount of Impairment to Carrying Amount of Regulatory Assets
unclassified.description: Discloses the amount of any reduction to the carrying amounts of regulated assets that result from impairment (for example, rate actions of a regulator).

unclassified.label: AOCI before Tax, Attributable to Parent
unclassified.description: Amount before tax of increase (decrease) in accumulated equity from transactions and other events and circumstances from non-owner sources, attributable to parent. Excludes net income (loss), and accumulated changes in equity from transactions resulting from investments by owners (distributions to owners).

unclassified.label: AOCI, Derivative Qualifying as Hedge, Excluded Component, after Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of accumulated gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in value of excluded component of derivative hedge.

unclassified.label: AssetAcquisitionConsiderationTransferred
unclassified.description: Amount of consideration transferred in asset acquisition. Includes, but is not limited to, cash, liability incurred by acquirer, and equity interest issued by acquirer.

unclassified.label: AssetAcquisitionContingentConsiderationLiability
unclassified.description: Amount of liability recognized from contingent consideration in asset acquisition.

unclassified.label: Asset Retirement Obligation, Foreign Currency Translation (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Assets Disposed of by Method Other than Sale, in Period of Disposition, Gain (Loss) on Disposition
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) from disposal other than by sale of long-lived asset. Includes, but is not limited to, exchange or distribution to owner in spinoff.

unclassified.label: Assets Held-for-sale, Not Part of Disposal Group, Current, Other
unclassified.description: Amount of other assets held-for-sale that are not part of a disposal group, expected to be sold within a year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Assets Held-for-sale, Property, Plant and Equipment (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Assets Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Interest Rate
unclassified.description: Interest rate on the amount to be repaid to the counterparty to the repurchase agreement when the carrying amount (or market value, if higher than the carrying amount) of securities or other assets sold under the repurchase agreement exceeds 10 percent of total assets.

unclassified.label: Assets Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Repurchase Liability
unclassified.description: Amount, including accrued interest, to be repaid to counterparty to repurchase agreement when carrying amount or market value if higher, of security or other asset sold under repurchase agreement exceeds 10 percent of total assets.

unclassified.label: Auction Market Preferred Securities, Shares, Redeemed
unclassified.description: These are the number of AMPS shares redeemed during the period.

unclassified.label: Auction Market Preferred Securities, Stock Series, Per-Share Redemption Amount
unclassified.description: The per-share amount at which preferred stock may be called or is subject to redemption through sinking-fund operations or otherwise.

unclassified.label: Auction Market Preferred Securities, Stock Series, Value (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Auction Market Preferred Securities, Stock Series, Variable Interest Rate Earned
unclassified.description: The interest (or dividend) rates earned on action market preferred securities (on an annual basis or APY) for the period reported.

unclassified.label: Available-for-sale Equity Securities, Accumulated Gross Unrealized Gain, before Tax
Available-for-sale Equity Securities, Accumulated Gross Unrealized Loss, before Tax
Available-for-sale Equity Securities, Gross Unrealized Gain
Available-for-sale Securities, Accumulated Gross Unrealized Gain (Loss), before Tax
Available-for-sale Securities, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, 12 Months or Longer, Accumulated Loss
Available-for-sale Securities, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, Less than 12 Months, Accumulated Loss
Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, Amortized Cost
unclassified.description: Amortized cost of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Maturity, without Single Maturity Date, Amortized Cost
unclassified.description: Amortized cost of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), without single maturity date and not allocated over maturity grouping.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Maturity, without Single Maturity Date, Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), without single maturity date and not allocated over maturity grouping.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Current
unclassified.description: Amount of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), classified as current.

unclassified.label: Available-for-sale, Securities in Unrealized Loss Positions, Qualitative Disclosure, Number of Positions (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Available-for-sale, Securities in Unrealized Loss Positions, Qualitative Disclosure, Number of Positions, Less than One Year
Available-for-sale Securities, Income Tax Expense on Change in Unrealized Holding Gain (Loss) (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Available-for-sale Securities, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, 12 Months or Longer, Aggregate Losses (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Available-for-sale Securities, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, Aggregate Losses (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Available-for-sale Securities, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, Less than 12 Months, Aggregate Losses (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Available-for-sale, Securities in Unrealized Loss Positions, Qualitative Disclosure, Number of Positions
Available-for-sale, Securities in Unrealized Loss Positions, Qualitative Disclosure, Number of Positions, Greater than or Equal to One Year
Bankruptcy Claims, Amount of Claims Filed
unclassified.description: Amount of bankruptcy claim filed with bankruptcy court.

unclassified.label: Bankruptcy Claims, Amount Paid to Settle Claims
unclassified.description: Amount paid to settle bankruptcy claim.

unclassified.label: Below Market Lease, Accumulated Amortization
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated amortization of leases acquired as part of a real property acquisition at below market lease rate with a finite life.

unclassified.label: Below Market Lease, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount before amortization of leases acquired as part of a real property acquisition at below market lease rate with a finite life.

unclassified.label: Borrowings under Guaranteed Investment Agreements
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the sum of the obligations to contract holders to provide to them an agreed upon rate of return pursuant to the terms of the underlying contract.
