These contracts represent lending by the contract holders to the entity in return for a guaranteed (primarily fixed) interest rate until maturity, unless called earlier if the contracts provide that option to the contract holders (usually institutions). There is little or no insurance risk for the entity.

unclassified.label: Buildings and Improvements, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount before accumulated depreciation of building structures held for productive use including addition, improvement, or renovation to the structure, including, but not limited to, interior masonry, interior flooring, electrical, and plumbing.

unclassified.label: Business Acquisition, Cost of Acquired Entity, Liabilities Incurred (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Acquisition, Equity Interest Issued or Issuable, Value Assigned
unclassified.description: Value of equity interests (such as common shares, preferred shares, or partnership interest) issued or issuable to acquire the entity.

unclassified.label: Business Acquisition, Equity Interest Issued or Issuable, Number of Shares
unclassified.description: Number of shares of equity interest issued or issuable by acquirer as part of consideration transferred in business combination.

unclassified.label: Business Acquisition, Preexisting Relationship, Gain (Loss) Recognized (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Business Acquisition, Pro Forma Net Income (Loss) (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Deferred Taxes Asset (Liability), Net, Noncurrent (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Noncontrolling Interest (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Noncurrent Liabilities (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Combination, Acquired Receivables, Estimated Uncollectible
unclassified.description: Amount of estimated contractual cash flow not expected to be collected for receivable purchased without credit deterioration, acquired in business combination. Excludes purchased financial asset with credit deterioration.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Consideration Transferred, Including Equity Interest in Acquiree Held Prior to Combination
unclassified.description: Fair value at acquisition date of asset transferred, liability incurred, equity interest issued or issuable by acquirer, and equity interest in acquiree held by acquirer immediately before acquisition date in business combination achieved in stages. Includes, but is not limited to, instrument or interest issued or issuable by acquirer.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Consideration Transferred, Liabilities Incurred
unclassified.description: Amount of liabilities incurred by the acquirer as part of consideration transferred in a business combination.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration, Asset
unclassified.description: Amount of asset recognized arising from contingent consideration in a business combination.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Provisional Information, Initial Accounting Incomplete, Adjustment, Equity Interests
unclassified.description: This element represents the amount of any measurement period adjustment (as defined) realized during the reporting period to equity interests acquired in connection with a business combination for which the initial accounting was incomplete.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Provisional Information, Initial Accounting Incomplete, Adjustment, Intangibles
unclassified.description: This element represents the amount of any measurement period adjustment (as defined) realized during the reporting period to intangibles acquired in connection with a business combination for which the initial accounting was incomplete.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Provisional Information, Initial Accounting Incomplete, Adjustment, Inventory
unclassified.description: This element represents the amount of any measurement period adjustment (as defined) realized during the reporting period to inventory acquired in connection with a business combination for which the initial accounting was incomplete.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Current Assets, Other
unclassified.description: Amount of asset acquired in business combination and recognized at acquisition date, classified as other and current.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Current Liabilities, Long-term Debt
unclassified.description: Amount of long-term debt assumed in business combination and recognized at acquisition date, classified as current.

unclassified.label: Business Combination Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Deferred Tax Assets
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax asset acquired in business combination and recognized at acquisition date.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Financial Liabilities
unclassified.description: Amount of financial liability assumed in business combination and recognized at acquisition date.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Inventory
unclassified.description: Amount of inventory acquired in business combination and recognized at acquisition date, classified as current.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Noncurrent Liabilities
unclassified.description: Amount of liability assumed in business combination and recognized at acquisition date, classified as noncurrent.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Separately Recognized Transactions, Expenses and Losses Recognized
unclassified.description: The expenses and losses recorded for each transaction with the acquiree that was recognized separately from the acquisition of assets and assumptions of liabilities in the business combination.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Separately Recognized Transactions, Revenues and Gains Recognized
unclassified.description: The revenues and gains recognized recorded for each transaction with the acquiree that is recognized separately from the acquisition of assets and assumptions of liabilities in the business combination.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Step Acquisition, Equity Interest in Acquiree, Percentage
unclassified.description: Percentage of equity in the acquiree held by the acquirer immediately before the acquisition date in a business combination.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Step Acquisition, Equity Interest in Acquiree, Remeasurement Gain
unclassified.description: Amount of gain from remeasurement of acquisition-date fair value of equity interest in acquiree held by acquirer immediately before acquisition date in business combination achieved in stages.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Step Acquisition, Equity Interest in Acquiree, Remeasurement Gain (Loss), Net
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) from remeasurement of acquisition-date fair value of equity interest in acquiree held by acquirer immediately before acquisition date in business combination achieved in stages.

unclassified.label: Business Exit Costs
unclassified.description: Amount of expenses associated with exit or disposal activities pursuant to an authorized plan. Includes, but is not limited to, one-time termination benefits, termination of an operating lease or other contract, consolidating or closing facilities, and relocating employees, and termination benefits associated with an ongoing benefit arrangement. Excludes expenses associated with special or contractual termination benefits, a discontinued operation or an asset retirement obligation.

unclassified.label: Capital Expenditure, Discontinued Operations
unclassified.description: Amount of capital expenditure attributable to discontinued operations.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Contingent Rental Payments Due
unclassified.description: Amount due based upon the occurrence of an event specified in the contractual terms.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments Due in Two and Three Years
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for capital leases due in the second and third fiscal years following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Net Minimum Payments (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Net Minimum Payments
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for capital leases net of executory costs, which include amounts paid by the lessee to the lessor for insurance, maintenance and taxes.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments Receivable
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum lease payments to be received by the lessor for capital leases.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Receivable Thereafter
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum lease payments to be received by the lessor for capital leases after the fifth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Lessee Balance Sheet, Assets by Major Class, Other Property, Plant, and Equipment, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount before depreciation of leased long-lived, physical assets used to produce goods and services and not intended for resale meeting the criteria for capitalization, classified as other.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Net Investment in Direct Financing Leases, Executory Costs
unclassified.description: Estimated remaining costs to be incurred to service the direct financing lease, such as taxes, maintenance and insurance and the profit thereon, that are included in the minimum lease payments.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Net Investment in Direct Financing Leases, Minimum Payments to be Received
unclassified.description: Amount of remaining payments as of the balance sheet date that lessees are obligated to make or can be required to make under direct financing leases, including any guarantee of residual value and executory costs. The amount also includes any guaranteed rental payments by an unrelated third-party provided that are financially capable of making such payments.

unclassified.label: Capitalized Computer Software, Additions
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed. Excludes capitalized cost for internal-use software.

unclassified.label: Capitalized Contract Cost, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount, before accumulated amortization and accumulated impairment loss, of asset recognized from cost incurred to obtain or fulfill contract with customer.

unclassified.label: Capitalized Contract Cost, Net
unclassified.description: Amount, after accumulated amortization and accumulated impairment loss, of asset recognized from cost incurred to obtain or fulfill contract with customer.

unclassified.label: Capitalized Costs, Accumulated Depreciation, Depletion, Amortization and Valuation Allowance Relating to Oil and Gas Producing Activities
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated depreciation, depletion, amortization, and valuation allowance for capitalized cost in oil- and gas-producing activities.

unclassified.label: Capitalized Costs of Unproved Properties Excluded from Amortization, Period Cost
unclassified.description: Amount of capitalized acquisition, exploration, and development costs and capitalized interest incurred during period and excluded from amortization for oil- and gas-producing activities accounted for under full cost method.

unclassified.label: Capitalized Costs, Oil and Gas Producing Activities, Net
unclassified.description: Amount, after accumulated depreciation, depletion, amortization, and valuation allowance, of capitalized cost in oil- and gas-producing activities.

unclassified.label: Capitalized Costs, Proved Properties
unclassified.description: Amount, before accumulated depreciation, depletion, amortization, and valuation allowance, of capitalized cost for proved property in oil- and gas-producing activities.

unclassified.label: Capitalized Costs, Unproved Properties
unclassified.description: Amount, before accumulated depreciation, depletion, amortization, and valuation allowance, of capitalized cost for unproved property in oil- and gas-producing activities.

unclassified.label: Cash Acquired in Excess of Payments to Acquire Business
unclassified.description: The cash inflow associated with the acquisition of a business when the cash held by the acquired business exceeds the cash payments to acquire the business.

unclassified.label: Cash, Cash Equivalents, and Federal Funds Sold
unclassified.description: The sum of cash and cash equivalents plus Federal Funds Sold. Cash and cash equivalents consist of short term, highly liquid investments that are readily convertible to known amounts of cash and are so near their maturity that they present negligible risk of changes in value due to changes in interest rates -- usually with an original maturity less than 90 days.

unclassified.label: Cash Divested from Deconsolidation
unclassified.description: Reduction in cash due to no longer including the former subsidiary's cash in the consolidated entity's cash.

unclassified.label: Cash Flow Hedge Gain (Loss) Reclassified to Other Income, Net (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Cash Flow Hedge Gain (Loss) Reclassified to Revenue, Net (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Cash Flow Hedge Gain Reclassified to Earnings (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Cash Flow Hedge Gain Reclassified to Other Income (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Cash Flow Hedges Derivative Instruments at Fair Value, Net
unclassified.description: Net fair value of all derivative instruments designated as cash flow hedging instruments, which is ordinarily reflected within other comprehensive income.

unclassified.label: Cash Flows Between Transferor and Transferee, Proceeds from Collections Reinvested in Revolving Period Transfers
unclassified.description: Cash Flows between a transferor and a transferee attributable to collections reinvested in revolving period transfers related to either a securitization, asset-backed financing arrangement, or similar transfer in which the transferor has continuing involvement with the transferred financial assets underlying the transaction (including, but not limited to, servicing, recourse, and restrictions on transferor's interests in the transferred financial assets).

unclassified.label: Cash Flows Between Transferor and Transferee, Proceeds from New Transfers
unclassified.description: Cash Flows between a transferor and a transferee attributable to newly transferred assets related to either a securitization, asset-backed financing arrangement, or similar transfer in which the transferor has continuing involvement with the transferred financial assets underlying the transaction (including, but not limited to, servicing, recourse, and restrictions on transferor's interests in the transferred financial assets).

unclassified.label: Cash Flows Between Transferor and Transferee, Beneficial Interest
unclassified.description: Cash flows between transferee and transferor in payment of the transferor's beneficial interest related to a securitization, asset-backed financing arrangement, or similar transfer in which the transferor has continuing involvement with the transferred financial assets underlying the transaction.

unclassified.label: Cash Surrender Value, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of the amount that could be realized under a life insurance contract or contracts owned by the entity, commonly known as corporate-owned life insurance (COLI) or bank-owned life insurance (BOLI).

unclassified.label: Cash, Uninsured Amount
unclassified.description: The amount of cash as of the balance sheet date that is not insured by the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation.

unclassified.label: Certificates of Deposit, at Carrying Value
unclassified.description: A savings certificate entitling the Entity (that is, bearer) to receive interest at an established maturity date, based upon a fixed interest rate. A certificate of deposit may be issued in any denomination. Certificates of deposit are generally issued by commercial banks and, therefore, insured by the FDIC (up to the prescribed limit). Certificates of deposit generally restrict holders from withdrawing funds on demand without the incurrence of penalties. Generally, only certificates of deposit with original maturities of three months or less qualify as cash equivalents. Original maturity means original maturity to the entity holding the investment. As a related example, both a three-month US Treasury bill and a three-year Treasury note purchased three months from maturity qualify as cash equivalents. However, a Treasury note purchased three-years ago does not become a cash equivalent when its remaining maturity is three months.

unclassified.label: Change in Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Fair Value Hedging Instruments (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Change in Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Fair Value Hedging Instruments
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) from the increase (decrease) in fair value of derivative and nonderivative instruments designated as fair value hedging instruments recognized in the income statement.

unclassified.label: Change in Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Foreign Currency Fair Value Hedging Instruments (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Change in Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Hedged Item in Fair Value Hedge (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Class of Warrant or Right, Exercise Price of Warrants or Rights (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Coal Industry Retiree Health Benefit Act of 1992, Estimated Amount of Obligation
unclassified.description: Amount of obligation for medical and death benefits to be provided under Coal Industry Retiree Health Benefit Act of 1992.

unclassified.label: Commitments, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of arrangements with third parties, including, but not limited to, operating lease arrangement and arrangement in which the entity has agreed to expend funds to procure goods or services, or has agreed to commit resources to supply goods or services.

unclassified.label: Common Stock, Discount on Shares
unclassified.description: Discount on common shares, or any unamortized balance thereof, shown separately as a deduction from the applicable account(s) as circumstances require.

unclassified.label: Common Stock Held by Subsidiary
unclassified.description: Value of entity shares held by subsidiary, which are purchased for the purpose of granting the shares to senior employees as part of an employee stock option plan approved by the Entity's Board of Directors. Presented as a reduction of shareholders' equity at their cost to the subsidiary.

unclassified.label: Common Stock Held in Trust
unclassified.description: Value of common stock held in trust.

unclassified.label: Common Stock, Including Additional Paid in Capital, Net of Discount (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Common Stock, Other Value, Outstanding
unclassified.description: Value of share of other common stock instruments held by shareholder. Includes, but is not limited to, exchangeable share.

unclassified.label: Common Stock, Value, Subscriptions
unclassified.description: Monetary value of common stock allocated to investors to buy shares of a new issue of common stock before they are offered to the public. When stock is sold on a subscription basis, the issuer does not initially receive the total proceeds. In general, the issuer does not issue the shares to the investor until it receives the entire proceeds.

unclassified.label: Consolidation, Less than Wholly Owned Subsidiary, Parent Ownership Interest, Change Due to Net Income Attributable to Parent and Effects of Changes, Net
unclassified.description: This element represents the total net income attributable to the parent for the period and the effect of net changes during the period impacting the parent's ownership interest in a subsidiary as it relates to the total (consolidated) equity attributable to the parent. The changes to the parent's ownership interest in a subsidiary represented by this element did not result in a deconsolidation of the subsidiary from the consolidated financial statements.

unclassified.label: Consolidation, Less than Wholly Owned Subsidiary, Parent Ownership Interest, Changes, Issuance of Equity by Subsidiary to Noncontrolling Interests
unclassified.description: Represents a sale (new stock issuance) by a subsidiary to noncontrolling interests (third parties, parties directly or indirectly unrelated to parent) during the period. The capital transaction by subsidiary does not result in a loss of control by the parent, but does effect a change in total (consolidated) equity attributable to the parent.

unclassified.label: Consolidation, Less than Wholly Owned Subsidiary, Parent Ownership Interest, Changes, Net
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the period impacting the parent's ownership interest in a subsidiary as it relates to the total (consolidated) equity attributable to the parent. The changes to the parent's ownership interest in a subsidiary represented by this element did not arise in a deconsolidation of the subsidiary from the consolidated financial statements.

unclassified.label: Consolidation, Less than Wholly Owned Subsidiary, Parent Ownership Interest, Changes, Sale of Interest by Parent
unclassified.description: Represents a sale by the parent of a portion of its equity interest in a subsidiary during the period, thereby effecting a change in total (consolidated) equity attributable to the parent. The sale of the equity interest represented by this element does not result in a loss of control by the parent.

unclassified.label: Construction Payable
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable for the acquisition of merchandise, materials, supplies and services pertaining to construction projects such as a housing development or factory expansion not classified as trade payables.

unclassified.label: Contract Receivable, Due after Next Rolling Twelve Months (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Contract Receivable, Due after One Year, Highest Interest Rate (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Contract Receivable Retainage
unclassified.description: Amount billed to customers under long-term contracts or programs that have been withheld because of retainage provisions in a contract.

unclassified.label: Contract Receivable Retainage, after Next Twelve Months
unclassified.description: Amount billed to customers under long-term contracts or programs that have been withheld because of retainage provisions in a contract to be collected after the next fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Contract with Customer, Asset, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
unclassified.description: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for expected credit loss on right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time.

unclassified.label: Contract with Customer, Asset, Cumulative Catch-up Adjustment to Revenue, Change in Estimate of Transaction Price
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in revenue recognized for cumulative catch-up adjustment from change in estimate of transaction price which increases (decreases) right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time. Includes, but is not limited to, change in assessment of whether estimate of variable consideration is constrained.

unclassified.label: Contract with Customer, Asset, Cumulative Catch-up Adjustment to Revenue, Change in Measure of Progress
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in revenue recognized for cumulative catch-up adjustment from change in measure of progress which increases (decreases) right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time.

unclassified.label: Contract with Customer, Asset, Increase (Decrease) for Contract Acquired in Business Combination
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time, from business combination.

unclassified.label: Contract with Customer, Liability, Cumulative Catch-up Adjustment to Revenue, Modification of Contract
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in revenue recognized for cumulative catch-up adjustment from contract modification which (increases) decreases obligation to transfer good or service to customer for which consideration from customer has been received or is due.

unclassified.label: Contract with Customer, Liability, Increase (Decrease) for Contract Acquired in Business Combination
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in obligation to transfer good or service to customer for which consideration from customer has been received or is due, from business combination.

unclassified.label: Contract with Customer, Performance Obligation Satisfied in Previous Period
unclassified.description: Amount of revenue recognized from performance obligation satisfied or partially satisfied in previous reporting periods. Includes, but is not limited to, change in transaction price.

unclassified.label: Contract with Customer, Refund Liability, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount of liability for consideration received or receivable from customer which is not included in transaction price, when consideration is expected to be refunded to customer, classified as noncurrent.

unclassified.label: Conversion of Stock, Shares Issued
unclassified.description: The number of new shares issued in the conversion of stock in a noncash (or part noncash) transaction. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

unclassified.label: Convertible Notes Payable
unclassified.description: Including the current and noncurrent portions, carrying value as of the balance sheet date of a written promise to pay a note, initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer, which can be exchanged for a specified amount of one or more securities (typically common stock), at the option of the issuer or the holder.

unclassified.label: Convertible Preferred Dividends, Net of Tax
unclassified.description: The after-tax amount of any dividends on convertible preferred stock.

unclassified.label: Convertible Subordinated Debt
unclassified.description: Including the current and noncurrent portions, the carrying value of convertible subordinated debt, as of the balance sheet date, initially scheduled to be repaid after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle if longer. This form of debt can be exchanged for a specified amount of another security, typically the entity's common stock, at the option of the issuer or the holder, and places a lender in a lien position behind debt having a higher priority of repayment in liquidation of the entity's assets.

unclassified.label: Convertible Subordinated Debt, Current
unclassified.description: The portion of the carrying value of convertible subordinated debt as of the balance sheet date that is scheduled to be repaid within one year or in the normal operating cycle if longer. This form of debt can be exchanged for a specified amount of another security, typically the entity's common stock, at the option of the issuer or the holder, and places a lender in a lien position behind debt having a higher priority of repayment upon liquidation of the entity's assets.

unclassified.label: Cost, Direct Labor
unclassified.description: Cost of labor directly related to good produced and service rendered. Includes, but is not limited to, payroll cost and equity-based compensation.

unclassified.label: Cost of Coal Products and Services (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Cost of Goods and Services, Energy Commodities and Services (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Cost, Amortization
unclassified.description: Amount of expense for allocation of cost of intangible asset over its useful life directly used in production of good and rendering of service.

unclassified.label: Cost, Depreciation
unclassified.description: Amount of expense for allocation of cost of tangible asset over its useful life directly used in production of good and rendering of service.

unclassified.label: Cost of Goods Sold, Excluding Depreciation, Depletion, and Amortization (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Cost of Purchased Water
unclassified.description: Cost of water purchased, may include any water related assessment. If water is bought on a unit volume basis, would also be considered as commodity costs.

unclassified.label: Cost-method Investments, Other than Temporary Impairment
Costs Incurred, Development Costs
unclassified.description: Amount of development cost incurred in oil- and gas-producing activities. Includes capitalized cost and cost charged to expense.

unclassified.label: Costs Incurred, Oil and Gas Property Acquisition, Exploration, and Development Activities
unclassified.description: Amount of property acquisition, exploration, and development costs incurred in oil- and gas-producing activities. Includes capitalized cost and cost charged to expense.

unclassified.label: Credit Derivative, Maximum Exposure, Undiscounted
unclassified.description: Maximum potential amount of future undiscounted payments that could be required under the credit derivative, before reduction for potential recoveries under recourse or collateralization provisions.

unclassified.label: Energy Related Inventory, Crude Oil and Natural Gas Liquids
unclassified.description: The aggregate carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of unrefined petroleum and the liquid hydrocarbon components recovered from natural gas.

unclassified.label: Cumulative Effect on Retained Earnings, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Cumulative Translation Adjustment, Net of Tax, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) in cumulative translation adjustment before transfers included in determining net income.

unclassified.label: Current Federal, State and Local, Tax Expense (Benefit)
unclassified.description: Amount of current federal, state, and local tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations. Includes, but is not limited to, current national, regional, territorial, and provincial tax expense (benefit) for non-US (United States of America) jurisdiction.

unclassified.label: Customer Advances or Deposits, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Aggregate noncurrent portion of prepayments received from customers for goods or services to be provided in the future, as well as the current portion of money or property received from customers that is to be returned upon satisfactory contract completion or as partial prepayment for goods or services to be provided in the future.

unclassified.label: Customer Refund Liability, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Noncurrent regulatory liabilities generally represent obligations to make refunds to customers for various reasons including overpayment.

unclassified.label: Customer Refundable Fees, Refund Payments
unclassified.description: Amount of cash outflow to customers for refund payments.

unclassified.label: Debt and Equity Securities, Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of unrealized and realized gain (loss) on investment in debt and equity securities.

unclassified.label: Debt and Equity Securities, Realized Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of realized gain (loss) on investment in debt and equity securities.

unclassified.label: Debt Default, Short-term Debt, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of outstanding short-term debt or borrowing associated with any securities or credit agreement for which there has been a default in principal, interest, sinking fund, or redemption provisions, or any breach of covenant that existed at the end of the period and subsequently has not been cured.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Convertible, Effective Interest Rate (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Debt Instrument, Convertible, If-converted Value in Excess of Principal
unclassified.description: The amount by which the convertible debt's if-converted value exceeds its principle amount at the balance sheet date, regardless of whether the instrument is currently convertible. This element applies to public companies only.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Convertible, Number of Equity Instruments
unclassified.description: The number of equity instruments that the holder of the debt instrument would receive if the debt was converted to equity.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Convertible, Threshold Percentage of Stock Price Trigger
unclassified.description: Minimum percentage of common stock price to conversion price of convertible debt instruments to determine eligibility of conversion.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Decrease, Forgiveness
unclassified.description: Decrease for amounts of indebtedness forgiven by the holder of the debt instrument.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Increase (Decrease), Net
unclassified.description: Net increase or decrease in the carrying amount of the debt instrument for the period.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Interest Rate, Effective Percentage Rate Range, Maximum (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Debt Instrument, Interest Rate, Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Incremental percentage increase (decrease) in the stated rate on a debt instrument.

unclassified.label: DebtInstrumentIssuedPrincipal
unclassified.description: Amount of principal of debt issued.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Periodic Payment
unclassified.description: Amount of the required periodic payments including both interest and principal payments.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Redemption Price, Percentage
unclassified.description: Percentage price of original principal amount of debt at which debt can be redeemed by the issuer.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Redemption Price, Percentage of Principal Amount Redeemed
unclassified.description: Percentage of principal amount of debt redeemed.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Sinking Fund Payment
unclassified.description: Amount paid into a fund, which is used to retire the debt instrument.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Unamortized Discount, Current
unclassified.description: Amount of debt discount to be amortized within one year or within the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Unamortized Discount, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount of debt discount to be amortized after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Unamortized Premium, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount of debt premium to be amortized after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Unused Borrowing Capacity, Fee
unclassified.description: Amount of commitment fees for the unused borrowing capacity under the long-term financing arrangement that is available to the entity.

unclassified.label: Debt Issuance Costs, Line of Credit Arrangements, Net
unclassified.description: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of debt issuance costs related to line of credit arrangements. Includes, but is not limited to, legal, accounting, underwriting, printing, and registration costs.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Accrued Interest, after Allowance for Credit Loss
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of accrued interest on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Allowance for Credit Loss, Not Previously Recorded
unclassified.description: Amount of expense for credit loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), for which no credit loss was previously recorded.

unclassified.label: DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAmortizedCostAfterAllowanceForCreditLoss
unclassified.description: Amortized cost, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

unclassified.label: DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAmortizedCostAllowanceForCreditLossExcludingAccruedInterest
unclassified.description: Amount excluding accrued interest, of allowance for credit loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, 12 Months or Longer, Number of Positions
unclassified.description: Number of investments in debt securities measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), in continuous unrealized loss position for 12 months or longer, without an allowance for credit loss. Includes beneficial interest in securitized financial asset.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, Less than 12 Months, Number of Positions
unclassified.description: Number of investments in debt securities measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), in continuous unrealized loss position for less than 12 months, without an allowance for credit loss. Includes beneficial interest in securitized financial asset.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Realized Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of realized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Unrealized Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

unclassified.label: DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityAmortizedCostAfterAllowanceForCreditLoss
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

unclassified.label: DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityAmortizedCostExcludingAccruedInterestAfterAllowanceForCreditLossMaturityAllocatedAndSingleMaturityDateAfterYear10
unclassified.description: Amount excluding accrued interest, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing after tenth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityAmortizedCostExcludingAccruedInterestAfterAllowanceForCreditLossMaturityAllocatedAndSingleMaturityDateAfterYear5Through10
unclassified.description: Amount excluding accrued interest, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing in sixth through tenth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityAmortizedCostExcludingAccruedInterestAfterAllowanceForCreditLossMaturityAllocatedAndSingleMaturityDateAfterYearOneThroughFive
unclassified.description: Amount excluding accrued interest, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing in second through fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityAmortizedCostExcludingAccruedInterestAfterAllowanceForCreditLossMaturityAllocatedAndSingleMaturityDateYearOne
unclassified.description: Amount excluding accrued interest, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityExcludingAccruedInterestAfterAllowanceForCreditLoss
unclassified.description: Amount excluding accrued interest, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Purchase
unclassified.description: Amount of increase from purchase of debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Realized Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of realized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) and investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

unclassified.label: Debtor-in-Possession Financing, Letters of Credit Outstanding
unclassified.description: Amount of letters of credit outstanding under debtor-in-possession financing arrangement.

unclassified.label: Debtor Reorganization Items, Debtor-in-Possession Facility Financing Costs
unclassified.description: Amount of reorganization items related to debtor-in-possession facility financing costs.

unclassified.label: Debtor Reorganization Items, Gain (Loss) on Settlement of Other Claims, Net
unclassified.description: Amount of net gain (loss) on settlement of other claims for entities in bankruptcy, reported as a reorganization item.

unclassified.label: Debtor Reorganization Items, Legal and Advisory Professional Fees
unclassified.description: Amount of reorganization items related to legal and advisory professional fees related to entities in bankruptcy.

unclassified.label: Debtor Reorganization Items, Revaluation of Assets and Liabilities
unclassified.description: Amount recognized from the revaluation of assets and liabilities.

unclassified.label: Debtor Reorganization Items, Write-off of Debt Issuance Costs and Debt Discounts
unclassified.description: Amount of write-off of debt issuance costs and debt discounts related to prepetition debt obligations.

unclassified.label: Deconsolidation, Revaluation of Retained Investment, Gain (Loss), Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) from remeasurement to fair value of retained investment in former subsidiary and group of assets constituting business or nonprofit activity deconsolidated and derecognized, excluding conveyance of oil and gas mineral rights and transfer of product or service in contract with customer.

unclassified.label: Decrease Due to Sales of Minerals in Place
Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Contributions by Employer
unclassified.description: Amount of contributions made by employer into fund established for purposes of making future disbursement to individual in accordance with deferred compensation arrangement.

unclassified.label: Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Employer Contribution (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Deferred Compensation Cash-based Arrangements, Liability, Classified, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Aggregate carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the liabilities for deferred compensation arrangements payable after one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer). Represents currently earned compensation under cash arrangements (such as a profit-sharing plan, rabbi trust, and employee contract--excluding equity-based arrangements) that is not actually paid until a later date.

unclassified.label: Deferred Costs, Leasing, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount, before accumulated amortization, of deferred initial direct cost for lease.

unclassified.label: Deferred Costs, Leasing, Net
unclassified.description: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of deferred initial direct cost for lease.

unclassified.label: Deferred Gain on Sale of Property
unclassified.description: Amount of gain on the sale of property that does not qualify for gain recognition as of the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Deferred Income, Current
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred income excluding obligation to transfer product and service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable, classified as current.

unclassified.label: Deferred Rent Credit, Current
unclassified.description: Amount of excess of rental payment required by lease over rental income recognized, classified as current.

unclassified.label: Deferred Rent Credit, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount of excess of rental payment required by lease over rental income recognized, classified as noncurrent.

unclassified.label: Deferred Revenue, Additions
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred revenue recognized for transactions arising during the current reporting period. Deferred revenue is a liability as of the balance sheet date related to a revenue producing activity for which revenue has not yet been recognized. Generally, an Entity records deferred revenue when it receives consideration from a customer before achieving certain criteria that must be met for revenue to be recognized in conformity with GAAP.

unclassified.label: Deferred Revenue and Credits
unclassified.description: Total carrying amount of consideration received or receivable as of the balance sheet date representing potential earnings that were not as yet recognized as revenue or other forms of income in conformity with GAAP.

unclassified.label: Deferred Revenue and Credits, Current
unclassified.description: Total carrying amount of consideration received or receivable as of the balance sheet date on potential earnings that were not recognized as revenue or other forms of income in conformity with GAAP, and which are expected to be recognized as such within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Deferred Lease Income, before Accumulated Amortization
unclassified.description: Amount, before accumulated amortization, of deferred lease income. Includes, but is not limited to, amount paid in advance by lessee.

unclassified.label: Deferred Storm and Property Reserve Deficiency, Current
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of capitalized storm costs of a regulated entity that are expected to be recoverable through rate adjustments within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Deferred Storm and Property Reserve Deficiency, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of capitalized storm costs of a regulated entity that are expected to be recoverable through rate adjustments after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Inventory
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from inventory.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Other Loss Carryforwards
unclassified.description: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible loss carryforwards, classified as other.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense
unclassified.description: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowances, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible differences from reserves and accruals, compensation and benefit costs, and other provisions, reserves, and allowances.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Compensation and Benefits, Compensated Absences
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from compensated absences (includes, but not limited to, sick and personal days).

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from reserves and accruals.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals, Provision for Loan Losses
unclassified.description: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary difference from allowance for credit loss on financing receivable.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals, Restructuring Charges
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from restructuring reserve.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals, Unearned Premiums Reserve
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from the unearned premiums reserve.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Unrealized Losses on Trading Securities
unclassified.description: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary difference from unrealized loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Deferred Expense, Capitalized Interest
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from capitalized interest.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Deferred Expense, Capitalized Research and Development Costs
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from research and development costs.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Deferred Expense, Capitalized Software
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from capitalized software.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Financing Arrangements
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from financing arrangements.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Unrealized Currency Transaction Gains
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from unrealized gains on foreign currency transactions.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Accumulated Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, of accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss for defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit cost (credit).

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), after Tax (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Gain (Loss), before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, of accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for gain (loss) of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit.

unclassified.label: Accumulated Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, Prior Service Cost (Credit), after Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss for cost (credit) of benefit change attributable to participants' prior service from plan amendment or plan initiation of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit cost (credit).

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Accumulated Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Prior Service Cost (Credit), before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, of accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss for cost (credit) of benefit change attributable to participants' prior service from plan amendment or plan initiation of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit cost (credit).

unclassified.label: Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Transition Asset (Obligation), after Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for transition asset (obligation) of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Amortization of Net Prior Service Cost (Credit) (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Future Amortization of Transition Obligation (Asset) (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, Prior Service Cost (Credit), after Reclassification Adjustment, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, after reclassification adjustment, of (increase) decrease in accumulated other comprehensive income from prior service cost (credit) of defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation
unclassified.description: Amount of actuarial present value of benefits attributed to service rendered by employee for defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, Payment for Settlement
unclassified.description: Amount of payment, which decreases benefit obligation of defined benefit plan, for irrevocable action relieving primary responsibility for benefit obligation and eliminating risk for obligation and assets used to effect settlement. Transaction constituting settlement includes, but is not limited to, making lump-sum cash payment to participant in exchange for their rights to receive specified benefits and purchasing nonparticipating annuity contract. Excludes decreases to benefit obligation for remeasurement due to settlement.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Effect of Plan Amendment on Accumulated Benefit Obligation (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Effect of Plan Amendment on Net Periodic Benefit Cost (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Effect of Settlements and Curtailments on Accumulated Benefit Obligation (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Amortization of Gain (Loss), Next Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount included in accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for gain (loss) of defined benefit plan expected to be recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit for fiscal year following most recent annual statement of financial position.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Amortization of Prior Service Cost (Credit), Next Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount included in accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss for prior service cost (credit) expected to be recognized in net periodic benefit cost (credit) for fiscal year following most recent annual statement of financial position.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Benefit Payment, Remainder of Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount of benefit for defined benefit plan expected to be paid in remainder of current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Employer Contributions, Current Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount of contributions received and expected to be received by defined benefit plan from employer in current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in plan assets of defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Future Amortization of Gain (Loss) (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Future Amortization of Prior Service Cost (Credit) (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Pension Plan with Projected Benefit Obligation in Excess of Plan Assets, Accumulated Benefit Obligation
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated benefit obligation for defined benefit pension plan with projected benefit obligation in excess of plan assets.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Pension Plan with Projected Benefit Obligation in Excess of Plan Assets, Projected Benefit Obligation
unclassified.description: Amount of projected benefit obligation for defined benefit pension plan with projected benefit obligation in excess of plan assets.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Net Periodic Benefit Cost (Credit), Gain (Loss) Due to Settlement and Curtailment
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit from settlement and curtailment.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, Special and Contractual Termination Benefits
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in benefit obligation for benefits provided to employees payable from defined benefit plan or payable upon retirement.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Target Allocation Percentage of Assets, Debt Securities (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Target Allocation Percentage of Assets, Equity Securities, Range Maximum (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Target Allocation Percentage of Assets, Equity Securities, Range Minimum (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets Level 3 Reconciliation, Increase (Decrease) for Assets Transferred into (out of) Level 3
unclassified.description: Amount, measured using unobservable inputs, of increase (decrease) in plan assets of defined benefit plan, for assets transferred into (out of) Level 3 of fair value hierarchy. Includes, but is not limited to, transfer due to change in observability of significant inputs.

unclassified.label: Delinquent Amount at End of Period on Loans Managed and Securitized or Asset-backed Financing Arrangement
unclassified.description: This is the principal amount of loans (across all types of loans) that are overdue in payment by a set number of days.

unclassified.label: Demand Deposit Accounts
unclassified.description: The amount of money in accounts that may bear interest and that the depositor is entitled to withdraw at any time without prior notice.

unclassified.label: Deposit Liability, Current
unclassified.description: The current portion, due within one year or one operating cycle, if longer, of deposits held other than customer deposits.

unclassified.label: Deposits, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of deposit liabilities held by the entity, including, but not limited to, foreign and domestic, interest and noninterest bearing, demand deposits, saving deposits, negotiable orders of withdrawal (NOW) and time deposits.

unclassified.label: Deposits, Wholesale
unclassified.description: The aggregate amount of all wholesale deposit accounts including certificates of deposits.

unclassified.label: Depreciation and Amortization, Discontinued Operations
unclassified.description: Amount of deprecation and amortization expense attributable to property, plant and equipment and intangible assets of discontinued operations.

unclassified.label: Depreciation Expense on Reclassified Assets
unclassified.description: Amount of depreciation expense for long-lived asset reclassified from held-for-sale to held-and-used due to decision not to sell.

unclassified.label: Derivative Asset, Fair Value of Collateral
unclassified.description: Fair value of securities received as collateral against derivative assets.

unclassified.label: Derivative Asset, Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement Deduction
unclassified.description: Fair value of financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset, not subject to a master netting arrangement, deducted from derivative assets.

unclassified.label: Derivative Asset, Notional Amount
unclassified.description: Nominal or face amount used to calculate payments on the derivative asset.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Average Fixed Interest Rate
unclassified.description: Average fixed interest rate related to the group of interest rate derivatives.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Basis Spread on Variable Rate
unclassified.description: The percentage points added to the reference rate to compute the variable rate on the interest rate derivative.

unclassified.label: Derivative Credit Risk Valuation Adjustment, Derivative Assets
unclassified.description: Amount of credit risk valuation adjustment to derivative assets to properly reflect the credit quality of the counterparties.

unclassified.label: Derivative Credit Risk Valuation Adjustment, Derivative Liabilities
unclassified.description: Amount of credit risk valuation adjustment to derivative liabilities to properly reflect the credit quality of the entity.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Fair Value, Gross Amount Not Offset Against Collateral, Net (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Derivative, Gain on Derivative
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in the fair value of derivatives recognized in the income statement.

unclassified.label: Derivative Instruments, Gain (Loss) Reclassification from Accumulated OCI to Income, Estimated Net Amount to be Transferred
unclassified.description: The estimated value of gains (losses), net anticipated to be transferred in the future from accumulated other comprehensive income into earnings.

unclassified.label: Derivative Instruments, Gain Reclassified from Accumulated OCI into Income, Effective Portion
unclassified.description: The effective portion of gain reclassified from accumulated other comprehensive income into income on derivative instruments designated and qualifying as hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Derivative Instruments, Gain Recognized in Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Effective Portion (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Derivative Instruments, Loss Recognized in Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Effective Portion (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments, Gain
unclassified.description: Amount of realized and unrealized gain of derivative instruments not designated or qualifying as hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments, Loss
unclassified.description: Amount of realized and unrealized loss of derivative instruments not designated or qualifying as hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Derivative Liability, Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement Deduction
unclassified.description: Fair value of financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset, not subject to a master netting arrangement, deducted from derivative liabilities.

unclassified.label: Derivative Liability, Notional Amount
unclassified.description: Nominal or face amount used to calculate payments on the derivative liability.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Loss on Derivative
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in the fair value of derivatives recognized in the income statement.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Nonmonetary Notional Amount
unclassified.description: Nominal number of units used to calculate payment on derivative.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Nonmonetary Notional Amount, Volume
unclassified.description: Nominal volume used to calculate payments on a derivative instrument.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Variable Interest Rate
unclassified.description: Variable interest rate in effect as of the balance sheet date related to the interest rate derivative.

unclassified.label: Development Costs, Period Cost
unclassified.description: Amount of capitalized development cost incurred during period and excluded from amortization for oil- and gas-producing activities accounted for under full cost method. Excludes acquisition and exploration costs and capitalized interest.

unclassified.label: Direct Financing Lease, Interest Income
unclassified.description: Amount of interest income from net investment in direct financing lease.

unclassified.label: Direct Financing Lease, Lease Income
unclassified.description: Amount of lease income from variable lease payments, interest income on direct financing lease and after offset of loss recognized at commencement.

unclassified.label: Direct Financing Lease, Unguaranteed Residual Asset
unclassified.description: Present value expected to be derived from underlying asset, following end of lease term, not guaranteed by lessee or other third party unrelated to lessor.

unclassified.label: Direct Operating Costs
unclassified.description: The aggregate direct operating costs incurred during the reporting period.

unclassified.label: Discontinued Operation, Amount of Other Income (Loss) from Disposition of Discontinued Operations, before Income Tax (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
Discontinued Operation, Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operation During Phase-out Period, before Income Tax
unclassified.description: Amount before tax of income (loss) from operations classified as a discontinued operation. Excludes gain (loss) on disposal and provision for gain (loss) until its disposal.

unclassified.label: Discontinued Operation, Provision for Loss (Gain) on Disposal, before Income Tax
unclassified.description: Amount before tax of (gain) loss recognized for the (reversal of write-down) write-down to fair value, less cost to sell, of a discontinued operation.

unclassified.label: Discontinued Operation, Provision for Loss (Gain) on Disposal, Net of Tax
unclassified.description: Amount after tax of (gain) loss recognized for the (reversal of write-down) write-down to fair value, less cost to sell, of a discontinued operation.

unclassified.label: Discontinued Operation, Tax Effect of Adjustment to Prior Period Gain (Loss) on Disposal
unclassified.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) for an increase (decrease) to a gain (loss) previously reported in discontinued operations in a prior period.

unclassified.label: Discontinued Operation, Tax (Expense) Benefit from Provision for (Gain) Loss on Disposal
unclassified.description: Amount of tax (expense) benefit on (gain) loss recognized for the (reversal of write-down) write-down to fair value, less cost to sell, of a discontinued operation.

unclassified.label: Discounted Future Net Cash Flows Relating to Proved Oil and Gas Reserves, Future Development Costs (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Discounted Future Net Cash Flows Relating to Proved Oil and Gas Reserves, Future Income Tax Expense (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Discounted Future Net Cash Flows Relating to Proved Oil and Gas Reserves, Future Income Tax Expense (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Discounted Future Net Cash Flows Relating to Proved Oil and Gas Reserves, Future Production Costs (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Discounted Future Net Cash Flows Relating to Proved Oil and Gas Reserves, Standardized Measure (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities
unclassified.description: Amount classified as accounts payable and accrued liabilities attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities, Current
unclassified.description: Amount classified as accounts payable and accrued liabilities attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Accrued Income Tax Payable, Current
unclassified.description: Amount classified as income tax obligations attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Accrued Liabilities
unclassified.description: Amount classified as accrued liabilities attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Accrued Liabilities, Current
unclassified.description: Amount classified as accrued liabilities attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Capital Leased Assets
unclassified.description: Amount classified as capital leased assets attributable to disposal group.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Cash
unclassified.description: Amount of currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits, held by a disposal group.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Costs of Goods Sold
unclassified.description: Amount of costs of goods sold attributable to disposal group, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Deferred Tax Assets
unclassified.description: Amount classified as deferred tax assets attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Deferred Tax Assets, Noncurrent
Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Deferred Tax Liabilities, Noncurrent
Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Foreign Currency Translation Gains (Losses)
unclassified.description: Amount of foreign currency translation gain (loss) in the disposal group, including discontinued operation, recognized in the statement of income as a result of the sale or complete or substantially complete liquidation of an investment in a foreign entity.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Goodwill, Current
unclassified.description: Amount classified as goodwill attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Goodwill, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount classified as goodwill attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Intangible Assets
unclassified.description: Amount classified as intangible assets, excluding goodwill, attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Intangible Assets, Net (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Inventory
unclassified.description: Amount classified as inventory attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Inventory, Current
unclassified.description: Amount classified as inventory attributable to disposal group, expected to be disposed of within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Other Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of other expense attributable to disposal group, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Pension Plan Benefit Obligation
unclassified.description: Amount classified as defined benefit plan benefit obligations attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Pension Plan Benefit Obligation, Current
unclassified.description: Amount classified as defined benefit plan benefit obligations attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Pension Plan Benefit Obligation, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount classified as defined benefit plan benefit obligations attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of beyond one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Postretirement Plan Benefit Obligation
unclassified.description: Amount classified as defined benefit non-pension postretirement plan obligations attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

unclassified.label: Distributed Earnings
unclassified.description: The total amount of dividends declared in the period for each class of stock and the contractual amount of dividends (or interest on participating income bonds) that must be paid for the period (for example, unpaid cumulative dividends). Dividends declared in the current period do not include dividends declared in respect of prior-period unpaid cumulative dividends. Preferred dividends that are cumulative only if earned are deducted only to the extent that they are earned.

unclassified.label: Distribution Made to Limited Liability Company (LLC) Member, Distributions Paid, Per Unit
unclassified.description: Per unit of ownership amount of cash distributions paid to unit-holder of a limited liability company (LLC).

unclassified.label: Distribution Made to Limited Partner, Cash Distributions Paid
unclassified.description: Amount of cash distribution paid to unit-holder of limited partnership (LP).

unclassified.label: Distribution Made to Limited Partner, Distributions Declared, Per Unit
unclassified.description: Per unit of ownership amount of cash distributions declared to unit-holder of a limited partnership (LP).

unclassified.label: Distribution Made to Limited Partner, Distributions Paid, Per Unit
unclassified.description: Per unit of ownership amount of cash distributions paid to unit-holder of a limited partnership (LP).

unclassified.label: Distribution Made to Limited Partner, Unit Distribution, Dilution Per Unit
unclassified.description: Per unit of ownership amount of dilution resulting from the issuance of additional unit for payment of unit distribution to unit-holder of a limited partnership (LP).

unclassified.label: Distribution Made to Member or Limited Partner, Cash Distributions Paid (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
DividendAndInterestReceivable
unclassified.description: Amount of dividend and interest receivable from investment.

unclassified.label: Dividend Income, Operating
unclassified.description: Amount of operating dividend income on securities.

unclassified.label: Dividends Receivable
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of dividends declared but not received.

unclassified.label: Due from Officers or Stockholders, Current
Due to Officers or Stockholders, Current
Early Repayment of Senior Debt
unclassified.description: The cash outflow for the extinguishment of long-term borrowing, with the highest claim on the assets of the entity in case of bankruptcy or liquidation, before its maturity.

unclassified.label: Earnings Per Share, Diluted, Pro Forma Adjustment
unclassified.description: Pro forma diluted earnings per share adjustment to reconcile between net income and pro forma amounts.

unclassified.label: Effect of Exchange Rate on Cash and Cash Equivalents, Continuing Operations
Effect of Exchange Rate on Cash and Cash Equivalents, Discontinued Operations
Effect on Retained Earnings (Accumulated Deficit) Due to Change in Measurement Date, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationCrossBorderOtherAmount
unclassified.description: Amount of reported income tax expense (benefit) from difference to income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying statutory federal (national) income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation, attributable to cross-border tax law classified as other.

unclassified.label: EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationCrossBorderTaxEffectAmount
unclassified.description: Amount of reported income tax expense (benefit) from difference to expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying statutory federal (national) income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation, attributable to cross-border tax law.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Deduction, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to deduction. Includes, but is not limited to, dividend deduction, deduction for dividend paid to employee stock ownership plan (ESOP), Medicare prescription drug benefit subsidy deduction, and other deductions.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Deduction, Dividend, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to deduction for dividend.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Deduction, Medicare Prescription Drug Benefit, Percent
