unclassified.description: Percentage of difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to deduction for Medicare prescription drug benefit subsidy.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Disposition of Asset, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations, attributable to disposition of asset. Includes, but is not limited to, intra-entity transfer of asset other than inventory.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Equity in Earnings (Losses) of Unconsolidated Subsidiary, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to equity in earnings (loss) of unconsolidated subsidiaries exempt from income taxes.

unclassified.label: EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationGiltiAmount
unclassified.description: Amount of reported income tax expense from difference to expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation, attributable to net controlled foreign corporation (CFC) tested income (NCTI) (formerly referred to as global intangible low-taxed income (GILTI)).

unclassified.label: EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationGiltiPercent
unclassified.description: Percentage of reported income tax expense from difference to expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation, attributable to net controlled foreign corporation (CFC) tested income (NCTI) (formerly referred to as global intangible low-taxed income (GILTI)).

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Leases, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to lease expense.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Restructuring Charges, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to restructuring charges.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Repatriation of Foreign Earnings, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to the repatriation of foreign earnings.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Contingency, Other, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to other income tax contingencies.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Settlement, Foreign, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to foreign income tax settlement.

unclassified.label: Embedded Derivative, Fair Value of Embedded Derivative Asset
unclassified.description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of the embedded derivative or group of embedded derivatives classified as an asset.

unclassified.label: Embedded Derivative, Fair Value of Embedded Derivative Liability
unclassified.description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of the embedded derivative or group of embedded derivatives classified as a liability.

unclassified.label: Embedded Derivative, Fair Value of Embedded Derivative, Net
unclassified.description: Net fair value as of the balance sheet date of the embedded derivative or group of embedded derivatives classified as assets, net of those classified as liabilities.

unclassified.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Nonvested Award, Excluding Option, Cost Not yet Recognized, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of cost to be recognized for nonvested award under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes share and unit options.

unclassified.label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Deferred Shares, Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of unearned shares held by the employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

unclassified.label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Dividends Paid to ESOP
unclassified.description: Dividends paid on stock held by an employee stock ownership plan.

unclassified.label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Number of Allocated Shares
unclassified.description: The shares or units in an ESOP trust that have been assigned to individual participant accounts based on a known formula. IRS rules require allocations to be nondiscriminatory generally based on compensation, length of service, or a combination of both. For any particular participant such shares or units may be vested, unvested, or partially vested.

unclassified.label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Number of Suspense Shares
unclassified.description: Shares contributed to the ESOP that have not yet been released, committed to be released, or allocated to participant accounts. Suspense shares generally collateralize ESOP debt.

unclassified.label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Shares Contributed to ESOP
unclassified.description: This item represents the number of shares provided to the Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) during the period.

unclassified.label: Energy Marketing Contract Liabilities, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Fair value of liability arising from energy marketing activities (trading activities), expected to be settled after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer. Examples of energy marketing activities include, but are not limited to, trading of electricity, coal, natural gas and oil using financial instruments, including, but not limited to, forward contracts, options and swaps.

unclassified.label: Energy Marketing Contracts Assets, Current
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the asset arising from energy trading activities that involves the purchase and sale of energy under forward contracts at fixed and variable prices and the buying and selling of financial energy contracts that include exchange futures and options and over the counter options and swaps, which are expected to be converted into cash or otherwise disposed of within a year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Disclosure on Geographic Areas, Long-Lived Assets in Entity's Country of Domicile (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Disclosure on Geographic Areas, Revenue from External Customers Attributed to Entity's Country of Domicile (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Disclosure on Geographic Areas, Revenue from External Customers Attributed to Foreign Countries (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Environmental Costs Recognized, Capitalized
unclassified.description: Amount of costs recognized in the balance sheet for known or estimated future costs arising from requirements to perform activities to remediate one or more sites.

unclassified.label: EquityClassifiedWrittenCallOptionModificationEquityIssuanceIncreaseDecreaseInEquityAmount
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in equity for freestanding written call option classified as equity from modification recognized as equity issuance cost. Includes, but is not limited to, exchange by issuer and holder. Excludes share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Equity, Fair Value Adjustment
unclassified.description: Amount of addition (reduction) to the amount at which an instrument classified in shareholders' equity could be incurred (settled) in a current transaction between willing parties.

unclassified.label: Equity, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value of the entity's equity.

unclassified.label: Development Stage Entities, Equity Issuance, Per Share Amount (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
Equity Method Investment, Aggregate Cost
unclassified.description: This element represents the aggregate cost of investments accounted for under the equity method of accounting.

unclassified.label: Equity Method Investment, Quoted Market Value
unclassified.description: This item represents the aggregate value of each identified investment accounted for under the equity method of accounting based on the quoted market price for those investments in common stock for which a quoted market price is available.

unclassified.label: Equity Method Investment, Amount Sold
unclassified.description: Amount of the entity's equity method investment which has been sold.

unclassified.label: Equity Method Investment, Summarized Financial Information, Cost of Sales (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Equity Method Investment Summarized Financial Information, Equity (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Equity Method Investment, Summarized Financial Information, Equity Excluding Noncontrolling Interests (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Equity Method Investment, Summarized Financial Information, Gross Profit (Loss) (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Equity Method Investment, Summarized Financial Information, Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Equity Method Investment, Summarized Financial Information, Liabilities (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Equity Method Investment, Summarized Financial Information, Redeemable Preferred Stock (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Escrow Deposits Related to Property Sales
unclassified.description: Escrow deposits related to property sales in noncash investing and financing activities.

unclassified.label: Estimated Insurance Recoveries
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of amounts expected to be recovered under the terms of insurance contracts.

unclassified.label: Exploration Costs, Period Cost
unclassified.description: Amount of capitalized exploration cost incurred during period and excluded from amortization for oil- and gas-producing activities accounted for under full cost method. Excludes acquisition and development costs and capitalized interest.

unclassified.label: Extended Product Warranty Accrual
unclassified.description: Amount as of the balance sheet date of the aggregate extended product warranty liability. Does not include the ending balance for the standard product warranty liability.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Assets Measured on Recurring Basis, Change in Unrealized Gain (Loss) Included in Investment Income (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Fair Value Assumptions, Expected Dividend Rate (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Fair Value Assumptions, Risk Free Interest Rate (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Fair Value, Concentration of Risk, Cash and Cash Equivalents
unclassified.description: Fair value of cash and cash equivalent subject to concentration of credit or market risk or both.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Concentration of Risk, Derivative Instruments, Assets
unclassified.description: Fair value of derivative asset subject to concentration of credit or market risk or both.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Concentration of Risk, Notes Receivable
unclassified.description: Fair value of note receivable subject to concentration of credit or market risk or both.

unclassified.label: Fair Value Hedge Assets
unclassified.description: Fair value of all derivative assets designated as fair value hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Fair Value Hedge Liabilities
unclassified.description: Fair value of all derivative liabilities designated as fair value hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Fair Value Hedges, Net
unclassified.description: Net fair value of all derivative instruments designated as fair value hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Fair Value Inputs, Counterparty Credit Risk (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Fair Value, Level 2 to level 1 Transfers, Amount (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Fair Value, Liabilities Measured on Recurring Basis, Change in Unrealized Gain (Loss) Included in Other Income (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Fair Value, Measured on Recurring Basis, Gain (Loss) Included in Earnings (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Liability, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) of financial instrument classified as a liability measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Liability, Purchases, (Sales), Issuances, (Settlements)
unclassified.description: Amount of purchases, (sales), issuances and (settlements) of financial instrument classified as a liability measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Liability, Sales
unclassified.description: Amount of sales of financial instrument classified as a liability measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Net Derivative Asset (Liability) Measured on Recurring Basis, Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) of financial instrument classified as a derivative asset (liability) after deduction of derivative liability (asset), measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Net Derivative Asset (Liability) Measured on Recurring Basis, Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Sales
unclassified.description: Amount of sales of financial instrument classified as a derivative asset (liability) after deduction of derivative liability (asset), measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Option, Aggregate Differences, Long-term Debt Instruments
unclassified.description: This item represents the difference between the aggregate fair value and the aggregate unpaid principal balance of long-term debt instruments that have contractual principal amounts and for which the fair value option has been elected.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Option, Changes in Fair Value, Gain (Loss) (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Fair Value, Option, Changes in Fair Value, Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: For each line item in the statement of financial position, the amounts of gains and losses from fair value changes included in earnings.

unclassified.label: Federal Funds Purchased
unclassified.description: Amount of short term borrowing where a bank borrows, at the federal funds rate, from another bank.

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank Advances
unclassified.description: Amount of Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) advances to member financial institutions.

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advance, Maturity, Average Interest Rate, after Year Five
unclassified.description: Weighted average interest rate of advance from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) due after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advance, Maturity, Average Interest Rate, Year Five
unclassified.description: Weighted average interest rate of advance from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) due in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advance, Maturity, Average Interest Rate, Year One
unclassified.description: Weighted average interest rate of advance from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) due in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advance, Maturity, Average Interest Rate, Year Two
unclassified.description: Weighted average interest rate of advance from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) due in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advance, Maturity, Average Interest Rate, Year Four
unclassified.description: Weighted average interest rate of advance from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) due in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advance, Maturity, Average Interest Rate, Year Three
unclassified.description: Weighted average interest rate of advance from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) due in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advance, Maturity, after Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of advance from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) maturing after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advance, Maturity, Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of advance from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) maturing in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advance, Maturity, Year Two
unclassified.description: Amount of advance from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) maturing in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advance, Maturity, Year Four
unclassified.description: Amount of advance from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) maturing in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advance, Maturity, Year Three
unclassified.description: Amount of advance from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) maturing in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advance, Maturity, Year One
unclassified.description: Amount of advance from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) maturing in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank Stock
unclassified.description: Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLB) stock represents an equity interest in a FHLB. It does not have a readily determinable fair value because its ownership is restricted and it lacks a market (liquidity).

unclassified.label: FederalStateAndLocalIncomeTaxExpenseBenefitContinuingOperations
unclassified.description: Amount of current and deferred federal, state, and local tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations. Includes, but is not limited to, current and deferred national, regional, territorial, and provincial tax expense (benefit) for non-US (United States of America) jurisdiction.

unclassified.label: Finance Lease, Impairment Loss
unclassified.description: Amount of impairment loss from right-of-use asset from finance lease.

unclassified.label: Finance Leased Asset, Measurement Input
unclassified.description: Value of input used to measure asset under finance lease.

unclassified.label: Financial Guarantee Insurance Contracts, Premium Receivable, Premium Payments Received (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Financial Instruments, Owned, at Fair Value
unclassified.description: The aggregate fair value as of the balance sheet date of financial instruments and other positions owned by the entity including: (1) mortgages, mortgage-backed and asset backed securities; (2) US government and agency obligations; (3) state and municipal government obligations; (4) other sovereign government debt; (5) corporate obligations; (6) corporate equities; (7) principal investments; (8) derivative contracts; and (9) physical commodities. Includes both pledged and unpledged holdings.

unclassified.label: Financial Instruments, Owned, Mortgages, Mortgage-backed and Asset-backed Securities, at Fair Value
unclassified.description: The fair value as of the balance sheet date of firm holdings in mortgages, mortgage backed securities (investment instruments that represent ownership of an undivided interest in a group of mortgages, where principal and interest from the individual mortgages are used to pay investors' principal and interest on the mortgage backed security) and asset-backed securities that are primarily paid from the cash flows of a discrete pool of receivables or other financial assets (such as credit-card receivables), either fixed or revolving, that by their terms convert into cash within a finite time period. Includes both pledged (to counterparties as collateral for financing transactions) and unpledged holdings.

unclassified.label: Financial Instruments, Owned, Physical Commodities, at Fair Value
unclassified.description: The fair value as of the balance sheet date of firm holdings in physical commodity contracts (for example, agricultural products, metals and energy). Includes both pledged (to counterparties as collateral for financing transactions) and unpledged holdings.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Writeoff, after Recovery
unclassified.description: Amount, after recovery, of writeoff of financing receivable, charged against allowance for credit loss.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Losses, Collectively Evaluated for Impairment
unclassified.description: Amount of allowance for credit loss on financing receivable evaluated on collective basis. Excludes financing receivable evaluated on individual basis.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Losses, Individually Evaluated for Impairment (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Losses, Individually Evaluated for Impairment
unclassified.description: Amount of allowance for credit loss on financing receivable evaluated on individual basis. Excludes financing receivable evaluated on collective basis.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in allowance for credit loss on financing receivable.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Losses, Provisions (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Losses, Recoveries (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Financing Receivable, before Allowance for Credit Loss and Fee
unclassified.description: Amortized cost, before allowance for credit loss, fee, and loan in process, of financing receivable. Excludes financing receivable covered under loss sharing agreement and net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Collectively Evaluated for Impairment
unclassified.description: Amount of financing receivable collectively evaluated for credit loss. Excludes financing receivable individually evaluated for credit loss.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Deferred Commitment Fee
unclassified.description: Amount of fee received for commitment to originate or purchase financing receivable where likelihood of commitment being exercised is remote, to be recognized as service income.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestAfterAllowanceForCreditLoss
unclassified.description: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, after allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestBeforeAllowanceForCreditLoss
unclassified.description: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, before allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestModifiedPast12Months
unclassified.description: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, of financing receivable 12 months after modification for debtor experiencing financial difficulty.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestModifiedPeriod
unclassified.description: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, of financing receivable modified during period for debtor experiencing financial difficulty.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestOriginatedMoreThanFiveYearsBeforeCurrentFiscalYear
unclassified.description: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, of financing receivable originated more than five years prior to current fiscal year. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestOriginatedMoreThanFiveYearsBeforeCurrentFiscalYearWriteoff
unclassified.description: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of writeoff of financing receivable originated more than five years before current fiscal year. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestRevolving
unclassified.description: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, of financing receivable that can be withdrawn, repaid, and redrawn.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestRevolvingConvertedToTermLoan
unclassified.description: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, of revolving financing receivable converted to term loan.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestYearFiveOriginatedFourYearsBeforeCurrentFiscalYear
unclassified.description: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, of financing receivable originated four years prior to current fiscal year. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestYearFiveOriginatedFourYearsBeforeCurrentFiscalYearWriteoff
unclassified.description: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of writeoff of financing receivable originated four years before current fiscal year. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestYearFourOriginatedThreeYearsBeforeCurrentFiscalYear
unclassified.description: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, of financing receivable originated three years prior to current fiscal year. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestYearFourOriginatedThreeYearsBeforeCurrentFiscalYearWriteoff
unclassified.description: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of writeoff of financing receivable originated three years before current fiscal year. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestYearOneOriginatedCurrentFiscalYear
unclassified.description: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, of financing receivable originated in current fiscal year. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestYearOneOriginatedCurrentFiscalYearWriteoff
unclassified.description: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of writeoff of financing receivable originated in current fiscal year. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestYearThreeOriginatedTwoYearsBeforeCurrentFiscalYear
unclassified.description: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, of financing receivable originated two years prior to current fiscal year. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestYearThreeOriginatedTwoYearsBeforeCurrentFiscalYearWriteoff
unclassified.description: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of writeoff of financing receivable originated two years before current fiscal year. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestYearTwoOriginatedFiscalYearBeforeCurrentFiscalYear
unclassified.description: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest of financing receivable originated in fiscal year prior to current fiscal year. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestYearTwoOriginatedFiscalYearBeforeCurrentFiscalYearWriteoff
unclassified.description: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of writeoff of financing receivable originated in fiscal year before current fiscal year. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Individually Evaluated for Impairment
unclassified.description: Amount of financing receivable individually evaluated for credit loss. Excludes financing receivable collectively evaluated for credit loss.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableModificationToTotalFinancingReceivablesExcludingAccruedInterestPercent
unclassified.description: Percentage, excluding accrued interest, of financing receivable modified during period for debtor experiencing financial difficulty to total financing receivables.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Modifications, Number of Contracts
unclassified.description: Number of financing receivables that have been modified by troubled debt restructurings.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Troubled Debt Restructuring, Postmodification
unclassified.description: Amortized cost of financing receivable modified during period for debtor experiencing financial difficulty.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Troubled Debt Restructuring
unclassified.description: Accumulated amortized cost of financing receivable modified for debtor experiencing financial difficulty.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Troubled Debt Restructuring, Subsequent Default, Number of Contracts
unclassified.description: Number of financing receivable contracts modified as troubled debt restructuring within previous 12 months, with subsequent payment default.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Troubled Debt Restructuring, Subsequent Default
unclassified.description: Amortized cost of financing receivable with payment default in current period and modified within previous 12 months preceding payment default for debtor experiencing financial difficulty.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Nonaccrual, No Allowance
unclassified.description: Amortized cost of financing receivable on nonaccrual status with no allowance for credit loss. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Originated, More than Five Years before Current Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amortized cost of financing receivable originated more than five years prior to current fiscal year. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Year Five, Originated, Four Years before Current Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amortized cost of financing receivable originated four years prior to current fiscal year. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Year One, Originated, Current Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amortized cost of financing receivable originated in current fiscal year. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Year Two, Originated, Fiscal Year before Current Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amortized cost of financing receivable originated in fiscal year prior to current fiscal year. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Year Four, Originated, Three Years before Current Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amortized cost of financing receivable originated three years prior to current fiscal year. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Year Three, Originated, Two Years before Current Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amortized cost of financing receivable originated two years prior to current fiscal year. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Reclassification to Held-for-sale
unclassified.description: Amount of financing receivable reclassified to held-for-sale.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Recorded Investment, 30 to 59 Days Past Due (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
Financing Receivable, Recorded Investment, 60 to 89 Days Past Due (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
Financing Receivable, 90 Days or More Past Due, Still Accruing
unclassified.description: Amortized cost of financing receivable 90 days or more past due and still accruing. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Recorded Investment, Equal to Greater than 90 Days Past Due (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
Financing Receivable, Nonaccrual
unclassified.description: Amortized cost of financing receivable on nonaccrual status. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Revolving
unclassified.description: Amortized cost of financing receivable that can be withdrawn, repaid, and redrawn.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Unamortized Loan Fee (Cost) and Purchase Premium (Discount)
unclassified.description: Amount of unamortized loan commitment, origination, and other costs (fees) and purchase premium (discount) on financing receivable recognized as adjustment to yield. Excludes financing receivable covered under loss sharing agreement.

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Amortization Expense, Rolling Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization expense for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life expected to be recognized in the fifth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Finite-lived Intangible Assets, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of assets, excluding financial assets, that lack physical substance, having a limited useful life.

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in finite-lived intangible asset. Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Patents, Gross
unclassified.description: Gross carrying amount before accumulated amortization as of the balance sheet date of the costs pertaining to the exclusive legal rights granted to the owner of the patent to exploit an invention or a process for a period of time specified by law. Such costs may have been expended to directly apply and receive patent rights, or to acquire such rights.

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Trade Names, Gross
unclassified.description: Gross carrying amount before accumulated amortization as of the balance sheet date of the rights acquired through registration of a trade name to gain or protect exclusive use thereof for a reasonably expected period of economic benefit.

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Trademarks, Gross
unclassified.description: Gross carrying amount before accumulated amortization as of the balance sheet date for the rights acquired through registration of a trademark to gain or protect exclusive use of a business name, symbol or other device or style for a specified period of time.

unclassified.label: Foreign Currency Cash Flow Hedge Gain (Loss) to be Reclassified During Next 12 Months
unclassified.description: The estimated net amount of unrealized gains or losses on foreign currency cash flow hedges at the reporting date expected to be reclassified to earnings within the next 12 months.

unclassified.label: Foreign Currency Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments at Fair Value, Net
unclassified.description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all foreign currency derivatives not designated as hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Foreign Currency Derivative Liabilities at Fair Value (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Foreign Currency Derivatives at Fair Value, Net (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Foreign Currency Fair Value Hedge Liability at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all derivative liabilities designated as foreign currency fair value hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Foreign Currency Transaction Gain (Loss), Realized
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, of realized gain (loss) from foreign currency transaction.

unclassified.label: Foreign Earnings Repatriated
unclassified.description: Amount of foreign earnings repatriated from subsidiaries outside the country of domicile.

unclassified.label: Former Gain Contingency, Recognized in Current Period
unclassified.description: Amount of gain recognized in the period that had been disclosed in prior periods as a contingent gain.

unclassified.label: ForwardContractIndexedToEquitySettlementShareFairValue
unclassified.description: Fair value of shares that would be issued upon settlement of forward contract indexed to equity.

unclassified.label: Forward Contract Indexed to Issuer's Equity, Settlement Alternatives, Shares, at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Number of shares as a settlement alternative for each freestanding forward contract.

unclassified.label: Fresh-Start Adjustment, Increase (Decrease), Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss)
Fresh-Start Adjustment, Increase (Decrease), Current Maturities of Long-term Debt
Fresh-Start Adjustment, Increase (Decrease), Debt Issuance Costs
Fresh-Start Adjustment, Increase (Decrease), Deferred Income Tax Assets, Noncurrent
Fresh-Start Adjustment, Increase (Decrease), Liabilities and Stockholders' Equity
Fresh-Start Adjustment, Increase (Decrease), Liabilities Subject to Compromise
Fresh-Start Adjustment, Increase (Decrease), Noncurrent Other Obligations
Fresh-Start Adjustment, Increase (Decrease), Other Assets, Noncurrent
Fresh-Start Adjustment, Increase (Decrease), Other Current Liabilities
Fresh-Start Adjustment, Increase (Decrease), Other Noncurrent Obligations
Fresh-Start Adjustment, Increase (Decrease), Other Property and Equipment
Fresh-Start Adjustment, Increase (Decrease), Prepaid and Other Current Assets
Fresh-Start Adjustment, Increase (Decrease), Property and Equipment, Net
Funds Held for Clients
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the funds held on behalf of others and that are expected to be liquidated within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer. This does not include funds held under reinsurance agreements.

unclassified.label: Furniture and Fixtures, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount before accumulated depreciation of equipment commonly used in offices and stores that have no permanent connection to the structure of a building or utilities. Examples include, but are not limited to, desks, chairs, tables, and bookcases.

unclassified.label: Future Amortization Expense, Remainder of Fiscal Year (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Future Minimum Sublease Rentals, Sale Leaseback Transactions, within Five Years
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum sublease rentals for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing to be received by the seller-lessee in the fifth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Future Minimum Sublease Rentals, Sale Leaseback Transactions, within Four Years
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum sublease rentals for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing to be received by the seller-lessee in the fourth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Future Minimum Sublease Rentals, Sale Leaseback Transactions, within Three Years
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum sublease rentals for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing to be received by the seller-lessee in the third fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Future Minimum Sublease Rentals, Sale Leaseback Transactions, within Two Years
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum sublease rentals for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing to be received by the seller-lessee in the second fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Future Net Cash Flows Relating to Proved Oil and Gas Reserves, Cash Inflows
Future Net Cash Flows Relating to Proved Oil and Gas Reserves, Development Costs
Future Net Cash Flows Relating to Proved Oil and Gas Reserves, Income Tax Expense
Future Net Cash Flows Relating to Proved Oil and Gas Reserves, Net Cash Flows
Future Net Cash Flows Relating to Proved Oil and Gas Reserves, Production Costs
Future Net Cash Flows Relating to Proved Oil and Gas Reserves, Ten Percent Annual Discount for Estimated Timing of Cash Flows
Gain (Loss) from Components Excluded from Assessment of Fair Value Hedge Effectiveness, Net
unclassified.description: Net gain (loss) relating to components of the gain (loss) on the fair value hedging instrument excluded from the assessment of fair value hedge effectiveness. Recognized in earnings.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) from Hedged Firm Commitment Not Qualifying as Interest Rate Fair Value Hedge, Net
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in earnings when a hedged firm commitment no longer qualifies as an interest rate fair value hedge.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Derivative Instruments Held for Trading Purposes, Net
unclassified.description: Aggregate net gain and losses (whether realized or unrealized) on all derivative instruments held for trading purposes whether or not settled physically.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Discontinuation of Interest Rate Cash Flow Hedge Due to Forecasted Transaction Probable of Not Occurring, Net
unclassified.description: The amount of net gain (loss) reclassified into earnings when interest rate cash flow hedge is discontinued because it is probable that the original forecasted transactions will not occur by the end of the original period or an additional two month time period.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Other Assets (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Gain (Loss) on Fair Value Hedge Ineffectiveness, Net
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss)recognized in the income statement from the hedging ineffectiveness of a fair value hedge.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Fair Value Hedges Recognized in Earnings
unclassified.description: Total amount of gain (loss) derived from fair value hedges recognized in earnings in the period.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Foreign Currency Fair Value Hedge Derivatives
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in fair value of foreign currency derivative and nonderivative instruments designated as fair value hedge recognized in earnings and from related hedged item to extent that fair value hedge was determined to be effective.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Price Risk Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in earnings in the period from the increase (decrease) in fair value of price risk derivatives not designated as hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Equity Investments
Gain (Loss) on Sale of Interest in Projects
unclassified.description: Gain (loss) included in earnings resulting from the sale of interest in projects.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Oil and Gas Property
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of proven and unproven oil and gas properties.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Securitization of Financial Assets
unclassified.description: A gain (loss) realized on a transfer, accounted for as a sale, of all or a portion of financial assets in which the transferor surrenders control and receives consideration other than a beneficial interest in the assets transferred. Reflects the amount of sales proceeds in excess of, or deficient from, the sum of the carrying amounts of transferred financial assets plus transaction costs.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Termination of Lease
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) on termination of lease before expiration of lease term.

unclassified.label: Gain on Cash Flow Hedge Ineffectiveness
unclassified.description: The gain recognized in earnings during the reporting period representing the amount of the cash flow hedges' ineffectiveness.

unclassified.label: Gain on Derivative Instruments, Pretax
unclassified.description: Aggregate gain on all derivative instruments recognized in earnings during the period, before tax effects.

unclassified.label: Gain on Discontinuation of Cash Flow Hedge Due to Forecasted Transaction Probable of Not Occurring
unclassified.description: The amount of gain reclassified into earnings in the period when cash flow hedge is discontinued because it is probable that the original forecasted transactions will not occur by the end of the original period or an additional two month time period.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Stock in Subsidiary
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of equity in securities of subsidiaries.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Extinguishment of Debt, before Write off of Debt Issuance Cost
unclassified.description: Reflects the difference between the fair value of payments made to legally extinguish a debt and its carrying value at that time. This item excludes the write-off of amounts previously capitalized as debt issuance costs.

unclassified.label: Gains (Losses) on Sales of Credit Card Portfolio
unclassified.description: The gain (loss) resulting from the sale of credit card receivables (portfolios).

unclassified.label: Gas and Oil Area, Undeveloped, Net
Gas Gathering, Transportation, Marketing and Processing Costs (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Gas Purchase Payable, Current
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable for purchases of natural gas. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

unclassified.label: Gas Purchase Payable
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable for purchases of natural gas.

unclassified.label: General Partners' Capital Account
unclassified.description: The amount of the general partner's ownership interest.

unclassified.label: Good Faith and Margin Deposits with Broker-Dealers
unclassified.description: Amount of right to receive cash and securities on deposit with broker-dealers to demonstrate an intention to complete a purchase (good faith deposit) and collateral deposited by counterparty to cover the credit risk assumed (margin deposit).

unclassified.label: Goodwill, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount, before accumulated impairment loss, of asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized. Includes amount, before amortization expense and impairment loss, of goodwill for private company.

unclassified.label: Goodwill, Translation and Purchase Accounting Adjustments
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) from foreign currency translation and measurement period adjustments of asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

unclassified.label: GovernmentAssistanceAmount
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in income from government assistance.

unclassified.label: GovernmentAssistanceAmountCumulative
unclassified.description: Amount of asset from government assistance.

unclassified.label: GovernmentAssistanceAssetIncreaseNoncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in asset from government assistance, classified as noncurrent.

unclassified.label: GovernmentAssistanceLiabilityCurrent
unclassified.description: Amount of liability from government assistance, classified as current.

unclassified.label: GovernmentAssistanceNonoperatingExpense
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease (increase) in expense from government assistance, classified as nonoperating.

unclassified.label: Grants Receivable
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of amounts due under the terms of governmental, corporate, or foundation grants.

unclassified.label: Guaranty Liabilities
unclassified.description: This item represents a non-contingent liability for the fair value of an obligation to stand ready to perform over the term of a guaranty issued in the event that specified triggering events or conditions occur.

unclassified.label: Hedged Liability, Discontinued Fair Value Hedge, Cumulative Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of cumulative increase (decrease) in fair value of hedged liability in fair value hedge, attributable to hedged risk, remaining after discontinued hedge. Excludes cumulative basis adjustment related to foreign exchange risk.

unclassified.label: Hedged Liability, Fair Value Hedge
unclassified.description: Amount of liability hedged in fair value hedging relationship.

unclassified.label: Hedging Assets, Current
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the asset arising from a financial instrument or a contract used to mitigate a specified risk (hedge), and which are expected to be converted into cash or otherwise disposed of within a year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Hedging Liabilities, Current
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the liability arising from a financial instrument or a contract used to mitigate a specified risk (hedge), and which are expected to be converted into cash or otherwise disposed of within a year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Hedging Liabilities, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Fair value of liability arising from a financial instrument or contract used to mitigate a specified risk (hedge), expected to be settled after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity
unclassified.description: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Accumulated Unrecognized Gain
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated unrecognized gain on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Accumulated Unrecognized Loss
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated unrealized loss on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, 12 Months or Longer, Accumulated Loss
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated unrealized loss on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), in continuous loss position for 12 months or longer.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, Less than 12 Months, Accumulated Loss
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated unrealized loss on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), in continuous loss position for less than 12 months.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Amortized Cost, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, after Year 5 Through 10
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing in sixth through tenth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Amortized Cost, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, after Year One Through Five
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing in second through fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Amortized Cost, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, after Year 10
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing after tenth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Held-to-maturity Securities, Debt Maturities, Fair Value (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, Amortized Cost
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Amortized Cost, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, Year One
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Maturity, without Single Maturity Date, Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), without single maturity date and not allocated over maturity grouping.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Maturity, without Single Maturity Date, Amortized Cost
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) without single maturity date and not allocated over maturity grouping.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), classified as noncurrent.

unclassified.label: Hosting Arrangement, Service Contract, Implementation Cost, Capitalized, Accumulated Amortization
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated amortization of capitalized implementation cost from hosting arrangement that is service contract.

unclassified.label: Hosting Arrangement, Service Contract, Implementation Cost, Capitalized, before Accumulated Amortization
unclassified.description: Amount, before accumulated amortization, of capitalized implementation cost from hosting arrangement that is service contract.

unclassified.label: Hybrid Instruments at Fair Value, Net
unclassified.description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of hybrid instruments.

unclassified.label: Impaired Assets to be Disposed of by Method Other than Sale, Amount of Impairment Loss
unclassified.description: Loss recognized as a result of the initial and subsequent write-down of a long-lived asset's carrying amount to fair value.

unclassified.label: Impaired Financing Receivable, Average Recorded Investment
unclassified.description: Average amount of investment of impaired financing receivables with related allowance for credit losses and without a related allowance for credit losses.

unclassified.label: Impaired Financing Receivable, Interest Income, Accrual Method
unclassified.description: Amount of interest income recognized that the financing receivables (with related allowance for credit losses and without a related allowance for credit losses) were impaired.

unclassified.label: Impaired Financing Receivable, Recorded Investment
unclassified.description: Amount of investment of impaired financing receivables with related allowance for credit losses and without a related allowance for credit losses.

unclassified.label: Impaired Financing Receivable, Related Allowance
unclassified.description: Amount of allowance for credit losses related to recorded investment.

unclassified.label: Impaired Financing Receivable, Unpaid Principal Balance
unclassified.description: Amount of unpaid principal balance of impaired financing receivables with related allowance for credit losses and without related allowance for credit losses.

unclassified.label: Impaired Financing Receivable, with No Related Allowance, Average Recorded Investment
unclassified.description: Amount of average investment of impaired financing receivables for which there is no related allowance for credit losses.

unclassified.label: Impaired Financing Receivable, with No Related Allowance, Interest Income, Accrual Method
unclassified.description: Amount of interest income, recognized on accrual basis, on financing receivables that are recognized as impaired, for which there is no related allowance for credit losses.

unclassified.label: Impaired Financing Receivable, with No Related Allowance, Recorded Investment
unclassified.description: Amount of investment in impaired financing receivables for which there is no related allowance for credit losses.

unclassified.label: Impaired Financing Receivable, with No Related Allowance, Unpaid Principal Balance
unclassified.description: Amount of unpaid principal balance of impaired financing receivables for which there is no related allowance for credit losses.

unclassified.label: Impaired Financing Receivable, with Related Allowance, Average Recorded Investment
unclassified.description: Amount of average investment of impaired financing receivables for which there is a related allowance for credit losses.

unclassified.label: Impaired Financing Receivable, with Related Allowance, Interest Income, Accrual Method
unclassified.description: Amount of interest income, recognized on accrual basis, on financing receivables, for which there is a related allowance for credit losses and are recognized as impaired.

unclassified.label: Impaired Financing Receivable, with Related Allowance, Recorded Investment
unclassified.description: Amount of investment in impaired financing receivables for which there is a related allowance for credit losses.

unclassified.label: Impaired Financing Receivable, with Related Allowance, Unpaid Principal Balance
unclassified.description: Unpaid principal balance of impaired financing receivables for which there is a related allowance for credit losses.

unclassified.label: Impairment of Real Estate
unclassified.description: The charge against earnings in the period to reduce the carrying amount of real property to fair value.

unclassified.label: Income (Loss) from Subsidiaries, Net of Tax
unclassified.description: Amount after tax of income (loss) of subsidiary attributable to the parent entity.

unclassified.label: Income Tax Effects Allocated Directly to Equity
unclassified.description: The sum of the tax effects of all items occurring during the period that have been charged or credited directly to other comprehensive income or to related components of shareholders' equity.

unclassified.label: Income Tax Effects Allocated Directly to Equity, Equity Transactions
unclassified.description: The tax effect of an increase or decrease in contributed capital (for example, deductible expenditures reported as a reduction of the proceeds from issuing capital stock) during the period charged or credited directly to shareholders' equity.

unclassified.label: Income Tax Examination, Increase (Decrease) in Liability from Prior Year
unclassified.description: The amount the liability recorded for the income tax examination increased or decreased in the current year/accounting period.

unclassified.label: Income Tax Examination, Interest Accrued
unclassified.description: The amount of estimated interest accrued as of the balance sheet date arising from income tax examinations.

unclassified.label: Income Tax Examination, Penalties Expense
unclassified.description: The amount of estimated penalties recognized in the period arising from income tax examinations.

unclassified.label: Income Tax Expense (Benefit), Continuing Operations, Discontinued Operations
unclassified.description: Amount of current tax expense (benefit) and deferred tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations and income (loss) from discontinued operations.

unclassified.label: Income Tax Expense (Benefit), Intraperiod Tax Allocation
unclassified.description: Amount of income tax expense (benefit) for continuing operations, discontinued operations, other comprehensive income, and items charged (credited) directly to shareholders' equity.

unclassified.label: IncomeTaxPaidFederalBeforeRefundReceived
unclassified.description: Amount, before income tax refund received, of cash paid to federal (national) tax jurisdiction for tax on income.

unclassified.label: IncomeTaxPaidForeignBeforeRefundReceived
unclassified.description: Amount, before income tax refund received, of cash paid to foreign tax jurisdiction for tax on income.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Charitable Contributions, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to nondeductible charitable contributions expense.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Meals and Entertainment, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to nondeductible meals and entertainment expense.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Research and Development, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to nondeductible research and development expense.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Restructuring Charges, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to nondeductible restructuring charges.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Contingency, Other, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to increase (decrease) in other income tax contingencies.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Exempt Income, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to income (loss) exempt from income taxes.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Settlement, Other, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to other income tax settlements.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) Due from Affiliates
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in receivables to be collected from an entity that is controlling, under the control of, or within the same control group as the reporting entity by means of direct or indirect ownership.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accrued Interest Receivable, Net
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount due from borrowers for interest payments.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Assets Held-for-sale
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the period in book value of long-lived assets that the reporting entity plans to sell within one year (or one business cycle).

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Billing in Excess of Cost of Earnings
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the liability reflecting cash payments received before the related costs have been incurred.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Contract Receivables, Net
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in receivables arising from the contracting of goods and services, net for uncollectible accounts.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Customer Advances
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount of prepayments by customers for goods or services to be provided at a later date.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Revenue and Customer Advances and Deposits
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount of (a) prepayments by customers for goods or services to be provided at a later date, (b) the amount of customer money held in customer accounts, including security deposits, collateral for current or future transactions, initial payment of the cost of an acquisition or for the right to enter into a contract or agreement, (c) the increase (decrease) during the reporting period, excluding the portion taken into income, in the liability reflecting services yet to be performed by the reporting entity for which cash or other forms of consideration was received or recorded as a receivable, or (d) some combination of (a), (b), and (c).

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Deposits Outstanding
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in monies given as security or collateral for items acquired or borrowed on a temporary basis. Deposits may also be paid as initial payment of the cost of acquisition or for the right to enter into a contract or agreement.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Fair Value of Hedged Item in Interest Rate Fair Value Hedge (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Increase (Decrease) in Fair Value of Hedged Item in Interest Rate Fair Value Hedge
unclassified.description: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) included in earnings related to the fair value of the hedged item in an interest rate fair value hedge, offset by the gain (loss) on the hedging instrument to the extent that the fair value hedge is determined to be effective.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Fair Value of Hedged Item in Price Risk Fair Value Hedge (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Increase (Decrease) in Fair Value of Hedged Item in Price Risk Fair Value Hedge
unclassified.description: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) recognized in earnings related to the fair value of the hedged item in a price risk fair value hedge, offset by the gain (loss) on the hedging instrument to the extent that the fair value hedge is determined to be effective.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Fair Value of Interest Rate Fair Value Hedging Instruments
unclassified.description: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) related to the fair value of interest rate derivatives designated as fair value hedging instruments, as offset by the gain (loss) on the hedged item to the extent that the fair value hedge is determined to be effective.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Fossil Fuel Inventories
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the value of fossil fuel held in inventory.

unclassified.label: Changes in Future Income Tax Expense Estimates on Future Cash Flows Related to Proved Oil and Gas Reserves
Increase (Decrease) in Gas Balancing Receivable
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in receivable in gas-balancing arrangement in oil- and gas-producing activities.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Intangible Assets, Current
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in intangible assets (for example patents and licenses).

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Marketable Securities, Restricted
unclassified.description: The change during the period, either increase or decrease, in total debt and equity financial instruments including: (1) securities held-to-maturity, (2) trading securities, and (3) securities available-for-sale that are pledged to one or more secured parties who have the right to buy, sell, or re-pledge the collateral.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Notes Receivable, Related Parties
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount owed to the reporting entity in the form of loans and obligations (generally evidenced by promissory notes) made to the following types of related parties: a parent company and its subsidiaries; subsidiaries of a common parent; an entity and trust for the benefit of employees, such as pension and profit-sharing trusts that are managed by or under the trusteeship of the entity's management, an entity and its principal owners, management, or member of their immediate families, affiliates, or other parties with the ability to exert significant influence.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Option Premium Contracts Payable
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the period in the carrying amount of option premium contracts for energy-related commodities.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Deferred Liability
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in deferred obligations classified as other.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Fossil Fuel Inventories
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the value of fossil fuel, other than coal, held in inventory.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Outstanding Checks, Financing Activities
unclassified.description: The change in cash during the period due to the net increase or decrease in outstanding checks, the liability that represents checks that have been issued but that have not cleared. The entity may classify these cash flows as financing or operating activities.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Outstanding Checks, Operating Activities
unclassified.description: The change in cash during the period due to the net increase or decrease in outstanding checks, the liability that represents checks that have been issued but that have not cleared. The entity may classify these cash flows as financing or operating activities. Another element, Increase (Decrease) in Outstanding Checks, Financing Activities, represents cash flows from outstanding checks classified as financing activities.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in over Energy Recovery
unclassified.description: The change during the reporting period in the value of the asset created by an over recovery. An over recovery means that the basic energy product price based on the daily product price and exchange rate is less than the basic fuel price used in the calculation of the monthly retail energy product.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Postemployment Obligations
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the current portion of the liability that represents various benefits due to former or inactive employees, their beneficiaries, and covered dependents after employment but before retirement.

unclassified.label: IncreaseDecreaseInProfessionalFeePayable
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in fee payable for professional service, including, but not limited to, legal and accounting services.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Raw Materials, Packaging Materials and Supplies Inventories
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the value of raw materials, packaging materials and supplies held in inventory.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Recoverable Refundable Gas Costs
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the asset or liability created by a public utility's ability to recover gas costs that are higher or lower than the basic cost included in rate payer calculations.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Restricted Cash for Operating Activities
Increase (Decrease) in Risk Management Assets and Liabilities
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in fair value of financial instruments other than those that are purchased and held principally for the purpose of hedging or mitigating market risk, credit risk, legal risk, operational risk and other types of risk.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Self Insurance Reserve
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the period in the carrying amount of accrued known and estimated losses incurred for which no insurance coverage exists, and for which a claim has been made or is probable of being asserted, typically arising from workmen's' compensation-type of incidents and personal injury to nonemployees from accidents on the entity's property.

unclassified.label: Increase Due to Purchases of Minerals in Place
Increase in Unrecognized Tax Benefits is Reasonably Possible
unclassified.description: Amount of increase reasonably possible in the next twelve months for the unrecognized tax benefit.

unclassified.label: Indefinite-lived Intangible Assets Acquired
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in indefinite-lived asset acquired in business combination, asset acquisition, and from joint venture formation. Excludes goodwill.

unclassified.label: Insurance Commissions and Fees
unclassified.description: Income from agency and brokerage operations (includes sales of annuities and supplemental contracts); service charges, commissions, and fees from the sale of insurance and related services; and management fees from separate accounts, deferred annuities, and universal life products.

unclassified.label: Interest and Dividend Income, Operating
unclassified.description: Represents the total of interest and dividend income, including any amortization and accretion (as applicable) of discounts and premiums, earned from (1) loans and leases whether held-for-sale or held-in-portfolio; (2) investment securities; (3) federal funds sold; (4) securities purchased under agreements to resell; (5) investments in banker's acceptances, commercial paper, or certificates of deposit; (6) dividend income; or (7) other investments not otherwise specified herein.

unclassified.label: Interest and Fee Income, Other Loans
unclassified.description: Amount of interest and fee income from loans classified as other.
