unclassified.label: Interest-bearing Domestic Deposit, Certificates of Deposits
unclassified.description: Amount of interest-bearing domestic certificate of deposit liabilities.

unclassified.label: Interest-bearing Domestic Deposit, Checking
unclassified.description: Amount of interest-bearing domestic checking deposit liabilities.

unclassified.label: Interest-bearing Domestic Deposit, Money Market
unclassified.description: Amount of interest-bearing domestic money market demand account deposit liabilities.

unclassified.label: Interest-bearing Domestic Deposit, Savings
unclassified.description: Amount of interest-bearing domestic savings deposit liabilities. Saving deposits bear interest and have no stated maturity.

unclassified.label: Interest Expense, Beneficial Interests Issued by Consolidated Variable Interest Entities
unclassified.description: Interest expense on beneficial interests issued by consolidated variable interest entities.

unclassified.label: Interest Expense, Borrowings
unclassified.description: Aggregate amount of interest expense on all borrowings.

unclassified.label: Interest Expense, Commercial Paper
unclassified.description: Amount of interest expense on commercial paper.

unclassified.label: Interest Expense, Deposits
unclassified.description: Aggregate amount of interest expense on all deposits.

unclassified.label: Interest Expense, Lessee, Assets under Capital Lease
unclassified.description: The amount, during the lease term, of each minimum [capital] lease payment allocated to interest expense so as to produce a constant periodic rate of interest on the remaining balance of the capital lease obligation.

unclassified.label: Interest Expense, Long-term Debt and Capital Securities
unclassified.description: Total interest expense on long-term debt and capital securities.

unclassified.label: Interest Expense, Money Market Deposits
unclassified.description: Interest expense incurred on all money market deposits.

unclassified.label: Interest Expense, Savings Deposits
unclassified.description: Interest expense incurred on all savings account deposits.

unclassified.label: Interest Expense, Time Deposits
unclassified.description: The aggregate interest expense incurred on time deposits, including certificates of deposits, in domestic offices.

unclassified.label: Interest Income, Deposits with Financial Institutions
unclassified.description: Interest income derived from funds deposited with both domestic and foreign financial institutions including funds in money market and other accounts.

unclassified.label: InterestIncomeInterestEarningAsset
unclassified.description: Amount of interest income from interest-earning asset.

unclassified.label: Interest Income, Securities, Operating, Tax Exempt
unclassified.description: Amount of operating interest income, including amortization and accretion of premiums and discounts, on securities exempt from state, federal and other income tax.

unclassified.label: Interest Income, Securities, Operating, Taxable
unclassified.description: Amount of operating interest income, including amortization and accretion of premiums and discounts, on securities subject to state, federal and other income tax.

unclassified.label: Interest Portion of Minimum Lease Payments, Sale Leaseback Transactions
unclassified.description: Amount necessary to reduce minimum lease payments to present value for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing.

unclassified.label: Interest Rate Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments, Asset at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all derivative assets not designated as hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Interest Rate Fair Value Hedge Asset at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all derivative assets designated as interest rate fair value hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Interest Receivable
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of interest earned but not received. Also called accrued interest or accrued interest receivable.

unclassified.label: Inventory, Finished Goods and Work in Process, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount before valuation reserves of merchandise or goods held by the entity that are readily available for sale and items held by the entity which are partially complete or in the process of being readied for sale.

unclassified.label: Inventory, Finished Goods and Work in Process, Net of Reserves
unclassified.description: The aggregated amount of merchandise or goods held by the entity and readily available for future sale plus items held by the entity which are partially complete or in the process of being readied for future sale. This amount is net of valuation reserves and adjustments.

unclassified.label: Inventory, Gross
unclassified.description: Gross amount, as of the balance sheet date, of merchandise, goods, commodities, or supplies held for future sale or to be used in manufacturing, servicing or production process.

unclassified.label: Inventory, LIFO Reserve
unclassified.description: Amount by which inventory stated at last-in first-out (LIFO) is less than (in excess of) inventory stated at other inventory cost methods.

unclassified.label: Inventory, Parts and Components, Net of Reserves
unclassified.description: Carrying amount, net of valuation reserves and adjustments, as of the balance sheet date for elements of machinery or equipment held for the purpose of replacing similar parts in the course of repair or maintenance.

unclassified.label: Inventory, Raw Materials, Net of Reserves
unclassified.description: Carrying amount, net of valuation reserves and adjustments, as of the balance sheet date of unprocessed items to be consumed in the manufacturing or production process.

unclassified.label: Inventory Recall Expense
unclassified.description: Reflects the amount charged against earnings comprised of the costs to announce and effect a recall of defective merchandise.

unclassified.label: Inventory, Work in Process and Raw Materials
unclassified.description: The aggregate carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of items held by the entity which are partially completed at the time of measurement and unprocessed items that will go through the production process and become part of the final product. Includes supplies used directly or indirectly in the manufacturing or production process. This element may be used when the reporting entity combines work in process and raw materials into an aggregate amount.

unclassified.label: Inventory, Work in Process, Net of Reserves
unclassified.description: Carrying amount, net of reserves and adjustments, as of the balance sheet date of merchandise or goods which are partially completed. This inventory is generally comprised of raw materials, labor and factory overhead costs, which require further materials, labor and overhead to be converted into finished goods, and which generally require the use of estimates to determine percentage complete and pricing.

unclassified.label: Investment Banking, Advisory, Brokerage, and Underwriting Fees and Commissions
unclassified.description: Amount of fees and commissions from banking, advisory, brokerage, and securities underwriting activities. Activities include, but are not limited to, underwriting securities, private placements of securities, investment advisory and management services, merger and acquisition services, sale and servicing of mutual funds, and other related consulting fees.

unclassified.label: Investment Income, Dividend
unclassified.description: Amount of dividend income on nonoperating securities.

unclassified.label: Investment Income, Net, Amortization of Discount and Premium
unclassified.description: Amount of accretion (amortization) of purchase discount (premium) on nonoperating securities.

unclassified.label: Investment Income, Nonoperating
unclassified.description: The aggregate amount of income from investments (for example, dividends) not considered a component of the entity's core operations.

unclassified.label: Investment Interest Rate
unclassified.description: Rate of interest on investment.

unclassified.label: Investment Owned, at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of investment in security owned.

unclassified.label: Investment Owned, Percent of Net Assets
unclassified.description: Percentage of investment owned to net assets.

unclassified.label: Investment Owned, Subject to Option, Price
Investment Owned, Unrecognized Unrealized Appreciation
unclassified.description: This element represents the excess of the cost (face amount, notional amount) of an investment (security, contract) over its fair value which deficiency has not been recognized in earnings of the entity.

unclassified.label: Investment Owned, Unrecognized Unrealized Depreciation
unclassified.description: This element represents the excess of the cost (face amount, notional amount) of an investment (security, contract) over its fair value which deficiency has not been recognized in earnings of the entity.

unclassified.label: Investments and Cash
unclassified.description: Sum of investments and unrestricted cash as of the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Investments in Affiliates, Subsidiaries, Associates, and Joint Ventures, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of investments in an entity not consolidated. Includes, but is not limited to, investments in an entity that is affiliated with the reporting entity by means of direct or indirect ownership, an entity in which the reporting entity shares control of the entity with another party or group, an entity which the company has significant influence, but does not have control and subsidiaries that are not required to be consolidated and are accounted for using the equity or cost method.

unclassified.label: Investments in and Advances to Affiliates, at Fair Value, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in the investments in and advances to affiliates.

unclassified.label: Investments in Power and Distribution Projects
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of investments in power and distribution projects that are expected to be realized after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Jointly Owned Utility Plant, Proportionate Ownership Share
unclassified.description: The proportionate share of interest (percent) in a jointly owned utility plant.

unclassified.label: Junior Subordinated Debenture Owed to Unconsolidated Subsidiary Trust
unclassified.description: Including the current and noncurrent portions, the carrying value of junior subordinated long-term debt owed to unconsolidated subsidiary trusts as of the balance sheet date. Such debt places a lender in a lien position behind debt having a higher priority of repayment in liquidation of the entity's assets and was initially scheduled to be repaid after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle if longer.

unclassified.label: Junior Subordinated Debenture Owed to Unconsolidated Subsidiary Trust, Current
unclassified.description: The current portion of the carrying value of junior subordinated long-term debt owed to unconsolidated subsidiary trusts as of the balance sheet date. Such debt places a lender in a lien position behind debt having a higher priority of repayment in liquidation of the entity's assets and was initially scheduled to be repaid after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle if longer.

unclassified.label: Land and Land Improvements
unclassified.description: Amount before accumulated depreciation and depletion of real estate held for productive use and additions or improvements to real estate held for productive use, examples include, but are not limited to, walkways, driveways, fences, and parking lots. Excludes land held for sale.

unclassified.label: Lease Deposit Liability
unclassified.description: Amount of liability for lease payments received, including variable lease payments, when collectability is not probable at commencement date for sales-type lease.

unclassified.label: Lease Incentive Receivable
unclassified.description: This item represents a receivable for an incentive or inducement contractually stipulated between parties to a lease whereby the lessor has committed to provide the entity (lessee) with a cash payment as inducement to enter the lease.

unclassified.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Discount Rate
unclassified.description: Discount rate used by lessee to determine present value of operating lease payments.

unclassified.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, Payments, Due after Rolling Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments for operating lease, due after fifth rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

unclassified.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, Payments, Due in Rolling Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments for operating lease, due in fifth rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

unclassified.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, Payments, Due in Rolling Year Four
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments for operating lease, due in fourth rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

unclassified.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, Payments, Due in Rolling Year Three
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments for operating lease, due in third rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

unclassified.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, Payments, Due in Rolling Year Two
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments for operating lease, due in second rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

unclassified.label: Lessor, Direct Financing Lease, Lease Not yet Commenced, Assumption and Judgment, Value of Underlying Asset, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount lessor expects from underlying asset following end of direct financing lease term for lease that has not yet commenced.

unclassified.label: Lessor, Operating Lease, Payments to be Received, Next Rolling Twelve Months
unclassified.description: Amount of lease payments to be received by lessor in next rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date for operating lease. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

unclassified.label: Leveraged Lease Investment
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of leveraged lease investments which represent the aggregate amount of the estimated residual value of the lease assets and lease payments receivables, net of unearned and deferred income to be allocated over the lease term and non-recourse debt.

unclassified.label: Leveraged Leases, Income Statement, Income from Leveraged Leases
unclassified.description: Pretax lease income allocated in proportionate amounts from unearned income.

unclassified.label: Leveraged Leases, Income Statement, Income Tax Expense on Leveraged Leases
unclassified.description: The tax effect from the current year income from arrangements meeting the criteria for classification as a leveraged lease.

unclassified.label: Leveraged Leases, Income Statement, Investment Tax Credit Recognized on Leveraged Leases
unclassified.description: Amount of investment tax credit recognized as income.

unclassified.label: Leveraged Leases, Net Investment in Leveraged Leases Disclosure, Deferred Income
unclassified.description: The estimated portion of pretax income and investment tax credit remaining to be allocated to income over the lease term.

unclassified.label: Leveraged Leases, Net Investment in Leveraged Leases Disclosure, Deferred Taxes Arising from Leveraged Leases
unclassified.description: Taxes arising from arrangements meeting the criteria for classification as leveraged leases due to timing differences between accounting and tax income recognition.

unclassified.label: Leveraged Leases, Net Investment in Leveraged Leases Disclosure, Investment in Leveraged Leases, Net
unclassified.description: The net investment in arrangements meeting the criteria for classification as leveraged leases including deferred taxes.

unclassified.label: Leveraged Leases, Net Investment in Leveraged Leases Disclosure, Rental Receivables, Net
unclassified.description: This element represents leveraged lease rentals receivable, net of that portion of the rental applicable to principal and interest on the nonrecourse debt.

unclassified.label: Leveraged Leases, Net Investment in Leveraged Leases Disclosure, Residual Value of Leased Assets
unclassified.description: The estimate of the value of the leased asset at the end of the lease term.

unclassified.label: Liabilities Subject to Compromise
unclassified.description: Total amount of liabilities subject to compromise.

unclassified.label: Liabilities Subject to Compromise, Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities
unclassified.description: The amount of trade accounts payable included in liabilities subject to compromise.

unclassified.label: Liabilities Subject to Compromise, Early Contract Termination Fees
unclassified.description: The amount of early contract termination fees included in liabilities subject to compromise.

unclassified.label: Liabilities Subject to Compromise, Other Liabilities
unclassified.description: The amount of other obligations included in liabilities subject to compromise.

unclassified.label: Liability Subject to Compromise, Pension and Other Postretirement Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation
unclassified.description: Amount classified as pension and other postretirement obligations included in liability subject to compromise.

unclassified.label: Liability for Asbestos and Environmental Claims, Gross
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of reserves for the costs of settling insured claims and costs incurred in the claims settlement process attributable to asbestos and environmental claims, before estimated recoveries from reinsurers.

unclassified.label: Liability for Title Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense
unclassified.description: The amount needed to reflect the estimated ultimate cost of settling asserted and unasserted claims estimated to have been incurred by the insureds on or before the balance sheet date pertaining to the existence of a lien, encumbrance, defect or other matter purportedly affecting the title to the interest as insured.

unclassified.label: Liability for Uncertainty in Income Taxes, Current
unclassified.description: Amount recognized for uncertainty in income taxes classified as current.

unclassified.label: Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Net
unclassified.description: Liability as of the balance sheet date for amounts representing estimated cost of settling unpaid claims under the terms of the underlying insurance policies, less estimated reinsurance recoveries on such claims. This includes an estimate for claims which have been incurred but not reported. Claim adjustment expenses represent the costs estimated to be incurred in the settlement of unpaid claims.

unclassified.label: Limited Partners' Capital Account, Distribution Amount
unclassified.description: The total amount of distributions to limited partners.

unclassified.label: Line of Credit Facility, Capacity Available for Specific Purpose Other than for Trade Purchases
unclassified.description: The maximum amount of borrowing capacity under a line of credit that is available as of the balance sheet date for a specific purpose other than for financing goods acquired for inventory or imminent delivery to a customer.

unclassified.label: Line of Credit Facility, Commitment Fee Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the fee for available but unused credit capacity under the credit facility.

unclassified.label: Line of Credit Facility, Increase, Additional Borrowings (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Line of Credit Facility, Interest Rate During Period
unclassified.description: The effective interest rate during the reporting period.

unclassified.label: Line of Credit Facility, Periodic Payment, Interest
unclassified.description: Amount of the required periodic payment applied to interest.

unclassified.label: Estimated Litigation Liability, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Carrying amount of estimated litigation liability for known or estimated probable loss from litigation, which may include attorneys' fees and other litigation costs, which is expected to be paid after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: LitigationSettlementGain
unclassified.description: Amount of gain from litigation settlement for amount awarded from other party. Excludes claims within an insurance entity's normal claims settlement process.

unclassified.label: Litigation Settlement Interest
unclassified.description: Interest expense (income) directly attributable to an award in settlement of litigation.

unclassified.label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Gross, Commercial (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Loans and Leases Receivable, Commitments to Purchase or Sell
unclassified.description: Amount of financing receivable commitment to purchase or sell.

unclassified.label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount before allowance of loans and leases held in portfolio, including but not limited to, commercial and consumer loans. Includes deferred interest and fees, undisbursed portion of loan balance, unamortized costs and premiums and discounts from face amounts. Excludes loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements.

unclassified.label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Loans in Process
unclassified.description: Amount of undisbursed portion of the loan receivable balance (loans in process). Excludes loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements.

unclassified.label: Loans from Other Federal Home Loan Banks
unclassified.description: Amount of Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) loans from another FHLBank.

unclassified.label: Loans Payable to Bank
unclassified.description: Including the current and noncurrent portions, carrying value as of the balance sheet date of loans from a bank with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle if longer.

unclassified.label: Loans Receivable, Gross, Commercial, Real Estate (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Loans Receivable, Net (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
Financing Receivable, Held-for-Sale, Not Part of Disposal Group, after Valuation Allowance
unclassified.description: Amount, after valuation allowance, of financing receivable held for sale and not part of disposal group. Excludes loan covered under loss sharing agreement and loan classified as investment in debt security.

unclassified.label: Long Lived Assets Held-for-sale, Proceeds from Sale (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Long-term Contract for Purchase of Electric Power, Amount of Long-term Debt or Lease Obligation Outstanding
unclassified.description: Under long-term contracts with public utility districts, cooperatives or other organizations, a utility company receives a portion of the output of a production plant constructed and financed by the district or cooperative. The utility has only a nominal or no investment at all in the plant but pays a proportionate part of the plant's costs, including debt service.

unclassified.label: Long-term Contract for Purchase of Electric Power, Annual Minimum Debt Service Payment Required
unclassified.description: Under long-term contracts with public utility districts, cooperatives or other organizations, a utility company receives a portion of the output of a production plant constructed and financed by the district or cooperative. The utility has only a nominal or no investment at all in the plant but pays a proportionate part of the plant's costs, including debt service. If the utility is obligated to pay certain minimum amounts which cover debt service requirements whether or not the plant is operating, the amount can be disclosed here.

unclassified.label: Long-term Contract for Purchase of Electric Power, Estimated Annual Cost
unclassified.description: Estimated annual cost to purchase electricity under a long-term contract from a production plant constructed and financed by a public utility district, cooperative, or other organization.

unclassified.label: Long-term Debt and Capital Lease Obligations, Maturities, Repayments of Principal Remainder of Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount of long-term debt and capital lease obligation maturing in the remainder of the fiscal year following the latest fiscal year ended.

unclassified.label: Long-term Debt, Maturities, Repayments of Principal in Rolling Year Two
unclassified.description: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirements, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable prices and dates maturing in the second rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Notes and Loans, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of all notes and loans payable (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer), excluding current portion.

unclassified.label: Long-term Debt, Percentage Bearing Variable Interest, Amount
unclassified.description: The portion of the carrying amount of long-term borrowings outstanding as of the balance sheet date, including current maturities, which accrues interest at a rate subject to change from time to time.

unclassified.label: Long-term Debt, Weighted Average Interest Rate, at Point in Time
unclassified.description: Weighted average interest rate of long-term debt outstanding calculated at point in time.

unclassified.label: Loss Contingency Accrual, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in loss contingency liability.

unclassified.label: Loss Contingency, Claims Settled, Number
unclassified.description: Number of claims settled.

unclassified.label: Loss Contingency, Range of Possible Loss, Portion Not Accrued
unclassified.description: The difference between the maximum amount of estimated loss and the amount recorded as of the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Loss on Contracts
unclassified.description: Losses recognized in the current period on contracts which are expected to generate losses, which are probable and can be reasonably estimated, in a future period.

unclassified.label: Loss on Derivative Instruments, Pretax
unclassified.description: Aggregate loss on all derivative instruments charged against earnings during the period, before tax effects.

unclassified.label: Loss on Discontinuation of Cash Flow Hedge Due to Forecasted Transaction Probable of Not Occurring
unclassified.description: The amount of loss reclassified into earnings in the period when cash flow hedge is discontinued because it is probable that the original forecasted transactions will not occur by the end of the original period or an additional two month time period.

unclassified.label: Loss on Sale of Investments
unclassified.description: The difference between the carrying value and the sale price of an investment. A loss would be recognized when the sale price of the investment is less than the carrying value of the investment. This element refers to the Loss included in earnings and not to the cash proceeds of the sale.

unclassified.label: Malpractice Loss Contingency, Letters of Credit and Surety Bonds
unclassified.description: Amount of letters of credit and other surety bonds that are available for the future payment of malpractice claims.

unclassified.label: Management Fee Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of expense for investment management fee, including, but not limited to, expense in connection with research, selection, supervision, and custody of investment.

unclassified.label: Marketable Securities, Unrealized Gain (Loss), Excluding Other-than-temporary Impairment Loss
unclassified.description: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in marketable security, excluding other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI).

unclassified.label: Marketing and Advertising Expense
unclassified.description: The total expense recognized in the period for promotion, public relations, and brand or product advertising.

unclassified.label: Maturities of Senior Debt
unclassified.description: The cash outflow for the settlement of long-term borrowing, with the highest claim on the assets of the entity in case of bankruptcy or liquidation, as it matures.

unclassified.label: Minimum Lease Payments, Sale Leaseback Transactions
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing.

unclassified.label: Noncontrolling Interest in Limited Partnerships
unclassified.description: Carrying amount of the equity interests owned by noncontrolling partners of a limited partnership included in the entity's consolidated financial statements.

unclassified.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest, Operating Partnerships (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest, Other (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Noncontrolling Interest in Preferred Unit Holders
unclassified.description: Carrying amount of the equity interests owned by noncontrolling preferred unit holders in an entity included in the reporting entity's consolidated financial statements.

unclassified.label: Multiemployer Plan, Employer Contribution, Cost
unclassified.description: Amount of cost for employer contribution to multiemployer plan. Multiemployer plan includes, but is not limited to, pension plan determined to be individually significant and insignificant and other postretirement benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Multiemployer Plan, Pension, Insignificant, Employees Covered by Collective-Bargaining Arrangement to All Participants, Percentage
unclassified.description: Percentage of entity's employees covered by collective-bargaining arrangement (CBA) to all participants in multiemployer pension plan determined to be individually insignificant.

unclassified.label: Multiemployer Plans, Withdrawal Obligation
unclassified.description: Amount of the obligation recognized by withdrawing from a pension or postretirement benefit plan to which two or more unrelated employers contribute where assets contributed by one participating employer may be used to provide benefits to employees of other participating employers.

unclassified.label: Net Asset Value Per Share
unclassified.description: Net asset value per share or per unit of investments in certain entities that calculate net asset value per share. Includes, but is not limited to, by unit, membership interest, or other ownership interest. Investment includes, but is not limited to, investment in certain hedge funds, venture capital funds, private equity funds, real estate partnerships or funds. Excludes fair value disclosure.

unclassified.label: Derivative Instruments in Hedges, Net Investment in Foreign Operations, Assets, Fair Value, Net
unclassified.description: Net fair value of all derivatives designated as hedges of net investment in foreign operations.

unclassified.label: Net Investment in Direct Financing and Sales Type Leases
unclassified.description: The net amount due as of the balance sheet date consisting of: (a) minimum lease payments due on direct financing and sales-type leases, (b) unguaranteed residual value, and (c) any unamortized initial direct costs on direct financing leases; less: (i) executory costs, (ii) unearned income, and (iii) the accumulated allowance for uncollectible minimum lease payments.

unclassified.label: NetInvestmentInLeaseExcludingAccruedInterestBeforeAllowanceForCreditLoss
unclassified.description: Amount excluding accrued interest, before allowance for credit loss, of net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases.

unclassified.label: NetInvestmentInLeaseExcludingAccruedInterestBeforeAllowanceForCreditLossCurrent
unclassified.description: Amount excluding accrued interest, before allowance for credit loss, of net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases, classified as current.

unclassified.label: NetInvestmentInLeaseExcludingAccruedInterestBeforeAllowanceForCreditLossNoncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount excluding accrued interest, before allowance for credit loss, of net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases, classified as noncurrent.

unclassified.label: Net Investment Income
unclassified.description: Amount, after investment expense, of income earned from investments in securities and real estate. Includes, but is not limited to, real estate investment, policy loans, dividends, and interest. Excludes realized gain (loss) on investments.

unclassified.label: New Accounting Pronouncement or Change in Accounting Principle, Cumulative Effect of Change on Equity or Net Assets (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
New Accounting Pronouncement or Change in Accounting Principle, Effect of Change on Basic Earnings Per Share (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
New Accounting Pronouncement or Change in Accounting Principle, Effect of Change on Diluted Earnings Per Share (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
New Accounting Pronouncement or Change in Accounting Principle, Effect of Change on Operating Results (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Noncash Merger Related Costs
unclassified.description: Amount of expense (income) related to the increase (decrease) in reserve for business combination costs. Includes, but is not limited to, legal, accounting, and other costs incurred to consummate the merger.

unclassified.label: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Debt Assumed (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Employee Benefit Liabilities Assumed
unclassified.description: The amount of employee benefit liabilities that an Entity assumes in acquiring a business or in consideration for an asset received in a noncash (or part noncash) acquisition. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

unclassified.label: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Intangible Assets Acquired (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Net Nonmonetary Assets Acquired (Liabilities Assumed)
unclassified.description: The net book value of a nonmonetary asset transferred or exchanged in connection with the acquisition of a business or asset in a noncash transaction. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. Nonmonetary assets and liabilities are assets and liabilities that will not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the future.

unclassified.label: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Value of Assets Acquired (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Noncash Project Abandonment Costs
unclassified.description: The expense charged against earnings to eliminate the capitalized costs of projects that have been terminated during the reporting period, which is added back to net income when calculating cash provided by (used in) operations using the indirect method.

unclassified.label: Noncontrolling Interest in Net Income (Loss) Preferred Unit Holders, Nonredeemable
unclassified.description: Amount after tax of income (loss) attributable to nonredeemable noncontrolling preferred unit holders.

unclassified.label: Nondebtor Reorganization Items, Net (Gain) Loss on Settlement of Other Claims
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) on settlement of other claims for entities not in bankruptcy, reported as a reorganization item.

unclassified.label: Noninterest-bearing Deposit Liabilities
unclassified.description: The aggregate amount of all domestic and foreign noninterest-bearing deposits liabilities held by the entity.

unclassified.label: Noninterest-bearing Domestic Deposit, Checking
unclassified.description: Amount of noninterest-bearing domestic checking deposit liabilities.

unclassified.label: Noninterest Income, Other Operating Income
unclassified.description: Amount of revenue earned, classified as other, excluding interest income.

unclassified.label: Nonmonetary Notional Amount of Price Risk Cash Flow Hedge Derivatives (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Nonredeemable Noncontrolling Interest
unclassified.description: Portion of equity (net assets) in a subsidiary not attributable, directly or indirectly, to the parent entity which is not redeemable by the parent entity.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
unclassified.description: Amortized cost, before allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable classified as current. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amortized cost, before allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable classified as noncurrent. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: Notes Payable, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of notes payable.

unclassified.label: Notes Payable to Bank, Current
unclassified.description: Current portion of the total carrying amount as of the balance sheet date due within one year or the operating cycle, if longer, on all notes payable to banks paid on an installment with long term maturities. This can include the amount of any loans from the applicant firm. This does not, however, include any mortgage balances.

unclassified.label: Notional Amount of Cash Flow Hedge Instruments (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Notional Amount of Derivative Instruments Designated as Net Investment Hedges (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Notional Amount of Foreign Currency Cash Flow Hedge Derivatives (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Notional Amount of Net Investment Hedge Instruments (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Notional Amount of Nonderivative Instruments Designated as Net Investment Hedges (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Number of Countries in which Entity Operates
unclassified.description: The number of countries in which the entity operates as of balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Obligation to Return Securities Received as Collateral
unclassified.description: The fair value of collateral received by the entity associated with securities borrowed that must be returned if the counterparty fulfills its obligations. It appears on the balance sheet as a liability and has a corresponding asset that appears on the balance sheet called Securities Received as Collateral.

unclassified.label: OCI, before Reclassifications, before Tax, Attributable to Parent
unclassified.description: Amount before tax and reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss) attributable to parent.

unclassified.label: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Transfer to Held-to-Maturity, Adjustment from AOCI for Amortization of Gain (Loss), after Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for amortization of gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) from transfer to investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

unclassified.label: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Transfer to Held-to-Maturity, Adjustment from AOCI for Amortization of Gain (Loss), Tax
unclassified.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) on adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for amortization of gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) from transfer to investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

unclassified.label: OCI, Equity Method Investment, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, of other comprehensive income (loss) (OCI) for proportionate share of equity method investee's OCI.

unclassified.label: OciMarketRiskBenefitInstrumentSpecificCreditRiskGainLossBeforeAdjustmentsAfterTax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax and before adjustments, of unrealized gain (loss) from (increase) decrease in instrument-specific credit risk on contract or contract feature in long-duration contract issued by insurance entity that both protects contract holder from other-than-nominal capital market risk and exposes insurance entity to other-than-nominal capital market risk.

unclassified.label: OciMarketRiskBenefitInstrumentSpecificCreditRiskGainLossReclassificationAdjustmentFromAociAfterTax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income for gain (loss) (AOCI) from (increase) decrease in instrument-specific credit risk on contract or contract feature in long-duration contract issued by insurance entity that both protects contract holder from other-than-nominal capital market risk and exposes insurance entity to other-than-nominal capital market risk, realized in income upon derecognition for benefit.

unclassified.label: Off-Balance Sheet, Credit Loss, Liability, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
unclassified.description: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for expected credit loss for off-balance sheet credit exposure. Excludes off-balance sheet credit exposure accounted for as insurance and instrument accounted for under derivatives and hedging.

unclassified.label: Salary and Wage, Officer, Excluding Cost of Good and Service Sold
unclassified.description: Amount of expense for salary and wage arising from service rendered by officer. Excludes allocated cost, labor-related nonsalary expense, and direct and overhead labor cost included in cost of good and service sold.

unclassified.label: Oil and Gas Property, Full Cost Method, Net
unclassified.description: Amount, after accumulated depletion, of oil and gas properties subject to amortization accounted for under full cost method.

unclassified.label: Oil and Gas Sales Payable, Current
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable to third parties for oil and gas that has been sold but not delivered. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

unclassified.label: Operating Lease, Impairment Loss
unclassified.description: Amount of loss from impairment of right-of-use asset from operating lease.

unclassified.label: Operating Lease, Payments, Use
unclassified.description: Amount of cash outflow from operating lease to bring another asset to condition and location necessary for its intended use.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments Due, Future Minimum Sublease Rentals
unclassified.description: Contractually required future rental payments receivable on noncancelable subleasing arrangements.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Rolling Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the fifth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Rolling Year Four
unclassified.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the fourth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Rolling Year Three
unclassified.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the third rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Rolling Year Two
unclassified.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the second rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Next Rolling Twelve Months
unclassified.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the next rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments Receivable, Remainder of Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments receivable in the remainder of the fiscal year following the latest fiscal year ended for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable letter-terms in excess of one year.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Income Statement, Depreciation Expense on Property Subject to or Held-for-lease
unclassified.description: Amount of depreciation expense for lessor's underlying asset for which right to use has been conveyed to lessee under operating lease.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Rent Expense, Contingent Rentals
unclassified.description: The increases or decreases in lease payments that result from changes occurring after the inception of the lease in the factors (other than the passage of time) on which lease payments are based, except that any escalation of minimum lease payments relating to increases in construction or acquisition cost of the leased property or for increases in some measure of cost or value during the construction or preconstruction period, are excluded from contingent rentals. Contingent rentals also may include amounts for which the triggering events have not yet occurred or the specified targets for which have not yet been achieved (such as sales based percentage rent), but which events are considered probable of occurring or which specified targets are considered probable of being achieved.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Rent Expense, Minimum Rentals
unclassified.description: This element represents the payments that the lessee is obligated to make or can be required to make in connection with a property under the terms of an agreement classified as an operating lease, excluding contingent rentals and a guarantee by the lessee of the lessor's debt and the lessee's obligation to pay (apart from the rental payments) executory costs such as insurance, maintenance, and taxes.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Rent Expense, Sublease Rentals
unclassified.description: The total amount of sublease rental income recognized during the period that reduces the entity's rent expense incurred under operating leases.

unclassified.label: Option Indexed to Issuer's Equity, Settlement Alternatives, Cash, at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Amount that would be paid upon settlement of option contract indexed to equity.

unclassified.label: Option Indexed to Issuer's Equity, Shares
unclassified.description: Maximum number of shares that could be issued to settle option contract indexed to equity.

unclassified.label: Origination of Notes Receivable from Related Parties
unclassified.description: The cash outflow for a loan, supported by a promissory note, granted to related parties where one party can exercise control or significant influence over another party; including affiliates, owners or officers and their immediate families, pension trusts, and so forth.

unclassified.label: Other Adjustments for Noncash Items Included in Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations (Deprecated 2009-01-31)
Other Assets, Miscellaneous, Current
unclassified.description: Amount of other miscellaneous assets expected to be realized or consumed within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Other Cash Equivalents, at Carrying Value
unclassified.description: Amount of short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates, classified as other. Excludes cash and cash equivalents within disposal group and discontinued operation.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Available-for-sale Securities Adjustment, before Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Available-for-sale Securities Adjustment, Net of Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax and reclassification adjustment, of gain (loss) in value of unsold investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), attributable to parent.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Available-for-sale Securities, Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent
unclassified.description: Amount, after reclassification adjustment, of tax expense (benefit) for gain (loss) in value of unsold investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), attributable to parent.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Effect of Change in Accounting Principle, before Taxes (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Effect of Change in Accounting Principle, Net of Taxes (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Pension and Other Postretirement Benefit Plans, Adjustment, before Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, before Tax, after Reclassification Adjustment, Attributable to Parent
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, after reclassification adjustment, of (increase) decrease in accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss for defined benefit plan, attributable to parent entity.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivatives Qualifying as Hedges, Net of Tax, Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
unclassified.description: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments, of increase (decrease) in accumulated gain (loss) from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's increase (decrease) in deferred hedging gain (loss), attributable to noncontrolling interests.

unclassified.label: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Gain (Loss), after Adjustment, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax and after adjustment, of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) and unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to available-for-sale.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss) before Reclassifications, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) allocated to other comprehensive income (loss) before reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income (loss).

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), before Tax, Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
unclassified.description: Amount before tax of other comprehensive income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interests.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), after Reclassification, Tax, Parent
unclassified.description: Amount, after reclassification, of tax expense (benefit) for gain (loss) from derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness, attributable to parent.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), before Reclassification and Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax and reclassification, of gain (loss) from derivative instrument designated and qualifying cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivative, Excluded Component, Increase (Decrease), after Adjustments and Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax and adjustments, of gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in value of excluded component of derivative designated and qualifying as hedge. Adjustments include, but are not limited to, reclassifications for sale and settlement, and amounts recognized under systematic and rational method.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivative, Excluded Component, Increase (Decrease), before Adjustments, after Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax and before adjustments, of gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in value of excluded component of derivative designated and qualifying as hedge. Adjustments include, but are not limited to, reclassifications for sale and settlement, and amounts recognized under systematic and rational method.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivative, Excluded Component, Increase (Decrease), before Adjustments, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before adjustments, of tax expense (benefit) for gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in value of excluded component of derivative designated and qualifying as hedge. Adjustments include, but are not limited to, reclassifications for sale and settlement, and amounts recognized under systematic and rational method.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Settlement and Curtailment Gain (Loss), before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, of increase (decrease) to other comprehensive income from settlement and curtailment gain (loss) of defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Financial Liability, Fair Value Option, after Reclassification Adjustment, Tax, Attributable to Parent
unclassified.description: Amount, after reclassification adjustment, of tax expense (benefit) of gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in instrument-specific credit risk of financial liability measured under fair value option, attributable to parent.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Adjustment, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount before tax, after reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, Realized upon Sale or Liquidation, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount before tax of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income for translation gain (loss) realized upon the sale or liquidation of an investment in a foreign entity and foreign currency hedges that are designated and qualified as hedging instruments for hedges of the foreign currency exposure of a net investment in a foreign operation.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, Realized upon Sale or Liquidation, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income for translation gain (loss) realized upon the sale or liquidation of an investment in a foreign entity and foreign currency hedges that are designated and qualified as hedging instruments for hedges of the foreign currency exposure of a net investment in a foreign operation.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Reclassification Adjustment Realized upon Sale or Liquidation, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Translation Reclassification Adjustment Realized upon Sale or Liquidation, Tax (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net Investment Hedge, Gain (Loss), Reclassification, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, of reclassification from accumulated other comprehensive income (AOCI) for gain (loss) from derivative designated and qualifying as net investment hedge.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment for Sale of Securities Included in Net Income, before Tax (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Transition Asset (Obligation), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) for reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for transition asset (obligation) of defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Tax, Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
unclassified.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) allocated to other comprehensive income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment for Sale of Securities Included in Net Income, before Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment for Write-down of Securities Included in Net Income, Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)

Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification, Pension and Other Postretirement Benefit Plans, Net Transition Asset (Obligation), Recognized in Net Periodic Benefit Cost, before Tax (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Other Deferred Credits, Current
unclassified.description: Amount of unearned revenue or income classified as other, expected to be taken into income within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Other Income Tax Expense (Benefit), Continuing Operations
unclassified.description: Amount of other current and other deferred income tax expense (benefit) attributable to continuing operations.

unclassified.label: Other Inventory, Net of Reserves
unclassified.description: Amount, after of valuation reserves and allowances, of inventory, classified as other, expected to be sold, or consumed within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Other Investments and Securities, at Cost
unclassified.description: Includes other investments and securities that are not at fair value as of the balance sheet date and those that are not accounted for under the equity method.

unclassified.label: Other Liabilities, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of other liabilities.

unclassified.label: Other Noncontrolling Interests
unclassified.description: Carrying amount of equity interests owned by noncontrolling shareholders, partners, or other equity holders in one or more of the entities consolidated into the reporting entity's financial statements other than joint ventures, limited partnerships, operating partnerships or interests held by preferred unit holders.

unclassified.label: Other Noninterest Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of noninterest expense classified as other.

unclassified.label: Other Nonrecurring Gain
unclassified.description: Amount of gain that is infrequent in occurrence or unusual in nature.

unclassified.label: Other Partners' Capital
unclassified.description: Amount of other partners' capital.

unclassified.label: Liability, Other Retirement Benefits, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount of liability, classified as noncurrent, for retirement benefits, classified as other.

unclassified.label: Other Research and Development Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of other research and development expense.

unclassified.label: Other Restricted Assets
unclassified.description: Total assets that cannot be used for operating purposes because of contract or regulatory requirements that are in effect for a period that extends beyond one year.

unclassified.label: Other Restructuring Costs
unclassified.description: Amount of other expenses associated with exit or disposal activities pursuant to an authorized plan. Excludes expenses associated with a discontinued operation or an asset retirement obligation.

unclassified.label: Other Sundry Liabilities
unclassified.description: The aggregate carrying amount, as of the balance sheets date, of obligations not otherwise itemized or categorized in the footnotes to the financial statements.

unclassified.label: Other than Temporary Impairment, Credit Losses Recognized in Earnings, Additions, Additional Credit Losses
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in accumulated credit loss recognized in earnings for other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI) of debt security held for which previous OTTI was recognized in other comprehensive income (OCI), investor does not intend to sell debt security, and it is not more likely than not that investor will be required to sell debt security before recovery of its amortized cost basis.

unclassified.label: Other than Temporary Impairment, Credit Losses Recognized in Earnings, Additions, No Previous Impairment
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in accumulated credit loss recognized in earnings for other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI) of debt security held for which no OTTI was previously recognized.

unclassified.label: Other than Temporary Impairment, Credit Losses Recognized in Earnings, Credit Losses on Debt Securities Held
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated credit loss recognized in earnings for debt security held for which portion of other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI) was recognized in other comprehensive income (OCI).

unclassified.label: Other than Temporary Impairment, Credit Losses Recognized in Earnings, Reductions, Securities Sold
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in accumulated credit loss recognized in earnings for other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI) of debt security from sale of impaired security.

unclassified.label: Other-than-temporary Impairment Loss, Debt Securities, Portion Recognized in Earnings
unclassified.description: Amount of other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI) on investment in debt security, recognized in earnings.

unclassified.label: Other-than-temporary Impairment Loss, Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Portion in Other Comprehensive Loss, before Tax, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, of other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), recognized in other comprehensive income (OCI).

unclassified.label: Other than Temporary Impairment Losses, Investments, Portion in Other Comprehensive Loss, Net of Tax, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
unclassified.description: Amount after tax of other than temporary impairment (OTTI) loss on investments in available-for-sale and held-to-maturity debt securities, recognized in other comprehensive loss.

unclassified.label: Other than Temporary Impairment Losses, Investments, Portion in Other Comprehensive Loss, Tax, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
unclassified.description: Amount of tax (expense) benefit for other than temporary impairment loss (OTTI) on investments in available-for-sale and held-to-maturity debt securities, recognized in other comprehensive loss.

unclassified.label: Participating Securities, Distributed and Undistributed Earnings (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Participating Securities, Distributed and Undistributed Earnings (Loss), Diluted
unclassified.description: Amount of earnings (loss) distributed and earnings (loss) allocated to participating securities for the diluted earnings (loss) per share or per unit calculation under the two-class method.

unclassified.label: Partners' Capital
unclassified.description: The amount of ownership interest of different classes of partners in limited partnership.

unclassified.label: Partners' Capital Account, Private Placement of Units
unclassified.description: Monetary value of the issuance of new units of limited partnership interest in a private placement.

unclassified.label: Partners' Capital Account, Public Sale of Units
unclassified.description: Monetary value of the issuance of new units of limited partnership interest in a public offering.

unclassified.label: Partners' Capital Account, Public Sale of Units Net of Offering Costs
unclassified.description: Amount, after offering cost, from issuance of new unit of limited partnership interest in public offering.

unclassified.label: Partners' Capital Account, Return of Capital
unclassified.description: Total change in each class of partners' capital accounts during the year due to the return of partner's capital. That is, excess distributions over earnings to partners. All partners include general, limited and preferred partners.

unclassified.label: Partners' Capital Account, Units, Acquisitions
unclassified.description: Change in the number of units for each class of partners' capital accounts during the year due to acquisitions. Partners include general, limited and preferred partners.

unclassified.label: Partners' Capital Account, Units, Sold in Private Placement
unclassified.description: The number of units sold in a private placement of each class of partners' capital account. Units represent shares of ownership of the general, limited, and preferred partners.

unclassified.label: Partners' Capital Account, Units, Sold in Public Offering
unclassified.description: The number of units sold in a public offering of each class of partners' capital account. Units represent shares of ownership of the general, limited, and preferred partners.

unclassified.label: Partners' Capital Account, Units, Treasury Units Purchased
unclassified.description: Units that were previously issued and have been repurchased during the year.

unclassified.label: Partners' Capital Account, Units, Treasury Units Reissued
unclassified.description: Units that were previously issued and then were repurchased and classified as treasury units. This element represents the number of these units which were reissued during the period.

unclassified.label: Partners' Capital Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
unclassified.description: Total of all Partners' Capital (deficit) items which is directly or indirectly attributable to that ownership interest in subsidiary equity which is not attributable to the parent (noncontrolling interest, minority interest).

unclassified.label: Partners' Capital, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
unclassified.description: Amount of partners' capital (deficit), including portions attributable to both the parent and noncontrolling interests. Excludes temporary equity and is sometimes called permanent equity.

unclassified.label: PayableInvestmentPurchase
unclassified.description: Amount of payable for purchase of investment.

unclassified.label: Payment for Contingent Consideration Liability, Operating Activities
unclassified.description: Amount of cash outflow, not made soon after acquisition date of business combination, to settle contingent consideration liability exceeding amount recognized at acquisition date. Includes, but is not limited to, measurement period adjustment and less amount paid soon after acquisition date.

unclassified.label: Payments for Affordable Housing Programs
unclassified.description: Amount of cash outflow for payment made by Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) for Affordable Housing Program (AHP) assessment required by Federal Home Loan Bank Act of 1932.

unclassified.label: Payments for Deposits Applied to Debt Retirements
unclassified.description: Cash outflow during the period as a deposit on account for application (deposits to retire or pay down) against an amount of debt owed by the entity.

unclassified.label: Payments for Hedge, Financing Activities
unclassified.description: The cash outflow for a financial contract that meets the hedge criteria as either cash flow hedge, fair value hedge or hedge of net investment in foreign operations.

unclassified.label: Payments for Investment in Restricted Cash from Pollution Control Bond
unclassified.description: The cash outflow for investments in restricted cash from pollution control bond, which is a debt security issued by a state, certain agencies or authorities, a local government, or development corporation to finance the construction of air- or water-pollution control facilities or sewage or solid waste disposal facilities pursuant to federal law. The bonds are backed by the credit of the beneficiary of the financing rather than the credit of the issuer.

unclassified.label: Payments for Leasing Costs
unclassified.description: Amount of cash outflow for initial direct cost of lease incurred by lessor, classified as investing activity.

unclassified.label: Payments for Merger Related Costs
unclassified.description: The amount of cash paid during the reporting period for charges associated with the mergers.

unclassified.label: Payments for Operating Activities
unclassified.description: Total amount of cash paid for operating activities during the current period.

unclassified.label: Payments for Origination and Purchases of Loans Held-for-sale
unclassified.description: The aggregate amount of cash outflow for loans purchased and created with the intention to resell them in the near future.

unclassified.label: Payments for Other Operating Activities
unclassified.description: Amount of cash outflow for operating activity, classified as other.

unclassified.label: Payments for Other Taxes
unclassified.description: Amount of cash outflow for taxes classified as other.

unclassified.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Deposit on Loan
unclassified.description: The net cash inflow or outflow from resulting from payment, receipt or drawdown of cash deposit to guarantee a loan during the period.

unclassified.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Hedge, Financing Activities
unclassified.description: The net cash outflow or inflow for a financial contract that meets the hedge criteria as either cash flow hedge, fair value hedge or hedge of net investment in foreign operations.

unclassified.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Other Deposits
unclassified.description: Amount of cash (inflow) outflow from deposits classified as other.

unclassified.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Previous Acquisition
unclassified.description: The net cash inflow or outflow associated with the aggregate amount of adjustment to the purchase price of a previous acquisition.

unclassified.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Real Estate Partnership Investment, Net
unclassified.description: The net cash inflow or outflow from the sale or purchase of and distributions from real estate partnership investment during the period.

unclassified.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Short-term Investments
unclassified.description: The net amount paid (received) by the reporting entity through acquisition or sale and maturities of short-term investments with an original maturity that is three months or less which qualify for treatment as an investing activity based on management's intention and intended by management to be liquidated, if necessary, within the current operating cycle. Includes cash flows from securities classified as trading securities that were acquired for reasons other than sale in the short-term.

unclassified.label: Payments for Purchase of Other Assets
unclassified.description: Amount of cash paid to purchase other assets as part of operating activities.

unclassified.label: Payments for Royalties
unclassified.description: The amount of cash paid for royalties during the current period.

unclassified.label: Payments to Acquire Available-for-sale Securities, Equity
PaymentsToAcquireEquitySecuritiesFvNi
unclassified.description: Amount of cash outflow to acquire investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI), classified as investing activity.

unclassified.label: Payments to Acquire Federal Home Loan Bank Stock
unclassified.description: Amount of cash outflow to acquire Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLB) stock.

unclassified.label: Payments to Acquire Lease Receivables
unclassified.description: The cash outflow for the purchase of receivables arising from the lease of real estate, equipment or other fixed assets for a specified time in exchange for payment, usually in the form of rent.

unclassified.label: Payments to Acquire Leases Held-for-investment
unclassified.description: The cash outflow associated with purchasing leases held for investment purposes during an accounting period.

unclassified.label: Payment to Acquire Life Insurance Policy, Investing Activities
unclassified.description: Amount of cash outflow for payment of premium on corporate-owned life insurance policy, classified as investing activities. Includes, but is not limited to, bank-owned life insurance policy.

unclassified.label: Payments to Acquire Limited Partnership Interests
unclassified.description: Cash outflow related to the acquisition or continued holding of limited partnership interests held for investment purposes.

unclassified.label: Payments to Acquire Loans Held-for-investment
unclassified.description: The cash outflow associated with purchasing loans held for investment purposes during the period.

unclassified.label: Payments to Acquire Machinery and Equipment
unclassified.description: The cash outflow for acquisition of machinery and equipment.

unclassified.label: Payments to Acquire Mining Assets
unclassified.description: The cash outflow from the purchase of mining and mining related assets during the period.

unclassified.label: Payments to Acquire Oil and Gas Property and Equipment
unclassified.description: The cash outflow to purchase long lived physical asset for use in the normal oil and gas operations and to purchase mineral interests in oil and gas properties not intended for resale.

unclassified.label: Payments to Acquire Other Loans and Leases Held-for-investment
unclassified.description: Amount of cash outflow from purchases of loans and leases held-for-investment classified as other.

unclassified.label: Payments to Acquire Partners Interest in Real Estate Partnership, Net of Cash Acquired
unclassified.description: The cash outflow from the purchase of ownership in a partnership, the purpose of which is to construct, sell, hold or invest in real estate.

unclassified.label: Payments to Acquire Real Estate
unclassified.description: The cash outflow from the acquisition of a piece of land, anything permanently fixed to it, including buildings, structures on it and so forth; includes real estate intended to generate income for the owner; excludes real estate acquired for use by the owner.

unclassified.label: Payments to Acquire Restricted Certificates of Deposit
unclassified.description: The cash outflow from temporary investment with specific maturity and interest rate that are prohibited for current use.

unclassified.label: Payments to Acquire Restricted Investments
unclassified.description: The cash outflow to acquire investments (not to include restricted cash) that are pledged or subject to withdrawal restrictions.

unclassified.label: Payments to Fund Long-term Loans to Related Parties
unclassified.description: The cash outflow associated with extending a long-term loan to a related party. Alternate caption: Payments for Advances to Affiliates.

unclassified.label: Liability, Pension and Other Postretirement and Postemployment Benefits, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for pension, other postretirement and postemployment benefits, classified as noncurrent.

unclassified.label: Pension Cost (Reversal of Cost)
unclassified.description: Amount of cost (reversal of cost) for pension benefits. Excludes other postretirement benefits.

unclassified.label: Pledged Assets Separately Reported, Other Assets Pledged as Collateral, at Fair Value
Pledged Assets Separately Reported, Securities Pledged under Letter of Credit Facilities, at Fair Value
Policyholder Benefits and Claims Incurred, Net, Health
unclassified.description: Amount, after effect of policies assumed or ceded, of expense related to provision for policy benefits and costs incurred for health insurance contracts.

unclassified.label: Policyholder Benefits and Claims Incurred, Net
unclassified.description: Amount, after effects of policies assumed or ceded, of expense related to the provision for policy benefits and costs incurred.

unclassified.label: Preferred Stock, Accretion of Redemption Discount
unclassified.description: The amount of accretion of the preferred stock redemption discount during the period.
