unclassified.label: Preferred Stock, Amount of Preferred Dividends in Arrears
unclassified.description: Aggregate amount of cumulative preferred dividends in arrears.

unclassified.label: Preferred Stock, Dividend Rate, Per-Dollar-Amount
unclassified.description: The amount per share used to calculated dividend payments on preferred stock.

unclassified.label: Preferred Stock, Dividends, Per Share, Cash Paid
unclassified.description: Aggregate dividends paid during the period for each share of preferred stock outstanding.

unclassified.label: Preferred Stock, Redemption Amount
unclassified.description: The redemption (or callable) amount of currently redeemable preferred stock. Includes amounts representing dividends not currently declared or paid but which will be payable under the redemption features or for which ultimate payment is solely within the control of the issuer.

unclassified.label: Preferred Stock, Redemption Amount, Future Redeemable Securities
unclassified.description: The redemption (or callable) amount of redeemable preferred stock, excluding currently redeemable preferred stock. Includes amounts representing dividends not declared or paid but which will be payable under the redemption features or for which ultimate payment is solely within the control of the issuer.

unclassified.label: Preferred Units, Issued
unclassified.description: The number of preferred units issued.

unclassified.label: Preferred Units, Outstanding
unclassified.description: The number of preferred units outstanding.

unclassified.label: Preferred Units, Preferred Partners' Capital Accounts
unclassified.description: The amount of the preferred partners' ownership interests.

unclassified.label: Prepaid Expense
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of expenditures made in advance of when the economic benefit of the cost will be realized, and which will be expensed in future periods with the passage of time or when a triggering event occurs.

unclassified.label: Prepaid Expense Other, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of amounts paid in advance which will be charged against earnings in periods after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Prepaid Interest
unclassified.description: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for interest that provides economic benefits within a future period of one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Prepaid Mineral Royalties, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of capitalized amounts paid for mineral royalties which will be charged against earnings after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Prescription Drug Benefit, Effect of Subsidy on Net Periodic Postretirement Benefit Cost (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Prescription Drug Benefit, Net Periodic Postretirement Benefit Cost, (Increase) Decrease for Subsidy
unclassified.description: Amount of (increase) decrease in net periodic benefit cost from government subsidy for prescription drug benefits.

unclassified.label: Prescription Drug Benefit, Reduction in Accumulated Postretirement Benefit Obligation for Subsidy (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Prescription Drug Subsidy Receipt, after Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of prescription drug subsidy receipt expected after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Prescription Drug Subsidy Receipts, Five Fiscal Years Thereafter (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Prescription Drug Subsidy Receipts, Year Five (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Prescription Drug Subsidy Receipt, Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of prescription drug subsidy receipt expected in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Prescription Drug Subsidy Receipts, Year Four (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Prescription Drug Subsidy Receipt, Year Four
unclassified.description: Amount of prescription drug subsidy receipt expected in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Prescription Drug Subsidy Receipts, Year Three (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Prescription Drug Subsidy Receipt, Year Three
unclassified.description: Amount of prescription drug subsidy receipt expected in third fiscal year following current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Prescription Drug Subsidy Receipt, Year Two
unclassified.description: Amount of prescription drug subsidy receipt expected in second fiscal year following current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Amortization Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization expense (reversal of expense) for present value of future profits of insurance contract acquired in business combination.

unclassified.label: Present Value of Future Minimum Lease Payments, Sale Leaseback Transactions
unclassified.description: Present value of minimum lease payments for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing.

unclassified.label: Previously Estimated Development Costs Incurred During Period (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
Price Risk Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments Asset, at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all price risk derivative assets not designated as hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Price Risk Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments Liability, at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all price risk derivative liabilities not designated as hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Principal Amount Outstanding on Loans Held-for-sale or Securitization or Asset-backed Financing Arrangement
unclassified.description: This is the principal amount outstanding for loans which are in the process of being securitized as of the date of the statement of financial position (across all types of loans).

unclassified.label: Proceeds and Excess Tax Benefit from Share-based Compensation
Proceeds from Accounts Receivable Securitization
unclassified.description: Proceeds from securitizations of receivables treated as collateralized borrowings, which are classified as financing transactions.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Collection of Retained Interest in Securitized Receivables
unclassified.description: Amount of cash inflow from collection on beneficial interest in securitization of receivables.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Construction Loans Payable
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from borrowings to finance the cost of construction.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Customers
unclassified.description: Cash receipts from customers during the current period which are usually for sales of goods and services.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Deposits from Customers
unclassified.description: Cash received from customers for deposits on goods or services during the period; excludes deposits with other institutions and time deposits, which pertain to financial services entities.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Distribution of Restricted Cash from Pollution Control Bond
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from amounts received from distributions of restricted cash from pollution control bond, which is a debt security issued by a state, certain agencies or authorities, a local government, or development corporation to finance the construction of air- or water-pollution control facilities or sewage or solid waste disposal facilities pursuant to federal law. The bonds are backed by the credit of the beneficiary of the financing rather than the credit of the issuer.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Grantors
unclassified.description: Cash received from grantors during the current period related to operating activities. This element represents receipts from a guarantor for the amount of guarantee provided.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Convertible Preferred Stock
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from issuance of preferred stocks identified as being convertible into another form of financial instrument, typically the entity's common stock.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Issuance of First Mortgage Bond
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from amounts received from a long-term debt instrument secured by a first mortgage deed of trust, containing a pledge of real property. The lender has the highest claim on the property in case of default.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Redeemable Preferred Stock
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from issuance of preferred stock that is classified as callable.

unclassified.label: Proceeds, Issuance of Shares, Share-based Payment Arrangement, Excluding Option Exercised
unclassified.description: Amount of cash inflow from issuance of shares under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes option exercised.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Trust Preferred Securities
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from issuance of preferred stocks by a business trust or other special purpose entity, mainly established by a bank holding entity, to third party investors. The trust's assets are deeply subordinated debentures of the bank holding entity. Most trust preferred securities are subject to a mandatory redemption upon the repayment of the debentures.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Loans
unclassified.description: Cash received from principal payments made on loans related to operating activities.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Maturities, Prepayments and Calls of Other Investments
unclassified.description: The cash inflow associated with the maturity (principal being due), prepayment and call (request of early payment) of other investments not otherwise defined in the taxonomy.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Maturities, Prepayments and Calls of Short-term Investments
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from maturities, prepayments, calls and collections of all investments, including securities and other assets, having ready marketability and intended by management to be liquidated, if necessary, within the current operating cycle. Includes cash flows from securities classified as trading securities that were acquired for reasons other than sale in the short-term.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Other Deposits
unclassified.description: Amount of cash inflow for receipts of deposits classified as other.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Other Operating Activities
unclassified.description: Amount of cash inflow from operating activity, classified as other.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Pollution Control Bond
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from amounts received from a long-term debt security issued by a state, certain agencies or authorities, a local government, or development corporation to finance the construction of air- or water-pollution control facilities or sewage or solid waste disposal facilities pursuant to federal law. The bonds are backed by the credit of the beneficiary of the financing rather than the credit of the issuer.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Previous Acquisition
unclassified.description: Cash inflow representing an adjustment to the purchase price of a previous acquisition.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Rents Received
unclassified.description: Cash received for rents during the current period.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Repayment of Loans by Employee Stock Ownership Plans
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from the financed defined contribution plan to acquire shares of the entity. The plan initially holds the shares in a suspense account, which is collateral for the loan. As the plan makes payment on the debt, the shares are released from the suspense account and become available to be allocated to participant accounts.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Accounts Receivable Securitization
unclassified.description: Proceeds from (repayments of) securitizations of receivables treated as collateralized borrowings, which are classified as financing transactions.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Notes Payable
unclassified.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from long-term debt supported by a written promise to pay an obligation.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Pollution Control Bond
unclassified.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from a long-term debt instrument issued by a state, certain agencies or authorities, a local government, or development corporation to finance the construction of air- or water-pollution control facilities, sewage, or solid waste disposal facilities.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Restricted Cash, Financing Activities
Proceeds from (Repayments of) Secured Debt
unclassified.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from long-term debt wholly or partially secured by collateral. Excludes tax exempt secured debt.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Short-term Debt, Maturing in More than Three Months
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from a borrowing net of the cash outflow from repayment of a borrowing having initial term of repayment of more than three months but less than one year or one operating cycle (if the normal cycle is more than one year).

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale and Maturity of Held-to-maturity Securities
unclassified.description: Amount of cash inflow from the sale or maturity of long-term held-to-maturity securities.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale, Maturity and Collection of Long-term Investments
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from sales, maturities, prepayments, calls and collections of all investments, including securities and other assets, having ready marketability and intended by management to be liquidated, if necessary, beyond the current operating cycle.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale of Available-for-sale Securities, Equity
ProceedsFromSaleOfEquitySecuritiesFvNi
unclassified.description: Amount of cash inflow from sale of investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI), classified as investing activity.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale of Federal Home Loan Bank Stock
unclassified.description: Amount of cash inflow from sale of Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLB) stock.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale of Finance Receivables
unclassified.description: The cash inflow associated with the sale of receivables arising from the financing of goods and services.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale of Investment Projects
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from the sale of investment projects held by an entity in hopes of getting a future return or interest from it.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale of Land Held-for-investment
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from the sale of land held for investment; excludes sales of land held as inventory or productive use.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale of Lease Receivables
unclassified.description: The cash inflow associated with the sale of receivables arising from the lease of real estate, equipment or other fixed assets for a specified time in exchange for payment, usually in the form of rent; excludes proceeds from sales-type lease transactions, which are classified as operating activities.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale of Loans Held-for-sale
unclassified.description: The cash inflow resulting from the sale of loans classified as held-for-sale, including proceeds from loans sold through mortgage securitization.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale of Loans Receivable
unclassified.description: The cash inflow associated with the sale of loans receivables arising from the financing of goods and services.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale of Other Real Estate
unclassified.description: The cash inflow associated with the sale of other real estate not otherwise defined in the taxonomy.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale of Other Receivables
unclassified.description: Amount of cash inflow from the sale of receivables classified as other.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale of Restricted Investments
unclassified.description: The cash inflow associated with the sale of investments that are pledged or subject to withdrawal restrictions during the period.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale of Debt and Equity Securities, FV-NI, Held-for-investment
unclassified.description: The cash inflow associated with the sale of securities classified as trading securities and held for investment purposes. Excludes proceeds from trading securities purchased and held principally for the purpose of selling them in the near term (thus held for only a short period of time).

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale of Wholly Owned Real Estate and Real Estate Acquired in Settlement of Loans
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from proceeds From Sales of Wholly Owned Real Estate and Real Estate Acquired in Settlement of Loans.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Stock Plans
unclassified.description: The cash inflow associated with the amount received from the stock plan during the period.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Subordinated Short-term Debt
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from an obligation which places a lender in a lien position behind debt having a higher priority of repayment (senior loan) in liquidation of the entity's assets scheduled to be repaid within one year or in the normal operating cycle of the entity, if longer.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Unsecured Lines of Credit
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from a contractual arrangement with the lender, including letter of credit, standby letter of credit and revolving credit arrangements, under which borrowings can be made up to a specific amount at any point in time with either short term or long term maturity that is uncollateralized (where debt is not backed by the pledge of collateral).

unclassified.label: Standard and Extended Product Warranty Accrual
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable for estimated claims under standard and extended warranty protection rights granted to customers.

unclassified.label: Standard and Extended Product Warranty Accrual, Additions from Business Acquisition
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in liability for standard and extended product warranty acquired in business combination.

unclassified.label: Standard and Extended Product Warranty Accrual, Decrease for Payments
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in the standard and extended product warranty accrual from payments made in cash or in kind to satisfy claims under the terms of the standard and extended product warranty.

unclassified.label: Standard and Extended Product Warranty Accrual, Increase for Warranties Issued
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in the standard and extended product warranty accrual from warranties issued.

unclassified.label: Product Warranty Expense
unclassified.description: The expense charged against earnings for the period pertaining to standard and extended warranties on the entity's goods and services granted to customers.

unclassified.label: Property, Plant, and Equipment, Owned, Net
unclassified.description: Amount, after accumulated depreciation, of long-lived, depreciable flight asset owned. Excludes right-of-use asset from finance lease for flight asset.

unclassified.label: Property Subject to or Available for Operating Lease, Net
unclassified.description: Amount, after accumulated depreciation, of lessor's underlying asset for which right to use has been conveyed to lessee under operating lease.

unclassified.label: Proved Developed and Undeveloped Reserves, Extensions, Discoveries, and Additions
Public Utilities, Amount of Allowance for Earnings on Equity Capitalized for Rate Making Purposes
unclassified.description: Discloses the amount of any allowance for earnings on shareholders' investment capitalized for rate making purposes but not for the financial statements.

unclassified.label: Public Utilities, Approved Equity Capital Structure, Percentage
unclassified.description: Percentage of public utility's approved equity to capital, including debt and equity.

unclassified.label: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Amount of Acquisition Adjustments (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Amount of Acquisition Adjustments
unclassified.description: Amount of acquisition adjustments included in property, plant and equipment (PPE) for utilities.

unclassified.label: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Amount of Acquisition Adjustments, Related Accumulated Depreciation
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) for acquisition adjustments on accumulated depreciation included in long-lived, physical assets used to produce goods and services and not intended for resale for utilities.

unclassified.label: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Amount of Construction Work in Process Included in Rate Base
unclassified.description: Discloses the amount of construction work in process that is included in the rate making process at period end.

unclassified.label: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Amount of Indirect Disallowance of Costs of Recently Completed Plants
unclassified.description: The amount of indirect disallowance of costs of a recently completed plant. When it becomes probable that part of the cost of a recently completed plant will be disallowed for rate-making purposes and a reasonable estimate of the amount of the disallowance can be made, the estimated amount of the probable disallowance is deducted from the reported cost of the plant and recognized as a loss. If part of the cost is explicitly, but indirectly, disallowed (for example, by an explicit disallowance of return on investment on a portion of the plant), an equivalent amount of cost is deducted from the reported cost of the plant and recognized as a loss.

unclassified.label: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Amount of Loss (Recovery) on Plant Abandonment
unclassified.description: Amount of loss (recovery of loss) related to a plant abandonment.

unclassified.label: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Common
unclassified.description: Period end amount of property, plant and equipment (PPE) related to regulated assets common to business units.

unclassified.label: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Equipment
unclassified.description: Period end book value of equipment owned (but not classified elsewhere) by the public utility.

unclassified.label: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Nuclear Fuel under Capital Lease (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Public Utilities, Requested Return on Equity, Percentage
unclassified.description: Percentage of public utility's requested return on equity.

unclassified.label: Purchase Commitment, Remaining Minimum Amount Committed
unclassified.description: Minimum amount to be expended to satisfy the terms of arrangements in which the entity has agreed to expend funds to procure goods or services, excluding long-term purchase commitments or unconditional purchase obligations.

unclassified.label: Purchase Options, Land
unclassified.description: Carrying amount of an option or options to acquire real property.

unclassified.label: Quarterly Financial Information, Quarterly Charges and Credits, Amount Reconciling to Previously Reported Results (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Real Estate Inventory, Capitalized Interest Costs
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of interest costs that were capitalized to properties under development during the land development and construction period of a project, and which are included in inventory.

unclassified.label: Real Estate Investment Property, at Cost
unclassified.description: Amount of real estate investment property which may include the following: (1) land available-for-sale; (2) land available-for-development; (3) investments in building and building improvements; (4) tenant allowances; (5) developments in-process; (6) rental properties; and (7) other real estate investments.

unclassified.label: Real Estate Investments, Net
unclassified.description: Amount of real estate investments, net of accumulated depreciation, which may include the following: (1) land available-for-sale; (2) land available-for-development; (3) investments in building and building improvements; (4) tenant allowances; (5) developments in-process; (6) rental properties; (7) other real estate investments; (8) real estate joint ventures; and (9) unconsolidated real estate and other joint ventures not separately presented.

unclassified.label: Real Estate Investments, Unconsolidated Real Estate and Other Joint Ventures
unclassified.description: The carrying amount of investments in unconsolidated real estate and other joint ventures not separately presented. This includes direct and indirect investments.

unclassified.label: Real Estate Tax Expense
unclassified.description: A tax based on the assessed value of real estate by the local government. The tax is usually based on the value of property (including the land).

unclassified.label: Real Estate Taxes and Insurance
unclassified.description: The aggregate total of real estate taxes and insurance expense.

unclassified.label: Realized Investment Gains (Losses)
unclassified.description: Amount of realized gain (loss) on investment.

unclassified.label: Receivable from Shareholders or Affiliates for Issuance of Capital Stock
unclassified.description: Amount due from owner or affiliate of reporting entity for issuance of shares. Includes, but is not limited to, amount due for award under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes amount due from officer or director.

unclassified.label: Recorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of recorded unconditional purchase obligation to be paid in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Recorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Year Four
unclassified.description: Amount of recorded unconditional purchase obligation to be paid in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Recorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Remainder of Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount of recorded unconditional purchase obligation to be paid in remainder of current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Recorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Year Two
unclassified.description: Amount of recorded unconditional purchase obligation to be paid in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Recorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Year Three
unclassified.description: Amount of recorded unconditional purchase obligation to be paid in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Recovery Stranded Costs
unclassified.description: Revenue from billings to utility customers to recover what are also referred to as stranded assets or stranded investments. These are assets that formerly regulated utilities with monopolies on local service are allowed to recover during their transition to deregulated suppliers in competitive markets. Essentially, these investments are sunk costs, made by utilities under the old regulated system, which might not be recovered in a truly competitive marketplace. However, since they were valid investments at the time, the utilities are allowed to recover these costs from customers (for example, an investment in electrical generation assets that may not be recouped if customers are now allowed to purchase electricity from another utility).

unclassified.label: Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest, Equity, Other, Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of noncontrolling interests which are redeemable by the parent entity and classified as other equity.

unclassified.label: Refundable Gas Costs
unclassified.description: Gas costs of a regulated entity that are refundable through future rate adjustments. Such costs are a form of a regulatory liabilities and are expected to be refunded in less than one year through rate adjustments.

unclassified.label: Regulated Operating Revenue, Steam
unclassified.description: The amount of regulated steam operating revenues recognized during the period.

unclassified.label: Regulated Operating Revenue, Water
unclassified.description: The amount of regulated water operating revenues recognized during the period.

unclassified.label: Related Parties Amount in Cost of Sales
unclassified.description: Amount included in cost of sales related to transactions with related parties incurred and recorded in the statement of operations for the period.

unclassified.label: Related Party Tax Expense, Due to Affiliates, Current
unclassified.description: The amount of any current tax-related balances due to affiliates as of the date of each statement of financial position presented.

unclassified.label: Related Party Transaction, Purchases from Related Party
unclassified.description: Purchases during the period (excluding transactions that are eliminated in consolidated or combined financial statements) with related party.

unclassified.label: Related Party Transaction, Rate
unclassified.description: Identify the stated interest rate per the agreement, for example, leasing and debt arrangements between related parties.

unclassified.label: Related Party Transaction, Revenues from Transactions with Related Party (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Related Party Transaction, Selling, General and Administrative Expenses from Transactions with Related Party
Reorganization Value
unclassified.description: Amount attributed to the reconstituted entity, as well as the expected net realizable value of those assets that will be disposed before reconstitution occurs.

unclassified.label: Repayments of Advances for Construction
unclassified.description: Amount of cash outflow for repayment of advance for construction, classified as investing activity. Includes, but is not limited to, payment to developer, builder, government agency, and municipality for borrowing received in construction.

unclassified.label: Repayments of Construction Loans Payable
unclassified.description: The cash outflow from repayment of borrowings to finance the cost of construction.

unclassified.label: Repayments of First Mortgage Bond
unclassified.description: The cash outflow from the repayment of a long-term debt instrument issued, secured by a first mortgage deed of trust, containing a pledge of real property. The lender has the highest claim on the property in case of default.

unclassified.label: Repayments of Medium-term Notes
unclassified.description: The cash outflow to pay off borrowing used to receive debt funding on a regular basis with maturities ranging from 5-10 years.

unclassified.label: Repayments of Subordinated Debt
unclassified.description: The cash outflow from the repayment of long-term borrowing where a lender is placed in a lien position behind debt having a higher priority of repayment (senior) in case of liquidation of the entity's assets or underlying collateral.

unclassified.label: Repayments of Subordinated Short-term Debt
unclassified.description: The cash outflow for an obligation which places a lender in a lien position behind debt having a higher priority of repayment (senior loan) in liquidation of the entity's assets scheduled to be repaid within one year or in the normal operating cycle of the entity, if longer.

unclassified.label: Replacement Reserve Escrow
unclassified.description: This element represents those amounts set aside for the repair and replacement of real or personal property in the foreseen future. Such amount may be funded from sales revenue (for example; timeshare sales) or operating revenues; in a lump sum or installments (such as monthly); as per internal policy (for example: hotel operators), as required by contractual agreement (for example: sales contract); or by the terms of debt agreements.

unclassified.label: Research and Development Arrangement with Federal Government, Customer Funding to Offset Costs Incurred
unclassified.description: The amount of customer funding recorded as an offset to costs incurred for a fixed-price, best-efforts research and development cost-sharing arrangement with the Federal Government.

unclassified.label: Research and Development Expense (Excluding Acquired in Process Cost)
unclassified.description: Amount of expense for research and development. Excludes cost for computer software product to be sold, leased, or otherwise marketed, writeoff of research and development assets acquired in transaction other than business combination or joint venture formation or both, and write-down of intangible asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, used in research and development activity.

unclassified.label: Residual Value of Leased Asset
unclassified.description: Amount of residual asset covered by residual value guarantee. Excludes guarantee considered to be lease payments for lessor.

unclassified.label: Restatement of Prior Year Income, Tax Effects (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Restricted Cash and Investments
unclassified.description: Cash and investments whose use in whole or in part is restricted for the long-term, generally by contractual agreements or regulatory requirements. For use in an unclassified balance sheet.

unclassified.label: Restricted Cash Equivalents
unclassified.description: Amount of cash equivalent restricted as to withdrawal or usage. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

unclassified.label: Restricted Cash Equivalents, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount of cash equivalent restricted as to withdrawal or usage, classified as noncurrent. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

unclassified.label: Restricted Stock Award, Forfeitures, Dividends
unclassified.description: The value of dividends forfeited related to restricted stock awards forfeited.

unclassified.label: Restricted Stock or Unit Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of noncash expense for award of restricted stock or unit under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Restricted Stock, Shares Issued Net of Shares for Tax Withholdings
unclassified.description: Number, after shares used to satisfy grantee's tax withholding obligation for award under share-based payment arrangement, of restricted shares issued. Excludes cash used to satisfy grantee's tax withholding obligation.

unclassified.label: Restricted Stock, Value, Shares Issued Net of Tax Withholdings
unclassified.description: Value, after value of shares used to satisfy grantee's tax withholding obligation for award under share-based payment arrangement, of restricted shares issued. Excludes cash used to satisfy grantee's tax withholding obligation.

unclassified.label: Restructuring and Related Cost, Cost Incurred to Date (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Restructuring and Related Cost, Cost Incurred to Date
unclassified.description: Amount of costs incurred to date for the specified restructuring cost.

unclassified.label: Restructuring and Related Cost, Expected Cost
unclassified.description: Amount expected to be recognized in earnings for the specified restructuring cost.

unclassified.label: Restructuring Costs and Asset Impairment Charges
unclassified.description: Amount, after cash payment, of expenses associated with exit or disposal activities pursuant to an authorized plan and expenses resulting from the write-down of assets. Excludes expenses related to a business combination, a discontinued operation or an asset retirement obligation.

unclassified.label: Restructuring Reserve, Current
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of known and estimated obligations associated with exit from or disposal of business activities or restructurings pursuant to a duly authorized plan, which are expected to be paid in the next twelve months or in the normal operating cycle if longer. Costs of such activities include those for one-time termination benefits, termination of an operating lease or other contract, consolidating or closing facilities, relocating employees, and costs associated with an ongoing benefit arrangement, but excludes costs associated with the retirement of a long-lived asset.

unclassified.label: Restructuring Reserve, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of known and estimated costs associated with exit from or disposal of business activities or restructurings pursuant to a duly authorized plan, which are expected to be paid after one year or beyond the next operating cycle, if longer. Costs of such activities include those for one-time termination benefits, termination of an operating lease or other contract, consolidating or closing facilities, and relocating employees, and costs associated with an ongoing benefit arrangement, but excludes costs associated with the retirement of a long-lived asset.

unclassified.label: Results of Operations, Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization, and Valuation Provisions
unclassified.description: Amount of depreciation, depletion, amortization, and valuation provision charged to expense in oil- and gas-producing activities.

unclassified.label: Results of Operations, Dry Hole Costs
unclassified.description: Amount of dry hole cost charged to expense in oil- and gas-producing activities.

unclassified.label: Results of Operations, Expense from Oil and Gas Producing Activities
unclassified.description: Amount of cost charged to expense in oil- and gas-producing activities. Excludes general corporate overhead and interest cost.

unclassified.label: Results of Operations, Impairment of Oil and Gas Properties
unclassified.description: Amount of impairment for oil and gas properties charged to expense in oil- and gas-producing activities.

unclassified.label: Results of Operations, Income before Income Taxes
unclassified.description: Amount, before income tax expense (benefit), of result of operation in oil- and gas-producing activities. Excludes corporate overhead and interest costs.

unclassified.label: Results of Operations, Income Tax Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of income tax expense (benefit) in oil- and gas-producing activities.

unclassified.label: Results of Operations, Oil and Gas Producing Activities Net Income (Excluding Corporate Overhead and Interest Costs)
unclassified.description: Amount, after income tax expense (benefit), of result of operation in oil- and gas-producing activities. Excludes corporate overhead and interest costs.

unclassified.label: Results of Operations, Production or Lifting Costs
unclassified.description: Amount of production (lifting) cost charged to expense in oil- and gas-producing activities. Includes, but is not limited to, depreciation of support equipment and facility, cost of labor, material, supply, and fuel consumed and service utilized to operate oil and gas well, its equipment and facility, cost of repair and maintenance, property tax and insurance for proved property, well, and equipment and facility, and severance tax.

unclassified.label: Results of Operations, Revenue from Oil and Gas Producing Activities
unclassified.description: Amount of revenue in oil- and gas-producing activities. Excludes royalty payment and net profit disbursement.

unclassified.label: Retained Earnings, Cumulative Effect of Change in Accounting Principle, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Royalty Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of expense related to royalty payments under a contractual arrangement such as payment for mineral and drilling rights and use of technology or intellectual property.

unclassified.label: Royalty Guarantees, Commitments, Amount
unclassified.description: The amount the entity has committed to make for future royalty guarantees.

unclassified.label: Salary and Wage, Excluding Cost of Good and Service Sold
unclassified.description: Amount of expense for salary and wage arising from service rendered by nonofficer and officer employees. Excludes allocated cost, labor-related nonsalary expense, and direct and overhead labor cost included in cost of good and service sold.

unclassified.label: Sale Leaseback Transaction, Accumulated Depreciation
unclassified.description: The accumulated depreciation and amortization related to the asset(s) sold in connection with the property sold to another party and leased back to the seller.

unclassified.label: Sale Leaseback Transaction, Current Period Gain Recognized
unclassified.description: The portion of the deferred gain that was recognized in the current period.

unclassified.label: Sale Leaseback Transaction, Deferred Gain, Net
unclassified.description: The portion of the gain that will be recorded as income or a reduction in rent expense in future periods less amounts recognized in the current period.

unclassified.label: Sale Leaseback Transaction, Gross Proceeds, Financing Activities
unclassified.description: Amount of cash inflow before closing and debt issuance costs received by a seller-lessee in a sale-leaseback recognized in financing activities.

unclassified.label: Sale Leaseback Transaction, Net Proceeds, Financing Activities
unclassified.description: Amount of cash inflow after closing and debt issuance costs received by a seller-lessee in a sale-leaseback recognized in financing activities.

unclassified.label: Sale of Stock, Percentage of Ownership before Transaction
unclassified.description: Percentage of subsidiary's or equity investee's stock owned by parent company before stock transaction.

unclassified.label: Sales and Excise Tax Payable
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of liabilities incurred through that date and payable for statutory sales and use taxes, including value added tax.

unclassified.label: Sales-type and Direct Financing Leases, Lease Receivable, Payments to be Received, Next Rolling Twelve Months
unclassified.description: Amount of undiscounted cash flows to be received by lessor for sales-type and direct financing leases in next rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

unclassified.label: Sales-type Lease, Interest Income
unclassified.description: Amount of interest income from net investment in sales-type lease.

unclassified.label: SalesTypeLeaseNetInvestmentInLeaseAfterAllowanceForCreditLoss
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of net investment in sales-type lease.

unclassified.label: Sales-type Lease, Net Investment in Lease, Allowance for Credit Loss
unclassified.description: Amount of allowance for credit loss on net investment in sales-type lease.

unclassified.label: Sales-type Lease, Net Investment in Lease, Purchase
unclassified.description: Amount of increase from purchase of net investment in sales-type lease.

unclassified.label: Schedule of Insured Financial Obligations with Credit Deterioration, Insured Contractual Payments Outstanding
unclassified.description: This element represents the amount of insured contractual payments outstanding on the underlying insured obligations for financial guarantee insurance contracts presented in the context of each surveillance grouping or category used by management to monitor and track potential deterioration in the credit worthiness of the insured party's ability to meet its financial obligations related to the contracts underlying financial guarantee insurance contracts the entity has issued.

unclassified.label: Secured Debt, Repurchase Agreements
unclassified.description: Carrying value, as of the balance sheet date, of securities sold under agreements to repurchase where the transferor maintains effective control over the assets, accounting for them as secured debt.

unclassified.label: Securities Borrowed, Amount Offset Against Collateral
unclassified.description: Amount, after effect of master netting arrangement and deduction of obligation to return financial collateral not offset and financial instrument subject to master netting arrangement not offset, of security borrowed from entity in exchange for collateral. Includes security borrowed not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

unclassified.label: Securities Borrowed, Collateral, Obligation to Return Cash
unclassified.description: Amount of obligation to return cash collateral under master netting arrangements that have not been offset against securities borrowed.

unclassified.label: Securities Held as Collateral, at Fair Value
unclassified.description: The carrying amount (fair value) as of the balance sheet date of securities held that had been pledged by counterparties under financing and lending arrangements, pursuant to which the entity has the right by agreement or custom to sell or re-pledge such securities.

unclassified.label: Securities Loaned
unclassified.description: Amount, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of securities loaned to entities in exchange for collateral. Includes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

unclassified.label: Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase
unclassified.description: Amount, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of funds outstanding borrowed in the form of a security repurchase agreement between the entity and another party for the sale and repurchase of identical or substantially the same securities at a date certain for a specified price. Includes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

unclassified.label: Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Asset
unclassified.description: Amount of asset associated with funds outstanding borrowed in the form of a security repurchase agreement between the entity and another party for the sale and repurchase of identical or substantially the same securities at a date certain for a specified price.

unclassified.label: Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Collateral, Right to Reclaim Cash
unclassified.description: Amount of right to receive cash collateral under master netting arrangements that have not been offset against securities sold under agreement to repurchase.

unclassified.label: Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount, before effects of master netting arrangements, of funds outstanding borrowed in the form of a security repurchase agreement between the entity and another party for the sale and repurchase of identical or substantially the same securities at a date certain for a specified price. Includes liabilities elected not to be offset. Excludes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement.

unclassified.label: Securitization or Asset-backed Financing Arrangement, Financial Asset for which Transfer is Accounted as Sale, Gain (Loss) on Sale
unclassified.description: Reflects, by transferred financial asset type, the amount of sales proceeds in excess of or deficient from the sum of the carrying amounts of transferred financial assets plus transaction costs, including those transactions in which the seller/transferor has continuing involvement with the financial assets that have been transferred.

unclassified.label: Segment Reporting Information, Interest Income (Expense), Net (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Segment Reporting Information, Other Noninterest Expense (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Self Insurance Reserve
unclassified.description: Carrying amount (including both current and noncurrent portions) of accrued known and estimated losses incurred as of the balance sheet date for which no insurance coverage exists, and for which a claim has been made or is probable of being asserted, typically arising from workmen's compensation-type of incidents and personal injury to nonemployees from accidents on the entity's property.

unclassified.label: Senior Notes, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of Notes with the highest claim on the assets of the issuer in case of bankruptcy or liquidation (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer), excluding current portion. Senior note holders are paid off in full before any payments are made to junior note holders.

unclassified.label: Settlement Liabilities, Current
unclassified.description: Amounts payable for money transfers, money orders, and consumer payment service arrangements. Settlement liabilities include amounts payable to intermediaries for global payment transfers.

unclassified.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Accelerated Cost
unclassified.description: Amount of additional cost recognized for award under share-based payment arrangement from occurrence of event accelerating recognition of cost.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Discount from Market Price, Purchase Date
unclassified.description: Discount rate from fair value on purchase date that participants pay for shares.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Forfeited in Period, Weighted Average Grant Date Fair Value (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Share-based Liabilities Paid (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Non-Option Equity Instruments, Exercised
unclassified.description: Number of non-option equity instruments exercised by participants.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Non-Option Equity Instruments, Granted
unclassified.description: Net number of non-option equity instruments granted to participants.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Vested and Expected to Vest, Exercisable, Weighted Average Remaining Contractual Term (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Percentage of Outstanding Stock Maximum
unclassified.description: Maximum number of shares that may be issued in accordance with the plan as a proportion of outstanding capital stock.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation, Shares Authorized under Stock Option Plans, Exercise Price Range, Exercisable Options, Weighted Average Exercise Price (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Share-based Compensation, Shares Authorized under Stock Option Plans, Exercise Price Range, Exercisable Options, Weighted Average Remaining Contractual Term (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Share-based Goods and Nonemployee Services Transaction, Quantity of Securities Issued
unclassified.description: The number of shares or units of entity securities issued in the transaction in which equity securities were issued to pay for goods or nonemployee services.

unclassified.label: Share-based Goods and Nonemployee Services Transaction, Tax Benefit
unclassified.description: The amount of income tax expense reduction and deferred tax asset recorded in the transaction in which equity securities were issued to pay for goods or nonemployee services.

unclassified.label: ShareRepurchaseProgramExciseTax
unclassified.description: Amount of excise tax on share purchased under share repurchase plan. Includes, but is not limited to, repurchase of stock and unit of ownership.

unclassified.label: ShareRepurchaseProgramExciseTaxPayable
unclassified.description: Amount of excise tax payable on share purchased under share repurchase plan. Includes, but is not limited to, repurchase of stock and unit of ownership.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Accelerated Vesting, Number
unclassified.description: Number of shares for which recognition of cost was accelerated for award under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Award Vesting Rights, Percentage
unclassified.description: Percentage of vesting of award under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Aggregate Intrinsic Value, Outstanding
unclassified.description: Intrinsic value of outstanding award under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes share and unit options.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Nonvested Options Forfeited, Number of Shares
unclassified.description: Number of non-vested options forfeited.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation, Shares Authorized under Stock Option Plans, Exercise Price Range, Exercisable Options, Weighted Average Remaining Contractual Term (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Shares, Outstanding
unclassified.description: Number of shares issued which are neither cancelled nor held in the treasury.

unclassified.label: Financial Instruments Subject to Mandatory Redemption, Settlement Terms, Share Value, Amount, Current
unclassified.description: The amount that is required to be paid, determined under the conditions specified in the contract, if as of the reporting date, the holder of the share has exercised the right to or the shares are mandatorily redeemable within one year of the reporting date or operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Short-term Debt, Percentage Bearing Fixed Interest Rate
unclassified.description: The portion of the carrying amount of short-term borrowings outstanding as of the balance sheet date which accrues interest at a set, unchanging rate.

unclassified.label: Short-term Debt, Refinanced, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of a short-term obligation that has been excluded from current liabilities in the balance sheet because of a refinancing of the obligation.

unclassified.label: Short-term Non-bank Loans and Notes Payable
unclassified.description: Amount of borrowings from a creditor other than a bank with a maturity within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Short-term Debt, Fair Value
unclassified.description: This element represents the portion of the balance sheet assertion valued at fair value by the entity whether such amount is presented as a separate caption or as a parenthetical disclosure. Additionally, this element may be used in connection with the fair value disclosures required in the footnote disclosures to the financial statements. The element may be used in both the balance sheet and disclosure in the same submission. This item represents the amount of short-term debt existing as of the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Significant Acquisitions and Disposals, Acquisition Costs or Sale Proceeds (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
Standard Product Warranty Accrual, Additions from Business Acquisition
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in liability for standard product warranty acquired in business combination. Excludes liability for extended warranty acquired in business combination.

unclassified.label: Standardized Measure of Discounted Future Net Cash Flow of Proved Oil and Gas Reserves, Other
Standardized Measure of Discounted Future Net Cash Flow of Proved Oil and Gas Reserves, Period Increase (Decrease)
Standardized Measure of Discounted Future Net Cash Flow Relating to Proved Oil and Gas Reserves, Accretion of Discount
Stock and Warrants Issued During Period, Value, Preferred Stock and Warrants
unclassified.description: Value of preferred stock and warrants for common stock issued.

unclassified.label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Conversion of Units
unclassified.description: The number of shares issued during the period upon the conversion of units. An example of a convertible unit is an umbrella partnership real estate investment trust unit (UPREIT unit).

unclassified.label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Employee Stock Ownership Plan
unclassified.description: Number of shares of capital stock issued (purchased by employees) in connection with an employee stock ownership plan.

unclassified.label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Issued for Services
unclassified.description: Number of shares issued in lieu of cash for services contributed to the entity. Number of shares includes, but is not limited to, shares issued for services contributed by vendors and founders.

unclassified.label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Restricted Stock Award, Forfeited
unclassified.description: Number of shares related to Restricted Stock Award forfeited during the period.

unclassified.label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Restricted Stock Award, Net of Forfeitures
unclassified.description: Number of shares issued during the period related to Restricted Stock Awards, net of any shares forfeited.

unclassified.label: Shares Issued, Shares, Share-based Payment Arrangement, Forfeited
unclassified.description: Number of shares (or other type of equity) forfeited during the period.

unclassified.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Employee Stock Ownership Plan
unclassified.description: Aggregate value of stock issued during the period as a result of employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

unclassified.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Purchase of Assets
unclassified.description: Value of shares of stock issued during the period as part of a transaction to acquire assets that do not qualify as a business combination.

unclassified.label: Stock Issued, Value, Stock Options Exercised, Net of Tax Benefit (Expense)
unclassified.description: Value of stock issued as a result of the exercise of stock options, after deduction of related income tax (expense) benefit.

unclassified.label: Stock Repurchase Program, Number of Shares Authorized to be Repurchased
Stock Repurchase Program, Remaining Authorized Repurchase Amount (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Stock Repurchase Program, Remaining Number of Shares Authorized to be Repurchased
unclassified.description: Number of shares remaining authorized to be purchased under share repurchase plan. Includes, but is not limited to, repurchase of stock and unit of ownership.

unclassified.label: Stockholders' Equity, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) in stockholders' equity during the period.

unclassified.label: Storm Damage Provision
unclassified.description: A noncash adjustment to the provision established for storm damage by an oil, gas, or utility company.

unclassified.label: Subordinated Long-term Debt, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of collateralized/uncollateralized debt obligation (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer), excluding current portion. Subordinated debt places a lender in a lien position behind the primary lender of the company.

unclassified.label: Subsidiary or Equity Method Investee, Deferred Income Tax Provision on Gain (Loss) Recognized, Amount
unclassified.description: The amount provided for deferred income taxes in relation to any gain (loss) recognized in income of the entity resulting from the issuance of shares by a subsidiary or equity method investee.

unclassified.label: Supplemental Deferred Purchase Price
unclassified.description: A device of credit enhancement where a part of the purchase price for the receivable/ payable is retained to serve as a cash collateral.

unclassified.label: Supplemental Unemployment Benefits, Disability Related Benefits
unclassified.description: Liability for amount due a former employee for benefits as a result of them becoming physically or mentally impaired.

unclassified.label: Supplemental Unemployment Benefits, Severance Benefits
unclassified.description: Liability for amount due employees, in addition to wages and any other money that employers owe employees, when their employment ends through a layoff or other termination. For example, a company may provide involuntarily terminated employees with a lump sum payment equal to one week's salary for every year of employment.

unclassified.label: Supplies Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of expense associated with supplies that were used during the current accounting period.

unclassified.label: Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, Change in Tax Rate, Deferred Tax Asset, Income Tax Expense
Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, Incomplete Accounting, Change in Tax Rate, Deferred Tax Liability, Existing Income Tax Benefit (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, Incomplete Accounting, Change in Tax Rate, Deferred Tax Liability, Provisional Income Tax Benefit (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, Incomplete Accounting, Provisional Income Tax Expense (Benefit) (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Temporary Equity, Carrying Amount, Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Temporary Equity, Foreign Currency Translation Adjustments
unclassified.description: Adjustments to temporary equity resulting from foreign currency translation adjustments.

unclassified.label: Temporary Equity, Interest in Subsidiary Earnings
unclassified.description: Subsidiary earnings portion attributable to temporary equity.

unclassified.label: Temporary Equity, Carrying Amount, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Change in the value of each type or class of stock classified as temporary equity during the period. The redemption requirement does not constitute an unconditional obligation that will be settled in a variable number of shares constituting a monetary value predominantly indexed to (a) a fixed monetary amount known at inception, (b) an amount inversely correlated with the residual value of the entity, or (c) an amount determined by reference to something other than the fair value of issuer's stock. Does not include mandatorily redeemable stock. The exception is if redemption is required upon liquidation or termination of the reporting entity.

unclassified.label: Temporary Equity, Liquidation Preference
unclassified.description: The aggregate liquidation preference (or restrictions) of stock classified as temporary equity that has a preference in involuntary liquidation considerably in excess of the par or stated value of the shares. The liquidation preference is the difference between the preference in liquidation and the par or stated values of the share. Temporary equity is a security with redemption features that are outside the control of the issuer, is not classified as an asset or liability in conformity with GAAP, and is not mandatorily redeemable. Includes any type of security that is redeemable at a fixed or determinable price or on a fixed or determinable date or dates, is redeemable at the option of the holder, or has conditions for redemption which are not solely within the control of the issuer. If convertible, the issuer does not control the actions or events necessary to issue the maximum number of shares that could be required to be delivered under the conversion option if the holder exercises the option to convert the stock to another class of equity. If the security is a warrant or a rights issue, the warrant or rights issue is considered to be temporary equity if the issuer cannot demonstrate that it would be able to deliver upon the exercise of the option by the holder in all cases. Includes stock with put option held by ESOP and stock redeemable by holder only in the event of a change in control of the issuer.

unclassified.label: Time Deposit Maturities, after Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of time deposit maturing after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Time deposit includes, but is not limited to, certificate of deposit. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Time Deposit Maturities, Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of time deposit maturing in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Time deposit includes, but is not limited to, certificate of deposit. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Time Deposit Maturities, Year Four
unclassified.description: Amount of time deposit maturing in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Time deposit includes, but is not limited to, certificate of deposit. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Time Deposit Maturities, Year One
unclassified.description: Amount of time deposit maturing in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Time deposit includes, but is not limited to, certificate of deposit. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Time Deposit Maturities, Year Three
unclassified.description: Amount of time deposit maturing in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Time deposit includes, but is not limited to, certificate of deposit. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Time Deposit Maturities, Year Two
unclassified.description: Amount of time deposit maturing in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Time deposit includes, but is not limited to, certificate of deposit. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Time Deposits
unclassified.description: Amount of time deposit liabilities, including certificates of deposit.

unclassified.label: Time Deposits, $100,000 or More
unclassified.description: Amount of time deposit liabilities, including certificates of deposit, in denominations of $100,000 or more.

unclassified.label: Trading Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) resulting from the difference between the acquisition price and the selling price or fair value of trading assets and trading liabilities, conducted separately from customer trading activities. Includes, but is not limited to, changes in fair value of trading assets and trading liabilities.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Trading
unclassified.description: Amount of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Trading, Amortized Cost
unclassified.description: Amortized cost of investments in debt securities classified as trading.

unclassified.label: Transfer of Financial Assets Accounted for as Sales, Cash Proceeds Received for Assets Derecognized, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount, before counterparty netting, of cash proceeds received in transfers of derecognized financial assets from transactions which comprise an initial transfer and an agreement entered into in contemplation of the initial transfer resulting in retention of substantially all of the exposure to the economic return throughout the term of the transaction.

unclassified.label: Transfer from Investments
unclassified.description: Value of investments transferred from the entity's investments in noncash transactions.

unclassified.label: Real Estate Owned, Transfer from Real Estate Owned
unclassified.description: Value transferred out of real estate owned (REO) in noncash transactions.

unclassified.label: Transfer of Portfolio Loans and Leases to Held-for-sale
unclassified.description: Value of loans and leases held in the entity's portfolio transferred to loans and leases held-for-sale in noncash transactions.

unclassified.label: Derivatives used in Net Investment Hedge, Net of Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of cumulative translation adjustment attributable to gain (loss) on foreign currency derivatives that are designated as, and are effective as, economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity.

unclassified.label: Treasury Stock, Carrying Basis
unclassified.description: Cost basis for treasury stock acquired for purposes other than retirement.

unclassified.label: Treasury Stock, Value, Retired, Par Value Method (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
US Government Securities, at Carrying Value
unclassified.description: Debt (bills, notes or bonds) that are issued by the government of the United States which are short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Generally, only investments with original maturities of three months or less qualify under that definition. Original maturity means original maturity to the entity holding the investment. For example, both a three-month US Treasury bill and a three-year Treasury note purchased three months from maturity qualify as cash equivalents. However, a Treasury note purchased three-years ago does not become a cash equivalent when its remaining maturity is three months.

unclassified.label: Unamortized Loan Commitment and Origination Fees and Unamortized Discounts or Premiums, Commercial (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Unamortized Loan Commitment and Origination Fees and Unamortized Discounts or Premiums, Other (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Underlying, Derivative Energy Measure
unclassified.description: Specified interest rate, security price, commodity price, foreign exchange rate, index of prices or rates for a derivative contract measured in energy volume but not the derivative contract itself.

unclassified.label: Undistributed Continuing Operation Earnings (Loss), Allocation to Participating Securities, Basic
unclassified.description: Amount of undistributed earnings (loss) from continuing operations allocated to participating securities for basic earnings (loss) per share or per unit calculation under two-class method.

unclassified.label: Undistributed Discontinued Operation Earnings (Loss), Allocation to Participating Securities, Basic
unclassified.description: Amount of undistributed earnings (loss) from discontinued operations allocated to participating securities for basic earnings (loss) per share or per unit calculation under two-class method.

unclassified.label: Undistributed Earnings Allocated to Participating Securities (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Undistributed Earnings, Diluted
unclassified.description: The earnings that is allocated to common stock and participating securities to the extent that each security may share in earnings as if all of the earnings for the period had been distributed. Includes the adjustments resulting from the assumption that dilutive securities were converted, options or warrants were exercised, or that other shares were issued upon the satisfaction of certain conditions.

unclassified.label: Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Energy Contracts
unclassified.description: The net change in the difference between the fair value and the carrying value, or in the comparative fair values, of open agreements to purchase or sell energy at some future point, held at each balance sheet date, that was included in earnings for the period.

unclassified.label: Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Marketable Securities, Cost Method Investments, and Other Investments
Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, Change of Amount as Result of Variable Components
unclassified.description: Amount of change that payments under a contractual obligation might vary as facts and circumstances change.

unclassified.label: Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, Imputed Interest
unclassified.description: If disclosed, the amount of imputed interest necessary to reduce an unconditional purchase obligation to present value on an unrecorded unconditional purchase obligation.

unclassified.label: Unusual or Infrequent Item, or Both, Net (Gain) Loss
unclassified.description: Amount of (gain) loss for an event or transaction that is unusual in nature or occurs infrequently, or both.

unclassified.label: SEC Schedule, 12-09, Valuation Allowances and Reserves, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in valuation and qualifying accounts and reserves.

unclassified.label: SEC Schedule, 12-09, Valuation Allowances and Reserves, Addition, Recovery
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in valuation and qualifying accounts and reserves from recovery of amount previously written off or reestablishment of reserve previously utilized.

unclassified.label: Value Added Tax Receivable
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of value added taxes due either from customers arising from sales on credit terms, or as previously overpaid to tax authorities.

unclassified.label: Value Added Tax Receivable, Current
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of value added taxes due either from customers arising from sales on credit terms, or as previously overpaid to tax authorities. For classified balance sheets, represents the current amount receivable, that is amounts expected to be collected within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Variable Interest Entity, Consolidated, Assets, Current (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Variable Interest Entity, Consolidated, Assets, Noncurrent (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Variable Interest Entity, Consolidated, Liabilities, Current (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Variable Interest Entity, Consolidated, Liabilities, Noncurrent (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Variable Interest Entity, Financial or Other Support, Amount
unclassified.description: The amount of financial or other support the reporting entity has provided (explicitly or implicitly) to the Variable Interest Entity (VIE) that it was not previously contractually required to provide or that the reporting entity intends to provide, including, for example, situations in which the reporting entity assisted the VIE in obtaining another type of support.

unclassified.label: Variable Interest Entity, Nonconsolidated, Carrying Amount, Liabilities (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Variable Lease, Income
unclassified.description: Amount of variable lease payments from operating, direct financing, and sales-type leases, excluding amount included in measurement of lease receivable.

unclassified.label: Water Production Costs
unclassified.description: Cost incurred related to water production and may include cost of treatment plants, pumps, pipes and reservoir, purchased water, power and pump taxes as well as the cost of reducing water leakage.

unclassified.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Basic and Diluted (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Weighted Average Rate, Interest-bearing Domestic Deposits, Point in Time
unclassified.description: Weighted average interest rate calculated at point in time for domestic deposit liability.

unclassified.label: Weighted Average Rate Domestic Deposit, Certificates of Deposit
unclassified.description: The weighted average interest rate for domestic certificates of deposit liabilities.

unclassified.label: Weighted Average Rate Domestic Deposit, Checking
unclassified.description: The weighted average interest rate for domestic checking deposit liabilities.

unclassified.label: Weighted Average Rate Domestic Deposit, Money Market
unclassified.description: The weighted average interest rate for domestic money market demand account deposit liabilities.

unclassified.label: Weighted Average Rate Domestic Deposit, Savings
unclassified.description: The weighted average interest rate for domestic savings deposit liabilities.

unclassified.label: Workers' Compensation Liability, Current
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations and payables pertaining to claims incurred of a workers compensation nature. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

unclassified.label: Workers' Compensation Liability
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations and payables pertaining to claims incurred of a workers compensation nature.
